2Fbw95wE43vM7b5ZPAv8: At the speed for minimum glide angle the aircraft is exactly at (CL/CD)max. Reducing mass while holding the SAME speed reduces the lift required, so CL falls and the aircraft is no longer at the best-ratio point: CL/CD decreases. Since tan(glide angle) = CD/CL, the glide angle increases, and with speed unchanged and the path steeper, the rate of descent increases too. The correct response to lower mass is to fly SLOWER, back to the new best-glide speed.
2GKk5u7njYifcyGZiAIM: Accident investigation almost never finds a single cause: the standard picture is a chain of latent organisational conditions and active errors that had to line up. That is why the response is systemic - procedures, design, training, culture - rather than training the front-line crew harder.
2HmqvqOaHseu5HjBus28: EAS is CAS corrected for compressibility, and the compressibility correction depends on how far the air has been compressed - a function of speed and of pressure altitude. Density altitude is what converts EAS to TAS, which is the next step in the chain and not what is asked here.
2IEubOnXVujDtXU6loxz: In an unpressurised aeroplane the airflow around the fuselage lowers the cabin pressure slightly below true static, so selecting the alternate source feeds the instruments a pressure that is too low. The altimeter jumps up, and the vertical speed indicator responds to the change with a brief indication of climb before settling.
2IdV7hnxAJiVqQtIoGJH: A turbulent boundary layer mixes fast-moving air from the free stream down toward the surface, so it carries more kinetic energy close to the skin. That extra energy lets it fight an adverse pressure gradient for longer, so it separates LATER than a laminar layer, not sooner. The price is that it is thicker and gives higher skin friction drag - the trade that vortex generators deliberately accept.
2JKXqkqheuTlU2LQy7F3: A landplane operated over water beyond gliding distance from land, or more than 50 NM from the shore, must carry a life jacket for every person on board - 60 persons, 60 jackets. Life rafts are an additional requirement in their own right and never substitute for individual jackets.
2KR67hkbHWxbvQEoIvWF: Statement 2 is the standard definition of alternate fuel: missed approach at destination, climb, cruise, descent, approach and landing at the alternate. Statement 1 is false. A computer flight plan uses forecast winds and temperatures but does not decide that the weather is bad and add fuel for it; that judgement, and the extra fuel, belongs to the commander and the dispatcher.
2Kug11pbsiVqr1rcrwIm: On a short sector very little fuel is carried, so neither the take-off nor the landing mass limit bites - there is simply not enough fuel aboard to reach them. What remains is the structural limit on the aeroplane and its payload with no fuel at all, the maximum zero fuel mass.
2LMIDbA7DoyeHkGstppv: With the time equation nil the sun is over the Greenwich meridian at 1200 UTC and moves 15 degrees west per hour, so at 1840 UTC its GHA is 100 degrees, putting it over 100W. Near the North Pole with the grid aligned to the Greenwich meridian, the sun's grid bearing is GHA + 180 = 280 degrees. Against a grid heading of 315 degrees that gives a relative bearing of 280 - 315 = 325 degrees, which is the sun's bearing the crew uses to hold heading.
2Lhpmq9xGOOS1DotdXpg: ICAO Annex 11 states that the lower limit of a control area shall be established at a height not less than 200 metres (700 ft) above the ground or water. This minimum ensures a workable buffer between uncontrolled airspace near the surface and the controlled airspace above.
2NnGFCOalvQGylTfwBAr: At a constant flight level the pressure is fixed, so warmer air is less dense and the same dynamic pressure - the same CAS - is produced by a higher true airspeed. Mach number, however, is essentially unchanged, because the speed of sound rises with temperature in the same proportion as the TAS does.
2NsiqAjkCETYuk13Sx9T: TCAS knows nothing about the aircraft's weight, configuration or performance: it computes the vertical rate needed for separation from geometry alone. It is therefore the crew's responsibility to fly the RA only as far as the aeroplane's actual performance allows, and stall warning takes priority over an RA.
2NzHWgquxrU9EdbwvPnz: The light monitors the locks, not the position: it comes on whenever a reverser door is unlocked, which is exactly the condition that would matter in flight. It illuminates normally as the reversers are selected on landing and extinguishes when they are stowed and relocked.
2OUNbaxaizTd3oQVKVXB: In subsonic flow through a converging tube the mass flow must be conserved, so the air speeds up as the area reduces. Bernoulli's theorem says total pressure is constant, so the rise in dynamic pressure must be paid for by a fall in STATIC pressure. This is exactly the mechanism by which the accelerated flow over a wing's upper surface produces its suction. Note that above M1.0 the relationship reverses.
2P0ggxXMnQxKzooAabyG: The Operations Manual is the operator's document. The operator must provide flight operations personnel with the parts relevant to their duties and must issue amendments to keep those copies current. The Authority approves or accepts the manual but does not distribute it, and the manufacturer and owner have no role in it.
2PudoFZf3Yx5gyPnHmrW: A night's sleep runs through roughly 90 minute cycles, and the REM portion of each cycle gets LONGER as the night goes on - which is why cutting sleep short costs disproportionately much REM. Chronic REM deprivation damages mood, memory and learning, so both statements hold.
2QCVVugjWqsEWzf872Gd: Frontal or precipitation fog forms ahead of a warm front, where warm rain falls through the cold air below the frontal surface, evaporates into it and raises its dewpoint until it saturates. It can occur at any time of day or night because it does not depend on radiational cooling, which is what distinguishes it from radiation fog.
2QcbZS1SX3PuGRHEqquu: Under Annex 9, a carrier's obligation to transport an inadmissible person away from the territory of a Contracting State terminates once that person has been definitively admitted into another Contracting State of destination. The statement in the question stem is correct.
2S74X5nEPVzc3DMri11i: An electric tachogenerator produces its own signal and needs no supply, whereas an electronic tachometer counts pulses and has to be powered to work - so a loss of the supply takes the indication with it. Its compensating advantages are that it is insensitive to line resistance and to temperature.
2SWErVQ9PQWmGkT5OgWa: A magnetic tachometer is a drag-cup instrument: a permanent magnet driven at engine speed rotates inside a non-magnetic cup, and the eddy currents induced drag the cup round against a hairspring by an amount proportional to speed. It is simple and self-contained, needing no electrical supply.
2SbVplaVYxPk9d76SoQJ: Control wheel steering lets the pilot manoeuvre through the autopilot: moving the control wheel or column commands a new attitude, which the autopilot then holds when the control is released. It is a way of flying with the autopilot engaged rather than a way of disengaging it.
2Sn6q8lvt7MR7cY4zZ97: REM sleep gets LONGER, not shorter, with each successive cycle, so the first statement is false. Note the second statement is worded loosely: REM is generally associated with mental and psychological recovery, while deep slow-wave sleep is the stage most associated with physical restoration.
2T8t1L6mY4ORXZo0xYPu: Eastward travel is harder, because it requires the body clock to be SHORTENED, and the free-running clock naturally runs slightly long. Recovery is roughly a day per time zone westbound and rather worse eastbound, and it varies a great deal between individuals - which is why fixed crew rest rules have to be conservative.
2TUHqtlB1XJ62a55SaTX: An attitude is a learned tendency to respond to something in a consistent way, with a belief component, a feeling component and a behavioural component. Unlike personality, attitudes CAN be changed, which is the entire premise of CRM training.
2U9TskRijiSJGk1Ze5O6: Dry air is about 78 percent nitrogen, 21 percent oxygen and 0.03 percent carbon dioxide, the rest being rare gases. Note the traps: helium is not a major constituent, and carbon MONOXIDE is not a natural constituent at all - it is a contaminant, typically from exhaust gases leaking into a cabin heater.
2UNY7hEyWVkfDMA9eDVM: Perihelion, the closest approach to the sun at about 147 million km, occurs in early January; aphelion at about 152 million km occurs in early July. This is worth remembering because it is counter-intuitive for northern hemisphere students: the earth is nearest the sun during the northern winter.
2UnDu7a41on2PGFMgyus: The GPS constellation is 24 operational satellites in 6 orbital planes inclined at 55 degrees, 4 satellites per plane, at about 20 200 km with a period of roughly 12 hours. That geometry guarantees at least 4 satellites in view anywhere on earth, which is the minimum for a 3D fix plus receiver clock error.
2WLyT3xX9gTf1SZ3KR0t: Standard procedure is for the flight crew to contact departure control after take-off, typically when instructed by the tower controller. The crew does not wait until clear of the airport or until entering cloud; they switch to departure frequency as soon as they are airborne and the tower hands them off.
2WQaVH4loVlyEZULRXvt: The navigation database holds what is needed to fly a route: navaids, waypoints, airways, and the SIDs, STARs and approach procedures with their coded legs, along with runway and airport data. Obstacle data belongs to the terrain database used by EGPWS, not to the FMS navigation database.
2XGhtf4DBEPg1ylBBiDV: ICAO Annex 18 is 'The Safe Transport of Dangerous Goods by Air' - hazardous materials. Aircraft noise sits in Annex 16 (Environmental Protection), so the noise option belongs to a different Annex entirely.
2XhDPuKlt8CZPP9OjS9w: Cross-feed opens a manifold between the tank feed lines so that any engine can be supplied from any tank. Its uses are to correct a lateral imbalance and to keep an engine running when its own tank or pump has failed. Jettison and defuelling are separate systems.
2XpNdrldfPkPXEltpuwP: The wind at 275 is only 15 degrees off the nose for a track of 260, so it is almost a pure headwind. The crosswind component is 30 x sin15 = about 8 kt, giving less than 2 degrees of drift, so the heading is about 262 degrees. The headwind component is 30 x cos15 = about 29 kt, so the groundspeed is about 241 kt.
2Xu425Vj1OkMew0vMlpI: Hyperventilation means breathing beyond what the body actually needs, so anything that drives the breathing rate without a matching metabolic demand qualifies: pressure breathing, anxiety, stress and pain. Jogging is the exception - there the fast breathing IS matched to demand, so it is not hyperventilation.
2XzosGx1XG6VLAWW3sXa: An inertial reference system integrates accelerations, so it produces attitude, heading, position, ground speed, track and drift. It cannot produce angle of attack, which needs an airflow sensor, nor barometric altitude, which needs a static source - the vertical channel is unstable without external damping.
2Y06nNfSkPYlKhSYb0mc: Working back from the landing limit, the greatest mass at which the aeroplane may take off is the maximum landing mass plus the fuel that will be burnt on the way. That figure is then compared with the maximum take-off mass and with the zero fuel limit plus fuel on board, and the lowest of the three governs.
2Y58AfYpBd6iEa3bCD9J: CFMU (formerly CEU) assigns departure slots with a tolerance window of minus 5 minutes to plus 10 minutes, giving a total window of 15 minutes. The slot validity period of 15 minutes allows for normal operational variability in pushback and taxi times.
2Y7zwNjgXVdBuv448sf4: This describes ICAO Class D airspace: both IFR and VFR are permitted, IFR flights receive ATC service and are separated from other IFR flights, and all flights receive traffic information as far as is practical. Class E is different because in Class E, VFR flights do not receive guaranteed traffic information.
2YsZ8DS0KVI5EKUbt90C: Turn radius = V2 / (g tan(bank)), which contains no mass term at all - so two aircraft at the same TAS and the same bank angle fly identical radii regardless of weight. The same is true of rate of turn. What the heavier aircraft needs is more LIFT to generate the same load factor, hence a higher CL or a higher speed to sustain the turn, but the geometry of the turn itself is unchanged.
2YzlQGIGxxnnOxOPscJg: A landing aeroplane produces vortices right up to the moment its wheels touch, and none after it, so the contaminated air lies on the approach path short of the touchdown point. Departing behind it you want to be airborne BEFORE that touchdown point and climbing above the preceding aircraft's approach path. Rotating beyond the touchdown point puts you underneath and behind the vortex-laden approach path.
2Z1GzPU9ewSxdJbbMNJ3: Supplemental oxygen is the supply required by JAR-OPS for operation at cabin pressure altitudes above 10 000 ft, to protect crew and passengers against hypoxia. It is distinct from first-aid oxygen carried for individual passengers who become unwell, and from protective breathing equipment used against smoke and fumes.
2Z8huYHti68zzMWa5VAz: The induction tachometer drives a small alternator whose three-phase output feeds an asynchronous (induction) motor in the instrument; the motor turns at a speed proportional to the supply frequency and drives the pointer against a spring. The engine speed is therefore transmitted as a frequency, which is unaffected by line resistance.
2Ze4A4ABrxlFJu0PcoOS: JAR-OPS 1.320 requires flight crew members to keep their safety belt fastened whenever they are at their station - not merely for take-off and landing. Cabin crew and passengers are subject to the narrower rule tied to critical phases and to the commander's instruction.
2aGJM4YQOH0UshbgSArX: Disorientation comes from an inadequate instrument scan combined with repeatedly switching between instrument and visual references, because each switch invites the vestibular system to reassert itself. Trusting the attitude indicator and staying on instruments is the defence, not the cause.
2cTRXXFFY7hULXUQxYyc: The trade winds are the low-level flow from the subtropical high-pressure belts toward the equatorial trough, blowing from the north-east in the northern hemisphere and the south-east in the southern hemisphere. Where they meet is the ITCZ. The doldrums are the calm belt at the ITCZ itself, not a wind system, and the westerlies lie on the poleward side of the subtropical highs.
2cg7U7GUqpGj1vpxRUBT: A straight line on a Lambert chart is very nearly a great circle, and its true direction changes by the chart convergence between the two meridians. So the difference between the departure track and the arrival track equals map (chart) convergency, which is dlong x sin(parallel of origin), not earth convergency at either end.
2dBrNOXSANabBCopFZu9: Transport aircraft use phosphate-ester synthetic fluids such as Skydrol, chosen because they are fire resistant - a mineral fluid sprayed from a burst line onto a hot brake or engine would burn. They attack paint and some plastics and must never be mixed with mineral fluid, which is why colour coding matters.
2eTL9oAO2Tf3JwxGwZFx: VLO is the landing gear OPERATING speed - the maximum speed at which the gear may be moved, extended or retracted. It is distinct from VLE, the landing gear EXTENDED speed, the maximum at which the aircraft may be flown with the gear already down and locked. VLO is normally the lower of the two, because the doors and moving gear are more vulnerable in transit.
2ecigZ0OCVAh7X8gkGjN: Two limits must both be met. Take-off limit: 4200 - 2800 - 400 = 1000 kg of fuel. Landing limit: landing mass = 2800 + 400 + fuel - 300 must not exceed 3700, giving fuel of 800 kg. The lower of the two governs, so the maximum fuel load is 800 kg, and the landing mass limit is the binding one.
2el5uXx7TocfuyIMT4DC: A tropical revolving storm needs a sea surface temperature of at least about 26.5 C through a deep layer. Both the south-east Pacific and the South Atlantic are dominated by cold ocean currents (the Humboldt and Benguela) and associated upwelling, so the water never gets warm enough to supply the latent heat. Coriolis force is present at those latitudes, so its absence is not the reason.
2fSggMUY2ogELtJYvklH: Untreated high blood pressure damages arteries silently for years and is a major risk factor for heart attack and stroke. It usually produces no symptoms at all, which is why it is screened for rather than waited for, and it is normally treatable without loss of licence.
2flwEBR13htyyIxByALF: Transport wander is apparent, not real: the gyro axis stays fixed in space while the aircraft carries it across the Earth, so the local meridian rotates underneath it. It is therefore measured against TRUE north, as a function of the change of longitude and the latitude flown. Magnetic north plays no part in gyroscopic wander at all.
2fuPX99dtEDjAFz1vXG5: The polar front is the boundary between cold polar maritime or polar continental air and warm tropical maritime air, and it is the zone along which mid-latitude depressions form. The corresponding boundary further north, between arctic and polar air, is the arctic front, which is a distinct and generally weaker feature.
2gAoHvt28cNsidSruMVn: Noise-induced hearing loss destroys hair cells in the cochlea, which do not regenerate, so the loss is PERMANENT and it hits selected frequencies first, characteristically a notch around 4 kHz. Presbyacusis is the separate, age-related loss, and neither has anything to do with the Eustachian tube.
2gU00HhbaZxlrU8bS3rC: Air accelerating through the venturi throat falls in pressure, and it is that depression, acting against the atmospheric pressure in the float chamber, which drives fuel out of the main jet into the airstream. The stronger the airflow the greater the depression, so fuel flow follows air flow automatically.
2gj4U94E1F18xlg0bvf9: Passenger briefings, including the oxygen demonstration for flights that will operate above FL250, must be completed before take-off. Waiting until a particular flight level is reached would leave the cabin unbriefed during the phase in which an emergency is most likely.
2hETyPXl84ZY66IPg19h: ICAO Doc 4444 requires pilots to read back both the mode and the code when acknowledging SSR transponder setting instructions. A simple 'Roger' or 'Wilco' is insufficient because it does not confirm the actual digits set, risking a wrong squawk.
2hHvplW4dR3Mt4Wpn6Fn: A visual approach is an approach by an IFR flight when part or all of the instrument procedure is not completed and the approach is executed with visual reference to terrain. The pilot must have the aerodrome or preceding traffic in sight. Permanent sight of the movement area and underlying ground is the standard requirement.
2hT2QVGlHEJjXEzieEA8: Close to the ground a climb or descent RA could be more dangerous than the traffic it was avoiding, so TCAS uses radio height to inhibit its outputs progressively: descend RAs are inhibited around 1,000 ft, increase-descent lower still, all RAs below about 900 ft and aural warnings below about 500 ft.
2iNvsTeklHa0PyN1xTDh: ICAO Annex 6 requires that operational records including the load manifest, airworthiness release, flight release, and flight plan be retained for at least 3 months. This is shorter than the retention period for flight recorder data or maintenance records.
2ivynNznGJEGqmrGcRr0: Under JAR-FCL, a professional flight crew licence from a non-JAA State may be rendered valid by the Authority of a JAA Member State for a period not exceeding one year, provided the basic licence remains valid. This ensures the foreign licence holder maintains current qualifications.
2jzLvIg8mZ9EpN5lop2Y: Astronomic (earth-rate) precession is caused by the Earth turning beneath a gyro whose axis is fixed in space, so it is present whether the aircraft is parked or airborne. Its rate is 15 x sin(latitude) degrees per hour, which makes it strongly latitude-dependent and zero only at the equator.
2kC1mV3RDmrWzndCAZsq: Above the transition altitude, vertical position is expressed in flight levels based on the standard pressure setting of 1013.25 hPa. IFR cruising levels within controlled airspace are therefore given as flight levels only above the transition altitude, when applicable.
2ksG5YvrATvmFVs8CQzd: EPR compares the pressure at the jet pipe with the pressure at the compressor inlet, so it measures the overall pressure rise the engine is producing and is therefore a direct measure of thrust. It is used as the thrust-setting parameter on engines that are not fan-speed rated.
2l6k9qD3yQgx7zLbkJMj: ISA temperature at a flight level is 15 minus 1.98 C per 1000 ft, so at FL300 it is 15 - 59.4 = about -45 C (the tropopause and its constant -56.5 C are not reached until FL360). An air mass 15 C warmer than ISA therefore gives -45 + 15 = -30 C. Above FL360 the ISA temperature stays constant, so this arithmetic only works below the ISA tropopause.
2lMymW4BzrC8Sf32LWKJ: ICAO Doc 8168 (PANS-OPS) defines up to five segments of an instrument approach procedure: arrival, initial approach, intermediate approach, final approach, and missed approach. A holding segment may also be included, but the standard named segments are those five.
2lSjqpkicUVkwbLyaB3w: Thrust is the rate of change of momentum of the gas stream: the same mass flow leaves faster than it arrived, so T = m(Vj - Vv). Forward speed therefore reduces thrust for a given jet velocity, which is why static thrust is the highest figure an engine ever produces.
2lTzUjhmlOMd9NhEsEuk: ICAO Annex 12 specifies colour codes for droppable SAR supplies. Blue containers and streamers indicate food and water. Red is for medical supplies, yellow is for blankets and protective clothing, and black (or no colour) is for miscellaneous equipment.
2llASnhRJm6e2O0Cr3sl: Decision-making is the conscious, deliberate selection of one option from several for a defined problem. Applying a memorised procedure automatically is not decision-making but rule-based behaviour, and the distinction matters: the danger is applying a rule when the situation actually calls for a decision.
2m0DC3plmO3isa7vINfr: Stress needs no present danger at all: anticipating an outcome, or meeting a situation that merely resembles a previous bad one, is enough to trigger the full physiological response. That is why briefing and preparation reduce stress, and why an old bad experience can colour a routine approach years later.
2mnx5IBDwQCAIshHBfi2: Code 2000 is the conspicuity code squawked by an aircraft entering from an area where SSR operation has not been required and no code has yet been assigned. The emergency codes are separate and worth knowing cold: 7500 unlawful interference, 7600 radio failure, 7700 emergency.
2n0SDJU0WVpeO4WUkPXk: The Yerkes-Dodson relationship is an inverted U: performance is poor when arousal is too low (boredom, complacency, missed cues) and poor again when it is too high (attention narrows, options are missed), with a broad optimum in the middle. Both ends of the curve are hazardous.
2nqtpbgwMoTLVuA2bb9N: Applying 2E when it should have been 2W puts the heading out by 4 degrees, not 2. By the 1-in-60 rule the off-track distance is 4/60 x 200 = 13.3, so about 14 NM. Reversing the sign of variation always doubles the error.
2nytbGGUuAtwGe7FcofM: The seat-of-the-pants sense reports the resultant of gravity and acceleration, and cannot separate the two, so in IMC it will confidently report a bank angle or a pitch attitude that is not there. It is fine as a supplement when the horizon is visible; without outside reference it is worse than useless because it feels convincing.
2o26wXCdmYEqlOUQGRdq: The cabin climbs with the aeroplane but far more slowly - typically 300-500 ft/min - so the differential builds progressively during the climb. The absolute cabin pressure is falling throughout; it simply falls more slowly than the pressure outside.
2o5Hfe28CRbSeliKQgSl: The touchdown zones at each end of a runway accumulate rubber deposits from landing tyres, and that polished, contaminated surface is exactly where a thin film of water produces viscous hydroplaning. Viscous hydroplaning needs only a very thin film and occurs at speeds well below the dynamic hydroplaning speed, which is why the touchdown areas are grooved or periodically rubber-removed.
2oUjxXJMvtrKUl8OCwa0: The air cycle machine's cold air unit is an expansion turbine: bleed air is made to do work driving the turbine, and in giving up that energy it loses both pressure and temperature. The refrigeration is produced by the expansion itself, which is why an air cycle system needs no refrigerant.
2oyXG5pvOe6bgxSk6S4O: Damage tolerance accepts that cracks will appear and designs the structure so that a crack can grow to a detectable size without the structure failing, with inspection intervals set so that it will be found first. It replaced safe-life design, in which parts are simply retired after a fixed life whether cracked or not.
2p9KE7N2sxRcPNxoAhvd: PSR distance = E x O x H / (O + H), where E is endurance, O is groundspeed out and H is groundspeed home. That gives 8 x 385 x 465 / 850 = 1685 NM. Note the total distance of 1860 NM is a distractor: the PSR calculation never uses it, because the PSR is fixed by fuel, not by where R happens to be.
2pKJpVdnzHfKB2hinhVw: A briefing works if it is short, precise, understandable to the person receiving it, and standard enough in shape that nothing gets left out. Piling in everything possible defeats the purpose: attention is limited, and a long briefing is one that stops being listened to.
2qB634rHrauLt6L2Tq7g: Radio height feeds TCAS, which uses it to inhibit resolution advisories near the ground (2), the GPWS, whose whole function depends on it (3), and the automatic landing system, which flies the flare from it (4). The altitude alert system works on barometric altitude against the selected level.
2qHagTAYCsaDV1Aq8AFG: The atmosphere is largely transparent to incoming short-wave solar radiation, so the sun heats the earth's surface rather than the air. The surface then warms the troposphere from below, by conduction into the lowest layer, by convection, and by long-wave terrestrial radiation absorbed by water vapour and carbon dioxide. This bottom-up heating is why temperature normally decreases with height.
2qalHzYO9OBJbiuHE3Ez: On an AC primary system the battery is charged through a transformer rectifier unit, which steps 115 V AC down and rectifies it to about 28 V DC. A static inverter does the reverse, supplying essential AC loads from the battery when generation is lost.
2r4zBxJE5TxqVbzRopVq: A squall line is a line of vigorous thunderstorms typically 50-300 NM ahead of and roughly parallel to a fast-moving active cold front. It forms where the cold air's downdraught outflow undercuts the warm sector well in advance of the surface front. Squall lines are frequently more severe than the front itself and are a mandatory SIGMET item.
2re61GvUZpmnIFI2I1vg: At cranking speed a magneto turns too slowly to produce a good spark, and the spark it does produce would arrive too early and kick the engine back. The impulse coupling holds the magneto rotor, then releases it with a spring to give a fast flick, producing a strong spark that is also retarded to near top dead centre.
2sl8acUaLfUeaLG9Mo9x: Sudden, obvious incapacitation is dangerous but it is instantly recognised and dealt with. The insidious kind - a gradual, partial loss of capability where the affected pilot still appears to be functioning and may even keep flying - is far more dangerous, because the other pilot may take a long time to notice anything is wrong.
2tLbhOqewCNtzn2AiLJH: Every link in the chain can fail: the sender can express it badly, the coding can be ambiguous, the channel can be noisy, the decoding can go wrong and the receiver can hear what they expected rather than what was said. That is why readback exists - it tests the whole chain rather than any one link.
2tf140P9r8pkPXUhryTz: Social conversation builds the rapport that makes a junior crew member willing to speak up when it matters, so it has a real safety function. What it must not do is intrude on critical phases of flight, which is exactly what the sterile cockpit rule exists to prevent.
2ttG7uKxpPoZDLJZy00i: The wind from 090 lies about 33 degrees off the port bow of the 123 heading, so it gives left drift and a headwind component. Resolving the vectors gives a track of about 134 degrees and a groundspeed of about 178 kt. Any option showing a groundspeed above the TAS of 225 kt can be discarded immediately.
2u1Bplot0N3LdVob3HX0: Risk-taking rises sharply when behaviour is observed by peers whose approval matters, because the social reward starts to compete with the safety judgement. It is the classic mechanism behind low flypasts and unnecessary displays, and it is why an audience is itself a hazard.
2u79ok3RNU0f6cYTi8f8: Once a mental model is formed, incoming information is interpreted to fit it rather than tested against it, so a WRONG model is not self-correcting - it actively resists the evidence that would overturn it. Breaking one usually needs an explicit challenge from outside, which is why crew cross-checking matters.
2u7ZKnak6DUiCRFIOTcQ: The Eustachian tube lets the middle ear equalise with the ambient (external) pressure by way of the pharynx. It vents easily on ascent as the middle ear pressure rises, but needs active help - swallowing, yawning, a Valsalva - on descent, which is why descent is when it hurts.
2u89GeTShMcPa7exAnvH: While the transmitter is radiating the receiver is blanked, so no echo can be processed until the pulse ends. Pulse length therefore sets the MINIMUM measurable range. Maximum range is set by the pulse recurrence interval, and bearing discrimination by beam width.
2uZNRaPEkCaiAPTcURVz: Cross-feed connects the engine feed lines so that any engine can be fed from any tank (1), which in practice is how a lateral imbalance is corrected - the heavy tank feeds both engines until the tanks match (3). It is not a jettison system and it does not transfer fuel between tanks, which is a separate transfer system.
2x3rGDJgcKnssKbs5e1e: Motivation comes from several directions at once: intrinsic drivers such as autonomy and achievement, and extrinsic ones such as pay, status and the wish to avoid sanction. All four listed items are genuine sources, which is why motivation cannot be managed with money alone.
2x9wtuKuE01qeQksQBOB: One US gallon is 3.785 litres, so 265 US-GAL is 1003 litres. Mass = volume x specific gravity = 1003 x 0.80 = about 803 kg. Take care not to use the Imperial gallon of 4.546 litres, which would give roughly 964 kg and is the trap behind the higher options.
2xbgFrfzmsjjRR1NPUYw: Anderson's three stages are COGNITIVE (thinking each step through, slow and effortful), ASSOCIATIVE (the steps link up, errors fall away) and AUTONOMOUS or automatic (the skill runs with little conscious attention). The last stage is what frees capacity for everything else - and is also where habit reversion becomes possible.
2xiIg8tm1ohogCQIr3S5: With QNH 1013 the pressure datum is effectively at sea level, so there is no pressure error, and FL120 reads 12,000 ft. The true altitude is also 12,000 ft, so there is no temperature error either. That can only be the case if the mean temperature of the layer between sea level and the aircraft equals the ISA mean. It says nothing about the temperature at any individual level, only the average.

3g9Jv5Hd9FHNvpmQn2Av: The 300 hPa level sits near 30,000 ft, where ISA temperature is about -44 C. A reading of -30 C is therefore some 14 C warmer than standard, which for that level is a high temperature. Interpreting an upper-air temperature always requires comparing it to the ISA value for the level, not judging the raw number.
3gDT1RljopoYhNQ07cmq: A compass swing measures deviation - the difference between compass north and magnetic north caused by the aircraft's own magnetism - and adjusts the corrector magnets to reduce it, recording what remains on a deviation card. True north is a separate matter, dealt with by applying variation.
3gUKagtAn5rXGzgV1i5w: Both are correct. Denser air at lower pressure altitude means greater mass flow and therefore more thrust available. It also means more drag for a given TAS and a less efficient operating point, so specific fuel consumption rises slightly - which is why jets are flown high.
3gva3CRDEd5FctAPP24I: Henry's law: the amount of a gas dissolved in a liquid is proportional to the partial pressure of that gas above it. Reduce the pressure and dissolved nitrogen comes out of solution as bubbles, exactly like opening a fizzy drink - which is decompression sickness.
3hHM6WX92bpxjb9R1LTm: Earth-rate (astronomic) precession is apparent wander caused by the Earth rotating beneath a gyro whose spin axis is fixed in space, so it continues whether the aircraft is parked or airborne. Its magnitude is 15 x sin(latitude) degrees per hour, so it is latitude-dependent and has nothing to do with the chart in use.
3hPHCwbs8ng3TO1t0dWP: Synergy means the crew working together produces MORE than the individuals would separately - errors are caught, workload is shared, and two mental models cross-check each other. The word implies coordination towards a shared objective, not merely people working alongside one another.
3jWbzUvC5CIbEYuMg0IX: Sweeping the wing means only the component of the airflow perpendicular to the quarter-chord line does the aerodynamic work, so the effective velocity over the aerofoil section is reduced by the cosine of the sweep angle. The flow therefore reaches sonic speed at a higher free-stream Mach number: Mcrit is raised. Vortex generators delay shock-induced SEPARATION but do not change the Mach number at which the shock first appears; dihedral affects lateral stability only.
3kC8wgTMMqI0kN8t6iaW: The propelling nozzle converts the remaining pressure energy into velocity, and its area must be matched so that the gas expands smoothly to the pressure it meets. Too large or too small an area gives the wrong pressure distribution and the flow breaks away from the walls, losing thrust. Directing gas onto the turbine is the nozzle guide vanes' job.
3kORjMb2TSSUbcwhGFit: ICAO Doc 8168 (PANS-OPS) defines a straight departure as one where the initial departure track is within 15 degrees of the alignment of the runway centre line. Any departure with a track deviation greater than 15 degrees is classified as a turning departure.
3kdyYoespq8rsEFbmWCd: The CVR records the flight deck: the crew's conversations and the radio transmissions made and received (2), together with everything audible in the cockpit through the area microphone - warnings, alerts and switch noises (4). Cabin crew conversations and the public address are recorded only where they pass through the flight deck audio system.
3lECQOvjtdjHY69LDk0F: 2D RNAV gives horizontal guidance only, 3D adds a vertical profile, and 4D adds time. Speed control on its own is not a dimension. Watch the wording carefully, because the distractors deliberately mix time guidance into the 3D answer.
3lbPLYpYMaqxuCb5i1r4: The three-pointer altimeter is a physical display whose design invited 10 000 ft misreadings, so the mismatch is between the human and the equipment: Liveware-Hardware. Had the problem been the way a procedure or manual was written, it would have been Liveware-Software.
3maCqt7C4RSxWbfJy8qn: Buffet margin is the gap between the low-speed and high-speed buffet boundaries at a given weight and altitude, and it widens as altitude decreases. Descending at a constant IAS reduces the Mach number and moves the aircraft away from both boundaries, so the margin increases. A step CLIMB does the opposite - it takes the aircraft higher and narrows the margin, which is precisely why step climbs are delayed until fuel burn has reduced weight enough.
3mz6c7E9WCUhEeOe6tP5: Doppler shift depends on the rate of change of the range between transmitter and receiver. Opening the range stretches each wave, lowering the received frequency; closing the range compresses them, raising it. So an apparent decrease means the transmitter is moving AWAY from the receiver.
3n3CcI2tTbf7Rb1A3kQj: The rule is a percentage of the seating, not one per row or per block: there must be at least 10% more dispensing units than passenger seats, so 180 seats require 198 masks. The surplus exists so that a unit is available wherever a passenger or a crew member happens to be when the masks drop.
3o9sJYAD6XCTK9EXZIER: The horizon gives the visual system an unambiguous, stable reference that overrides the misleading vestibular signal, which is what stops the disorientation. In IMC the same job is done by the attitude indicator, which is why the instruction there is to go on instruments and believe them.
3oPFNXY2r8CjeW22s1we: At constant IAS the dynamic pressure is fixed, so a lighter aeroplane needs a smaller CL and therefore flies at a lower angle of attack. A lower angle of attack means less acceleration of the flow over the upper surface, so the local flow reaches M1.0 only at a higher free-stream Mach number - Mcrit increases. This is why Mcrit is quoted against angle of attack, and why it falls as weight, load factor or altitude increase.
3oRgIF4VcazKKMy4BVyf: Vortices sink below the generating aircraft's path and then drift downwind, so the clean air is above and upwind. Staying above the preceding aircraft's flight path and on the upwind side keeps you out of both the sinking core and the downwind drift.
3ote8udEZaBlb4SDxPoJ: Near an aerodrome, vertical position at or below the transition altitude is expressed as altitude (on QNH). Above the transition level it is expressed as a flight level (on standard pressure 1013.25 hPa). The transition layer between the two is not used for level assignments.
3pihDhKKny6mjLW7NHCy: Higher pressure altitude means lower air density, which cuts thrust, reduces the lift generated at a given TAS and lengthens the take-off run, while also degrading the climb gradient. Every one of those effects works against the aeroplane, so the allowable take-off mass must be reduced to restore the certified margins. The reduction is continuous, not stepped - there is no altitude below which it can be ignored.
3rKNHRQMPxaKYxn60WFX: Long range cruise is flown at approximately a constant lift coefficient for a given weight, which means approximately a constant IAS. As altitude decreases at constant IAS the TAS falls, and at the same time the warmer air raises the local speed of sound - both effects reduce the Mach number. So below the optimum altitude the LRC Mach number decreases continuously as the aeroplane descends.
3rPPLHofj8DW8vCDVoFO: The command bars show what attitude to fly: the horizontal bar commands pitch and the vertical bar commands roll, and following both puts the aircraft on the profile the selected modes have computed. There is no yaw command bar - directional control is achieved by rolling.
3sPUsTfTXxZLEtElgNcM: Polar charts use the polar stereographic projection. Scale is very nearly constant over a wide area around the pole, meridians are straight lines radiating from the pole, and a straight line is close enough to a great circle for practical navigation. A Mercator is useless at the poles because it expands to infinity.
3sfSxY6hYZs3yB5L1HMW: Hyperventilation is a shortage of carbon dioxide, not of oxygen, so the cure is to put carbon dioxide back: rebreathing your own exhaled air raises blood CO2 and the symptoms clear within a minute or two. Talking aloud or slowing the breathing rate does the same thing more discreetly.
3u4DCjTIpsQov0xJDKjZ: A decreasing tailwind is an increasing-performance shear: the aeroplane's inertia keeps its groundspeed for a moment, so its airspeed rises, lift increases and it balloons above the glide path. The mirror case - a decreasing headwind - loses airspeed and drops the aeroplane below the path, which is the dangerous one.
3v0BXeCY9G3uVNYGnSwg: The flight director takes the selected mode, works out the path required and displays the attitude that will capture and hold it in an optimum way - the intercept angle and bank being computed from the geometry rather than fixed. It is guidance towards a path, not an envelope-protection device.
3vGQLmAWnjMt8mOLkPMe: The ram air turbine deploys into the airstream when the normal sources fail and drives a pump or a generator, providing enough power to work the primary flight controls and essential systems. It is a get-you-down provision, not enough for the gear, brakes or high-lift devices.
3vq3PSJSqET7SV2Y9iTA: Note the word CHECK. A check swing measures the residual deviation, i.e. the angle between magnetic north and compass north, and the result is recorded on the deviation card. Cancelling the aircraft's own magnetic fields is what the correcting magnets do during a full compensation swing, and no swing can cancel the earth's own field.
3w2moGngTVYU2cpcLjF9: Cold oil is thick, so it takes higher pressure to force it through the galleries and the relief valve may be at its stop. This is normal provided the pressure comes back into the band as the oil warms; the caution is to keep power low until it does, because high pressure on cold oil can burst a cooler or a filter.
3xXLOFrywgUI0Gp7y2Rb: Speed hold works by pitching the aeroplane to keep the selected airspeed, so it can be maintained in any condition in which pitch is free to vary - climbs, descents, turns and through thrust changes. It is the elevator, not the throttles, that holds the speed in this mode.
3xfAnxQ2EpcTHdALgRCj: Water extinguishes by cooling, which suits class A solids - paper, fabric and wood. It must not be used on hydrocarbons, where it sinks beneath the burning liquid and spreads it, nor on electrical fires, where it conducts back to the operator.
3xw3b4uKJqN0tZIhOmOx: The command bar shows what to do next, not where the aeroplane is. Left of the localiser it will initially command a turn towards the centreline, but once the pilot has established an appropriate intercept the bar centres to say 'hold this' - so a centred bar with the aircraft still displaced simply means the correction in hand is the right one.
3yOq3LuEmDzttvWLBZ2F: A transverse Mercator has its cylinder tangential along a meridian instead of the equator, so scale is nearly constant in a narrow band running north/south. That makes it the projection of choice for maps of large north/south extent, and the reason it underpins the UTM grid.
3ySDpV5jnVf5Tb0B6Fq6: A runway closure lasting a year is a long-term change. It is published via NOTAM for immediate notification and in the AIP (including AIP Supplement) for the permanent record. The AIP Supplement covers temporary information of long duration or containing extensive text or graphics.
3yfgZfNKOnIZlqyJCwN8: Excess thrust is unbalanced force, and by Newton's second law an unbalanced force produces acceleration. If the pilot holds altitude, that excess goes into accelerating the aeroplane; if instead the speed is held, the excess is converted into potential energy and the aeroplane climbs. Which of the two happens is entirely a matter of what the pilot chooses to hold constant.
3ytAHmsvhJN6j3NTWrsX: Gas moves down its partial pressure gradient. Oxygen is at high partial pressure in the alveoli and low in the venous blood, so it diffuses INTO the blood; carbon dioxide is the other way round, so it diffuses from the blood into the lungs to be breathed out.
41f93bdeKBdQWy5nBAZ0: Climbing at a constant Mach number, the falling density outweighs the falling speed of sound, so the dynamic pressure decreases and the IAS decays steadily. To keep generating the same lift with less dynamic pressure the aeroplane must fly at a higher CL - a higher angle of attack. That climbing CL is precisely why the buffet margin narrows with altitude and why the aeroplane eventually reaches its aerodynamic ceiling.
41tn3hxaLhNSCHnnVwHS: From Newton's second law, force = mass x acceleration, so the SI unit of force is the kilogram-metre per second squared, given the name newton. For comparison: the pascal is N/m2 (pressure), the joule is N m (work or energy), and the watt is J/s (power). Recognising the base-unit combination is the quickest way to identify which quantity is being described.
42ZLv3AUV7tu7JbXNdQE: Mixture strength is a mass ratio, and what matters is the charge that actually reaches the combustion chamber - so it is the mass of fuel to the mass of air entering the cylinder, about 1:15 for the chemically correct mixture. Volume ratios would be meaningless because air density varies with altitude and temperature.
44RiL7cc6IXS1fakeivF: The control law is the transfer function of the computer: it defines what output control-deflection signal is produced for a given input deviation from the demanded state, including the gains and the way they are scheduled with speed and configuration. It is the logic, not the hardware at either end of it.
44W0bIbGEl9D1BLMVz5o: Boost pumps deliver fuel to the engine feed lines at a positive pressure, which both guarantees supply to the engine-driven pump and keeps the pressure in the line above the fuel's vapour pressure, so vapour bubbles do not form. Preventing vapour lock and maintaining supply are two aspects of the same function.
44ZQZyXJLs5zS83pJwdg: Wind shear is defined by the RATE of change, not the size of the region: a substantial change of wind velocity and/or wind direction over a short distance. Spreading the same change over a large distance gives a gradual gradient the aircraft can absorb, which is why the definition is tied to a short distance and why it can appear in both the vertical and horizontal planes.
44wDkCKg50OqCLRRWwuf: The neutral point is the CG position at which the aeroplane has zero longitudinal static stability. For positive stability the CG must lie AHEAD of it, and the distance between them is the static margin. Certification requires a minimum static margin, which is what sets the aft CG limit; loading behind the neutral point would make the aeroplane divergently unstable in pitch.
45F8FIDY3UMrrDOrJlXe: Beyond extinguishers, the required fire-fighting equipment is crash axes or crowbars, used to gain access to a fire burning behind cabin panels or in a structure. They scale with seating capacity: one up to 200 seats, two above that.
45GktIRBbWO7Q7ulW2ug: The legal definition comes from ICAO's Technical Instructions for the Safe Transport of Dangerous Goods by Air (Doc 9284), which give effect to Annex 18. The IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations are an industry restatement of those Instructions and are not the defining document.
45eGikpiwALOcIjwlAGo: Transfer across the alveolar membrane is diffusion: gas moves from high to low partial pressure at a rate set by the pressure gradient, the surface area and the thickness of the membrane. Boyle's and Charles's laws describe how a gas volume behaves, not how it crosses a membrane.
462LdogUKpnHqGF2oXX9: Stress degrades all four. Attention narrows onto a single cue, concentration becomes hard to sustain, memory - especially working memory - deteriorates, and judgement suffers as options are missed and risk is assessed badly. That combination is why stress management is treated as a flight safety topic.
463ReFAUbcqu72M6ERb9: Groundspeed out is 470 + 55 = 525 kt and groundspeed home is 470 - 75 = 395 kt. PSR = E x O x H / (O + H) = 9.5 x 525 x 395 / 920 = about 2141 NM. As with any PSR, the 2900 NM distance to B plays no part in the calculation.
463sj0IElPdbuP6y1e8u: Dynamic hydroplaning speed depends on tyre pressure: for a rotating tyre V (kt) is about 9 x the square root of the pressure in psi. 14 bar is roughly 203 psi, and 9 x 14.25 gives about 128 kt, so the risk begins near 129 kt. Water depth determines whether hydroplaning can occur at all, but the speed threshold comes from the tyre pressure.
46TAOM5blhTlNcKnEHs8: The alarm phase is the immediate adrenaline-driven reaction: arousal jumps, heart rate and breathing rise, glucose is released for fuel, and resistance actually DIPS below normal before the body mobilises. Digestion is shut down, not activated, and cortisol belongs mainly to the later resistance phase.
46f0xvXcvmqu6sv9HZPq: Convert to true first: with 5W variation the true track is 310 and the true heading is 296, so drift is 14 degrees right. Groundspeed is 50 NM in 12 minutes = 250 kt. Resolving the 296/225 air vector against the 310/250 ground vector gives a wind of about 190 degrees at 63 kt.
46wRY1EKJbt2JUFxXeSP: With hot brakes the aim is to let them cool by convection and to avoid trapping heat: chock the wheels and release the parking brake, then ventilate the brakes. Holding the parking brake on clamps the hot discs together and can weld or warp them, and spraying water on a hot brake causes thermal shock and can rupture the wheel.
47RhR4LJ9sNGapZFcqDR: The command bar is a command, not a raw-data display: it shows the pitch change needed to capture and then hold the glideslope. Where the aeroplane actually is relative to the beam is shown by the glideslope pointer, and pitch attitude by the aircraft symbol against the horizon.
47SzhWFSraVyrYJqvqZM: Treating the automation as another crew member - one whose work you check, and whose intentions you predict before you verify them - keeps the pilot in the loop without giving up the workload benefit. Hand-flying everything throws that benefit away, and complacency is not inevitable.
48IotbhX99OUrjvfSTYK: High arousal narrows the span of attention, sometimes to a single cue. On a simple task that can help by excluding distraction, but a complex task needs breadth, so the narrowing shows up as missed information and tunnel vision - the right-hand limb of the inverted-U curve.
495LWSMeRgXfncq6vzKa: Induced drag is the penalty for the tip vortices produced by spanwise flow around the wing tip. A high aspect ratio wing is long and narrow, so the tips are a much smaller proportion of the span and their influence over the wing as a whole is reduced, cutting downwash and induced drag - CDi is inversely proportional to aspect ratio. This is why gliders and long-range aircraft use slender wings.
49UZXJb3Xb7fpT1J5DoS: The airflow over the fuselage lowers the pressure inside an unpressurised cabin slightly below true static, so the alternate source feeds the instruments a pressure that is too low. The altimeter therefore over-reads and the airspeed indicator over-reads, which is why the flight manual gives a correction for alternate static operation.
49ZOpetgefx5VoJmZy3d: Bypass ratio is cold flow divided by core flow. With 300 kg/s entering and 50 kg/s passing through the core, 250 kg/s goes round it, giving 250/50 = 5:1.
4ANDBxXVj7nG0a0qKRTr: One degree of longitude subtends 60 NM at the equator and shrinks as the cosine of latitude, so at 60 degrees north or south it is 60 x cos60 = 30 NM. Latitude is unaffected: one degree of latitude is 60 NM everywhere. The hemisphere is irrelevant, only the latitude value matters.
4AVvTLLMeoJe0wjFhYTi: On arrival at the alternate the fuel still on board is the final reserve plus the contingency fuel that the plan assumes was never needed, so the planned landing mass at the alternate is zero fuel mass + final reserve + contingency. The landing mass at the DESTINATION is higher because it still carries the alternate fuel, so you SUBTRACT the alternate fuel from it, not add it.
4B6KbhBlARm65kDVJaFV: A weak mixture burns slowly and continues burning as the piston descends, so heat is delivered to the cylinder walls and exhaust valve for longer instead of being converted into work. Excess fuel in a rich mixture cools the charge, which is why full rich is used for take-off and climb.
4BAEecibcmrCdmgiaDLP: With the pitot blocked, the trapped total pressure stays fixed while the static pressure changes with altitude, so the indicated difference varies with height alone - the airspeed indicator over-reads in a climb and under-reads in a descent, behaving exactly like a crude altimeter.
4Bqp0ATjJnaLcZnyxQmf: An active error is committed at the sharp end and shows its effects almost immediately, so it is quickly detected - the pilot who selects the wrong altitude sees it. A LATENT error, by contrast, is built into procedures, design or organisation and lies dormant, sometimes for years, until circumstances expose it.
4CQGDMXZrb0knO2JIUBR: The compass errors that matter in flight - turning and acceleration errors - come from the vertical component of the earth's field acting on a magnet system that is free to tilt. How much error appears depends on the heading and on the bank or acceleration applied, and it grows with magnetic latitude as dip increases.
4CxdhJqrM90XhJbOJPrH: Surge is a mismatch between the front and rear of the compressor at off-design speeds. Bleed valves opened between the spools dump some of the flow overboard, unloading the front stages, and variable inlet guide and stator vanes re-angle the flow. Fixed vanes cannot help because the problem is that conditions change.
4D6W3Qh7ibUd15oP1fNv: With a servo tab system the pilot's controls move only the tab, and the tab then flies the elevator. If the ELEVATOR itself jams, the tab still responds to the stick - but now it is acting as a tiny control surface in its own right, and its aerodynamic force acts in the OPPOSITE sense to the elevator deflection it would normally command. The result is pitch control that is much weaker and reversed in direction, a genuine trap for the unwary.
4Ezc9atA2YW0LQnUv8SK: The rotor of an aircraft alternator carries the field winding, and a field must be steady, so it is fed with direct current through slip rings or, in a brushless machine, through a rotating rectifier. The alternating current is generated in the stationary stator windings.
4Fy0EJkH0M7wmBOVWuKf: A healthy adult resting pulse is about 60 to 80 beats per minute; fit individuals sit lower. Rates persistently above about 100 (tachycardia) or below about 50 (bradycardia) at rest are outside the normal range and warrant medical attention.
4G5NQqQq0q33VcndKlI5: The earth turns 15 degrees of longitude per hour, 15 minutes of arc per minute of time and 15 seconds of arc per second of time. So 5 h = 75 degrees, 20 min = 5 degrees, 20 sec = 5 minutes of arc, giving 80 degrees 05 minutes.
4GHINq3YKzinWVDBeWHM: In an irreversible system no aerodynamic load reaches the controls, so there is nothing for a trim tab to balance - the feel comes from an artificial feel unit instead. Trimming therefore means moving the zero-force datum of that feel unit, so the control column can sit at a new position with no force on it.
4GUr1tLEotnNV5ODaUPF: Crosswind = wind speed x sine of the angle between wind and runway. The angle is 305 - 260 = 45 degrees, so crosswind = 30 x sin45 = 30 x 0.707 = about 21 kt. At 45 degrees the headwind and crosswind components are equal, which is a useful check.
4Gf26T5BXsatPISqM06u: During climb, the pilot sets the altimeter to standard pressure (1013.25 hPa) when passing the transition altitude, switching from altitude to flight level. During descent, the pilot sets QNH when passing the transition level, switching from flight level to altitude.
4H4LGnyxTOKHn7tQnwfk: The mental model is built from both directions at once: incoming sensory information, and the store of past experience that tells you what that information probably means. That is why two pilots can look at the same picture and see different things, and why an unusual situation is so easily forced into a familiar pattern.
4HBCFIoLkG7gZxNpJV2o: Take-off fuel is block minus taxi: 35,500 - 1,000 = 34,500. The zero fuel limit gives 86,400 + 34,500 = 120,900; the landing limit gives 93,800 + 27,500 = 121,300; the structural take-off limit is 146,900. The lowest of the three governs, so 120,900 kg.
4IW9bbEdr1FwrzbA5kJ0: The masks drop when the cabin altitude exceeds about 14,000 ft, but the generator does not start until the wearer pulls the mask down to the face, which pulls a lanyard and fires the chemical oxygen candle. That is why the safety demonstration stresses pulling the mask firmly towards you.
4KwENJr48mWJxvTOoXIw: The trimmable stabiliser setting for take-off is scheduled against CG, and an aft CG calls for a setting toward the nose-DOWN end of the permitted band - precisely because an aft CG already needs less nose-up trim to rotate. So an aft CG paired with the maximum permissible nose-down THS position is the correctly scheduled combination, and rotation using the normal technique will be normal. A mismatch between the two is what produces under- or over-rotation.
4LBwVRFXSUrvl9P0Qi2V: CAS has already had the instrument and position errors removed, so what remains is compressibility, which converts CAS to EAS, and density, which converts EAS to TAS. Both corrections grow with altitude, which is why the difference between CAS and TAS is large in the cruise and small near the ground.
4LHr6qi4gKD0QM1px9XV: Long-term memory has no known limit on either capacity or duration - the practical problem is not storing information but RETRIEVING it, which depends on how well it was encoded and how it is cued. Working memory is the one that is tightly limited in both size and time.
4LYQFi91W0IMmPZFnw5o: Conditional instability means the environmental lapse rate lies between the saturated and dry adiabatic rates. A dry parcel cools at 3 C/1000 ft, faster than the environment, so it becomes colder and denser and sinks back: stable. A saturated parcel cools more slowly because of latent heat release, so it stays warmer than the environment and keeps rising: unstable. The instability is thus conditional on the air being saturated.
4LjykI1oif6ljZtGsuOs: Astigmatism comes from a cornea (or occasionally a lens) that is not evenly curved, so rays in different planes focus at different distances and the image is blurred or distorted in one axis. It is corrected with a cylindrical lens and has nothing to do with accommodation or vitamin A.
4LtznRYTQrSsXyDTWsQl: Selecting flap at the right moment is a practised, procedure-driven action: the skill of operating the lever, governed by the rule that says when. Knowledge-based behaviour is what you fall back on when no rule fits - a novel failure with no procedure - and that is a much slower and more error-prone mode.
4NEDB3SMJ1thwM6BrFTO: After anti-icing the fluid film is the aeroplane's only protection, and hot jet efflux or propeller wash from the aircraft ahead will strip or dilute it and can melt contamination that then refreezes on a cold structure. Both wakes are therefore to be avoided, never sought out.
4OT8vhQeynoHZbYqQLvk: The bends is joint pain from nitrogen bubbles, and it is the commonest presentation of decompression sickness. Distinguish it from the chokes (chest pain and coughing), the creeps (itching and skin mottling) and the staggers (neurological involvement). The leans is a vestibular illusion and nothing to do with DCS.
4PPqUBXClueuIzIFs5fX: The value of studying error mechanisms is that understanding HOW people go wrong lets you redesign procedures and interfaces so the error is harder to make and easier to catch, and lets you build error management into normal operations. Identifying a culprit achieves nothing, and no amount of insight makes an individual automatically immune in future.
4PTpW0db3tt1hMlmITOj: The autothrottle controls thrust, so its modes are those that can be achieved with thrust: holding a speed (1) or a Mach number (2), or holding a thrust setting expressed as N1 or EPR (4). Angle of attack and flight path are held with pitch, which is the autopilot's business.
4PjKd1nwI8aNfZTSi2TN: A transformer rectifier unit steps the 115 V AC down and rectifies it to about 28 V DC, supplying the DC busses and charging the battery. A static inverter works the other way, producing AC from the battery when generation is lost.
4PmFXfHJjvWoDfTZFrVH: Total drag is the sum of induced drag, which varies as 1/V2 and dominates at low speed, and parasite drag, which varies as V2 and dominates at high speed. Adding the two gives the classic U-shaped curve: drag falls as speed rises from the stall, reaches a minimum where the two components are equal (VMD, the best L/D speed), then rises again toward VNE.
4PrSO28ju265WACMdVFc: At FL80 the pressure is about 753 hPa and the air at +20C is much warmer than the ISA value of -1C, so the density ratio is about 0.73 and TAS = CAS / root(sigma) = 120 / 0.855 = about 141 kt. The rule of thumb of adding about 2 percent per 1000 ft would give 139 kt from altitude alone, with the warm air adding the rest.
4QrzIEQacMiqNX8Xhp2V: In the JAR-OPS 1.430 system minima table, a VOR/DME approach has a lowest MDH of 250 ft, the DME arc or fix giving a positive range check that a plain VOR approach lacks. Plain VOR and NDB both sit at 300 ft.
4Qvhp8hLST12SZzelkjc: Selye called the body's stereotyped response to any stressor the General Adaptation Syndrome (GAS). It runs in three phases: alarm (adrenaline release, the mobilisation the question refers to), resistance (the body holds an elevated but stable level of coping) and exhaustion (reserves are spent and performance collapses). The other three names are invented distractors.
4RfqDSNzKamMAv7Damll: Article 38 of the Chicago Convention requires each Contracting State to notify ICAO of any differences between its national regulations and practices and the international Standards contained in any Annex. This ensures ICAO and other States are aware of where a State does not fully comply.
4SktsStwde8fivhiDQQl: Wake vortices from a wide-body decay over roughly two to three minutes in typical conditions, which is why the ICAO wake separations are two and three minutes. They do not vanish the moment the aircraft has passed - they sink, drift downwind and decay slowly - and in calm air with no crosswind to break them up they persist longer, so the minima are a floor rather than a guarantee.
4TjCilAE4nPsMr5bKZ10: Transport (travel) wander comes from carrying the gyro across meridians, so it is the change of longitude multiplied by the sine of the mean latitude flown: g x sin Lm. The expression 15 x sin(latitude) per hour is EARTH rate, which is a function of time rather than of distance travelled, and is a separate correction.
4Tl9wI6vxeZpKUQnjp5a: Bleed air arrives far too hot to use, and the air cycle machine cools it: a compressor and an expansion turbine on a common shaft, with heat exchangers, so that the air gives up energy driving the turbine and emerges cold. 4U3rvKIxB97yTQYPLHgt: Hull-loss rates fell steeply while engineering reliability improved, then flattened out from about the 1970s onward. 4hImgKEW8hCjz2QNvc8v: Cross track error is a linear distance, not an angle: it is how far the aircraft lies to the left or right of the active flight plan leg, measured at right angles to it. Track angle error is the separate angular quantity comparing the aircraft's track with the desired track.

4iC4MTdQndFduU2AYAhP: Approach categories run from VAT: A below 91 kt, B 91-120 kt, C 121-140 kt, D 141-165 kt and E 166-210 kt, so 91-120 kt is Category B. VAT is 1.3 x VSO (or 1.23 x VS1g) at maximum certificated landing mass.
4iuRzE8ABYzeFf3OuOxH: If a transponder is found unserviceable before departure and cannot be repaired, the flight may depart to the nearest suitable airport where repair can be effected. The aircraft is not grounded indefinitely, but neither is unrestricted continuation of the flight permitted.

4jZK6HZpXroGDwUcP2a3: Convergence at low level forces air upward because it cannot go into the surface. 4lbFUJEycrFtNqpni6Ss: Groundspeed is 105 NM in 21 minutes = 300 kt, and CAS 200 kt at FL120 in ISA gives a TAS of about 240 kt. Applying 15W variation, the true track is 207 and the true heading 200, so drift is 7 degrees right. Resolving the vectors gives a wind from about 050 degrees at 70 kt.

4oOrE8HE3UBuq0yKGsll: Survival or supplemental oxygen is what the aircraft carries to keep the occupants conscious and functioning if cabin pressure is lost - the drop-out masks for passengers and the crew system. 4oscNlN1OrnEmCJ8oqhY: The dangerous goods transport document - its content and format - is specified in the ICAO Technical Instructions (Doc 9284). The Flight Manual and Operations Manual carry aircraft and operator procedures, not the regulatory specification of the shipper's document.
4pxMVvszjI3WPN8nqymg: Automation adds a third party to the flight deck whose intentions have to be communicated, verified and shared. 4qMnwAQ3O9MrrYOphyIS: At FL180 the pressure is about 506 hPa and -30C is ISA-9, giving a density ratio of about 0.59. TAS = CAS / root(sigma) = 150 / 0.77 = about 195 kt. The 2 percent per 1000 ft rule of thumb gives 150 x 1.36 = 204 kt, close enough to identify the right option.
4qv2SZpG9zB5dXLipEmL: Above the friction layer only the pressure gradient force and the Coriolis force act, and they come into balance with the Coriolis force equal and opposite to the pressure gradient force. 4rJFL7S6ZVN6xI0ZoJmg: An inertial system measures its own accelerations and integrates them, so it needs nothing from outside once it has been aligned and given a starting position. 4sEyCy761M9GNsGF6yip: Skill acquisition passes through the cognitive phase (the learner thinks each step through and performance is slow and error-prone), the associative phase (the parts link together, errors reduce, some spare mental capacity appears) and finally the automatic phase (the motor programme runs with little conscious attention, leaving capacity for other tasks). 4sdbfB1oXF8Eth3IHq64: Wake vortices are the by-product of lift: pressure differential between the lower and upper surfaces spills round the tip and rolls up into a pair of counter-rotating vortices. 4sr9VjTNSxD5aYeh5gwp: EAS is the speed that would give the same dynamic pressure at sea level, so converting it to true airspeed is purely a matter of correcting for the actual air density. Instrument and position errors were removed to get CAS, and compressibility was removed to get EAS.
4tGi8YhhSpZfhBNCJwf2: JAR-OPS 1.430 system minima: ILS without glidepath (localizer only) 250 ft, VOR/DME 250 ft, VOR 300 ft, NDB 300 ft, VDF 300 ft. 4vD9Efm8FAYxJneHvy9K: A reversal is annunciated with the word NOW to distinguish it from an initial advisory and to convey urgency: the two aircraft's coordinated solution has been recomputed and the sense must be swapped. 4vNtZLcOJBoRAEWTpZGn: If sin(climb angle) varies inversely with mass, then gradient x mass is constant. So mass x 2.6% = 110,000 x 2.8%, giving mass = 110,000 x 2.8 / 2.6 = 118,455 kg. 4zLKoWaLVe0zaKAyoxhN: Roughly 90% of bird strikes occur below 500 m (about 1500 ft), which is why the take-off, initial climb, approach and landing phases carry nearly all the risk and why bird control is concentrated on and around the aerodrome.
4zQcICl1kMG1Stvoe3kn: Over-the-counter does not mean flight-safe: antihistamines, decongestants, cough preparations and analgesics can all cause drowsiness, blurred vision or reduced concentration, and the underlying illness may itself be disqualifying. 51s0clTkgw1zJEJxymsX: ICAO Annex 11 requires that a Control Zone (CTR) extend laterally to at least 5 nautical miles from the centre of the aerodrome in the direction from which approaches may be made. This ensures adequate protected airspace for arriving and departing traffic.

53i8nwGQQNZdqowJyLNO: Aviation applies a far stricter standard than road traffic: there is no safe blood-alcohol level for flying. 54dswG9KxSqWJnpfD7De: JAR-FCL requires an IR(A) applicant to have completed at least 50 hours of cross-country flight time as pilot-in-command in aeroplanes or helicopters, of which at least 10 hours shall be in aeroplanes. 58TREGJYWXyB0A5cdCRh: Exhaust gas temperature peaks at the chemically correct mixture of about 1 part fuel to 15 parts air, because that is where combustion is most complete and least heat is carried away by unburnt fuel or excess air. Both richer and leaner settings reduce EGT.
58gA6vGDZnuQStZmEv4y: JAR-OPS 1.790 scales hand extinguishers in the passenger compartment with the maximum approved seating configuration: one for 7-30 seats, two for 31-60, three for 61-200, and so on. A 31-seat configuration is one seat over the first threshold, so two are required.

5962fIfr2N9p0q3pZPDX: Gas exchange in the alveolus is passive diffusion down each gas's partial-pressure gradient. 598vBxKJ2x0O9GZaqqr0: A vertical gyro - the attitude indicator - must keep its spin axis aligned with the local vertical, and the gravity erector does that by sensing any tilt with a pendulous device and applying a small precessing torque to bring the gyro back. 59ZWC8bdaFbGkzKF3BwH: TAS = Mach number x local speed of sound, and the speed of sound depends only on temperature. 5AwSiKOLYL3cMY80rksI: The flight crew compartment door, where fitted, must be capable of being locked from WITHIN the compartment, so the crew retain control of access. A door that could be locked or unlocked from the cabin side would defeat the security purpose entirely.
5BnI7f5kgtIYzCeUk9C3: The yaw damper drives a series actuator in the rudder circuit, so the surface moves without the pedals moving. That is deliberate: the corrections are small and continuous, and feeding them back to the pedals would be both distracting and unnecessary.

5CRsFTMVqJGHU5nsyXex: Fear and anxiety drive the respiratory centre to increase breathing rate and depth beyond metabolic need, which is exactly the definition of hyperventilation. 5CnwmC6iI6DgJw6Gsi8c: JAR-OPS 1.135 requires certain flight preparation documents to be retained on the ground for the duration of the flight, and the mass and balance documentation is one of them where it is required for the operation. 5CuxCYaz5PlYtLrx4t3l: Closely spaced isobars mean a steep pressure gradient and therefore a strong wind. 5DCqgjPNmYqJ6WSl0e85: Generators feeding a common busbar are paralleled so that the total load is shared and the loss of one machine does not drop the bus. Parallel operation demands matched voltage, frequency and phase, which is what the real and reactive load-sharing circuits achieve.

5Di25al8EMMfNrEFKF2T: Scale is chart length divided by earth distance in the same units. 150 NM = 150 x 1852 m = 277 800 m = 27 780 000 cm, so the scale is 4.63 : 27 780 000, which reduces to about 1 : 6 000 000. Always convert the earth distance to centimetres before dividing.
5DiLbJcbouFUL8P5RXCo: Tidal volume is the air moved in one quiet breath and is about 500 ml in an adult. 5Dkd8REYeypIoWAh4YD3: The flux detector of a remote indicating compass is put in a wingtip or fin because that is the position furthest from the engines, generators, wiring looms and ferrous structure that create deviation. 5Dnlb6qn6AGlSvKVKZkj: Item 16 elapsed time is written as four digits, hours then minutes, with no separator. 1 hour 55 minutes is therefore 0155. The 0115 option is the trap for reading the digits as 1 h 15.

5FQkpvF2zmrXK4dEUNGj: Accelerometers measure acceleration, so integrating once gives velocity and integrating again gives distance - hence position comes from a double integration of acceleration with respect to time, or equivalently a single integration of the velocity that the first integration produced.
5FcdFzvZWm3JFX1p7Edw: Situational awareness is the correspondence between the pilot's mental model and the real situation. 5GbRUXcvtrQUu2PfuiIp: As a parcel rises, the surrounding pressure falls, so the parcel expands. 5Hg43Nm3gDA8K4MIWPUx: In the worst case, full go-around thrust alone will not arrest the descent, and the remaining performance has to be taken from attitude. 5I3QeCojR5JDhyy6KClu: The constant speed unit holds the selected RPM by changing blade pitch, so engine speed does not vary. Manifold pressure, however, is limited by the ambient pressure available to the induction system, so in an unsupercharged engine it falls steadily as the aircraft climbs.

5K2He87neMXcJQVeJRyR: If the waste gate sticks closed, all the exhaust gas continues to drive the turbine even as the throttle is opened in the descent, so boost keeps building into denser air.
