AO1K7FTLlkVNIcuOM9ZQ: A severe surge shows itself as a bang or a series of them, a change in vibration and noise, and a rapid rise in turbine gas temperature as the compressor stops delivering air while fuel continues to burn. EPR and fuel flow fall, and the response is to reduce thrust on the affected engine at once.
AQ7pgIe6Zq9rCZe5JfK0: The Eustachian tube is the only route by which air can pass between the middle ear and the outside world, so a tube blocked by swelling from a cold or catarrh is what prevents equalisation. Breathing through the mouth or pinching the nose does not obstruct it - pinching the nose is in fact part of the Valsalva manoeuvre used to force it open - and sinus barotrauma is a separate problem.
AQ8zbqg9T1iY3SABzNla: Maximum zero fuel mass is the greatest mass the wing structure can carry without the bending relief that fuel in the wings provides, so it is the dry operating mass plus the traffic load - everything except usable fuel. Unusable fuel and the crew are already inside the dry operating mass.
AQaRmvMwN8DuBdTcIwt5: Cyanosis of the lips and nail beds (statement 1), euphoria with loss of judgement and self-criticism (statement 2) and finally unconsciousness (statement 4) are all part of the hypoxia picture, from the earliest insidious change to the end point. Flatulence is caused by the expansion of trapped intestinal gas as pressure falls, which is a separate pressure effect rather than a sign of oxygen lack.
AQmKzcZpBmKs9HmNzLvU: Roughly 70-80% of the information a pilot uses reaches him through the eyes, which is why loss of visual references is so disabling and why visual illusions are such a large part of this syllabus. Hearing runs a distant second, and the kinaesthetic or seat-of-the-pants channel is the least reliable of all in flight because it cannot separate acceleration from gravity.
ARIG9WSRBwXYxmfwrxSm: The flow accelerates most over the UPPER surface, because that is where the curvature is greatest and the suction peak highest, so the local flow reaches M1.0 there first. That is the definition of the critical Mach number, and the shock forms just downstream of the suction peak, around mid-chord, then strengthens and moves aft as Mach increases. A lower-surface shock appears only at a higher Mach number.
ARgFqG75CDg3hFITf1AO: The chemically correct ratio is about 15:1 air to fuel by mass, so 9:1 has far more fuel than the air can burn - a very rich mixture. Combustion limits are roughly 8:1 at the rich end and 20:1 at the weak end, so 9:1 will still burn, but wastefully and with a cool, sooty flame.
AS0t083GkBqg7Myn1N8d: DAMP means the surface is not dry but the moisture on it does not give it a shiny appearance. Once the film is thick enough to look reflective the runway is WET, and once more than 25% is covered by more than 3 mm of water, or by snow or ice, it is CONTAMINATED.
ATOlNNBUOa5LwOnSPXZU: ICAO Doc 4444 limits speed adjustments on intermediate and final approach to plus or minus 20 knots. No speed adjustment shall be applied within 4 NM of the threshold to protect the stabilised approach.
ATZBk6CqmzCbZrkeg3MJ: At 35,000 ft the time of useful consciousness is of the order of half a minute to a minute, and a rapid decompression shortens it further because gas is driven out of the lungs and the alveolar oxygen pressure collapses at once. This is why the drill is mask on before anything else, and why the emergency descent follows immediately.
ATZgvVqxJMlu9mIRID5s: ICAO Annex 14 specifies that runway edge lights shall be white, except that on instrument runways the last 600 m or one-third of the runway (whichever is less) may show yellow to warn of the approaching runway end. Blue lights are for taxiway edges, not runway edges.
ATzK9oCaiZNCCQ65O7Qo: Error is not a property of the individual alone. Whether an error is made, whether it is detected and whether it damages safety all depend on the technical system, the organisational and social environment and the operational context in which the crew is working - the same crew will perform differently under different rostering, procedures and equipment. That is why safety work targets the system and not only training.
AUgSZvkt1UAk7xJNOCKs: ICAO Doc 8168 (PANS-OPS) states that establishment of change-over points should be limited to route segments of 60 NM or more, except in special cases. For shorter segments the mid-point is used by default.
AVrVJrplOnWUcxd7UgpG: Thrust has two parts: the momentum term, the mass flow multiplied by the increase in velocity it has been given, and the pressure term, which appears when the nozzle is choked and the jet leaves at a pressure above ambient. Temperature does not enter the force equation directly.
AVvX4PBV3XICRm49xYTd: Bypass ratio is cold flow divided by core flow, and both figures are given here: 250 divided by 50 is 5:1. Note that the inlet flow is the sum of the two, 300 kg/s, which is what the ratio would be computed from if only the total were given.
AW0MQSszcJsq91CvZFuA: The certification requirement pairs each severity with an acceptable probability. A minor failure - one that merely inconveniences the crew or slightly reduces margins - is allowed to be probable, in the region of 10^-3 to 10^-5 per flight hour. The more severe the effect, the more remote the failure must be.
AW2Nr8YVXPYw4exAehWC: Jettisoning is done in straight and level flight at a relatively high level, so the fuel atomises and evaporates long before it reaches the ground, and so the aircraft does not fly back through its own dumped fuel. Dumping while turning, holding or on final approach concentrates it in one place and close to the surface.
AW4g433QkDQSACaTGN3V: A major failure produces a significant reduction in safety margins and a significant increase in workload, so it must be remote - of the order of 10^-5 to 10^-7 per flight hour. Hazardous failures must be extremely remote and catastrophic ones extremely improbable, below 10^-9.
AWoQylhmEH9xOvdI746b: Detection is fitted where a fire is both likely and would be hidden from the crew: around the engines (5), in the APU compartment (4) and in the main wheel wells (1), where hot brakes and hydraulics are close together. Fuel and oil tanks are not fitted with detectors - the fire would be outside them, in the compartments that are monitored.
AWzQqzgguWkuJ8HK8ZX4: ICAO Annex 17 requires that permission for foreign agents to carry weapons on board aircraft be conditional upon prior notification by the state of embarkation to the state where the weapons will be carried, AND notification of the pilot in command. Both conditions must be met.
AXmXnZPlZyoq06hHLf6D: The wind from 120 is on the starboard quarter of the 355 heading, so it pushes the aircraft left and adds a tailwind component. Resolving the vectors gives a track of about 346 and a groundspeed of about 102 kt, i.e. 9 degrees of port drift and 12 kt above the TAS.
AYiKXn6rXDoVZFq7Dj9p: The democratic, cooperative leader treats a conflict as a problem to be understood: he brings the parties together and works out what the disagreement is actually about, so that the underlying cause rather than the surface irritation can be dealt with. Imposing a decision is autocratic, staying neutral is laissez-faire, and simply smoothing things over restores the atmosphere while leaving the cause intact.
AYj1Zz5NFLKn13ZToZK3: The SELCAL check must be completed at or before entering oceanic airspace, so the crew know the alarm will actually alert them before they take the HF watch off the loudspeaker. Discovering a failed SELCAL an hour into the ocean means either a continuous listening watch or a communications failure.
AZ4TQnLeCTbevcvYJBAG: Expectation biases perception: having predicted the standard clearance, the pilot hears the standard clearance even though a non-standard one was passed. This is why readback is required and why non-standard instructions are the ones most often misheard. Anticipating weather or delay is prudent planning; anticipating checklist items is the same trap applied to the checklist.
AZPBrUU4sOibuuaJCQan: Middle-ear pressure can only be equalised through the Eustachian tube, so a blocked tube - typically swollen shut by an upper respiratory infection - is what limits equalisation and leads to barotrauma on descent. Mouth breathing and a pinched nose do not obstruct the tube, and sinus barotrauma is an unrelated condition affecting the paranasal sinuses.
AbTNOE6LGWHycMZ1BzqA: 23.5S is the Tropic of Capricorn, the southernmost parallel the sun can reach. The sun's declination touches 23.5S only at the December solstice, so it passes through the zenith there exactly ONCE a year, around 22 December. Only positions between the tropics see the sun overhead twice a year.
AcFNPwvS19FMyR8iCtQV: In the NAT region a revised estimate must be passed to ATS as soon as the estimate for the next reporting point changes by 3 minutes or more. The tight tolerance exists because longitudinal separation there is measured in time, so a slipping estimate directly erodes the separation the controller is applying.
AcKxbKouCabhEBUSPoaS: ICAO Annex 11 states that procedures applicable in an upper flight information region (UIR) need not be identical with those in the underlying FIR. Different procedures may be established to suit the different traffic characteristics at higher altitudes.
AcdKaaocHokkLJSoejM4: EAS is CAS corrected for compressibility, and the compressibility correction depends on how far the air has been compressed - a function of speed and of pressure altitude. Density altitude is what converts EAS to TAS, which is a different step.
AcsTMwE3iLs0kopEHDJX: The wind from 130 is only 6 degrees off the nose of the 124 heading, so it is almost a pure headwind: the groundspeed falls from 375 to about 320 kt and there is barely 1 degree of drift, giving a track of about 123.
AeGAHNGTb9BscOGiFigP: Episodic memory is the long-term store of personally experienced events, held with their context of time and place. Being reconstructive rather than a recording, it is notoriously open to suggestion - which is why witness accounts of an incident change with the questions asked. Semantic memory, by contrast, is the long-term store of facts and word meanings.
AfRsUELAjaIpa8H9sYdb: Direct Mercator scale expands as the secant of latitude, so the earth distance covered by a fixed chart length is proportional to the cosine of latitude. Distance = 90 x cos30 / cos45 = 90 x 0.866 / 0.707 = about 110 NM. Less expansion at the lower latitude means the same chart length covers more ground.
AfTzKxnCRUqsndJtP6j2: Fail-passive means the failure is contained: the system disconnects without producing an out-of-trim condition or a significant deviation, so the aeroplane is handed back under control. What it cannot then do is land automatically, so the crew must complete the landing manually or go around.
AgJMfZ76r6cdzQBlV9UV: In a piston engine each process happens in turn in the same cylinder, and combustion occurs with the valves shut, so the volume is fixed and the pressure rises. In a gas turbine all four processes happen continuously in different parts of the engine, and the gas is free to expand as it burns, so combustion is at essentially constant pressure.
AgNTsMjb3wX1CSjm1u01: Required time of arrival works backwards from a time constraint the crew has entered at a waypoint: the FMS computes the speed schedule needed to meet it and commands that speed, adjusting continuously as the wind and the situation change. It is a speed target, not merely a prediction.
AhH0GBBdYACf4WAFA9SH: Runway End Identifier Lights (REIL) provide rapid identification of the approach end of a particular runway during reduced visibility conditions. They consist of two synchronised flashing lights located laterally on each side of the runway threshold.
AhfzQGPVIza317AjUQs6: A continuous loop detector is a length of sensing element run around the compartment, which changes its resistance or capacitance when any part of it is heated. It detects fire or overheat over a large area with one circuit, and it is not itself an extinguishing system.
AicVbII5SMdEcfe49ecl: Side stays and drag struts are folded slightly past their aligned position so that the loads acting on them tend to keep the joint closed rather than to fold it. The same principle is used at both ends of the travel, so an overcentre lock secures the gear up as well as down.
Ak6MO2T4T5uTMiZfHNNK: A constant true track of 270 is a rhumb line along the parallel, so the 720 NM covered in 6 hours is a departure. Change of longitude = departure / cos latitude = 720 / cos40 = 940 minutes of arc = 15 deg 40 min. Going west from E080 00 gives E064 20. The latitude is unchanged because the track is due west.
Akg9ISLrD0HcuIs1E8NL: CO2 smothers by displacing oxygen and is electrically non-conductive, so it can be used across paper, fabric, wood, hydrocarbons and electrical fires - every case in this list. Its weakness is that it does not cool, so a deep-seated class A fire can re-ignite; its absolute exclusion is burning metal.
AkgLaWzBUpfia1ssBT9L: Both altimeters read the same static pressure, so the difference between them is fixed by the 50 hPa gap between the two subscale settings; the 32C is a distractor, because temperature affects TRUE height, not the indication. Fifty hPa is roughly 1350 to 1500 ft depending on the conversion used, so the 1013 altimeter reads about 6350 to 6500 ft. The exact standard-atmosphere value is about 6400 ft, which falls between the two closest options, so treat this one as approximate.
AkrxXMNxG9spE5TPsxSf: Flying east shortens the day and requires the body clock to be advanced, which it resists because its free-running period is a little over 24 hours. Westward flight lengthens the day and only requires a delay, which is easier and faster. North-south routes cross few time zones and cause little disturbance.
Aku8Mv3hp2bqKxa2qnwT: A hung start is one in which light-up occurs normally but the engine then stabilises below idle, because there is not enough starter assistance or airflow for the fuel being supplied. The remedy is to shut down and investigate, since leaving it running risks a hot start as the temperature climbs.
Akzpl1dFFzE6NWPF5io7: Search and rescue information, including a brief description of the services responsible for SAR, is published in the GEN part of the AIP (specifically GEN 3.6). The ENR part covers en-route procedures and the AD part covers individual aerodrome data.
AlxZqKaqLI9rXlWmNV1M: Primary flight controls are the surfaces that control the aircraft about its three axes - the rudder in yaw (2) and the ailerons in roll (4), with the elevator in pitch. The trimmable stabiliser is a trim device and the speed brake changes drag, so both are secondary.
Am5Nm2gsro6q0Ako0if7: Time = distance / groundspeed = 5360 / 480 = 11.167 hours. The decimal 0.167 of an hour is 10 minutes, so the answer is 11 HR 10 MIN. Converting decimal hours to minutes rather than reading them as minutes is what the near-miss options are testing.
AmEsUIqAVKbe4xjRmAyb: Conflict is resolved by getting all the parties to work out a solution they can all accept, which is why participation is essential. Conflict is not intrinsically destructive - handled well it exposes genuine differences and improves the decision - it does not necessarily question anyone's general competence, and outside mediation is occasionally useful but never necessary in principle.
AmMXyniYBTiH7z7VLJY2: Smoking raises the risk of coronary heart disease (statement 1) and, because carbon monoxide occupies haemoglobin, it raises the smoker's physiological altitude several thousand feet above the actual cabin altitude (statement 2). Statement 3 is intended as the well-established increase in lung cancer risk, though the row as printed reads 'decreasing' - a typographical corruption of the original item.
AmYJPFu1kAARvRFo4KZL: A machmeter is fed from the pitot and static system, so it inherits the position error of the static source: the pressure sensed is not quite free-stream static, and the indicated Mach number is in error accordingly. It has no subscale to set, and being a ratio of pressures it is not affected by temperature or density directly.
AmaTyUr5CiwcgT0nTTR2: One small packet of safety matches may be carried on the person only. Checked baggage is prohibited because a fire in the hold cannot be reached, and the matches are not permitted loose in cabin baggage either - the requirement is that they stay under the owner's personal control.
AnSJdyZSevKyEJtYDG48: The terrain display and the look-ahead alerting compare the computed position against a stored terrain database, so both degrade if the position becomes unreliable - and the system will remove the terrain display rather than show it wrongly. The classic modes work from radio height and barometric rate and are unaffected by position accuracy.
AnpS8cstNYuZp0vtY5bP: The ICAO Standard Atmosphere has a sea-level temperature of 15 C and pressure of 1013.25 hPa, with temperature falling at 6.5 C per 1000 m (1.98 C per 1000 ft) up to the tropopause at 11 km, where it reaches -56.5 C and then remains constant to 20 km. The 3 C per 1000 m distractor is the dry adiabatic rate, which applies to a moving parcel, not to the standard environment.
AnpejvbyYjkCjjtfeYfH: A turbulent boundary layer continuously mixes fast-moving free-stream air down toward the surface, so the velocity climbs very steeply in the first fraction of a millimetre before levelling off. A laminar layer changes velocity gradually and smoothly through its whole depth. The steeper wall gradient is exactly why the turbulent layer produces more skin friction drag - and also why it carries more energy and separates later.
AoBUOmcc6fESpDcopOUD: Descending at a constant Mach number, both the rising temperature and the rapidly increasing density mean the IAS climbs steadily. Higher dynamic pressure needs a smaller lift coefficient to support the same weight, so the angle of attack decreases - and with it the pitch attitude. This is why a constant-Mach descent has to be flown to a crossover altitude and then continued at a constant IAS.
Aot9GUSDQQTQAftr8nwz: ICAO Annex 1 states that the period of validity of a medical assessment begins on the date the medical examination is performed and the assessment is issued, not on the date the licence is issued or delivered.
AovGV7m2SO9Dpx8WCxqi: Long-term memory is not a passive archive. What gets stored and what is retrieved is shaped by prior experience, by repetition and rehearsal, by suggestion at the time of recall, and by the individual's own desires and expectations - which is why memory of an event is reconstructive and can be confidently wrong.
ApRjpQVfe27KWmrdyCPh: With irreversible actuators the surface loads are taken by the actuator and none of them reaches the control column, so the pilot would have no feel at all and nothing to warn him of speed or load factor. An artificial feel unit is therefore added to generate a force that varies with dynamic pressure and control deflection.
ApY3nRDifBqzIAVnIHCl: Showers (SH) come from convective, cumuliform cloud, where strong updraughts allow droplets to grow large by collision and coalescence and where the cloud has limited horizontal extent. The result is precipitation that starts and stops abruptly, varies rapidly in intensity, and covers a small area. Stratiform cloud in stable air produces continuous, widespread, steadier precipitation instead.
Apy3Jqg6FHdQLxHfmiB2: The propelling nozzle is a convergent duct in which the hot, high pressure gas expands: pressure energy is converted into kinetic energy, so the gas leaves faster than it entered. It is that increase in the momentum of the gas stream which constitutes the thrust.
Aqe9aid4BiCXQesgLaro: Between 108.00 and 111.975 MHz the band is shared: VOR takes the EVEN tenths (108.00, 108.05, 108.20, 108.25 and so on) and the ILS localiser takes the ODD tenths (108.10, 108.15, 108.30, 108.35...). 108.35 has an odd first decimal, so it can only be an ILS localiser.
ArIMPgAQel8pbCU27h2P: A Fowler flap travels rearward on tracks first, increasing the wing AREA, and only then rotates downward to add CAMBER. Because it does both, it produces the largest CLmax increase of any trailing-edge device for a given drag penalty - which is why the first stages of Fowler flap give a big lift gain with little drag, ideal for take-off, while the final stages add mostly drag.
As1qE2aiFmVMSmITCoCp: The tropopause is highest where the troposphere is deepest and warmest, so over the equator it lies at about 16-18 km (roughly FL550), against about 11 km in mid-latitudes and 8 km over the poles. This is why tropical cumulonimbus can reach far higher tops than mid-latitude storms - there is no stable lid until much greater heights.
As2L08dCwMjXSfBLRWO3: Under gradually increasing +Gz the eye is the first organ to suffer, because the retinal artery has to work against both the blood column and the intra-ocular pressure. Peripheral vision dims first - greyout - then vision is lost altogether (blackout) while consciousness remains, and only at higher G does G-LOC follow. Red-out belongs to negative G.
Asj5Perwn1YNG9yXGtUA: Workload is not a property of the task alone: it is the demand the situation makes relative to the resources the individual has. It therefore depends on the current situation, on the pilot's expertise - an experienced pilot meets the same situation with automated routines and spare capacity - and on the ergonomics of the system, which determines how much effort extracting and entering information costs.
AtHHpaLDpNGiL4UA1eXx: All four reasons hold. The condition being treated may itself be disqualifying (1); reduced pressure, dehydration and low humidity can alter how the body handles a drug (2); side effects such as drowsiness or blurred vision directly threaten flight safety (3); and drug effects persist after the last dose, which is why a grounding period is imposed after stopping treatment (4).
AtYrrTLbypaw2AQN9ZUb: The wet south-west monsoon withdraws from India through September, October and November as the land cools and the thermal low over the subcontinent fills, and it is replaced by the dry north-east monsoon blowing off the Asian landmass. The reverse transition, north-east to south-west, occurs in April and May.
AumDMNTO5r2eGg10mtRY: The otolith organs work by the inertia of a weighted membrane resting on hair cells, so they respond to any sustained force acting on that mass: gravity, which tells the brain which way is up when the head is tilted, and linear acceleration, which is indistinguishable from a tilt. Angular acceleration is sensed by the semicircular canals instead - which is why acceleration on take-off produces the somatogravic illusion of pitching up.
AuqPt56XnY0AhDRFEk9o: In severe turbulence, vertical separation must be increased. The aircraft at FL 150 cannot descend to FL 140 until the other aircraft has reported passing through FL 130, providing 2000 ft of separation instead of the normal 1000 ft to account for turbulence-induced altitude deviations.
AvutJ7eq7qLJJk8CtIBr: A single gimbal - one degree of freedom - with the spin axis lying horizontally along the pitch axis makes a rate gyro that precesses in response to yaw rate, which is the turn indicator. A directional gyro needs two degrees of freedom so it can hold its axis fixed in space.
AwIiINwQBVfijn868qIy: Mode 2 detects the ground coming up to meet the aircraft rather than the aircraft descending onto it, and it announces 'TERRAIN, TERRAIN' before escalating to the pull-up warning. 'SINK RATE' belongs to Mode 1 and 'DON'T SINK' to Mode 3.
AwJPpvDjaWdvd19wEMoz: A polar track is defined by compass usability, not by latitude: it is one part of which lies in an area where the HORIZONTAL component of the Earth's field falls below 6 microtesla. The horizontal component is what a magnetic compass or flux valve senses, and below that figure the field is too weak and the dip too large for it to be reliable, which is why grid navigation and gyro steering are used.
AwRdhlFNmuI5ILxrwKcx: A short of the sensing loop to earth would look to the detector like a fire and produce a spurious warning, so the fault protection circuit recognises the short and inhibits the detector instead, annunciating a system fault. The alternative - a false engine fire drill in flight - would be far worse.
AwgF9RFURHorrQMjeOxK: Thrust on a turbofan is set and monitored either by engine pressure ratio, which measures the pressure rise the engine is producing, or by fan speed N1, which on a high bypass engine is a direct measure of the airflow producing most of the thrust. Which is used depends on the engine manufacturer.
AxNzDVwu9F4Oej6H2Fcp: At a constant flight level the static pressure is fixed, and holding CAS constant fixes the dynamic pressure. A fall in temperature reduces the true airspeed and the speed of sound in the same proportion - both vary as the square root of absolute temperature - so their ratio, the Mach number, is unchanged.
AxewD2T5EYHgSu9TBXdx: A headwind does not change the aeroplane's airspeed, rate of descent or air-relative glide angle - but it reduces the groundspeed, so for each foot lost the aeroplane covers less ground. The descent path traced over the ground is therefore STEEPER and the distance covered shorter. A tailwind flattens the ground path and extends the glide.
Axyoq2khOtGB70oXGHLg: Gyroscopic precession makes an applied force take effect 90 degrees onward in the direction of rotation. For a propeller turning clockwise as seen from the cockpit, a pitch-up input precesses into a YAW to the RIGHT, and a yaw to the right precesses into a PITCH DOWN - so both statements hold. The familiar tailwheel case is the same rule: raising the tail (pitching nose down) yaws the aeroplane left.
AyL2Yr5YNJ1k73BKUSAn: The atmosphere stays well mixed to about 80 km, so oxygen remains 21% by volume throughout the altitude band any aeroplane operates in. Total pressure falls with height, and the partial pressure of oxygen falls in proportion with it - that falling partial pressure, not any change in the percentage, is what produces hypoxia.
AyPYHhBywUpDQs56SpHK: Once NAV is selected the IRS navigates purely by dead reckoning from its accelerometers and gyros, and nothing external corrects it: the displayed IRS position drifts at roughly 2 NM per hour. The FMC computes its own updated position from radio and GNSS inputs, but that update goes to the FMC display, not back into the raw IRS position.
AyZvh0exoqNkUKvKqfZ3: Behind a shock wave the pressure rises steeply against the flow, and the boundary layer separates. The separated region destroys the suction peak over the rear of the upper surface, so lift falls sharply while drag rises steeply - the shock stall. The separation is also unsteady, which is what produces Mach buffet, and it can render ailerons in the affected region ineffective.
AzDEp1PmUg9scMkGM5vc: ICAO Annex 2 states that if a controlled flight inadvertently deviates from its track, the pilot shall adjust the heading to regain track as soon as practicable. The pilot is not required to wait for ATC instructions before correcting the deviation.
B0AsYTqiQMgwoDyyZ7av: Sudden in-flight incapacitation is far more often trivial in origin than dramatic: acute gastrointestinal upset - food poisoning, gastroenteritis, severe colic - is the commonest single cause, which is why crew members are advised not to eat the same meal. Cardiovascular events are more serious but much rarer, and screening at medical examinations is aimed at reducing them.
B10ZOw1aZ4Bl6XZ7F1GI: Modern jets use hot bleed air ducted through the wing leading edges and engine intakes - an anti-icing system which prevents ice forming rather than removing it after it has. Pneumatic boots suit turboprops, which have no large supply of bleed air to spare.
B1Q9esnjm6AfNw5mX2PJ: Flight Information Service is provided to all known aircraft in airspace classes C, D, E, F, and G. In Classes A and B, the service is implicit in the ATC service provided. The FIS provision covers traffic information, weather, and other operationally relevant data.
B2FFTNGEAucP7lmMQXvM: Life jackets are required for any flight beyond gliding distance from shore, so they are needed here. Life rafts become mandatory beyond 120 minutes at cruising speed or 400 NM, whichever is less, for an aeroplane able to continue with one engine inoperative - 120 minutes at 180 kt is 360 NM, so at 340 NM the rafts are not yet required.
B2uwJqda3BFxQRRAT1Ur: Safe life design establishes by test the life at which cracking becomes likely, applies a large scatter factor and retires the part at that figure whether or not anything has been found wrong with it. It is used where inspection is impractical, and it contrasts with damage tolerance, which accepts cracks and inspects for them.
B3ENIW3maxm03sW3xcZV: With the supply on and the oxygen lever at NORMAL the regulator dilutes the oxygen with cabin air on a schedule set by cabin altitude, giving more oxygen as the altitude increases and pure oxygen only when it must. That is what makes the bottled supply last long enough for a descent from cruise level.
B3HbGsYyjdvGBun4pxAG: Integration gives the change in a quantity, not its absolute value, so integrating acceleration once gives how much the velocity has changed - and the actual velocity requires the value it started from. The same argument applied a second time is why an initial position must also be entered.
B3Wgg1KW7ToYCqH083oA: Environmental capture is the tendency for a habitual skill to be triggered by the environment in which it was learned, even when it is now wrong - statement 1 - and its classic aviation form is carrying an action from a previous type into a new one, statement 2. Statement 3 describes social role behaviour and statement 4 is not a recognised term.
B3cpgdwwTbifz39qQztO: This is a wind shear performance problem, not a limits problem. Using runway 27 you start with a 5 kt headwind and, on climbing through the inversion, meet a 30 kt tailwind - a 35 kt loss of airspeed at 300 ft, which is a classic shear accident. Using runway 09 you accept a 5 kt tailwind on the roll and then gain a 30 kt headwind through the shear layer, an increasing-performance shear. Departing into the shear with the light tailwind is the safe choice.
B4dWvMVejoHAs5QGss9O: On approach the non-radar wake minimum for a LIGHT following a MEDIUM is 3 minutes, whereas a MEDIUM or LIGHT following a HEAVY is separated by 2 minutes. The LIGHT-behind-MEDIUM case gets the longer interval because the following aircraft is the least able to withstand the roll a vortex imposes.
B4uzXXtX9NHv0maxoWK8: Pressurisation keeps cabin altitude low, which keeps the partial pressure of oxygen high enough to prevent hypoxia (3), keeps dissolved nitrogen in solution so decompression sickness does not occur (1), and limits the expansion of trapped gas in the gut, sinuses and middle ear (2). Coronary disease has nothing to do with cabin pressure.
B5YjGn2WAbjkirFap5X9: V2 is defined as a multiple of the stall speed in the take-off configuration. A larger flap setting raises CLmax and therefore lowers the stall speed, so V2 comes down with it. The qualifier matters: V2 must also be at least 1.1 VMCA, and VMCA does not improve with flap, so at high flap settings VMCA can become the limiting floor.
B5yQv2TxSNll3yLY80AW: Cirrocumulus (CC) is a high cloud, so in temperate latitudes its base lies roughly 16,500-45,000 ft above sea level. With the ground itself only 1600 ft up, the base is on the order of 15,000-35,000 ft above the terrain. Remember that cloud classification is by base height above the surface: low 0-6500 ft, medium 6500-23,000 ft, high above that, and all three bands vary with latitude.
B6bG8yN5r5KAJm3gFYEm: Compression ratio compares the volume above the piston at bottom dead centre - swept plus clearance - with the volume at top dead centre, which is the clearance volume alone. A higher ratio gives better thermal efficiency but brings the charge closer to detonation, which is what limits it in a spark ignition engine.
B7QlGhIOZ8Zu3jL3UfXh: Through the power stroke both valves are shut so that the expanding gas can do work on the piston, and in the theoretical cycle the exhaust valve opens as the piston reaches bottom dead centre - so at the end of the stroke both are still closed. In practice the exhaust valve is opened somewhat before bottom dead centre to begin scavenging.
B7XURHlukKWFWYW3vUNT: The ceiling set by pressurisation is where the maximum differential the structure can take, added to the highest cabin altitude that may be scheduled, no longer reaches the outside pressure. Both halves matter: a bigger differential or a higher permitted cabin altitude would both raise the ceiling.
B7ihNNMnTU2GvW8TxGyB: Leaning towards the chemically correct mixture removes the excess fuel that was cooling the charge, so both the exhaust gas temperature and the cylinder head temperature rise and either may reach its limit. That is why leaning is done against the temperature limits rather than simply for minimum fuel flow.
B82AXdWJytuelzaIviHq: A slow decompression means the outflow of air exceeds what the packs can supply, but the structure is intact: a leaking door seal or a failure of the pressurisation system itself. B8cXYAfB2CAQzZe7cRuU: Halon interrupts the chemical chain reaction, is non-conductive, leaves no residue and works in small quantities, which makes it the standard aircraft agent for cabin, flight deck, cargo holds and engines. Powder on a flight deck coats the instruments and obscures the displays, which is why it is not used there.
B8ezVqraa55KEjpwIi67: ICAO Doc 8168 obstacle clearance surfaces for ILS precision approaches assume the pilot does not normally deviate from the localizer centreline by more than half a scale deflection after being established on the track. B9eSOwG0vbNEFYfKR8UR: A rhumb line cuts every meridian at the same angle, and a parallel of latitude cuts every meridian at 90 degrees, so every parallel is a rhumb line. BA2A8WHw1rKIEk6HptK9: Only the power stroke delivers work; the other three consume it, which is why a single-cylinder engine needs a flywheel to carry it round. Multi-cylinder engines overlap their cycles so that at least one cylinder is always on its power stroke, which is what smooths the output.
BA72klr5oW75Ut3kBCHe: Cost index expresses the cost of time relative to the cost of fuel. At zero, time is worth nothing and the FMS optimises for fuel alone, giving maximum range speed. A high cost index does the opposite, flying faster and burning more to save time.
BAtO1g6HP1LkDhpKPBPa: With one port blocked the instruments read only the other. In symmetric flight both ports see the same pressure, so nothing is wrong. In a sideslip the two differ, and using only the remaining port introduces an error whose sign depends on which way the aeroplane is slipping.
BCpStHqhdis2z1XNjTFf: A take-off alternate must be within one hour's flight time at the ONE-ENGINE-INOPERATIVE cruising speed, in still air, because the reason for going there is an engine failure just after take-off. BD1gIiZNiJIx7AnHbOkb: A directional gyro must be kept with its spin axis horizontal, so a pendulous device senses any departure from the local vertical and feeds the levelling erection torque motor, which applies a torque causing the gyro to precess back into the horizontal. BDsRUvdjBdC4redSqwJu: Automatic trim works in the pitch channel: it runs the stabiliser to cancel the elevator hinge moment the autopilot is holding, so the servo is unloaded and the aeroplane is in trim at disconnect. Rudder and aileron trim are set by the crew, not by the autopilot.
BEUT1jzHO3XI9WavIyHA: A resting adult breathes about 12-16 times a minute; 16 is the value in that band. Rates near 30 at rest indicate hyperventilation, and rates in the 70s belong to the pulse rather than to respiration.
BF2Px5iU4nU25jLCg7NS: Descending at constant Mach the true airspeed falls only as fast as the speed of sound, but the air is getting denser much faster than that - so the dynamic pressure rises and the calibrated airspeed increases. That is why a constant Mach descent has to be changed to a constant CAS descent at a crossover level.
BFhKmeTNSTnAAQak8jfx: ICAO defines three progressive emergency phases: Uncertainty phase (INCERFA), Alert phase (ALERFA), and Distress phase (DETRESFA). There is no separate 'urgency phase' in the ICAO alerting service framework.
BFktcs5PaXQ6g5vswMcQ: During a circling approach, descent below MDA should not be made until: (1) the landing threshold is in sight, AND (3) the required obstacle clearance can be maintained and a landing can be made. Condition 2 (visual reference established and maintained) is required throughout the circling manoeuvre but is not the specific trigger for descending below MDA.
BG87I19NxYNfXxmbhovN: The Minimum Sector Altitude (MSA) provides a minimum of 300 metres (1000 ft) obstacle clearance within a radius of 25 NM (46 km) from the navigation facility upon which the instrument approach procedure is based.
BGYFAahebZwBnn2CxDI5: JAR-FCL 1 allows 100% credit of co-pilot time in multi-pilot aeroplanes towards the total flight time required for a higher grade of pilot licence. This recognises that MPA co-pilot duties involve full operational responsibility.
BHBEVnmc0LDlNt7xjaKD: In Class B airspace above 10,000 ft MSL, VMC minima follow the standard ICAO table. Above 10,000 ft in all classes: 8 km visibility with distance from clouds of 1500 m horizontal and 1000 ft vertical. Some sources express the horizontal distance differently.
BHbcZdp6VANB5IPXlK7C: With a hydroplaning risk the technique is a firm, positive landing to break through the water film and put weight on the wheels, then maximum reverse thrust and braking as early as possible. Reverse thrust does not rely on tyre friction, so it works even while the wheels are hydroplaning, and delaying it wastes the runway that remains.
BITEx2RvczwOunF2UJYO: The pressoreceptors, or baroreceptors, sit in the carotid sinuses and the arch of the aorta, where they sense arterial blood pressure and feed the cardiovascular control centres. Their location high in the circulation is what makes them able to correct for a fall in pressure at head level, and their response is what is defeated by a rapid onset of +Gz.
BInerlFBjK4Ta9pKl4vR: Watzlawick's axiom means that behaviour has no opposite: silence, turning away or doing nothing are all read by the other person as messages, and they are read whether or not anything was intended. In a cockpit the captain who says nothing about a copilot's deviation has still communicated something, which is why the axiom matters operationally.
BJ2sb7EVdnd72MzkwC15: Groundspeed out is 180 - 15 = 165 kt and home is 180 + 15 = 195 kt. Distance from A to the ETP = D x H / (O + H) = 360 x 195 / 360 = 195 NM, so the distance from the ETP to B is 360 - 195 = 165 NM. Note the ETP lies UPWIND of the midpoint, i.e. towards the end that is harder to reach.
BJM3CTiuhD6FZxNoqXfr: The EGPWS terrain display uses the same logic as the weather radar picture: green for terrain well below, amber for terrain approaching the aircraft's level, red for terrain at or above it, and magenta for areas where no terrain data is held. The density of the dot pattern conveys the margin as well as the colour.
BJRj63z7HigDoRAmu2fv: First find the groundspeed: the wind from 180 is 60 degrees off the port bow of the 240 course, giving about 26 kt of crosswind and 15 kt of headwind, so the groundspeed is about 180 kt. Covering 39 NM at 180 kt takes about 13 minutes, and losing 18 000 ft in 13 minutes needs about 1400 ft/min.
BJdMEK3D6KsQcmU4Kau0: The bends - pain in the large joints, typically shoulders and knees, caused by nitrogen bubbles in and around the joint - are by far the commonest presentation of altitude decompression sickness at the cabin altitudes reached in airline operations. The chokes and neurological involvement are more serious but much rarer, and circulatory shock is a late complication.
BKUacTzhrO0vkRukMtnJ: A trim tab is deflected to hold the control surface where it is wanted with no force on the cockpit control, so the pilot can release the column and the aeroplane stays where it was put. It works in any regime of flight, not just the cruise, and it is a steady-state device rather than one that lightens manoeuvring forces.
BMubI8mp1iySlZ5w6qmd: For an aeroplane able to continue the flight to an aerodrome with the critical power unit inoperative, life rafts become mandatory beyond 120 minutes at cruising speed or 400 NM, whichever is the LESSER. Aeroplanes without that capability are limited to 30 minutes or 100 NM.
BNiQeAkaDnEBe6XnXYAZ: Output voltage depends on speed, on the number of conductors and on the strength of the magnetic field, and only the last of these is available for control - so the regulator adjusts the field current. Engine speed varies for its own reasons and cannot be used to control the generator.
BO3mjRJSuYMSm0KQ4S57: A microburst is an intense, small-scale downdraught from a convective cloud. The descending air is cooled by evaporating precipitation, so it is denser and colder than its surroundings, which is what drives it down and makes it spread violently outward on striking the ground. On approach it produces a headwind gain, then a severe downdraught, then a sudden headwind loss - the most dangerous low-level wind shear there is.
BOHJfZM1ts3hjnbDxqhm: ICAO Doc 4444 states that a Surveillance Radar Approach (SRA) should normally be terminated at 4 NM from the touchdown point unless otherwise established by the appropriate ATS authority. The pilot continues visually from that point.
BOJCWYiGwWiCnOBYWG4P: Flight crew masks incorporate a microphone and connect to the audio system, so the wearer can transmit on the radio and hear both the radio and the interphone. Without that the decompression drill could not be flown, since the crew would be unable to coordinate or to declare an emergency.
BOWWcpP8HrrDCGSFuu4O: An autocratic captain takes all the decisions and does much of the work himself, so he ends up overloaded while the copilot is left underused. The crew's capacity is wasted at exactly the moment it is needed, and because the copilot is not involved he is less able to monitor or to take over. Overload, not efficiency, is the normal outcome.
BOi2fSroZCIEVGUsxQGM: Alignment can be started either by selecting ALIGN or by selecting NAV directly, because selecting NAV runs the alignment first and then enters navigation automatically. ATT is an attitude-only reversion with no navigation function, so it cannot be used to align.
BOxpjCzIoPBkyWgp72eJ: In Class C airspace at or above 3050 m (10,000 ft) AMSL, VFR flights must maintain 8 km visibility and 1500 m horizontal / 300 m (1000 ft) vertical distance from clouds. Below 3050 m the visibility requirement reduces to 5 km.
BPV0kN76uJfwWp0Vc8yY: Item 13 of the ATS flight plan takes the estimated OFF-BLOCKS time, the moment the aircraft starts to move under its own power or under tow. Taxi time is then allowed for separately, which is why the EOBT and the estimated take-off time are not the same figure.
BPWmaDv3bai9YS5lZwQk: Optimum altitude is by definition the altitude giving the best specific air range for the current mass, so flying above it costs range. It also erodes the margins: the gap between low-speed buffet and high-speed buffet narrows, manoeuvre capability falls and the aeroplane sits on the back of the drag curve, where speed stability is poorer rather than better.
BPawt7QPGMKnn63v3IYP: Red blood cells exist to carry oxygen: haemoglobin binds oxygen in the lungs and releases it in the tissues, and the cells also carry part of the returning carbon dioxide. Defence and immunity are the job of the white cells, and clotting is the job of the platelets.
BPuqRmY8AeWI4mLcYfW9: The logon establishes the air-ground data link connection with a particular ATC centre and confirms that it is working before any operational use is made of it. Only once the connection exists can CPDLC messages be exchanged or automatic dependent surveillance reports be sent.
BQMphkK8nd57wfpfILov: Calibrated airspeed is indicated airspeed corrected for instrument and position error, so if neither error is present the two are the same. Equivalent airspeed requires a further correction for compressibility and true airspeed one for density.
BQROPcJgkX00dWHGzt7X: Statements 1 and 2 are true - pulse rate and stroke volume rise during a bout of exercise, while regular training lowers resting heart rate and blood pressure over the long term. BQmC9d5rjui7GFq01p20: The mixture control varies the amount of fuel reaching the main discharge nozzle for a given airflow, either by a needle in the fuel passage or by back-suction applied to the float chamber. It does not touch the air side - the throttle butterfly controls that, and the two are operated independently.
BQvzxcBWzYmVAAZEP9Vf: Category II minima are defined in terms of radio height, and the decision height must be measured against the actual surface rather than against a pressure datum, so the radio altimeter supplies it. Its serviceability is a condition for the approach.
BR9eb2akvyhj1ENPSmbP: On a transverse Mercator only the central meridian and the Equator project as straight lines, which is precisely why the stem excludes the Equator. Every other parallel projects as an ellipse, and the other meridians as complex curves.
BRGsOPcT6qW7UCq5ek2W: This describes ICAO Class F airspace: IFR and VFR flights are permitted, IFR flights receive air traffic advisory service (not full ATC separation), and all flights receive flight information service if requested. Class E provides ATC service to IFR, not just advisory service.
BRW3D5rnBwGTfA873EBX: In procedure A the aeroplane holds take-off thrust and take-off configuration through the initial climb, reduces to climb thrust at the height specified for the procedure, continues at V2 + 10 to 20 kt, and only accelerates and retracts flap at 3000 ft. 3000 ft is therefore the ACCELERATION height, not the thrust reduction height; current PANS-OPS puts the thrust reduction at 800 ft, and no noise abatement procedure may begin below that.
BSBUNd95rhuxkN8iEIES: Additional circuits in a holding pattern require ATC approval. The pilot must advise ATC and receive approval before making more than one circuit, as additional holding affects traffic sequencing and spacing.
BSpvoPTkRmBgrdf6pQpr: The propelling nozzle is a convergent duct which converts the remaining pressure into velocity, so the gas leaves faster than at any other point in the engine. Inside, the axial velocity is deliberately kept low - lowest in the combustion chamber, where the flame must not be blown out.
BT4UmJx2XQM74y5fGiaZ: Two effects stack. A forward CG needs a larger nose-up balancing moment from the tail, which means a bigger tail DOWNLOAD, and the wing must generate the weight plus that download. Idle thrust removes the nose-up couple that a below-CG thrust line normally supplies, so the tail has to provide even more download. Forward CG with idle thrust therefore demands the greatest wing lift - and gives the highest stall speed.
BT5CeY0AWUXP89GTGsrY: TCAS traffic and advisories are presented either on the instantaneous vertical speed indicator, whose scale shows the vertical rates to fly and to avoid (3), or on an EFIS display, normally the navigation display with the traffic overlaid on the map (4). Both give the crew the vertical guidance an RA demands.
BTYOsgQRfp6AGZWMbsMS: Special VFR flights may be authorised without a functioning radio receiver within Class E airspace only, when ground visibility is not less than 1500 metres. In Classes C and D, two-way radio communication is always required.
BTg759lc78wh56LlkZHy: Mode 1 detects a descent rate excessive for the height above the ground and announces 'SINK RATE' as a caution, escalating to 'WHOOP WHOOP PULL UP' if it is not corrected. 'TERRAIN' belongs to Mode 2 and 'DON'T SINK' to Mode 3.
BVOkTxjK9Vv2od4CCs53: Losing an engine hurts twice over. The failed engine, unless feathered, windmills and adds substantial drag, and the asymmetric thrust must be balanced by rudder and a small bank, which adds further drag from the deflected surfaces and the sideslip. Both increase the power required from the remaining engine or engines at the very moment when less power is available.
BVOy7rXMufdcTsdqzqJI: If the reported RVR or visibility is below the applicable minima, the approach may not be continued beyond the outer marker or equivalent position, or below 1000 ft above the aerodrome where there is no outer marker. The rule fixes a definite commit point, so the decision to discontinue is made before the aeroplane is committed to the final segment.
BWQeo2jY7IHa6gkT9XwK: All four are correct. Some stress is necessary for optimum performance (1); every individual has a limit beyond which even a moderate workload cannot be handled (2); anxiety generates worry which is itself a stressor (3); and the brain's interpretation of a situation as a threat is what triggers the adrenaline release of the alarm reaction (4).
BXNI6j2oxJiyNxm9LBMd: A LIGHT following a MEDIUM on approach requires 3 minutes, the longest of the approach wake minima, because the light aeroplane has the least roll authority to resist a vortex. A MEDIUM or LIGHT following a HEAVY is separated by 2 minutes.
BYHvwhDvCUYhkN0dvWVe: The inner ply is a soft plastic - polycarbonate or stretched acrylic - which is tough rather than brittle, so it absorbs the energy of a bird strike and holds together instead of shattering into the cockpit. The heating film is laminated behind the outer ply, where it also keeps the glass above its brittle transition temperature.
BZ138PMjMC5fTjwCHkrI: The two fixes are on reciprocal radials of the same line, so the problem can be solved without the chart. Inverness to Aberdeen is 14 NM of latitude and 106.5 minutes of longitude at 57.4N, which is 57 NM of departure, giving a total of about 59 NM. Subtracting the 20.5 NM and 10.5 NM DME ranges leaves 28 NM covered in 6 minutes, so the groundspeed is 280 kt.
BZ8BANDgP7qcQqnnAd00: ICAO Annex 1 credits co-pilot time at 50% towards the total flight time required for a higher grade of pilot licence. This is the ICAO standard; JAR-FCL allows 100% credit for MPA co-pilot time, which is a more generous provision.
BZdLWVS83qeGbUaDf1ys: The equation of time, the difference between apparent and mean solar time, reaches its extremes around mid-February at about -14 minutes and early November at about +16 minutes, and passes through zero four times a year. It is greatest when the obliquity and elliptical-orbit effects reinforce rather than cancel.
BZtbmGP87jMdeXuPdUeR: A take-off alternate for a twin must lie within one hour's flight time at the one-engine-inoperative cruising speed in still air. The scenario it covers is an engine failure at or after V1 with a return to the departure aerodrome impossible, so the speed used has to be the speed the aeroplane will actually have.
BadulEtdMC0PY0VqDGmg: The indicator shows how large the vibration is - its amplitude - after the accelerometer signal has been filtered to the frequency corresponding to the spool of interest, so that N1 and N2 imbalance can be told apart. The frequency is known already, being the spool speed; what the crew needs to know is whether the amplitude is rising.
BagQrXX42RianIXv7DPT: TCAS advisories are either corrective, requiring a change to the current vertical speed - climb, descend, or reduce the rate - or preventive, requiring only that the current vertical speed be maintained or a range avoided. TCAS never commands a change of heading or of airspeed.
BaoxibwhIVL95QGO6B5N: Each GPS satellite carries four atomic clocks, normally two caesium and two rubidium, with the others as spares. BbBnhbS6WbfZkgK7wUvD: Bypass ratio is cold flow divided by core flow. With 220 kg/s entering and 200 kg/s bypassing, only 20 kg/s goes through the core, giving 200/20 = 10:1 - a very high bypass ratio typical of a modern large turbofan.
BbkF4Zt01kzwTfiB48gi: The capsule is fed static pressure directly while the case is fed the same pressure through a calibrated leak, so the case lags behind. The pressure difference across the capsule is therefore a measure of how fast the static pressure is changing - which is rate of climb or descent.
BbtxWjkQmZvgMJBpFqRD: The third climb segment is the level acceleration segment, in which the aeroplane accelerates from V2 to the flap retraction speed while retracting flap. Regulations set a minimum acceleration height of 400 ft above the take-off surface, so the aeroplane must have completed the second segment climb to at least that height before levelling off. Noise abatement procedures may raise it, but never lower it.
BcaCWSaAViWkESEVtVBq: A propeller aeroplane's fuel flow is broadly proportional to POWER, and power required is drag times speed - so maximum range means minimum drag, which is (L/D)max. For propeller maximum ENDURANCE the target is minimum power, which is slower still.
BeTF2GnIQXlW70N36xfs: A fusible plug in the wheel melts at a set temperature and lets the tyre deflate in a controlled way, so an overheated brake cannot burst the tyre and throw debris. It protects the tyre, not the brake, which is why hot brakes are approached with caution from fore and aft rather than from the side.
BeTuDDq8F2yo8LNiK11Z: Pressure falls exponentially, not linearly, so a given altitude change costs more pressure low down than high up: about 1 hPa per 27 ft near sea level, but far more feet per hPa in the stratosphere. Bfxuczqc4MgSH2kyzvrl: ICAO Doc 4444 states that the preparation and dissemination of ATIS messages is the responsibility of the air traffic services unit. The meteorological office provides the weather data, but ATS compiles and broadcasts the complete ATIS message.
BgBhNBer3nzknjCbOdDT: Capacitive reactance is inversely proportional to frequency, so raising the frequency lowers the reactance and, for a given applied voltage, allows more current to flow. An inductive circuit behaves the opposite way, which is the basis of frequency-dependent filtering.
BgMnlrMwHiSqP2hNKGwc: ICAO Annex 2 Appendix 2 requires an intercepted aircraft to immediately attempt contact on the VHF emergency frequency 121.5 MHz and the UHF emergency frequency 243 MHz. These are the internationally designated distress and emergency frequencies.
BgepIO7QTSfJGA3H04mh: An AC generator's output has two components: the real power that does work, and the reactive power associated with the phase difference between voltage and current. BhQbl7JSYmePo68NY1f8: Chart convergence on a Lambert is exact only at the parallel of origin, so a great circle drawn on the sheet bows towards that parallel: it is a curve concave to the parallel of origin. A rhumb line is concave to the pole. Over short and medium distances the great circle is close enough to a straight line to be flown as one.
BhdOYGDqBgs87cUNSCMS: The torque link resists rotation of the wheels about the leg, so it is loaded whenever the gear is being twisted. Taxiing round a tight turn scrubs the bogie sideways and applies exactly that twisting moment continuously - a much larger and more sustained torsional load than a landing or braking produces.
BhgUCffuXBRfJNYQweVm: Feeder fault protection is a differential system: it compares the current leaving the generator with the current arriving at the bus, and any imbalance means current is escaping to earth somewhere in the feeder. That imbalance is detected as a difference in the flux produced by the two windings on the detector.
BhjDxdiu7nfXFdhRSKbX: Turning right to allow for drift means the drift is to the left, so the wind is coming from the aircraft's right. With the wind on the aircraft's right beam, backing into the wind puts the low ahead of the aircraft. (In the northern hemisphere the low would be behind.)
BidUuvEBbU05I4U2hJo3: With the static source blocked the pressure in the instrument case and capsule is trapped, so there is no longer any difference between them however the aircraft climbs or descends. The vertical speed indicator therefore falls back to zero and stays there, which is why a blocked static shows up as a VSI that will not move.
BikanX9nxWxdJJO3jIEL: The MEL is prepared by the OPERATOR from the manufacturer's MMEL, approved by the Authority, and it lives in the Operations Manual as a crew document. The Flight Manual is an aircraft document approved for the type and is not where operator dispatch relief is recorded.
BjJqvVRrj0ebTXca5kdO: Attenuation is the progressive weakening of a signal as it travels, from the spreading of the wavefront and from absorption and scattering along the path. Refraction is bending, ducting is trapping in a layer, and propagation is the travelling itself.
BjkJFfQtEPpgimz9Vz1M: All four steps belong to conflict resolution: the conflict must first be recognised and admitted rather than ignored (1), each party must state what he expects of the other (2) and his own position (4), and the parties must then look for the ground they can agree on (3). Skipping the first step is the commonest failure, since an unacknowledged conflict simply goes underground.
BjuRaPDtn4IGFvlJXG8B: A SAS failure degrades handling but does not endanger the aircraft immediately, so it is a caution rather than a warning: an amber annunciation tells the crew that the augmentation has dropped out and that the aeroplane must be flown accordingly. Red would imply immediate action, which is not the case.
Bk4nBdQd9VAGrfAaWKVW: Actively looking for the cues that would indicate a situation developing is exactly what maintains situational awareness: awareness includes projecting the current state forward, not merely perceiving it. Far from distracting from flying the aircraft, it is what allows a problem to be caught while there is still time and capacity to deal with it.
BlCVFscoY0j4zKcPqns2: The switch works by earthing the magneto's primary circuit to stop it. BmxHcuR21BR9R26POT41: A single-acting actuator has fluid on one side of the piston only: pressure drives it one way and a spring, or the load itself, returns it. It is simpler and lighter than a double-acting unit but the return is uncontrolled, which limits it to applications where that does not matter.
Bnrvrl9qCoP3FUL2YO71: A float gauge is simple to make and install (1), and where the indication is taken by a ratiometer - which compares two currents rather than measuring one - the reading is unaffected by supply voltage variation (2) and largely unaffected by temperature (4). Statement 3 claims the same immunity for a galvanometer, which measures a single current and is therefore affected by supply changes.
Bnw8CFO2tjdEWi3Y6v91: FL370 is below FL410, where levels are separated by 1000 ft in RVSM, so the contingency offset level is 500 ft above or below the assigned level - it puts the aeroplane midway between the levels others are using. Above FL410 the vertical minimum is 2000 ft, so the offset there is 1000 ft.
BoGkkpBDbBNYB1BMzRMc: Fine motor control is among the first functions to suffer from alcohol, and measurable loss of coordination on delicate, precise tasks appears from about 0.05% blood alcohol - well below the level at which the drinker feels impaired and below most driving limits. Judgement and self-criticism are affected at lower levels still, which is why no positive level is acceptable for flying.
BoNYmSC8CGWKL3AxhCg8: A Krueger flap is a leading edge device: a panel hinged at its forward edge which folds out and down from the lower surface to increase camber and the stalling angle. It is used where a slat would be impractical - typically inboard, though the definition does not depend on spanwise position.
BoSjgp2IHfaLp82aBOYv: Above FL410 the vertical separation minimum is 2000 ft, so the contingency offset is 1000 ft - half the interval - which places the aeroplane between the levels other traffic is using. The 500 ft offset belongs below FL410, where the levels are 1000 ft apart.
Bpw0umw1ElSPdxMRjPaT: A straight line on a polar stereographic chart has a constant GRID track, so work through the vertex. The route runs west, so at the highest latitude, at 035W, the true track is 270 and the grid track is 270 + 35 = 305 (north polar, grid on Greenwich: grid = true + west longitude). At B, longitude 102W, the true track is 305 - 102 = 203.
BqIF6BIZAmmtpGCrTvhh: The communications management unit is the router for data link: it takes messages from the FMS (2) and from the crew through the MCDU (3) and sends them by whichever radio is appropriate - VHF, HF or Satcom (4) - choosing the medium automatically. The flight director has no part in it.
BqZ1e7OjxiDVR241BZap: The immediate response to an acute stressor is the alarm reaction of Selye's General Adaptation Syndrome: adrenaline is released, heart rate and blood pressure rise, blood is redirected to the muscles and attention sharpens - the body mobilises resources to deal with the threat. The falling-away of resources belongs to the later exhaustion phase, after prolonged exposure.
BqsEnvbUJXO8RfdNKqpa: Time available is the dominant constraint on cockpit decision making: with time in hand the crew can gather information, generate options and evaluate them, whereas under time pressure the analysis is truncated and a recognition-primed, rule-based response is used instead. Habits and routines play a large part, the situation can be reassessed as it develops, and deciding means selecting one option, not several.
BrhPBTE1cNKswuad4ra4: The head up display projects flight guidance - attitude, speed, flight path vector and a director - onto a combiner at infinity focus in the pilot's forward field of view, so it can be flown without looking inside. Bs3qLbIzaci4hG98J84Z: Mode 1 gives a two-stage alert: 'SINK RATE' as a caution when the descent rate is excessive for the height (3), escalating to the 'PULL UP' warning if it is not corrected (4). 'TERRAIN' belongs to Mode 2 and 'DON'T SINK' to Mode 3.
BsQBLLwDUvw6vKENngQi: A synapse is the junction at which one neurone passes a signal to the next, normally by releasing a chemical transmitter across a narrow gap. BsUTY5xVIX2fNqjFMgZD: The wind from 035 is only 6 degrees off the nose of the 029 heading, so it is almost a pure headwind: the groundspeed drops from 250 to about 205 kt with barely 1 degree of drift, and that drift is to the left because the wind is slightly on the starboard bow.
BsiPTqe3lNB7cAgjhXzC: A Bourdon tube is a flattened, curved tube which straightens as the pressure inside rises, and that movement drives the pointer. It is used for the higher pressures of hydraulic and fuel systems; temperature is measured with thermocouples or resistance bulbs.
Bt0REVYs4aE4tjzN92MD: ICAO Doc 8168 considers a straight-in approach acceptable for a non-precision approach when the angle between the final approach track and the runway centreline is 30 degrees or less. Beyond 30 degrees, a circling approach is required.
Buks8mNbDOkaSgfvRggg: The Second Freedom of the Air is the right to land in another state for a technical stop (refuelling, maintenance, or crew change) without embarking or disembarking passengers or cargo commercially. The First Freedom is the right to overfly without landing.
Bw6JPhUEaOfUN8JhQ38M: At a constant flight level the static pressure is fixed, and holding CAS constant fixes the dynamic pressure. BwVILDtswVNahqEdZNKn: JAR-OPS 1.235 requires that the noise abatement procedure specified for any one aeroplane TYPE be the same at every aerodrome. BxkfJvHnNKEGIygbLyAA: The light monitors the locks, not the position: it comes on whenever a reverser door is unlocked, which is exactly the condition that would matter in flight. It illuminates normally as the reversers are selected on landing and extinguishes when they are stowed and relocked.
ByboNUdTmmhZqic9bOCd: As a filter clogs, the pressure drop across it rises, and at a set figure a differential pressure switch releases the pop-out button. Byf4cq19zrh8B6RbCl8B: The hottest parts are the flame tube of the combustion chamber and the nozzle guide vanes and first stage blades immediately behind it, which see the full gas temperature while being loaded by centrifugal force. BytrsXzvVJFfliWRrRVq: A resolution advisory is issued when the time to closest approach falls below the threshold that defines a genuine collision threat, typically about 25 seconds. A traffic advisory comes earlier, at about 40 seconds, for traffic that merits attention but is not yet a threat.
ByuJOkub4wTXkj0ji7wx: Bleed air is taken from an intermediate compressor stage in normal operation, with the high pressure valve opening only when the intermediate pressure is inadequate at low power. C2RBBLc3ezlzNmddsI0S: A base turn is a turn executed during the initial approach between the end of the outbound track and the beginning of the intermediate or final approach track, where the tracks are not reciprocal. A procedure turn has reciprocal tracks, and a racetrack uses a holding pattern.
C2nJNJwvpEEaKx4kJHW3: An open circuit is a break in the path, so no current can flow and the component simply does not work. C2uEXgVeDsgHv7PDgTmp: The physical signs of hypoxia are dangerous, but what kills is that the earliest effects are euphoria and a loss of judgement and self-criticism. C3VRkJgbBkJkAW9ZVfEK: In PANS-OPS (ICAO Doc 8168), DER stands for Departure End of Runway. It is the end of the runway surface suitable for take-off and is the reference point from which obstacle clearance surfaces for departures begin.
C4wfxX1Aqw554q2yw67W: Gyro drift is what limits an unaided inertial system: a tiny error in the sensed attitude tilts the accelerometer frame, so a component of gravity is integrated as acceleration and the position error grows with time. C5i4BbuApV9zbCNZSgvc: Boost pumps deliver tens of pounds per square inch - enough to hold the feed line pressure comfortably above the fuel's vapour pressure at altitude and to supply the engine-driven pump with a positive inlet head. The very high pressures are produced further downstream by the engine's own high pressure fuel pump.
C6CectCZJ23F10rRKjco: A magneto builds a magnetic field with a low voltage primary current, then breaks that current abruptly with the contact breaker. The collapsing field induces a very high voltage in the many-turn secondary winding, and the distributor delivers it to the appropriate plug.
C6ShrDKiUxklZOKOflAo: ICAO Doc 4444 specifies 5 minutes longitudinal separation for aircraft departed from the same aerodrome on the same track when the preceding aircraft maintains a TAS at least 20 kt faster than the following aircraft. C6m7xlGHnkQHlLcEuxxL: A weak mixture burns slowly and continues burning as the piston descends, so heat is delivered to the cylinder walls and exhaust valve for longer instead of being converted into work. C7YkC9UhRiBWzmYRS6J8: Under FAR 91.211, passengers need not be provided supplemental oxygen below 14,000 ft pressure altitude (cabin altitude). Between 12,500 and 14,000 ft for more than 30 minutes, only the crew requires oxygen. Above 14,000 ft, passengers must be provided oxygen.
C7tlpRRSTYKmTGfIiXEz: Geocentric latitude is measured from the earth's centre and geodetic latitude from the normal to the ellipsoid surface. C9Zoje1T77E4v0C2qq1a: Cold oil is thick, so it takes higher pressure to force it through the galleries and the relief valve may be at its stop. C9dDbvWPeh2VO4s7LpAj: In ICAO Class B airspace above 3050 m (10,000 ft) AMSL, VMC minima are 8 km visibility with 1500 m horizontal and 1000 ft vertical distance from clouds. The 'clear of clouds' provision applies only below 10,000 ft in Class B.
CA4xwRX7qKTxOiyMSDDx: Traffic load is what is left of the permitted take-off mass once the aeroplane and everything needed to operate it, including its fuel, has been accounted for - so it is the allowed take-off mass minus the operating mass. CAEkXsw7tfvbpFCRoyy7: The units must be reconciled first. 83 Imperial gallons at 4.55 litres is 377 litres, which is 377 / 3.78 = about 100 US gallons. CAOxmEh6KrnO9bbImUlB: Amber or yellow indicates a caution: a condition requiring immediate crew awareness and subsequent corrective action, but not immediate action. Red is reserved for warnings needing immediate action, and green, white, cyan or magenta carry advisory and status information.
CDOhe9VwVv0by7Mz0foY: Altitude alerting works against the altitude selected in the flight control panel: it gives an advance alert as the aircraft approaches the level and a further alert if the aircraft subsequently departs from it. CDainbVhjj3fPSi0cgfU: A constant speed propeller is worked by engine oil: the governor meters boosted oil to a piston in the hub which acts against a spring and the blades' own counterweights. That is why a loss of oil pressure makes the propeller default to a fixed pitch determined by the springs.
CDwNR0qKMwmXEKUZHDSF: 7500 signals unlawful interference, i.e. hijack. Learn the trio together: 7500 unlawful interference, 7600 radio communication failure, 7700 general emergency. Code 2000 is the conspicuity code for entering from an area where SSR was not required.
CEJegrvEJWc76lyUE9Ka: In Class E airspace, VFR flights receive traffic information as far as practical, and no ATC clearance is required. IFR flights receive ATC service and separation from other IFR flights in Class E, but VFR flights operate freely with only information service.
CEsDfuybpH0PRSpZXGKJ: The packs supply a substantially fixed mass flow, so the only variable available for controlling cabin pressure is how fast air is allowed out. CGdcIKvHqcUnCoB8lJwM: A fire warning must be impossible to miss whatever the crew are looking at, so the detection system drives both a visual indication - the fire warning light and the master warning - and an aural alert, the fire bell. Either alone could go unnoticed at the wrong moment.
CIU4UhWDhy4h8jK2pS4z: The earth distance is 10 x 60 x cos65 = 600 x 0.4226 = 254 NM = 469 600 m = 46 960 000 cm. Scale = 9.5 / 46 960 000, which is about 1 : 4 900 000, so approximately 1 : 5 000 000.
CJ6eP7aAWUfCQR4T539Y: At least one extinguisher is required in the flight crew compartment, and for a maximum approved seating configuration of 7-30 seats one more is required in the passenger compartment. Two in the passenger compartment become necessary only from 31 seats.
CJCAwvMMMuXmrbmTXech: Fuel in the wings produces a bending relief which opposes the lift, so the wing root bending moment is greatest when the wing is dry and all the load is in the fuselage. The maximum zero fuel mass is the limit on that condition, and it is therefore a wing root strength limit.
CK9OGmm4sCphyH0shWJA: The communications management unit routes data link traffic, so it connects to the radios that can carry it - HF (2), VHF (4) and Satcom (5) - and to the MCDU through which the crew composes and reads messages (3). The EGPWS has no data link function.
CKHh22MiTtrGOjt3BWv3: At -45C the local speed of sound is 38.94 x root(228) = about 588 kt, so Mach 0.75 is a TAS of about 441 kt. Groundspeed out is 441 + 10 = 451 kt and home is 441 + 35 = 476 kt. CKKdctFj6XErurYrh3fE: Expired air contains about 4-5% carbon dioxide against the 0.03% inhaled, since CO2 is the waste product being cleared. CKalDeWgeSpxgSz5glGI: A subsonic intake is a divergent duct: the flow slows through it and its kinetic energy is converted into static pressure - the ram rise. CLPjFgjJHg3Ng2QVfkSs: A cold air pool (cut-off low) is a mass of cold air aloft, often with little or no signature on the surface chart. Because it is cold aloft over relatively warmer air below, the lapse rate is steep and it brings instability, showers and thunderstorms.
CM3MKYX27hQtWCDPF7Zg: All three conditions are required together, and they are cumulative rather than alternatives. CM580hrgxblueyRM8GjC: QFE is the pressure at aerodrome level, so it is QNH reduced by the pressure equivalent of the aerodrome elevation. At about 27 ft per hPa, 1411 ft is 1411 / 27 = 52 hPa. CNwjgKWc58GQnS5B0g0X: Take-off performance depends on air density, and a high elevation and a tropical afternoon both reduce it - so the aeroplane will be limited by what it can achieve on the runway and in the climb rather than by any structural or fuel limit. CO5hmppvdyY5gNXLZCEd: An altitude alerting system must at least give the crew warning as the aircraft approaches the pre-selected altitude, so that the level-off is not missed, and a further alert if the aircraft subsequently deviates from it. CO9AcyAoPl9TJVkYlDFL: The platform is kept level continuously, not merely during alignment, because the accelerometers must stay horizontal for the navigation solution to be valid (3). COYtKlZwRCBYWMYGGJoY: Near an aerodrome, vertical position at or below the transition altitude is expressed as altitude above mean sea level (on QNH). At or above the transition altitude, the pilot sets standard pressure and reports flight levels.
COuM6uM5Y2qNuhrNcPrO: Autothrottle and autopilot modes are annunciated together in the flight mode annunciator across the top of the primary flight display, so a single glance shows what the automatics are doing in thrust, pitch and roll. CPjFtns5duBhI2ndg1xO: Fluid is essential, since dehydration degrades performance and is easy to reach in a dry cabin - but the drink should be still rather than carbonated, because the dissolved gas will expand as cabin pressure falls and produce abdominal distension and discomfort. CQcxRMOfynPi5WHb09xp: At the magnetic poles the earth's field is entirely vertical, so a freely suspended needle stands vertical and the horizontal component that drives a compass is zero. CQuwNiZjm7QYGKVC8CCg: The DME range closes 15 NM in 3 minutes, so the groundspeed along the radial is 300 kt. The remaining 105 NM then takes 105/300 = 21 minutes from 10:03, giving 10:24. Take the ETA from the time of the SECOND reading, not from 10:00.
CR7DDmdOxk412hFyYeJU: Automatic pitch trim runs the stabiliser continuously while the autopilot is engaged so that the elevator is left streamlined, which means the aeroplane is in trim at the moment of disconnect and the pilot takes over with no residual force on the column.
CRD8XXpj1s9RHrDRW1b1: In the AIP structure with separate sections (AGA, COM, MET, FAL, MAP, RAC, SAR), meteorological service information for areas and routes is published in the MET section. In the current three-part AIP (GEN/ENR/AD), this information is in GEN 3.5.
CRHGTcQ2fkPCCaPzJvNk: Acceleration errors appear on east and west headings and reverse between the hemispheres. In the southern hemisphere acceleration produces an apparent turn to the south and deceleration one to the north - the mirror image of the northern hemisphere's ANDS.
CRHJdgw76czeDnsmf1tO: Both statements are correct. The gust load increment is proportional to the wing's lift curve slope, and a higher aspect ratio gives a steeper lift curve slope, so the same gust produces a bigger change in lift and a larger load factor. And the increment is directly proportional to airspeed, so flying faster in turbulence increases the load - which is exactly why a turbulence penetration speed is published and flown.
CRHeDZQaP58RSvwExSMf: One of the main objectives of ICAO, as stated in the Chicago Convention, is to develop the principles and techniques of international air navigation and foster the planning and development of international air transport. ICAO does not approve airlines or set ticket prices.
CRNPD1TV1MDbX9raHPsP: ICAO Doc 4444 requires pilots to squawk IDENT only when requested by ATC. Unsolicited IDENT transmissions can cause confusion and interfere with radar identification procedures.
CRTZwPDbQomjHCDy26Oz: An airspeed indicator is calibrated using the compressible-flow relationship at standard sea level density, so once instrument and position errors have been removed it reads calibrated airspeed. It has no way of knowing the actual density, which is why converting to true airspeed remains the pilot's or the air data computer's job.
CRczYGMHBazxLYqzNgl4: Fail-operational means the system has enough redundancy to carry on after a single failure: the approach, flare and landing are still completed automatically. A fail-passive system merely disconnects safely, leaving the crew to land manually or go around.
CRrMt88yKbfB7raTpJHb: The tropopause marks the top of the troposphere, where the steady decrease of temperature with height comes to an end and gives way to isothermal conditions and then, higher in the stratosphere, a temperature increase. CS54TCLMlgcISDJjCHxd: Two things forbid this boarding. The certificate limits the aeroplane to eight occupants including the pilot, and one crew member plus six adults plus two children makes nine. Beyond that, children of 5 and 6 are not infants: each requires their own seat and their own restraint, so sharing a seat and a belt is not an option in any case.
CS8VftMVIB2vjJSbPC6i: On a Lambert the cone cuts the sphere at the two standard parallels, where the scale is exact. CSrt2VLjbOLaZFXwgGz6: During a sustained spin the fluid in the semicircular canals catches up with the canal and the sensation of rotation dies away. This is the somatogyral illusion behind the graveyard spin.
CTh4IneM9OJ7298pLWqN: The ICAO Standard Atmosphere is defined at mean sea level by a pressure of 1013.25 hPa (29.92 inHg), a temperature of 15 C and a density of 1.225 kg/m3, with temperature falling at 1.98 C per 1000 ft to the tropopause at 36,090 ft. It is the reference against which all altimeters, flight levels and aircraft performance data are calibrated.
CUHwJgC3Ov8lMiSMk63x: A landing aeroplane generates vortices until its wheels touch, so the contaminated air lies on the approach path SHORT of its touchdown point. Departing behind it, you want to be airborne before that point and climbing above the preceding approach path; rotating beyond it puts you into the wake.
CUPjs9ZRQpQOZmDbBfvD: A repetitive flight plan may be filed for flights operated regularly on at least 10 occasions, or daily over at least 10 consecutive days, with the same basic details each time. It saves filing an individual flight plan for every operation of a scheduled service.
CUQCk7aknPo4oWGKqfSy: Full Authority Digital Engine Control - full authority because the electronics have complete control of fuel scheduling with no mechanical back-up, which is what allows the engine to be operated precisely at its limits and its life to be managed automatically.
CUjp1YeM8zNBAq2WkYDs: Convert the speed to the same units: 194 kt is 194 x 6076 / 60, about 19,650 ft/min. The gradient is then 1000 / 19,650 = 5.1%.
