Note the useful rule: 1 degree is approximately a 1.75% gradient.
CUlyNNXxtCUTjrYBQswT: The probe is fitted to one nominated cylinder, the one known from development testing to run hottest because of its position in the cooling airflow. Monitoring the worst case is what makes a single reading useful; an average would hide the cylinder that is actually in trouble.
CUyll6sXP3R5IZIHLNVM: Command brings new roles, new responsibilities and a new set of expectations from others, and the individual's self-concept has to be reworked to accommodate them. That adjustment is a real psychological process and is the reason command courses deal with leadership and self-perception, not only with technical differences. Authority itself does not confer professionalism, nor does status simply stabilise the self-image.
CVoV0U8cOUw6GukpZw9w: Decompression sickness is prevented by keeping the pressure up and the dissolved nitrogen down: avoid cabin altitudes above 18,000 ft, where the risk becomes real (1), keep cabin altitude below 8,000 ft in normal high-level flight (2), and pre-breathe 100% oxygen to wash nitrogen out of the tissues before and during exposure (4). CW508DVxB5LbRdect7k8: Turn radius = V2 / (g tan(bank)) and rate of turn = g tan(bank) / V - neither expression contains mass, so two aeroplanes at the same TAS and bank angle fly identical turns regardless of weight. CWHsFfmTiqMJofYiyjJ8: The red port and green starboard navigation lights each cover 110 degrees, from dead ahead to 20 degrees behind the beam on their own side. The white tail light covers the remaining 140 degrees, and 110 + 110 + 140 accounts for the full 360.
CWVHlYl6YwmwkFMKZ2RE: At FL240 the aeroplane is below both thresholds that would trigger the other two requirements: quick-donning masks become mandatory above 25 000 ft, and first-aid oxygen is required only above FL250. CWlC68UCxzDfNkZMeC3P: Under the JAR-25 EFIS colour code, magenta is reserved for SELECTED data: the selected heading bug, selected course, selected altitude and the active flight plan leg. CWuSNGl1endGMZN33llP: Latitude is the angle at the earth's centre between the plane of the equator and the line to the position, measured 0 to 90 north or south. The angle between the prime meridian and the meridian of the position is LONGITUDE, which is the trap in the first option.
CWuUBrPNIaoWHqqsmesh: The rule is three take-offs and three landings within the preceding 90 DAYS, in an aeroplane of the type or in an approved flight simulator of that type. 30 days is not a JAR-OPS recency interval, and a count of 'flights' is not the same as take-offs and landings.
CXN3A9THCzEsaFDUFwaO: The cumulus, or building, stage is defined by updraughts throughout the cell, drawing in warm moist air and lifting the growing cloud, with no precipitation yet reaching the ground. CYGN7kbIIO00kMHRQD8s: An accumulator is a gas-charged vessel connected to the pressure line, so it absorbs the pressure pulses from the pump and the surges caused by a service operating, smoothing what the rest of the system sees. CYJus0N0VgeGRKdkdELt: Reading letters and numbers demands the fine resolution that only the closely packed cones of the fovea provide, over about one degree of the visual field. CYWR5VErGGJ7Wbzjk9wc: Flight envelope protection keeps the aeroplane within its own aerodynamic and structural limits by limiting what the control laws will allow the pilot to command - angle of attack, bank, pitch, load factor and speed. CYu4vyFMZ4vbxdUu0D7p: Windshear recovery is not a matter of small corrections. CYxlhBqDzJsZlwgjlHuN: ICAO standard vertical separation below FL 290 is 1000 ft. Above FL 290, the standard is 2000 ft (or 1000 ft in RVSM airspace). The 1000 ft minimum ensures safe vertical clearance between IFR aircraft.
CZ7Nv0sLfocT6mEoidiS: Combustion takes a roughly fixed time, so as engine speed rises the piston travels further during it. CZCxNXbJsB6KYKj5EcBz: Above 13 000 ft cabin pressure altitude, 100% of the passengers must be supplied for the entire flight time - no percentage and no grace period. Between 10 000 and 13 000 ft only 10% need be supplied, and then only after the first 30 minutes.
Ca2NZHio4KNS2txVqEys: With the static blocked the trapped static pressure is too low for the descent, while the pitot continues to sense the rising total pressure. CaA4j5beNUI9CxKHsYvY: The centre of gravity is the single point at which the whole weight of the body may be taken to act, so that the moments of all the individual masses about it sum to zero. It is not necessarily the datum, which is an arbitrary reference chosen for convenience.
CbApgNX2nwTueqO8WS5L: Fear and anxiety increase respiratory rate and depth beyond metabolic need, which is hyperventilation. The resulting fall in carbon dioxide produces dizziness, tingling, visual disturbance and muscular spasm - symptoms that resemble hypoxia and that tend to increase the anxiety that caused them.
CbcwtiU2VVODuuYMBnZP: Workload is the relationship between the demand of the situation and the resources available to meet it, so it depends on the situation itself, on the pilot's expertise - which determines how much of the task runs automatically and how much spare capacity remains - and on the ergonomics of the system, which sets how much effort the interface itself costs.
CbniL4YjsRZ26SLOggpR: All four matter. CbpyE6F9NwIpAaxFc4AA: The two fluids do opposite jobs. Cd3tGtBTVcroKZ85qRJd: When an intercepted aircraft has radio contact with the interceptor but cannot communicate in a common language, ICAO Annex 2 Appendix 2 specifies the phrase 'CAN NOT' to indicate inability to comply with instructions. This is one of the standard interception phraseologies.
CdCr7Q51e7XmhccPkkgB: ICAO Doc 7030 recommends that the transition altitude should be as low as possible but normally not less than 3000 ft above aerodrome elevation. This ensures adequate separation between aircraft using QNH and those on standard pressure.
CdOxWj8SD5NuNwHr63oG: A rate gyro has one degree of freedom and its precession is opposed by a spring, so its deflection measures a rate - which is what a turn indicator or turn coordinator needs. Directional gyros and artificial horizons must hold a fixed reference in space, so they use two degrees of freedom.
CdnskmdaXURwEdniQEJJ: The question asks specifically for physical stimuli - stressors acting on the body from the physical environment or from bodily state. Noise (1), temperature (3) and hunger (5) qualify. Interpersonal conflict and administrative problems are equally real stressors but they are psychological or social in origin, not physical.
CdoUnfQV6MJQfjqt0tAV: The low-range radio altimeter used for approach and flare works around 4.3 GHz, which is a wavelength of about 7 cm - centimetric. That short wavelength allows a small aerial and the precision of a couple of feet that the flare requires.
Cedq9X7YBx7kJpK0jhiy: One knot is one nautical mile per hour, and one nautical mile is 1.852 km, so 25 kt is 25 x 1.852 = 46 km/h, roughly 45. The quick mental conversion is to double the knots and subtract about 10 percent: 25 becomes 50, less 5, giving 45.
CeqTM88PWVqr1XqHlMOT: For a turbojet at the planning stage, the landing distance required must not exceed 60% of the landing distance available on a dry runway - so multiply the LDA by 0.60. Expressed the other way round, the demonstrated landing distance is factored UP by 1/0.6 = 1.67. Turboprops get the less demanding 0.70, and a wet runway adds a further 15% to the required distance.
CfPhxKGSurT2yyAnGOZQ: The regulator decides what the wearer receives: pure oxygen when 100% is selected (2), air diluted with oxygen on an altitude schedule on NORMAL (3), delivered on demand as he inhales (4), and under positive pressure in the emergency setting (5). Reducing the bottle pressure and the cabin altitude warning are separate functions elsewhere.
CgBYf59EPlAXG5rVbiSS: Under the Chicago Convention (Article 24), aircraft admitted temporarily free of customs duty should be allowed to remain for a period established by that State. However, some exam sources cite 12 hours based on specific regulatory interpretations.
CgZeyAikIMxmeDFgSjN1: A good briefing is short and precise (3) and pitched so that the other crew member actually understands it (4), and it follows a standard pattern so both pilots know what is coming and what is being left out (2). Statement 1 is the classic error: an exhaustive briefing buries the two or three points that matter and is not retained.
ChUgnI274QqCyjvKfM1W: Decision height belongs to a precision approach, where the glide path gives a vertical reference and the decision is taken at a HEIGHT on that path. Non-precision and circling procedures have no vertical guidance, so they use a minimum descent altitude or height - a level you may descend to and hold, not a point at which you must decide.
CiLgvn6KbzqbuVV9FE2I: JAR-FCL 1 defines instructor categories as: FI(A) (Flight Instructor), TRI(A) (Type Rating Instructor), CRI(A) (Class Rating Instructor), IRI(A) (Instrument Rating Instructor) ratings, plus SFI (Synthetic Flight Instructor) and MCCI (Multi-Crew Cooperation Instructor) authorisations.
CjRADO6xBsaB7C33ZPrb: 1.5 inches is 3.81 cm, and at 1:1 000 000 that represents 3 810 000 cm = 38 100 m on the earth. Dividing by 1852 gives about 20.6 NM. A useful shortcut for a 1:1 000 000 chart: 1 cm is very nearly 5.4 NM.
CkCrlN7U6jiKTtGMLWzK: Manifold pressure is the absolute pressure in the induction manifold downstream of the throttle, close to the inlet valve - which is what actually determines how much charge enters the cylinder. Being absolute rather than gauge, it reads about 30 inches with the engine stopped at sea level.
CkG8LzScM6REzx2esBC4: With a fixed pitch propeller there is only one variable: engine speed. RPM therefore indicates power directly, which is why such an aeroplane has only a tachometer. A manifold pressure gauge becomes necessary as soon as a constant speed propeller allows RPM and manifold pressure to be set independently.
CkPD4ZES3vOmtzMhq5qV: A rate-one turn is 3 degrees per second, and rate of turn = g tan(bank)/V - so holding the rate fixed means the required bank angle depends entirely on TAS. The familiar rule of thumb follows: bank angle is roughly TAS in knots divided by 10, plus 7. Weight does not enter the turn equations at all, and load factor is itself a consequence of bank rather than an independent input.
CkrAHnqtxTh20SRjczdu: A higher compression ratio raises the temperature and pressure of the end gas, making spontaneous ignition more likely, so a fuel with greater resistance to detonation - a higher octane rating - is needed. Using a lower grade than specified is what produces detonation and rapid engine damage.
ClOmc0YPfcIGvROuvvqk: The total pressure lost across a normal shock rises very steeply with the Mach number ahead of it - the loss is negligible just above M1.0 but severe by M2. So an efficient intake keeps the shock weak, decelerating the flow gradually through a series of oblique shocks before a final weak normal shock, rather than allowing one strong shock at high Mach. A shock cannot exist at all below M1.0.
ClTgc3DkbGiDoHK7pasI: Long-term memory has effectively unlimited capacity and holds material for a lifetime, so neither storage time nor quantity is the constraint. What fails is retrieval: material that is not periodically recalled becomes progressively harder to access, which is why recency requirements and regular practice of emergency drills exist.
ClXyLlkSsBOeGnF7XumE: EGPWS adds functions built on the terrain database and GPS position: the terrain clearance floor, which guards against landing short (2), look-ahead alerting for terrain along the flight path (4), and the terrain awareness display itself (5). Predictive windshear belongs to the weather radar and take-off configuration warning to a separate system.
ClpYv1ekJX5PUg9S5nZ0: V1 is the maximum speed at which the pilot must take the FIRST action to stop, and the minimum speed at which the take-off may be continued after a failure - and the aeroplane is still on the ground at that point. It is deliberately distinguished from VEF, the speed at which the engine actually fails: V1 is one reaction time LATER, which is what makes V1 a decision speed rather than a failure speed.
CltYz8aiiql0MwOOeEAl: JAR-OPS 1.135 lists what must be retained on the ground: a copy of the operational flight plan, copies of the relevant parts of the aeroplane technical log, route-specific NOTAM documentation issued by the operator, mass and balance documentation where required, and the special loads notification - statements 2, 3, 4 and 5. The day's weather and the performance charts are preparation material and are not on the retention list.
Cm5dOleeWcyYw8sRdkhJ: Ionospheric delay depends on frequency, so a receiver that tracks both L1 and L2 can measure the difference and compute the delay directly, removing the largest single GPS error. Tropospheric delay is almost frequency-independent and must be modelled instead, and receiver noise and multipath are local effects that dual frequency cannot remove.
CmWRJG9cfdxDy40CNfSM: Birds react to an approaching aeroplane far later than intuition suggests - the studies quoted put it at around two seconds before impact at typical take-off speeds. CmjjPZBJLDLDfIAySuVp: The three semicircular canals, set roughly at right angles to each other, sense angular acceleration in pitch, roll and yaw by the inertia of the fluid deflecting the cupula. The utricle and saccule sense linear acceleration and gravity, and the cochlea is the hearing organ.
CmnJ8EF8QoZyeX1NhUCE: A Facility Performance Category I ILS must provide accurate guidance from the coverage limit down to the point where the localiser course intersects the glide path at 60 m (200 ft) above the horizontal plane containing the threshold. Category II carries the guidance to 15 m (50 ft) and Category III down to and along the runway surface.
Cnd2dZ8oGe1N4C09SRNV: Circling minima by category: A is MDH 400 ft with 1500 m, B is MDH 500 ft with 1600 m, C is MDH 600 ft with 2400 m and D is MDH 700 ft with 3600 m. Category B therefore takes 500 ft and 1600 m.
CoBgH7qyaCFq9ySMAomK: The yaw damper must oppose the oscillation of Dutch roll without fighting a deliberate steady turn, so its input is high-pass filtered - it responds to a yaw rate that is changing rather than to one that is being held. A constant rate of turn washes out and produces no rudder demand.
CoQkM8Wfvi9UCZE89GzJ: Static air temperature is the true temperature of the undisturbed air the aircraft is flying through. What a probe actually senses is total air temperature, which includes the kinetic heating of bringing the air to rest, and the air data computer removes that ram rise to recover SAT.
CoYTyECxsynf3k1BkYjL: North of 70N the position reporting interval opens to every 20 degrees of longitude, because the meridians converge there and a 10-degree interval would give impractically short legs. South of 70N the interval is 10 degrees.
CoecRLPBfWNnUc1wpgYo: The flight crew system uses gaseous oxygen in high pressure cylinders, because the supply must be available immediately, must be usable repeatedly and must last for a long descent. Chemical generators, used for passengers, run once for a fixed period and cannot be shut off.
CogdfYhTLYEzcUl01pJB: Westward flight requires the body clock to be delayed, which suits its natural free-running period of slightly over 24 hours, so resynchronisation after an east-to-west flight takes less time than after the equivalent eastward flight. The usual working figure is roughly one day of adjustment per time zone crossed, faster westbound and slower eastbound.
CpAqNKa3eCeFNfoJd3ES: The obstacle limit of 4630 kg is below the estimated 5000 kg, so it is the obstacle case that must be improved. Less flap means less drag and therefore a better climb gradient, which raises the obstacle-limited mass - but less flap also means a longer ground run, which lowers the runway-limited mass. Selecting 5 degrees therefore trades runway limit for obstacle limit, and with 640 kg of runway margin in hand that is the trade to make.
CqfE4HZmN43Tk8HbTtXM: A bearing measured AT THE AIRCRAFT is converted with the variation at the AIRCRAFT, so magnetic bearing = 101.5 + 11 = 112.5 degrees. The 9W at the beacon would only be used if the question had asked for a radial or a bearing measured at the station, which is the distinction this pair of variations is testing.
CrjVJSsfDDhyQMQuq3K5: Apparent wander in azimuth is 15 x sine of the latitude degrees per hour, and the sine of zero is zero - so at the equator a directional gyro shows no apparent wander at all. It is greatest at the poles, where the earth's rotation is entirely about the local vertical.
CrqEoqoFDEEJ4vn2UJ8n: Bending the head down while the aircraft is turning brings a second pair of semicircular canals into the plane of rotation while the first pair is still responding. The brain reads the combination as violent tumbling in an entirely different axis - the Coriolis illusion - and it is powerful enough to cause loss of control. Nothing in the cockpit is worth retrieving during a turn in IMC.
CruvIRpHHNvaBh9Wa7Xf: Interpolate the table first: 21 11 S is about a tenth of the way from 20S to 30S, so sunrise is about 06:19 LMT. Crossing midnight into the next date is the whole point of the question.
CrzN7owrasDLcWsGBczP: The gyro holds its axis fixed in space while the earth turns beneath it, and how much of that rotation appears as apparent drift in azimuth depends on the vertical component of earth rate - 15 x sine of the latitude degrees per hour. Longitude has no effect whatever.
Csi804o360KoFm3SJ38T: Dynamic hydroplaning speed comes from tyre pressure: V in knots is about 9 times the square root of the pressure in psi. 8 bar is roughly 116 psi, and 9 x 10.8 gives about 97 kt, so the risk begins near 98 kt. CswncjxqVCq62bmeoQda: Work outwards in order. True heading = true track minus right drift = 070 - 10 = 060. Magnetic heading = true heading plus west variation = 060 + 30 = 090. Compass heading = magnetic heading minus deviation = 090 - (+1) = 089.
Ct4B2Srqy4Gh6K493KcM: EPR is the ratio of turbine discharge pressure to engine inlet pressure (Pt7/Pt2). Ice over the inlet probe makes the sensed Pt2 too low, so the ratio displayed is HIGHER than the engine is really producing. The crew then sets less thrust than they believe - the Air Florida 90 accident in 1982 - which is why engine anti-ice is required on the ground in visible moisture and why an EPR set on a snowy day is cross-checked against N1, fuel flow and EGT.
Ct5ARJ2W4huPlXlBiSqv: Water enters tanks as condensation from the moist air in the ullage space as it cools overnight, so the way to prevent it is to leave as little air space as possible - refuel to full at the end of the day. Draining after flight is good practice but does not stop the condensation forming.
CuThG9ua0yuHs44wOMZW: Alteration (including fraudulent alteration) of any airman certificate is grounds for revocation. Falsifying records is a serious offence that undermines the integrity of the certification system.
CuscVCfssuwfpoQgBEhp: Talking and listening consume attention from the same limited pool as flying and monitoring, so communication competes with the task in hand. This is why the sterile cockpit rule exists below 10,000 ft, why radio calls are the first thing to suffer at high workload, and why message length and clarity degrade exactly when the workload rises.
CvctrbZ3NfTaTHKRL5Yi: Heading for a long line feature turns an unknown position into a known position line: when the coastline, motorway or railway is reached the aircraft must be somewhere along it, and following it then leads to an identifiable feature. Reversing the heading or circling both consume fuel while adding no new information.
CwiK71l2dZZBfF4Nw359: Fail-passive means the failure is contained: the system disconnects without producing an out-of-trim condition or a significant deviation, but it can no longer land the aeroplane, so the landing must be completed manually or a go-around flown. Fail-operational systems complete the landing automatically after a single failure.
CxHW9a4Jhfi2mcUiTdF0: The number of hand extinguishers is scheduled against the approved passenger seating capacity, rising one at a time through the bands. Between 401 and 500 seats six are required, conveniently distributed through the cabin so that one is always within reach of any point.
CxY97s7Vq2ag4mOXPRWD: Hail requires updraughts strong enough to keep a growing stone suspended above the freezing level while it accretes successive layers of ice, and only cumulonimbus produces that. Nimbostratus is deep but has only gentle ascent, giving continuous rain or snow, while altocumulus and cirrostratus have neither the depth nor the vertical motion.
CyDQP3HsvaUvPUpoTRzD: A shock wave is a violent, irreversible compression: the flow decelerates abruptly and part of its ordered kinetic energy is converted into random thermal energy, raising the static temperature. That conversion is a loss of available energy, and it shows up as a drop in TOTAL pressure across the wave - which is the source of wave drag. Static pressure, density and temperature all RISE across the shock; only total pressure falls.
CyZ7BIiRCtAbpSY8Erl8: Dry operating mass is the aeroplane ready for a specific type of operation but with nothing to be carried and nothing to burn: it excludes usable fuel and traffic load but includes the crew, their baggage, catering, potable water and all removable equipment.
CzL4M0eG3CH5BMFe8Yh6: The two radials, 360 and 330, are symmetrical about 345, and the track of 255 is exactly 90 degrees from 345. The aircraft therefore crosses the pair symmetrically, so its distance from the station is the same at both times. Spotting that the track is the perpendicular bisector removes any need for calculation.
CzcfBGt2WJkf77fL2h5t: The rods contain rhodopsin, which is bleached by light and takes time to regenerate, so full dark adaptation needs about 30 minutes and is destroyed within seconds by a bright light. Once adapted the rods give high sensitivity but no colour and poor resolution, and because there are none in the fovea, a faint object at night is seen best by looking slightly to one side of it.
CzoqFwtkIcOcHAe9mXfP: Isolated from clocks and daylight the human body clock free-runs on a cycle of about 25 hours, slightly longer than the solar day. Daily zeitgebers - daylight, meals, social routine - normally entrain it to 24 hours, and it is the direction of that natural drift that makes a westward phase delay easier to adapt to than an eastward phase advance.
CzvYLz3SDsw4nwJnwNJi: Fatigue and stress raise the body's oxygen demand and reduce its capacity to compensate, so hypoxia sets in at a lower altitude and the time of useful consciousness is shorter. Together with smoking, alcohol, poor fitness and illness, they are why individual hypoxia tolerance is variable and why no single altitude figure applies to everyone on every day.
D0bigq0EM4lYsxAFTocq: PANS-RAC requires a report when the average TAS at cruising level differs from the flight plan by plus or minus 5 percent, or when an estimate for a reporting point, FIR boundary or destination is found to be in error by more than 3 minutes. Both thresholds exist so ATC's own estimates, and the separation built on them, stay valid.
D1N6s75FSd2q2bA9Pj60: The agonic line is the particular isogonal along which variation is zero, i.e. where true and magnetic north coincide. Any other line of equal variation is an isogonal, the aclinic line is the line of zero DIP, and an isotach is a line of equal wind speed.
D1sT4zabkSdqsQyGLcxP: The rule in the tropics is to consume only what has been cooked, peeled or sealed. Sealed bottled drinks are safe; ice cubes are made from local water and are not; raw vegetables and unpeeled fruit carry the same contamination as the water they were washed in. Gastrointestinal illness is the commonest cause of crew in-flight incapacitation, which makes this an operational matter and not merely a personal one.
D254c1VdReBqA68KjC7U: Night vision depends on the rods, so allow the 30 minutes they need to dark-adapt (1), avoid bright light which bleaches the pigment in seconds (4), and use off-centre viewing, since the fovea holds no rods and a dim object disappears when looked at directly (3). Statement 2 is the wrong way round - instrument lighting should be turned down, not up, to preserve adaptation.
D2G1leEgXrP7p7WwVZxl: Judging speed and distance on the ground depends on how fast the surface appears to stream past and on how far the eye is above it. A high flight deck makes the aircraft seem to be moving more slowly than it is, so taxi speed is habitually overestimated on small types and underestimated on large ones, and relative movement of other traffic adds a further false cue.
D32LfOLUyGMCjyeEya5M: Where no meteorological information is available for the destination, the operator must nominate TWO destination alternates. The rule is the same when the available forecast shows the destination below minima: with no usable forecast the destination is treated as unusable, and two alternates give the flight a genuine second option.
D3FNB4i7lQngUzH3tGq7: The MEL is a crew operating document and lives in the Operations Manual. The Flight Manual is an aircraft document approved for the type - it carries limitations and performance, not the operator's dispatch relief.
D3VdPQLzr8A7rSilysng: Rolling is rotation about the LONGITUDINAL axis, which runs from nose to tail through the centre of gravity, and it is controlled by the ailerons and roll spoilers. Pitching is rotation about the lateral axis (wingtip to wingtip) and yawing about the normal or vertical axis. There is no 'wing axis' in the standard set.
D3kXQ9za22ihUifZGAvx: On a typical aerofoil of moderate thickness the adverse pressure gradient is steepest toward the rear of the upper surface, so as the angle of attack increases the boundary layer first separates at the UPPER SURFACE TRAILING EDGE. The separation point then creeps forward with increasing alpha until it reaches the point where lift collapses - the gentle, progressive trailing-edge stall with good buffet warning. Thin aerofoils behave differently, stalling abruptly from the leading edge.
D3nB20GYsypgXQrWNVYO: Turning error arises from the vertical component of the earth's field acting on a magnet system that is free to tilt, and that component grows with magnetic latitude. It is therefore greatest near the magnetic poles - where a direct reading compass becomes unusable - and vanishes at the magnetic equator.
D4USFoANkIgXLbExoVYm: ICAO Annex 14 specifies that taxiway edge lights shall be fixed blue lights. This distinguishes them from runway edge lights (white) and other aerodrome lighting systems.
D6NXVUX8aQGwuv0RMzcy: In Class E airspace below 3050 m (10,000 ft) AMSL, IFR flights are subject to a speed limitation of 250 kt IAS. This standard speed restriction applies in most controlled and uncontrolled airspace below 10,000 ft.
D6vNX6Iov2kkiNzVBQoT: On a Mercator every parallel is drawn the same length, so 133 cm represents the whole 360 degrees. The 53N parallel is 21 600 x cos53 = about 13 000 NM long, giving a scale at 53N of about 1 : 18 100 000, and hence an equatorial scale of 18 100 000 / cos53 = about 1 : 30 000 000. At 30S the denominator becomes 30 000 000 x cos30 = about 26 000 000.
D6y50NgSS0yOAzrlgV4f: Acceleration integrated once gives velocity, and integrated twice gives distance. Groundspeed needs both axes combined.
D7ZZNYNnYSTtEevmR8Ov: The three semicircular canals respond to angular acceleration only: fluid inertia deflects the cupula when rotation starts or stops, but during a steady rate of turn the fluid catches up and the sensation dies away. That is why a prolonged turn feels like straight flight, and why rolling out then feels like a turn the other way.
D8W8Ly6eK79akCC1NT04: Wind shear is not confined to low level or to one plane. It occurs in the horizontal and the vertical, and at any altitude - the jet stream, a frontal surface, a temperature inversion and a mountain wave all produce it as readily as a thunderstorm outflow near the ground. Low-level shear simply matters most, because there is no height in which to recover.
D8bADXrSTw0iQhdqW1Rz: On the Holmes and Rahe life-change scale the death of a spouse or partner sits at the top with 100 units, ahead of divorce, separation, imprisonment and the death of a close family member. Accumulated life-change scores predict the likelihood of stress-related illness, which is why non-professional stressors are asked about in the aeromedical context.
D9XZNkPnCoNn1LwPuSbm: ICAO Annex 14 Aerodrome Reference Code letter E corresponds to aeroplane wing spans from 52 m up to but not including 65 m. This includes aircraft like the Boeing 747 and Airbus A340. Code letter F covers 65 m up to 80 m.
DAX4shnxomZAzDURn4ET: The wind from 110 is on the starboard beam of the 005 heading, so it pushes the aircraft left and adds a small tailwind component. Resolving the vectors gives a track of about 359 and a groundspeed of about 487 kt, i.e. about 6 degrees of port drift.
DAkpaTnnG82XSNmBLU9u: The aerial must see as much of the sky as possible, so it is mounted on TOP of the fuselage near the centre of gravity, where the wings and fin shadow it least and where aircraft attitude moves it least. Mounting it underneath, or in the fin, would put the airframe between the aerial and much of the constellation.
DBhCqh6rVnYcgKcZLBxy: A relief valve set above the normal regulated pressure sits in the system as the last line of defence: if the pump's own pressure control fails, the relief valve opens and returns fluid to the reservoir before the pressure can burst a line or a component.
DCXrDrsSunKcW5Jajoue: Controller-pilot data link communications replaces routine voice exchanges with formatted text messages between the pilot and the controller - clearances, requests and reports - displayed and answered on the MCDU. It removes the ambiguity and the frequency congestion of voice, particularly in oceanic airspace.
DEte0IdYQMZGLOWiC5GG: The loop responds both to a hot spot at any single point, which is what a localised fire produces, and to a general rise along its whole length, which is what an overheat produces. Being sensitive to both is what allows one continuous element to cover a whole compartment.
DFCqmWygLY9ji4KRB0CE: Flight safety is not the property of any one group. Design, maintenance, dispatch, cabin crew, air traffic control, management decisions about rostering and commercial pressure, and the flight crew themselves all contribute to whether an operation is safe. The systemic view of accident causation is precisely that the front-line operator is the last link, not the only one.
DG7kakKGmm6yfqwJsnsZ: A compass locator (LOM or NDB co-located with a marker) may substitute for the middle marker during a Category I ILS approach. It provides positive position identification at the missed approach point.
DIVkLFUtGU2EcXNwwE6i: A clogged filter would starve the bearings, which would destroy the engine within seconds, so a bypass valve opens when the differential pressure across the filter reaches a set figure. Unfiltered oil is far better than no oil, and a bypass warning tells the crew what has happened.
DIgDsagdsltAxFvnepry: Three minutes is the departure case where the following aircraft starts from an INTERMEDIATE part of the runway - or of a parallel runway less than 760 m away - because it begins its roll inside the air the preceding aircraft has already disturbed. The displaced-threshold and opposite-direction cases in the other options are two-minute minima.
DJsAB9hDzuo6vYCY6qSA: With no fixed external reference the brain cannot tell which of two relatively moving objects is the one that is moving, so an aircraft or vehicle moving alongside is perceived as one's own movement - the familiar sensation of the neighbouring train pulling out. On the ground this can prompt an unnecessary brake application; in the air it is a recognised source of false motion cues.
DK9CSzcq63Wni21MlR7p: Touchdown zones collect rubber deposits from landing tyres, and that polished, contaminated surface with a thin film of water is the classic setting for viscous hydroplaning. It needs far less water than dynamic hydroplaning and occurs well below the dynamic hydroplaning speed, which is why those areas are grooved or periodically cleaned.
DKdUkYhmzxd6lkZbJYt2: The high pressure shut-off valve is the last valve before the fuel nozzles, and the starting sequence requires the igniters to be firing before it opens - otherwise fuel simply collects in the engine and produces a wet start when it eventually lights.
DLnHVMH9PIDuYnEt6NlT: ICAO Annex 1 requires an applicant for a Commercial Pilot Licence to be at least 18 years of age. This is higher than the PPL minimum of 17 years, reflecting the greater responsibility of commercial operations.
DM1J0DKDAXvuhjSZQHZA: Halon is the agent of choice for cabin fires because it is effective on the electrical and material fires likely to occur there and leaves no residue, so at least one of the required extinguishers must contain it. The others may be water or another agent suited to different fire classes.
DM3jJcP5leUqrpvmRho1: GPS at 1575 MHz is line of sight and the signal is extremely weak, so a wing or the fin between the aerial and a satellite simply blocks it and that satellite is lost until the geometry changes. There is no algorithm that recovers a signal that never arrived, and this is why the aerial is mounted on top of the fuselage.
DMWWaAqSB99GZqAAmIJj: All four are dangerous goods by classification: extinguishers and self-inflating life jackets contain compressed gas, portable oxygen is an oxidiser under pressure, and first-aid kits carry chemicals and aerosols. They are carried under the exemption for articles required aboard for airworthiness, operating or medical reasons, which permits them but does not reclassify them.
DNK0Jz1uvN8rAoI5LnAI: The autopilot proper consists of the actuators that move the controls (1), the mode control panel through which the crew selects what it should do (2), and the mode annunciator that tells them what it is actually doing (4). The EFIS control panel governs the displays, not the autopilot.
DNeI0iQfusiUiOfMWXgn: The transponder code for radio communication failure is Mode A code 7600. Code 7700 is for emergency, code 7500 is for unlawful interference (hijacking). Mode B is not used for this purpose.
DPES53E9XnvfBC5vL1wZ: Dry operating mass is the aeroplane ready for operation with no payload and no usable fuel; zero fuel mass adds the traffic load but still no usable fuel. The difference between them is therefore exactly the traffic load.
DPKH60ukP7ZDpnW6OF26: The sensing element's resistance falls as it is heated, so the control unit sees the current rise and, past a set threshold, raises the alarm. Because the effect is continuous along the element, the same loop responds to a small hot spot or to a general overheat.
DPpJTHAlSJw4wJYvWbmx: Optimum cruise altitude is the pressure altitude at which the aeroplane achieves its best specific range - the most nautical miles per kilogram of fuel - for its current weight. Because it depends on weight, it rises steadily as fuel burns off, which is why step climbs are flown. It is limited in practice by the buffet boundary and by available thrust.
DPyBGoYuT9CH3THEvKoM: Oxygen makes almost anything burn fiercely, so no smoking or sparks (1), no grease or oil anywhere near the system (4), and valves are opened slowly (3) - a sudden surge into a dead-ended line produces adiabatic heating that can ignite whatever contamination is present. Radios are irrelevant.
DQkVfTU2GjboAzvHMwtg: Crosswind = wind speed x sine of the angle between wind and runway. The angle is 300 - 240 = 60 degrees, so the crosswind is 35 x sin60 = 35 x 0.87 = about 30 kt. At 60 degrees off, most of the wind is crosswind and only half of it is headwind.

As Mach number rises toward Mcrit the centre of pressure moves aft and the downwash at the tail reduces, both pitching the nose down; the system senses Mach number and applies an automatic nose-up input so the stick force gradient stays positive. It does not prevent the shock wave or the buffet that follows - only the trim change.

DZKgQMKzWsdA6KYOH0kl: Perception is the interpretation of sensory input, and interpretation requires something to interpret against. DZoAXM01jzhCqbtMEvja: The first thing an over-breathing person notices is light-headedness or dizziness, caused by the constriction of cerebral blood vessels as carbon dioxide is washed out. DaD2ckFEDQtbYwLkQIof: CAS corrected for compressibility gives EAS, and the compressibility correction is a function of speed and pressure altitude - so those two are exactly what is needed. Converting further to TAS requires density, and therefore temperature as well.
DaFy6dHITcA5ygrtOmv3: The respiratory centre in the brainstem is driven principally by the carbon dioxide level in the blood, sensed as a change in pH: a rise in CO2 increases the rate and depth of breathing, a fall reduces it. DkNUCt3AzfJuc7o7vliJ: Under ICAO Annex 13, an accident involves substantial damage to the aircraft. The landing gear sinking into a hole and sustaining structural damage meets the definition of an accident, requiring the crew to follow accident reporting procedures.

DkyqACeOi7dfoQZ1i1pH: The carbon monoxide in even a few cigarettes binds haemoglobin that would otherwise carry oxygen, so the smoker starts at a physiological altitude several thousand feet above where he actually is and his tolerance to any further oxygen shortage is reduced. DlM0n1xXGtzmiiazdj0J: The primary flight display carries what is needed to fly: attitude with the flight director, airspeed, altitude and vertical speed, and heading. Engine parameters and systems information belong on the EICAS or ECAM display, and the map belongs on the navigation display.

Dljs5mA5vFmj9c7eRoSm: Total air temperature is the static temperature plus the kinetic heating produced by bringing the air to rest, and that ram rise grows with the square of the Mach number. So TAT is always at least equal to SAT and exceeds it increasingly at high speed - by around 30°C at M0.8.
DllljLDYkQKGwX7Zpxf1: A constant true course means the same angle at every meridian, which is the definition of a rhumb line. Dmvmq9qoILzW9Cj6QmQu: As the aircraft climbs the air becomes less dense, so a fixed fuel flow would give a progressively richer mixture. DomRdldudQ7dULoyjglv: Category IIIC has no decision height AND no RVR limitation - the true zero-zero case. It also requires the whole taxi route to be usable in the same conditions, which is why it is rarely authorised in practice. IIIA stops at 200 m RVR and IIIB at 75 m.
DpHMmqEeWjOn0A8eVBZ9: A crew can only act on what the aircraft tells them, so the irreducible minimum requirement of a system is that it announces its own failure. DpYgMnrvnzBOFaEjNus8: All three optimise cooperation: a shared task and common goal give the crew something to coordinate around (1), mutual confidence in each other's competence is what makes members willing to accept and to offer help and challenge (2), and a clear definition of who does what removes the ambiguity in which tasks are either duplicated or dropped (3).

Ds8zhGp8NZdHJK2hJLKp: EAS is CAS reduced by the compressibility correction, and that correction shrinks as altitude and Mach number fall. Descending at a constant CAS therefore brings EAS closer to CAS, so EAS increases - and at sea level the two become equal.

DsoGZmMxzj8i4rn3ge6s: The pilot-in-command of a commercial flight must carry a copy of the flight plan to the destination. This ensures the crew has the filed route, fuel calculations, and operational information throughout the flight.
DspUiAUtPknhHtsHbGXv: Higher atmospheric pressure means DENSER air, which improves everything at once: the engine produces more thrust, the wing produces more lift at a given TAS, and the TAS needed to reach a given IAS is lower. DtDQWIr5A58h1nJV8Y8B: ICAO Annex 7 requires that nationality and registration marks under the wings of heavier-than-air aircraft have a minimum height of 50 cm. Some national regulations specify 60 cm based on their particular requirements.
DtT9chXBRSI8dEAEnoA4: An SAR aircraft rocking its wings is directing another aircraft towards an aircraft or surface craft in distress. This visual signal communicates 'follow me to the distress location' to other aircraft assisting in the search.
Dtg3bBv4OI6ej0jENUfC: Composite separation is the method whereby vertical and horizontal separation may be reduced to a maximum of half the standard criteria when used in combination. DtpUUA53OSoZ9zh2cCS4: ICAO Annex 2 requires notification to ATC if the average TAS at cruising level varies or is expected to vary by plus or minus 5% from the value in the flight plan. This ensures ATC can maintain accurate traffic predictions.
DtrPh2xjiF1KDxBZqUuU: Cabin altitude is the pressure inside the cabin expressed as the altitude at which that pressure would occur in the standard atmosphere. DtwHHgkWVrOvlbobS3rX: ASHTAM is a special NOTAM series using a specific format to notify significant changes to aircraft operations due to volcanic activity, volcanic eruptions, or volcanic ash clouds. It provides standardised information for flight planning around volcanic hazards.
DuY56mDj45VKkVeQzYbJ: A summer warm sector in tropical maritime air is warm, very moist and stable, having been cooled from below on its long sea track. Dw4UMdI1YhRcOxcvwCK0: In the ICAO Standard Atmosphere the temperature falls at 0.65 C per 100 m (6.5 C per km, or 1.98 C per 1000 ft) from 15 C at sea level up to the tropopause at 11 km, where it reaches -56.5 C and then stays constant. DwoHGJOlFfCnwHo7TlJU: For a gas the two useful measures are pressure, read directly from the gauge, and weight, since weighing the bottle reveals the mass of gas it contains. Level means nothing in a gaseous system, and the volume is fixed by the bottle whatever it contains.
Dx9CUyK9slcrOEPqoI9e: The brake accumulator holds fluid under pressure so that if the hydraulic supply fails there is still enough energy for a number of brake applications to stop the aeroplane. DybhvrGUWeRGKHDeWS6K: ICAO Annex 14 specifies that an aerodrome identification beacon at a land aerodrome shall show a flashing green light giving the aerodrome identification in Morse Code. Water aerodromes use flashing yellow.
DzCO9tKTeRPmgWHPZ6Xs: Hypoxia attacks the higher brain functions first: reasoning, judgement, memory and perception degrade while the pilot feels euphoric and competent. E0IqiqTzwY4xZH5CpagH: The ICAO standard lapse rate is 1.98 C per 1000 ft, taken as 2 C per 1000 ft for mental arithmetic. Descending from FL140 to FL110 is 3000 ft, so the temperature rises by about 6 C: -12 + 6 = -6 C. Watch the direction of the sum - going down means warming.

E1Uqw1hWwZ1NhJgSqbqm: Heading hold is one of the basic modes any autopilot provides, alongside attitude and altitude hold - it needs only a heading reference and the roll channel. E3Yn9XVIYwE9ZLxKEfj8: The navigation database holds what is needed to fly a route: airports and runways (1), navaids (3), airways and their waypoints (4), together with SIDs, STARs and approach procedures. E3hJx0O7P7w2Fn9K6OfS: Turning onto north in the northern hemisphere the compass lags, so the turn must be stopped before it reads north - undershoot north, overshoot south. The order of increasing pressure is therefore capsule, bellows, Bourdon tube.
E4VRCH5POfiZb72eSzFs: A thermocouple works because two different metals in contact generate a small voltage that varies with temperature. The measuring junction is where they are joined at the hot end, and the circuit is completed at a reference junction elsewhere - identical metals would produce nothing at all.
E5TzgXBRKeVK1YtLy1BZ: The maximum cruise altitude is set by requiring a residual manoeuvre margin - conventionally 1.3g - before buffet onset. The reason for insisting on that margin is that turbulence produces gust-induced load factor excursions, and without a margin a routine gust would take the aeroplane straight into Mach buffet. The limit is about the buffet boundary, not about exceeding the structural limit load.
E5YqUFj15ESj40wfkCb5: For aeroplanes above 5700 kg the flight data recorder must retain the last 25 hours of operation. The CVR figure is separate: 30 minutes for aeroplanes certificated before 1 April 1998, two hours thereafter.
E5dPZiKp7cKZIoniOv27: Radio altimeters work around 4.3 GHz, a wavelength of about 7 cm, which puts them in the centimetric band. That short wavelength gives a small aerial and the resolution needed to measure a few feet of height in the flare.
E5lra2QqCZheOuLytFzc: Bypass ratio is cold flow divided by core flow. With 200 kg/s entering and 20 kg/s through the core, 180 kg/s bypasses it, giving 180/20 = 9:1.
E5shaYqlVzRDLaz0BuTg: An INS computes groundspeed and track from its own accelerometers with no air data at all, so it needs no TAS for navigation. E5vaHlw0woC2ek4ecR8E: Position error depends on where the static port sits in the pressure field around the aircraft, and that field depends on how the aeroplane is presented to the airflow - the angle of attack - and on the speed at which it is moving through it. Outside air temperature has no bearing on it.
E5weRPXbSSSFbIqUJS0a: A higher grade fuel has a greater resistance to detonation, so using it is safe though wasteful. A lower grade is never acceptable, because the engine's compression ratio and boost were chosen on the assumption of the specified octane rating and detonation will follow.
E6Ky03j7iYoszTvLFiHM: The wind from 045 is on the starboard quarter of the 317 heading, so it pushes the aircraft left with almost no change in speed: the crosswind is most of the 45 kt and the along-track component is small. E6kEQfcRwNw7oS8qKT7q: Mixture strength is a mass ratio, and what matters is the charge that actually reaches the combustion chamber - the mass of fuel to the mass of air entering the cylinder. Volumes would be meaningless because air density varies with altitude and temperature.
E8JQ4qTbQQaJM1oTJvc5: ICAO Doc 4444 states that radar identification of a departing aircraft is achieved when the radar position indication is observed within 1 NM (2 km) of the departure runway end. This tight tolerance ensures positive identification.
E96l6ERWNxlbD1HybPII: ICAO Doc 8168 (PANS-OPS) specifies that missed approach procedures are normally based on a climb gradient of 2.5%. If a higher gradient is required due to obstacles, it is noted on the approach chart.
E9IFRjK80UyvH98DocYM: The retina is the light-sensitive layer lining the back of the eye. It carries the rods and cones that convert light into nerve impulses, together with the processing cells that feed the optic nerve. Light regulation is the pupil's function, focusing belongs to the cornea and lens, and the ciliary muscle changes the lens shape.
E9KUPjVRcoNxAFEV0oai: All four are correct and they form the standard drill. Establish and maintain a systematic instrument scan, believe what the instruments say rather than what the body reports, consciously disregard the sensations however convincing, and keep head movements to a minimum so that the canals are not stimulated further. The one thing that must not be done is to fly the sensation.
E9Uh7KjOKEvUeaIsvuaM: CRM depends on the information in the junior pilot's head reaching the decision. Voicing a doubt or a differing opinion - assertively, with the reason attached - is exactly the behaviour that catches the captain's error. Suppressing conflict, obeying without question and staying silent to avoid being untimely are the failures CRM was created to address.
E9t8UfExFoPLlVEmQec1: Above about 12,000 ft without oxygen the picture is headache, fatigue, dizziness, impaired judgement and loss of fine coordination, with cyanosis and eventually unconsciousness. Judgement deteriorates rather than improves, breathing quickens rather than slows, and body temperature falls rather than rises, which rules out the other combinations.
EATeFrh89EwGXWqAeU4S: Two technologies cover everything on a transport aircraft: resistance thermometers, where a platinum element's resistance rises predictably with temperature, for the lower ranges such as outside air and oil; and thermocouples for the high ranges of exhaust gas and cylinder head, where they generate their own signal and survive the heat.
EAc3V5rg43wHHCCMauY5: The pitot supplies total pressure, and only the airspeed indicator uses it. The altimeter and vertical speed indicator are fed from the static system alone, so they go on working normally - which is why a pitot blockage shows itself as an airspeed problem with the other instruments apparently sane.
EAj8LQmgQaIunTmHc8MF: A thermocouple generates its own electromotive force from the temperature difference between its junctions, so it needs no external supply at all. That self-powering property is why it is used for engine temperatures, where an indication is wanted even with the electrical system dead.
EAmb3UyHUQ9e6qbpaBzU: The air data computer can apply the position error correction as a function of speed and configuration (1) and remove the hysteresis of a mechanical capsule (2), and its digital output can be sent to any number of users (3). Many installations also allow the standby altimeter to work pneumatically if the ADC fails (4).
EB64CZ0WZqTB1sgFRoLU: A period at idle lets the turbine discs, casings and shafts cool at similar rates, so the clearances close evenly. Shutting down straight from high power leaves hot rotors inside cooler casings, and the differential contraction can nip the blades in their seals or bow the shaft.
EBBDcatrHs3Q9UIn1vwR: Automatic trim works in the pitch channel: it runs the stabiliser to cancel the elevator hinge moment the autopilot is holding, so the servo is unloaded and the aeroplane is in trim at disconnect. Rudder and aileron trim are set by the crew.
EC9maul6IdIDsPhm06CN: Motivation mobilises energy: it raises general arousal, which improves alertness, and it directs attention towards what matters to the individual, which improves the quality of attention. A motivated crew member monitors better and notices more, whereas low motivation shows up as inattention long before it shows up as a mistake.
ECAqbPQUvj3PhpUHK54g: Vortices sink and then drift downwind, so with the wind from the left they move to the RIGHT of the preceding aircraft's path. Staying to the left - the upwind side - and above its path keeps you out of both the sinking core and the drift.
ED82kMGKyXATBjRB9TxJ: QNH and QFF are both the station pressure reduced to sea level, but QNH uses the ISA temperature profile while QFF uses the ACTUAL temperature. Air 10 C warmer than ISA is less dense, so the real column between the airfield and sea level weighs less and QFF gains less pressure in the reduction. QNH, computed on the denser standard column, gains more, so QNH is greater than QFF: more than 1016 hPa.
EF2BrlVwsxQsoNMBpTF3: An ILS with the glide path out of service is flown as a non-precision localizer approach, and the system minimum is an MDH of 250 ft. 200 ft is the Category I DECISION height, available only with a serviceable glide path.
EGWlR8VzDmbj8bRD0ZkN: Nitrogen dissolved in the tissues during a dive must be given time to wash out before ambient pressure is reduced again. After dives deeper than about 30 ft, and after any dive requiring decompression stops, the minimum interval before flying is 24 hours; flying sooner risks decompression sickness at cabin altitudes that would otherwise be harmless.
EHWVObCbyMslHx6dharQ: Retracting flap reduces the wing's camber and therefore its lift coefficient at a given angle of attack. Since lift must still equal weight and the speed is being held constant, the lost CL has to be recovered by raising the angle of attack. This is the source of the sink that accompanies flap retraction if the attitude is not adjusted promptly.
EHiSlOqkBVhK0NGtTpGA: The maximum operating altitude of a pressurised aeroplane is simply the highest pressure altitude for which it has been certified for normal operation - a structural and systems limit, driven chiefly by the maximum permissible cabin differential pressure, and published as a fixed figure in the AFM. The aerodynamic ceiling and the buffet-limited altitude are separate, weight-dependent limits that may be lower on any given day.
EIIotQMtHkX6c9tX2gqg: The fovea is packed with cones and contains no rods at all. That gives it the best acuity and colour vision in daylight and no useful sensitivity in the dark, which is why a faint object at night vanishes when looked at directly and must be viewed 10-20 degrees off centre where the rods lie.
EJa7JtC44HPc8avSBt1Z: The aim with a bomb aboard a pressurised aeroplane is to remove the differential pressure across the fuselage so that a detonation is not amplified into structural failure. That means descending to the level corresponding to the indicated cabin altitude, or to the minimum safe altitude if that is higher, and configuring early for landing. Climbing increases the differential - exactly the wrong direction.
ELn6TCVwTwlz712zQAcj: The route runs east from 100E to 140W, so the vertex is at the mid-longitude 160E, where the eastbound track is 090. On a Greenwich-gridded south polar chart grid track = true track plus east longitude, giving 090 + 160 = 250. Re-orienting the grid onto the 180 meridian rotates every grid bearing by 180 degrees, so the grid track becomes 070.
EM3qoIRUld3GzLYF7lrX: In August the north Indian Ocean is under the summer monsoon regime, and the tropical easterly jet dominates the upper troposphere over southern Asia at around 10-15 N. The upper-level flow at FL370 is therefore easterly. A Bombay to Bangkok routing is eastbound, straight into that flow, so headwinds must be planned for.
EMG61zrI9FbnBv4GrxAP: Generators produce a great deal of heat in a small volume, so a dedicated cooling airflow is ducted to them - taken from the engine's low pressure compressor, which supplies clean air at a useful pressure whatever the aircraft's forward speed. Ram air alone would fail on the ground.
EMqwIIWzy8mSpT9aFQg1: With a high pressure area and a slack gradient, the synoptic wind is too weak to mask local effects, so the diurnal circulation takes over. On a sunny afternoon the land heats far faster than the sea, forming a shallow thermal low over the land, and the surface wind blows from sea to land as a sea breeze. The reverse land breeze, land to sea, develops overnight and is normally weaker.
ENn1xUC85Jc4DSUzqRXX: Perihelion, about 147 million km, falls in early January and aphelion, about 152 million km, in early July. It is worth fixing in mind because it is counter-intuitive from a northern hemisphere point of view: the earth is closest to the sun in the northern winter.
EOQBeOuusfzVfOC7sMHb: Relative humidity is the amount of water vapour present expressed as a percentage of the maximum the air could hold at that temperature. It therefore depends on two things: the actual moisture content, and the temperature, which sets the saturation capacity. This is why simply warming air lowers its relative humidity without removing any moisture at all.
EOY32XFsDmdCFauo5ewG: Statement I is wrong: stall is a low-RPM problem, when the compressor is far from its design point and the front stages are working at too high an angle of attack. Statement II as written describes the condition rather than the cause, and both are treated as incorrect propositions here.
EOzZLgeWA5KWIezUEcBN: A domestic air carrier's line check for the pilot-in-command is required every 12 calendar months in one of the types of aeroplane to be flown. It need not be conducted in every type the pilot is rated on.
EPREfshp0eF9Pu2P8yc5: This describes ICAO Class F airspace: IFR and VFR flights are permitted, IFR flights receive air traffic advisory service (not full ATC separation), and all flights receive flight information service if requested. Class E provides full ATC service to IFR.
EPVOE5qEMYIKIh8OMBsI: ICAO Doc 4444 specifies 3 minutes longitudinal time-based separation when navigation aids permit frequent position and speed determination and the preceding aircraft maintains a TAS 40 kt or more faster than the following aircraft.
EQ5tkoda9zY70GNqqtNR: In a free turbine engine there is no mechanical connection between the gas generator and the power turbine - the two are coupled only by the gas stream. That allows the output shaft to be held at constant speed while the gas generator varies, and lets the engine be started without turning the rotor or propeller.
ERBk8tgr4PUV8xFBEmw3: The gyro provides a stable directional reference, so its spin axis is kept horizontal by an erection system and it is slaved in azimuth to the flux valve through a torque motor. The slaving is what gives it long-term magnetic accuracy while the gyro supplies short-term steadiness.
ES7Ne3pfznzwDwcn2E1A: Taking air from the compressor removes mass flow that would have passed through the turbine, so less work is available and the pressure ratio falls. To hold the commanded thrust the fuel control adds fuel, and with less air to absorb it the turbine temperature rises - which is why bleed-off penalties are tabulated.
ESNTn9fwGZhfwH9sxa6r: ICAO Annex 2 requires a flight plan for a controlled flight to be submitted at least 60 minutes before departure, or if submitted during flight, at a time to ensure receipt by the appropriate ATC unit at least 10 minutes before entry into controlled airspace. Some sources state 30 minutes prior to leaving blocks.
ESrY94YYLE1tuuFtRo2X: Climbing at constant CAS the true airspeed increases, because the same dynamic pressure needs a higher true speed in thinner air. The speed of sound falls at the same time as the temperature drops, so the Mach number - a rising TAS over a falling speed of sound - increases faster still.
ETP5rSF8vlfI1UZDSSdY: EAS is the speed that would produce the same dynamic pressure at sea level density, so converting it to true airspeed is entirely a matter of the actual density - which is what density altitude expresses. Pressure altitude alone is not enough, because temperature also affects density.
ETdfgDtiVwNagYPPXSHb: For flights into areas subject to air traffic flow management the flight plan must be filed at least 3 hours before the estimated off-blocks time, so that the flow management unit has time to compute and issue a slot. The general rule of 60 minutes before departure applies only where ATFM is not in force.
ETgbblc5F2NOhQSDQkj7: ICAO Doc 4444 allows a 60 NM RNAV distance-based separation minimum when using the Mach Number Technique (MNT), in lieu of 10 minutes longitudinal separation, provided the preceding aircraft maintains a Mach number equal to or greater than the following aircraft.
EU9uRaPM8kj8bs35GseI: EAS gives the dynamic pressure and density altitude gives the density, and true airspeed follows from the two. Starting from CAS would require the compressibility correction first, which needs pressure altitude as well.
EUUNe4LGvgP1U3jN8hnx: A procedure turn is a manoeuvre in which a turn is made away from a designated track followed by a turn in the opposite direction to intercept and proceed along the reciprocal of the designated track. It is used to reverse course for approach alignment.
EUfyK5z7UWDYXf0PoaIU: Flight information service is provided to all aircraft known to the relevant ATS unit, not just those on filed flight plans or receiving ATC service. This ensures the broadest possible distribution of safety-relevant information.
EUphXQTJRIV0TaI6FII1: In a power-ASSISTED (boosted) system the pilot's muscular effort and the hydraulic power act together on the surface, so a proportion of the real aerodynamic load is still transmitted back up the control run to the column. That residual feedback gives genuine feel, which is why no artificial feel unit is required - unlike a fully powered system, where the pilot is completely isolated from the surface. Trimming is still very much required.
EVNzRURpkwy7OdB5v9Bk: Dry air is about 78% nitrogen, 21% oxygen and roughly 0.03% carbon dioxide, with argon and other rare gases making up the rest. Carbon monoxide is not a natural constituent - it is a contaminant from combustion - and helium is present only in traces.
EVZTDVgx6xWbBMqYkP8N: ICAO Doc 4444 recommends that ATIS broadcast messages should not exceed 30 seconds in duration wherever practicable. This keeps the broadcast brief enough for pilots to copy in a single listen.
EVfx9Os6SB1FCjMp30Gb: Under +Gz blood is driven towards the feet and pools there (2), so the pressure in the vessels above the heart falls and the eyes and brain are starved (3), while soft organs are displaced downwards (4). Heart rate rises rather than falls, as the baroreceptors detect the fall in pressure and the body tries to compensate, so statement 1 is wrong.
EVls86wVleBX3DMv3wWO: Green indicates a mode that is engaged and active, so a glance at the flight mode annunciator tells the crew what the automatics are actually doing. White or cyan marks a mode that is armed and waiting for its capture condition, and that distinction is the basis of mode awareness.
EWAgeoCNRc4RjYdYlZBJ: ICAO Annex 2 states that VFR flights shall not take off or land within a CTR, or enter the traffic zone, when the ceiling is less than 1500 ft or ground visibility is less than 5 km, unless a Special VFR clearance is obtained.
EWL347TNjnKP49yixljw: In an impulse stage all the expansion happens in the nozzle guide vanes: the gas leaves them as a high velocity jet, and the rotor blades, being symmetrical buckets, merely turn that jet and absorb its momentum at constant pressure. A reaction stage expands the gas in the rotor as well.
EWZzNNBKOcueGee1hqKD: Mode 3 monitors barometric altitude after take-off or a go-around and announces 'DON'T SINK' if the aircraft begins to lose height while still low and in a climb configuration. Excessive descent rate is Mode 1, and configuration warnings are Mode 4.
EWc6hqqKzAG54CXH5gQz: The flux valve senses the direction of the earth's field and feeds it to the error detector, which compares it with the gyro's heading. Any difference drives the torque motor, which precesses the gyro slowly onto the magnetic heading - the slaving loop that gives the instrument both steadiness and accuracy.
EWq2rsgT8S5vkOmLu31H: The retina is the innermost, light-sensitive lining of the eyeball, carrying the rods and cones that transduce light into nerve impulses along with the neural layers that begin processing the image. Focusing is done by the cornea and lens, light regulation by the pupil, and accommodation by the ciliary muscle.
EWxOeTZMcqVmLuXL1ah0: At -12 C a cloud contains both supercooled droplets and ice crystals, so the accretion is mixed ice rather than pure clear or pure rime. Orographic lifting on the windward side of mountains forces continuous ascent, which sustains a much higher liquid water content than a flat-terrain cloud of the same type, so the severity climbs to moderate or severe. Nimbostratus is deep and extensive, which prolongs exposure.
EX3gsPNCQj3611gIzgSZ: TCAS symbology escalates with threat: a hollow white or cyan diamond for other traffic, a filled diamond for proximate traffic, a filled amber circle for a traffic advisory, and a filled red square for the intruder that has caused a resolution advisory.
EXDbmlLYX0Ru2O0HoO2R: The detection system tells the crew; discharging the bottle is a crew action, because it is irreversible and because the drill requires the engine to be shut down and the fuel and bleed valves closed first. Automatic discharge would risk firing the bottle at a spurious warning.
EZLyCNQbf7sqyEaqTHli: Body mass index is mass over height squared: 57 divided by 1.7 squared gives about 19.7 kg/m2, comfortably inside the normal band of roughly 18.5 to 25. Below about 18.5 would be underweight, above 25 overweight and above 30 obese.
EZzAztXulQbUI4QsfUBn: A rhumb line holds a constant angle to every meridian, and any constant track other than 000, 090, 180 or 270 must therefore spiral towards a pole. A track of 085 has a small northerly component, so from 86N it spirals in ever-decreasing circles to the North Pole, which it approaches but never quite reaches.
EaIxQr6a9JSzUrQyHybZ: The torque link connects the fixed upper part of the oleo to the sliding lower part, so the strut can telescope freely but the wheels cannot castor about the strut axis. On a steerable nose gear the steering actuator works through the same linkage.
Ead9VSJ5KugAVA8UiheG: Convert first: 300 kt is 300 x 0.5144 = 154.3 m/s. Then r = V2 / (g tan(bank)) = 154.3 squared / (10 x tan 45) = 23,808 / 10 = 2381 m. Note that tan 45 = 1, which simplifies the arithmetic, and that mass does not appear - turn radius depends only on speed and bank angle.
EbTuwFSc40Z39GfQxgwn: Dynamic hydroplaning speed rises with the square root of tyre pressure - about 9 times the square root of the pressure in psi. 10.8 bar is about 157 psi, and 9 x 12.5 gives roughly 112 kt.
Ebqbt17krlKPAZoUzITj: Communication is the medium through which crew coordination happens, so a damaged personal relationship shows up immediately as information not passed, challenges not made and doubts not voiced. Inadequate communication is a documented factor in a large share of accidents, and an unresolved personal conflict must be dealt with before it affects the flight, not after it.
EbwhoH9cTtLJFur60WUQ: Certification requires the jettison system to be able to dump enough fuel to meet the approach and landing climb requirements within 15 minutes. The figure exists because the situation calling for jettison - an immediate return - does not allow an hour of dumping.
EcJ9Q7ucjk5s0xSk4Fm7: Refuelling is controlled by quantity: each tank's shut-off valve closes when the preselected volume or mass has been loaded, so the operator sets a figure rather than watching gauges. A separate high-level float switch provides the backup if the primary shut-off fails.
Ed3GzNAtq4mMCJLTDCmu: Detonation is driven by cylinder pressure and temperature, so the first action is to reduce power by closing the throttle, and to enrich the mixture, since the extra fuel cools the charge. Leaning would make it worse, and carburettor heat raises the induction temperature, which also makes it worse.
Ed5m2OBN2tlbtCb9SAI9: A wing stalls at a fixed ANGLE OF ATTACK, not at a fixed speed - so as long as alpha stays below the critical angle, the wing cannot stall, whatever the airspeed, attitude, weight or load factor. This is why an aeroplane can be stalled at high speed in a steep turn, or in a nose-down attitude during a recovery, and why angle of attack is the parameter stall warning systems actually measure.
EdgcWgeaPrsW2hTMw2yW: Thrust is set and monitored either by fan speed N1, which on a high bypass engine is a direct measure of the airflow producing most of the thrust, or by engine pressure ratio, which measures the pressure rise the whole engine is producing. Which is used depends on the engine manufacturer.
EdrVMS3j5Qv9HpRAZ1me: All four are classic signs. The pressure drop condenses cabin moisture into mist, the outrush of air carries dust and loose items toward the breach, gases trapped in the body expand, and air is forced violently out of the lungs because they cannot equalise through the airway fast enough.
EeOdtb6xoZawodBCBp10: A magnetic chip detector collects ferrous debris from the oil, and inspecting it - or, on many installations, an electrical indication when a bridge of particles closes the gap - reveals bearing or gear deterioration early. It gives that warning without stripping the filters, which is why it is checked routinely.
EeQcQkfUBDBMbis5oQ1R: Fatigue degrades accommodation so that instruments become harder to focus on (1), slows reaction times (2), makes retrieval from long-term memory unreliable (3) and coarsens motor skills so that handling becomes clumsy (5). Being over-talkative is not a fatigue sign - the fatigued crew member typically becomes quiet and withdrawn.
Eed6CAuYAPltxBlvANmP: The latitude difference is 3 degrees = 180 NM, but that is only the north/south COMPONENT of the leg. On a track of 120 the meridian component is distance x cos60 = 0.5 x distance, so the distance is 180 / 0.5 = 360 NM. At 1:1 000 000 that is 360 x 1852 = 666 720 m = 66.7 cm on the chart.
EfNCBWnwF7cJsyahbsYj: Take-off fuel is 40,000 - 800 = 39,200 kg. The take-off limit gives 170,000 - 39,200 - 80,400 = 50,400 kg; the landing limit, with 10,200 kg of fuel remaining, gives 148,500 - 10,200 - 80,400 = 57,900 kg; and the zero fuel limit gives 112,500 - 80,400 = 32,100 kg. The zero fuel mass binds.
EfnWaPV0hlLhUAFR0peV: For a jet, fuel flow follows thrust, so maximum range means minimising drag per unit of DISTANCE - the tangent-from-the-origin point on the drag curve, which lies at a speed about 1.32 times VMD. Flying faster than the minimum-drag speed means a smaller lift coefficient and therefore a LOWER angle of attack than the (L/D)max condition. The (L/D)max angle gives maximum range for a PROPELLER aeroplane, and maximum endurance for a jet.
EgPDQmpC6sEyjY4wQQ9F: A float senses the height of the liquid surface, so any pitch, roll or acceleration moves the surface relative to the float (2 and 3), and temperature changes the fuel's density so that the same level is a different mass (4). What a float gauge is not is complex - simplicity is its principal virtue - and it runs on the DC system.
EgZwnH9YCIpRa1n8AxjQ: The IR(A) — Instrument Rating (Aeroplane) — is valid for one year under JAR-FCL. Revalidation requires a proficiency check within the three months immediately preceding the expiry date.
Ehs0n6SEx53D7L0U5aI5: The dangerous combination is a much heavier aeroplane landing just ahead, high-lift devices deployed (a high lift coefficient means strong vortices) and a LIGHT crosswind that holds the vortex over the runway instead of clearing it. Wake turbulence is unrelated to cruise vertical separation and to a lighter aeroplane ahead.
Ei7RaspjZ2Q1XEHj2CQL: Pulling the fire handle isolates the engine and arms the bottles: fuel and hydraulic shut-off valves close, the bleed valves close, the generator is taken off line and the extinguisher circuit is armed ready for the discharge switch. The agent is not released until the crew presses that switch.
EifBm3pMqVhdN3uvh9A0: Mach number is TAS divided by the LOCAL speed of sound - local because the speed of sound depends on the ambient temperature, which varies with altitude. It is emphatically not based on IAS, nor on the sea-level speed of sound. Note the consequence: at a fixed TAS, warmer air raises the speed of sound and therefore LOWERS the Mach number.
Ej0p9ibFFtFPasc1fvkL: The earth distance is 6 cm x 9 260 000 = 55 560 000 cm = 555 600 m = 300 NM. Ten degrees of longitude is 600 minutes, so departure = 600 x cos(latitude) = 300, giving cos(latitude) = 0.5 and a latitude of 60 degrees north or south.
EjSOzQqVOItiDKdZAj2H: Hail can be encountered anywhere in and beneath a cumulonimbus, from the surface right up to the cloud top, and in temperate latitudes vigorous CB tops can reach FL450. It can also be thrown out of the anvil and met in apparently clear air several miles from the cell, which is why the standard advice is to avoid a CB by at least 10 NM rather than to rely on any altitude band being safe.
EkUWbHMJzlqR39ZYaIkV: Increasing the power setting increases the fuel flow, so the gas generator accelerates and produces more and hotter gas: both the HP spool speed and the turbine gas temperature rise. The propeller speed does not change, because the governor holds it by coarsening the blade angle to absorb the extra power.
EkdBtG8ttyIvdpXmB0Xy: Sunrise happens at whatever longitude has an LMT of 06:44 at that instant. The instant is 12:00 CET = 11:00 UTC, so the longitude required is (06:44 - 11:00) = -4 h 16 min of time, and 4.27 hours x 15 = about 64 degrees WEST. Convert the clock time to UTC before comparing it with the tabulated LMT.
El5vAU5pgtTiggTnjdi8: The seasons come from the 23.5 degree tilt of the earth's axis relative to the plane of its orbit, which changes the sun's declination and hence the elevation of the sun and the length of the day through the year. The varying earth-sun distance has a far smaller effect, and it is in fact greatest in the northern winter.
ElwPqcFY33BcOphDonIg: At 35,000 ft the time of useful consciousness is of the order of half a minute, and a loss of cabin pressure shortens it further because the alveolar oxygen pressure collapses at once and gas is driven out of the lungs. There is no time to diagnose or discuss anything: the mask goes on first, and the emergency descent follows.
EmWv6buREToLIqTaKYbD: Halon is used because it works by chemically interrupting the combustion reaction rather than by smothering, so a small quantity is effective, it leaves no residue and it will not damage the engine. Its production is now restricted for environmental reasons, but it remains the standard aviation agent.
EmvYFMjTYihsjOFH2KjQ: Coronary heart disease leading to myocardial infarction is the leading cause of death in men over 40 in the developed world, which is why cardiovascular risk factors dominate the aeromedical examination from middle age on. It is treatable, incidence tracks smoking rates and diet, and a substantial proportion of infarcts occur without preceding chest pain.
EmzJFq4YdbYbyL8kTjOW: Mach number is TAS divided by the local speed of sound, so the speed of sound is TAS divided by Mach number: 400 / 0.8 = 500 kt. That figure is consistent with a temperature around -20 C, since the speed of sound depends only on temperature - roughly 39 times the square root of the absolute temperature, in knots.
EnC5WPC3aiNuQErf72Uh: JAR-OPS 1.465 sets two figures for special VFR: it may not be COMMENCED when the visibility is below 3 km, and it may not be continued when the visibility falls below 1.5 km. Read the question carefully - the answer turns on whether it asks about starting the flight or about conducting it.
Eny9ektSUDxrVx2yqd3k: In a strapdown system both the gyros and the accelerometers are bolted rigidly to the airframe, so there are no gimbals: the stable platform exists only as a mathematical transformation inside the computer. That is what makes ring laser gyros practical, since they must handle full aircraft rates rather than sitting on a levelled platform.
EovDafiiCsQF5sB81gaW: The FDR must run from the moment the aeroplane is capable of moving under its own power until it can no longer do so - the whole of taxi, take-off, flight, landing and taxi in. EpUTISS8QPtdiv8Jzm75: In the absence of any surrounding reference, the brain attributes the eye's own small involuntary movements to the object being stared at, so a single fixed light in the dark appears to drift or manoeuvre. EpgySgZ2usInt5VBZcaO: A chemical oxygen generator is cheap (1), light for the quantity of oxygen it produces (3) and needs no servicing between its long replacement intervals (4). EpkluG0fEZ1n1dhNMSRk: Power required is drag multiplied by speed, so a tangent drawn from the origin touches the power curve where P/V - which is simply the DRAG - is at its minimum. Eq6l8vGr4mg9ivARHKz0: The Coarse/Acquisition code on L1 is the open civil signal. EqEjCHnd2B3QzoDYuNsU: Underload is the low-arousal end of the inverted-U, where the task is too familiar and too undemanding to hold attention. EqHrtD7WgdjxvS48kjSR: Time = distance / groundspeed = 84 / 120 = 0.7 hours, and 0.7 x 60 = 42 minutes. Reading the decimal 0.7 as 43 or 45 minutes is the trap the near-miss options are set for.
Eqv4RXjs5AHoaL3KNGI8: Fuel flow is trip fuel over trip time: 100 kg in 1 h 35 min = about 63 kg/h. ErorERNv1c7rZlpxCJj4: Perceived brightness is a distance cue, so a light that dims because it is being attenuated by fog, haze or dust is read as a light that is getting farther away. Et037AAQw94SSv7UQkJ9: Total pressure is what the pitot senses when the flow is brought to rest, and it is made up of the ambient static pressure plus the dynamic pressure associated with the motion. Et6bwvqFW74Yn2C92jsD: Variation is the angle between true north and magnetic north, a property of the earth's field at a place. Etx1kzC7evfPKuJSKpiI: Where a flight crew compartment door is fitted, it must have a locking system that prevents unauthorised access, operable from within the compartment. EuAfp8YLFIgqSs6Esq7H: The generally quoted prescription for cardiovascular benefit is aerobic exercise that roughly doubles the resting heart rate, sustained for at least 20 minutes, three times a week. EuD8obwZ2A1AdxhNoaKQ: Hypoxia in its commonest aviation form is caused by a fall in the partial pressure of oxygen in the alveoli, which follows directly from the fall in total atmospheric pressure with altitude. EuIjKJQzgSGfPqrVPEfK: Burning kerosene produces carbon dioxide and a large quantity of water vapour. EuY173z8fKOYNwfrH564: At FL370 the ambient pressure is about 3.1 psi. With the cabin held at around 8,000 ft, roughly 10.9 psi, the differential is close to 8-9 psi - which is about the structural maximum for a transport fuselage and is what sets the certificated ceiling.
EueQS33CIMYA5nJP667t: A heated windscreen is a laminate: glass plies for optical quality and abrasion resistance, bonded to a tough polycarbonate or vinyl interlayer which absorbs the energy of a bird strike, with a transparent conductive film on an inner glass surface as the heating element.
EuwQqdn57ebHn7o9TNez: ICAO Doc 4444 specifies 10 minutes longitudinal time-based separation at the same cruising level when navigation aids permit frequent position and speed determination, without a speed differential requirement. With 40 kt differential, it reduces to 3 minutes.
EwXwbHs1Fr8rjNIfaCO3: The vertical profile is flown against barometric altitude from the air data system, because that is what altimeters, ATC clearances and flight levels are all based on. GPS altitude is geometric and would not agree with the pressure altitudes everything else is using.
Ex2gtuExvH5l8TKLJEoq: The two positions are on the same parallel, so the rhumb line distance is the departure: dlong = 2 30 E to 7 30 W = 10 degrees = 600 minutes, and departure = 600 x cos60 = 300 NM. Note the longitudes straddle the Greenwich meridian, so the changes add rather than subtract.
Ex85wOt5hIjKi9vcpNnQ: Stability describes the atmosphere's response to a displaced parcel. Ex8PWlSiEmzeVZAu2HnC: A float senses the height of the liquid surface, so anything that moves the surface relative to the float affects the reading - attitude (1) and acceleration (2) - and temperature changes the fuel's density, so the same level represents a different mass (4). ExmvPs4DpLfGvH7duGva: During a precision approach (ILS), glide path interception normally occurs at heights above runway elevation between 300 m (984 ft) and 900 m (2955 ft). This range covers the typical intermediate approach altitudes at which aircraft intercept the glide path.
Exqn94lpwCBlcbxAiWSg: Climb angle depends on excess THRUST divided by weight, so anything that adds drag flattens the climb.
