ExsqthzOZxGIxit6nOXc: The seat-of-the-pants sense is proprioception: pressure receptors in the skin and the deeper tissues, plus stretch receptors in muscles, tendons and joints, reporting the direction of the resultant force and the position of the limbs. ExswI1ldmpcPoR5YjbwC: The command bar is proportional guidance: how far it is displaced tells the pilot how large a pitch change is needed as well as in which direction, and following it smoothly captures the profile without overshoot. EyUcb8SH3uJXYaYShGDP: On a polar stereographic the convergency between meridians is the full change of longitude, so a straight line changes its true direction degree for degree with longitude. F07pUPyI3OeTspA6WSQC: Air is supplied to the cabin at a roughly constant rate, so cabin pressure is set by how fast it is allowed to escape. F175IKuw77Lw4thjW3IK: The approach climb requirement is a go-around case with one engine inoperative, assessed in the approach configuration (gear up, approach flap) at the go-around thrust available. F18QDLLuObdcPeNjsAGx: A synergetic cockpit uses the whole crew's capability while preserving command: the captain decides, but the crew have prepared and contributed to the decision (1), and leadership is exercised flexibly, with the boundaries shifting according to the situation and the expertise available (4). F1U0tYbKPCd5SLLcD5vN: The summer (south-west) monsoon draws deep, very moist maritime air off the Indian Ocean over a strongly heated landmass. F1b133C5ePwj18PxOg5I: Dynamic hydroplaning requires enough water for the tyre to build a wedge of fluid pressure under the contact patch, so the depth of standing water is the primary factor in whether it can happen. F1jkwgxHXiFOXPZDvATJ: The accelerometers sense ACCELERATION, and everything else is arithmetic: one integration gives velocity and a second gives distance. F2XgQMxFvdHtTEhzfTEI: The buffer area extends 5 NM beyond the boundary of the holding area. This provides additional protection for aircraft that may slightly exceed the holding area boundary due to wind or piloting variations.
F427w1mfM5wCA2URhWrC: The behavioural signs of stress are aggression and irritability (1), withdrawal from the task and from the other crew member (4), and restless, purposeless gestures and fidgeting (5). F49RyHEaKHkKs5nM82NT: With one magneto out the charge is lit from one plug instead of two, so it burns more slowly and less completely. F4abAukdi2RStWoAE3TG: Vortices sink below the generating aircraft's path and then drift downwind, so a wind from the left carries them to the right. Staying on the left - the upwind side - and above the preceding aircraft's path is the only combination that avoids both the sink and the drift.
F4nX4tf9s0zXYdB6SQ7w: The inverted-U describes it: performance peaks at an optimum level of arousal (2), falls away when stress becomes excessive because attention narrows and thinking becomes rigid (3), and also falls away when there is too little stress because arousal, vigilance and motivation are inadequate (4). F5OTAR8zcgg8BEv7rrKM: Two conditions are needed. F5p0xaFsGaXosbvmtzhu: ICAO Annex 1 allows deferment of a medical re-examination for a single period of six months for non-commercial flight crew operating in areas distant from medical facilities. For commercial crew, the deferment is limited to a single period of three months.
F5qUYBTQTHnlnzSkOQty: Burning magnesium is hot enough to break water down into hydrogen and oxygen, so water makes it worse, and it will burn in carbon dioxide as well. F6V5lcHlXAQuVTEdVajc: The radio altimeter transmits a continuously frequency-modulated signal and compares the frequency of the returning echo with the frequency being transmitted at that instant. F75blTnCLo7xyqxQiw3p: A straight jet of water is for class A solids only - fabric, carpet, paper, wood - which it extinguishes by cooling. On flammable liquids it sinks below the fuel and spreads the fire, on gases it achieves nothing, and on burning metals such as sodium it reacts violently.
F8dUmKUtulq2dkQsENhQ: In the current three-part AIP structure (GEN/ENR/AD), information about areas and routes for which meteorological service is provided is in the GEN part (GEN 3.5 Meteorological Services).
F8iXc86Qen0hpjEkoIoS: Isogrives join places of equal GRIVATION, the angle between grid north and magnetic north, which is the quantity needed when navigating on a gridded polar chart with a magnetic compass. Lines of equal variation are isogonals, and the line of zero dip is the aclinic line.
F8oTzeLbX2NQYychoJh3: Total lung capacity is the sum of all four subdivisions: the tidal volume of a normal breath, the inspiratory reserve that can still be drawn in on top of it, the expiratory reserve that can still be pushed out below it, and the residual volume that cannot be expelled at all. FAKjX3R2pYUpfIMGiawC: Two rules govern hot brakes. Release the parking brake, with chocks in place, so the hot discs are not clamped together and can cool. FAUIWW0elGITt3oBJq01: Long range cruise deliberately accepts a specific range 1% below the maximum, and takes the HIGHER of the two speeds that deliver it. FAaFlFz1n6iWk35PFVGm: A symmetrical aerofoil has an essentially constant pitching moment coefficient about its aerodynamic centre at 25% chord, so as angle of attack changes the lift grows but its point of application barely moves. FB39Ztopjx4fkfGeZQ1t: Gimballing error appears when the aircraft is banked or pitched, because the gyro's gimbals are then no longer square to the aircraft's axes and the heading read off the compass card is not the true heading. FC0JjCOrA1NlZC2xmfeP: The certification scale runs minor, major, hazardous, catastrophic. A minor failure produces only a slight reduction in functional capabilities or safety margins, with a small increase in workload - it is the least severe category that still has any effect at all.
FCYJIyG934f3k23lWjVk: More power gives more speed, but drag rises with the square of speed, so the extra fuel burnt outruns the extra distance covered: fuel per hour and fuel per nautical mile both increase. FCnncTGGVLrSjYQpG18W: Check all three limits. Zero fuel mass is 35 500 + 14 500 = 50 000 kg, inside the 53 000 limit. FEaJ17n8pWw3Ak4b5EoB: Hypoxia is a supply of oxygen insufficient for the tissues' needs. FFPisvNTo8EytqncjL4l: Accidents are almost never traceable to a single cause. FGzlgydEkJxEc2rD5uDM: The compass magnet aligns with, and is driven by, the HORIZONTAL component of the earth's field, so the directive force varies directly with it. FHdINP60JFF9OgrlmEFg: The climb is flown at an indicated airspeed, and wind has no effect on the aeroplane's performance relative to the AIR - so the time to climb, the fuel burnt and the height gained are all unchanged. FIpmgtSPQ3yKJkrNbnx6: Kepler's second law says the radius vector from sun to planet sweeps equal AREAS in equal times. The consequence is that the earth moves fastest at perihelion and slowest at aphelion, which is one of the two causes of the equation of time, the other being the tilt of the axis.
FItaCniybgm9jtdJyemh: Overriding the automatically selected sensitivity during a GPS approach will cancel the approach mode annunciation. The automatic sensitivity steps (terminal, approach) are part of the approved procedure and should not be manually overridden.
FJkV0NsFJ0TpdUVTAOFl: In the ICAO Standard Atmosphere the temperature falls uniformly at 1.98 C per 1000 ft (0.65 C per 100 m) from 15 C at sea level to -56.5 C at the tropopause, 36,090 ft. The real atmosphere frequently departs from this, most obviously through inversions, but the standard profile is the reference for altimetry and performance.
FJvjEwqG4lKKqWa6sB5e: A small error in the gyros tilts the accelerometer frame, so a component of gravity is integrated as if it were acceleration and the position error grows with time. FJzpHKfGnMg4DBVXMdit: Certification requires an actual demonstration that the maximum seating capacity plus the required crew can be evacuated to the ground in 90 seconds, with half the exits blocked and in darkness. FK7cttfo1R2YwmbrXgIr: The propeller control lever selects blade angle through the governor, and pulling it fully back past the coarse pitch stop selects feather, driving the blades edge-on to the airflow. FKGOpixQL5kKBGlrtebT: Yawing left swings the STARBOARD wing forward, so it meets the air at a higher relative speed while the port wing slows. FLpBOIE7g3QBK0evyUN5: On a feathering propeller the governor's oil pressure drives the blades towards fine pitch, and the counterweights and feathering spring drive them the other way. FMKISjwKNRWaRgmyN5Iz: The free turbine is driven only by the gas stream the gas generator produces, so the power it delivers rises and falls with the gas generator's speed. FMR8IuTH9oqWnjf4PlRu: The carburettor meters fuel against the volume of air passing, not its mass, so as the air thins with altitude the same fuel flow is supplied to less and less air. FNJ3wlDVZhsCx6F70dl1: A paddle wheel or turbine flowmeter is turned by the fuel passing through it, and each revolution produces a pulse. Counting those pulses gives the volume that has passed. FNZrpAYzFRTda1XrxZtj: Fail-passive means the failure is contained: the system disconnects without producing an out-of-trim condition or a significant deviation, so the aeroplane is handed back under control. FNgHREmAVwcWt1wXtr4i: Barotrauma is tissue damage caused by a difference between the pressure of gas trapped in a body cavity - middle ear, sinuses, gut, a tooth cavity - and the ambient pressure. FNimki0DXIAMB522t0LL: Use the 1-in-60 rule twice. Track error = 6 NM in 40 NM run = 9 degrees. Closing angle = 6 NM in the 60 NM remaining = 6 degrees. Turning by the track error alone only parallels the intended track, so the alteration needed to REACH B is 9 + 6 = 15 degrees right.
FNzxJZ6u2wqyuS2zf2hn: Radiation fog needs the ground to radiate its heat away freely overnight, which requires little or no cloud - a cloud sheet would radiate heat back down and prevent the surface cooling. Dry air, strong winds and a cloudy sky all prevent it.
FOA04VCxqCVtegoEXyad: Human factors are cited in the region of 70-80% of aviation accidents, and the figure has been broadly stable for decades while technical causes have fallen away - which is what made human performance a licence subject. FOC8DxziRouorOCTAJMd: Above FL250 the number of dispensing units and outlets must exceed the number of SEATS by at least 10%. Seats, not booked passengers: the extra units cover cabin crew moving about and anyone not in their own seat when the masks drop.

FOjcmJ9AwSmoDEcIIwPO: The body clock is disturbed by crossing time zones, so the two transatlantic sectors (statements 2 and 4) disrupt it, the eastbound night flight most of all. FPSP8zPL7ZaMhYB3P0i2: The RMI shows QDM 090(M), so the true bearing to the NDB is 090 - 10W = 080(T) at the aircraft, and the reciprocal at the aircraft is 260. FQbpVupiEDCCHnK6n8P0: A Schuler-tuned system has a natural period of about 84 minutes, the period of a pendulum whose length is the earth's radius, so accelerations of the vehicle do not disturb the platform's alignment with the local vertical. FRPMIOEPfmdIjajoBR4N: Hypoxia is prevented by keeping the alveolar oxygen pressure up, which means using supplemental oxygen above about 10,000 ft cabin altitude - the limit at which unimpaired performance can be relied upon. FRVUE4YGimnQICGhesyW: Nitrogen is the culprit: it makes up 78% of the air, is inert and simply dissolves in the body's tissues and fluids in proportion to its partial pressure. FSY7kyikFSZjypZmClXd: Protection is given where ice would do harm and where the airflow first meets the aircraft: the engine intakes and cowls (1), the windscreens (2), the pitot heads and drain masts (4) and the wing leading edges (5). FSdX7tjBEA753xFcj6YV: A heavy landing on a short runway puts a great deal of kinetic energy into the brakes, so brake temperature is what matters afterwards - fuse plugs melting, tyres deflating, wheel fires, and a subsequent departure attempted with energy already absorbed. FSxiONFWdJx2pJhNDccu: An emergency locator transmitter must go on radiating long enough for a search to find it, and the requirement is 48 hours of continuous operation from its own battery. That is why the battery has a limited life and a replacement date marked on the unit.
FTQV1LSnWyOfrUf8p1s2: Range over the ground depends on ground nautical miles per kilogram of fuel. In a tailwind the reverse applies: slow down and let the wind do more of the work.
FTXTIgN2n7eBpvrHYT2y: A shock wave is a violent compression in which much of the flow's kinetic energy is converted into heat, so the static temperature rises sharply across it. FTsGdI4LtUdE5zOyNlO7: High manifold pressure with low RPM means a large charge burnt slowly with the crankshaft turning slowly, so peak cylinder pressures are high and applied for a long part of the stroke - the over-square condition that produces detonation and bearing damage. FU9vXY7xoHhajFrkjuo8: At low subsonic speeds the flow is treated as incompressible, which means by definition that density does not change: rho1 = rho2. FUSdzHPNeM7Fg9Pc2fof: Attention is highest at the start of a list and falls away through it, so the items that matter most - and the ones that will kill if missed - are placed at the beginning. FV8wI82Y4ZXqtgTiG9wp: The stabiliser setting is scheduled against CG, and a FORWARD CG calls for a nose-UP setting to help rotation. FVLdIwURasQEuKH0f2iB: In Class C airspace, departure control provides separation from all IFR aircraft and participating VFR aircraft. Non-participating VFR aircraft in the outer area may not receive separation service.
FVmYJoj0A1seXTNlh0XF: Both statements are wrong. Psychosomatic runs the other way: psychological or emotional stress produces genuine physical symptoms and illness, not the reverse. Faj8f43Zmmm2ea137ONy: PAPI (Precision Approach Path Indicator) consists of a single wing bar of 4 sharp-transition multi-lamp or paired light units equally spaced. A VASIS uses two bars. The 4-unit configuration provides a clear on-slope/above/below indication.

FawqeszyH5UxkEy77HP9: The erection system uses a pendulous device to find the vertical, and a deceleration displaces that pendulum exactly as a pitch change would. FdJCmTj7ghWwA9uBlFVq: The number of hand extinguishers is scheduled against the approved seating capacity, rising one at a time through the bands - six between 401 and 500 seats and seven between 501 and 600, distributed so that one is always within reach of any point in the cabin.
FdbrSzVC2Jgx3ysaV1ZX: A current limiter is a slow-blow protective device: it will pass a substantial overload for a short time without rupturing, which suits the surges of motor starting and generator paralleling, but it opens if the overload persists. FxCZdaANs4YlcgWZTipE: For ATC-instructed altitude changes of more than 1000 ft, the pilot should climb or descend as rapidly as practicable to 1000 ft above or below the assigned altitude, then at 500 to 1500 ft per minute until reaching the assigned altitude.

Fzv5ZV1gX74Vrf6pW4No: Teamwork spreads the work so no individual is saturated (1), improves safety through cross-monitoring and error capture (3), lowers stress because the burden and the responsibility are shared (5) and improves decisions by bringing more information and more viewpoints to bear (6). Ventilation flow is a function of the packs, and the differential is not constant - it varies with altitude.
GDFAVxeqHiZ1Wl5dlcKz: Autobrake applies a selected deceleration rate and continues until the crew intervenes - by pressing the brake pedals, advancing the thrust levers or selecting the system off. It does not time out or cut at a speed, because the crew must remain in control of the deceleration.
GERm66BCHVll5gqEg0E1: A series of red flashes from aerodrome control to an aircraft on the ground means 'taxi clear of the landing area in use.' This differs from a steady red light (stop) or a red flare (do not land, directed at aircraft in flight).
GEffJgoxEM8YEalIBTqg: The description matches an AIRMET, not a SIGMET. An AIRMET covers specified en-route weather affecting low-level operations that is not already in the area forecast. A SIGMET covers more severe phenomena at all flight levels.
GEiaqHMCfQOPGo8LXr8i: Emergency extension relies on gravity and simple stored energy: unlocking the uplocks mechanically or manually (4) and letting the gear fall and lock under its own weight (5), assisted where necessary by a stored charge of compressed nitrogen (2), which is inert and will not support combustion.
GFZpvjXB1IzTWvuuJg11: A system in which a single error propagates unchecked into the whole system is vulnerable - it has no capture mechanism. The opposite is an error-tolerant system, in which errors are trapped, contained or reversed before they do damage. Since human error cannot be eliminated, designing for tolerance rather than for perfection is the practical goal.
GFlEmO29ax6NEekVBEf5: A straight line drawn on a polar stereographic chart approximates a great circle closely, and the departure between them grows with the change of longitude covered. For two points at 60N separated by enough longitude to give 20 degrees of earth convergence, the maximum cross-track difference is of the order of 30 NM.
GFsVVgGH02L6TuTkQeQ4: Time = distance / groundspeed = 103 / 105 = 0.981 hours, which is 58.9 minutes, so 59 minutes. A quick check: at 105 kt the aircraft is 2 NM short of a full hour's run, and 2 NM takes just over a minute.
GGxsHF1kQxdN9v1ngGw8: Processing begins with a physical stimulus acting on a sense organ, briefly held in sensory memory. Selective attention then picks out part of that raw input, perception interprets it, and recognition matches it against what is already stored. Nothing can be attended to that was not first sensed.
GGyDhwctjt6yawXVFoMT: Cirrus (CI) forms above about 20,000 ft at temperatures typically below -40 C, so it is composed entirely of ice crystals with essentially no supercooled liquid water. Crystals bounce off the airframe rather than adhering, so icing can be ruled out. Stratocumulus, nimbostratus and cumulus all contain supercooled liquid water at sub-zero temperatures and can all ice an aircraft.
GIBkcGK0OG7HzmsrFbKV: Illusions cannot be prevented, but their effect can be. Knowing in advance which illusions this approach will produce - a black hole arrival, a sloping runway, a narrow strip, haze - lets the crew brief the counter-measure and cross-check against the instruments, and debriefing afterwards builds the experience. Sunglasses and eye tests address vision, not misinterpretation.
GIWSVlbv2EtD6kBw1TIM: Sweeping the wing means only the airflow component perpendicular to the quarter-chord line does the aerodynamic work, so the effective velocity over the aerofoil section is reduced by the cosine of the sweep angle. The local flow therefore reaches M1.0 only at a higher free-stream Mach number, raising Mcrit. Increasing aspect ratio actually lowers Mcrit slightly, and dihedral affects only lateral stability.
GJofH4lyVnsqIeP7uxy0: Selye's General Adaptation Syndrome has three phases: alarm, in which adrenaline mobilises the body; resistance, in which an elevated but sustainable level of coping is held; and exhaustion, in which the reserves are spent and performance and health break down. Alert and vigilance are not phases of the model.
GKDc6glIy5hfKxdnvLm4: CAS is IAS corrected for instrument error and position (pressure) error. Correcting CAS for compressibility gives EAS, and correcting EAS for density gives TAS. Working the chain in order - IAS, CAS, EAS, TAS - keeps the corrections straight.
GKUt9b7sKNvInBfp4KuM: In a precision approach Category I lighting system, the single, two, and three light source sections on the centreline have specific lengths. The 200 m dimension refers to the segment arrangement of the centreline barrettes.
GKhlzNwvo9G3pgOgY4EI: Hydroplaning depends on the speed of the tyre over the water, which is a GROUND speed. At a higher pressure altitude the same groundspeed is reached at a lower indicated airspeed, so in terms of the speed the crew reads, the hydroplaning threshold comes down. The physical 9 x root-pressure figure itself is unchanged - it is a true speed.
GKlxopaJewUYTtrI7KTy: ICAO Annex 2 states that if a controlled flight is delayed 30 minutes beyond the estimated off-blocks time, the flight plan should be amended or cancelled and a new one submitted. The 30-minute threshold uses off-blocks time, not departure time.
GL0rbCBLt3LtAlr75rAU: The recommended pattern loads the day at the front: breakfast should supply around a quarter of the daily calories, with the intake tapering towards a light evening meal so that digestion does not interfere with sleep. The diet should be balanced with adequate fibre, protein and complex carbohydrate, and sugar before flight causes a rebound fall in blood glucose rather than preventing one.
GLdNikxomthhtAXimp08: Hollnagel's descriptive level - the phenotype - lists what can actually be observed in an erroneous action rather than what caused it: an action repeated or omitted (1), performed too early or too late in the sequence, that is a jump forward or backward in the plan (2), and an action inserted that had no place in the plan at all (4).
GLgKPBKU9gF9masWbXOI: QFE is QNH reduced by the pressure equivalent of the aerodrome elevation. 200 m is about 656 ft, and at roughly 27 ft per hPa that is 656 / 27 = 24 hPa. QFE = 1025 - 24 = 1001, approximately 1000 hPa. QFE is always below QNH for an aerodrome above sea level, and the two coincide only at sea level.
GM00TRBjl0XxH9oDN3qZ: Rate of descent is about groundspeed x 5 for a 3 degree path, scaled in proportion to the angle. For 3.5 degrees that is 150 x 5 x 3.5/3 = about 875, and the exact figure, GS x 101 x tan3.5, is about 930 ft/min, so about 900 ft/min.
GMJDPfJEcbf2Yuv8XLKV: The vertical bar is a roll command: how far it is displaced tells the pilot how much bank to apply as well as in which direction, and following it captures and holds the lateral path. It is not a repeat of any raw deviation - the VOR or localiser displacement is shown separately.
GN4rLDMpVG5VLAXya9MC: Disorientation needs an absence of reliable visual reference or a conflict between references. Flying in IMC removes the visual cue (1), repeatedly transferring between outside and instrument references sets up conflicting inputs (2), and an approach over still water at night offers no texture, no horizon and possibly a mirrored surface (4). Emerging from IMC into VMC restores the visual reference rather than removing it.
GNZMh38PFW6xHUsZ43D4: A flight plan must be filed at least 60 minutes before the estimated OFF-BLOCKS time, and the off-blocks time here is 1815, so the deadline is 1715 UTC. The estimated take-off time of 1825 is a distractor: the 60 minutes runs from off-blocks, not from take-off.
GO9uCytnFRitJKT8tyff: For aeroplanes with 20 or more passenger seats the standard all-adult mass may be used, and for flights other than holiday charters that figure is 84 kg including hand baggage. Separate male and female figures of 88 and 70 kg are the alternative where the split is known.
GOUjwQEzCz5pDZuZVvem: In Class E airspace, VFR flights do not require an ATC clearance or two-way radio communication. VFR aircraft operate freely with traffic information provided as far as practical. Only IFR flights require ATC service in Class E.
GP3oQKOEaJ4hLh7c4rJ9: Below about 35°C the body's own defence begins to fail: shivering, which is the main heat-generating response, weakens and stops, and the victim becomes apathetic and stops acting in his own interest. That indifference is the danger sign, because it precedes confusion, coma and the loss of any chance of self-rescue.
GQaw2LTsCstmLpLthXXf: The usual prescription for cardiovascular benefit is aerobic exercise that roughly doubles the resting heart rate, held for at least 20 minutes, three times a week. Regularity is what produces the training effect - a single hard session a week does little - and exercise reduces rather than increases the long-term load on the heart.
GR2HDZcf13OkbeDOjk7e: Drag = CD x 1/2 rho V2 x S, so drag varies with the SQUARE of the airspeed. Multiplying the velocity by 4 multiplies the drag by 4 squared = 16. This square law is why parasite drag climbs so steeply at high speed and why small speed reductions in turbulence produce large reductions in airframe loading.
GRjr31Xc7azGw9A1Exp1: Working memory holds about seven unrelated items, plus or minus two. Chunking - grouping digits into meaningful blocks - increases the effective capacity, which is why a frequency or a squawk is read as pairs rather than as single digits, and why a long clearance must be written down rather than held.
GRlEInwPJzq3Snzi8LFI: Sleep deprivation reduces the reserve available to cope with anything else, so its effects are amplified by any additional stressor. Altitude adds a mild hypoxic load which compounds it (1), and high workload demands exactly the attentional resources that sleep loss has depleted (3). Neither altitude nor workload mitigates the deficit.
GRviu78mJnlaFTHHyXXd: Judgement is the process by which a pilot recognises a situation, weighs the risks in it and chooses a course of action, drawing on knowledge, skill, experience and - critically - his own attitude to risk. It is distinct from handling skill and from instrument interpretation, both of which can be excellent in a pilot whose judgement is poor.
GTK4bhDHqmQjqfU9P99l: The first effects of hypoxia fall on the brain: euphoria, over-confidence and impaired judgement, so the pilot neither notices the deterioration nor believes anything is wrong. With another pilot present the change may be spotted from outside; alone, there is nobody to notice, and by the time the physical signs appear the pilot may no longer be capable of reaching for the oxygen.
GUQGZDIYJw0uVxcukXyu: First the scale where it is measured: 5 degrees at 17N is 300 x cos17 = 287 NM = 53 130 000 cm, so the scale at 17N is 5 / 53 130 000, about 1 : 10 630 000. Convert to the equator by dividing by cos17, giving about 1 : 11 110 000, then to 57N by multiplying by cos57, giving about 1 : 6 052 000. Mercator scale denominators shrink with the cosine of latitude.
GUcv5IlRBEl7ccVNjjgf: Two effects combine. The great circle from A to B starts about 4 degrees left of the 090 rhumb line (conversion angle = half the change of longitude x sin(latitude) = 5 x 0.866). Then the free gyro wanders: earth rate 15 x sin 60 = 13 deg/h over 1 h 30 min, plus transport wander of 10 degrees of longitude x sin 60. Averaged over the flight the gyro reads roughly 14 degrees less than true, so the constant gyro heading works out near 076 degrees.
GUkKd3DX7we3jRvU4UDo: Vertical flight path modes control where the aeroplane goes in the vertical plane: holding a selected altitude (2) and capturing and tracking the glideslope (4). Pitch attitude hold is stabilisation rather than path control, and track hold is a lateral mode.
GV8dU1adtar9DusGCIT0: A SNOWTAM is valid for a maximum of 24 hours, and a new one must be issued whenever conditions change significantly - so the 24 hours is a ceiling, not a promise that the report still describes the runway.
GVAqwfvNWYP6NKn18S01: Holdover is longest in the condition that deposits the least water on the wing. Frost forms slowly from vapour and adds almost nothing to the fluid, so protection lasts longest. Freezing fog, steady snow and especially rain on a cold-soaked wing all dilute the fluid quickly, and rain on a cold-soaked wing is the shortest holdover of all.
GVK8drBOyiucwWG0vhFz: Work the legs in order. South 3600 NM is 60 degrees of latitude, from 60N to the equator. East 3600 NM on the EQUATOR is a full 60 degrees of longitude, reaching 030E. North 3600 NM returns to 60N. West 3600 NM at 60N is 3600/cos60 = 120 degrees of longitude, ending at 090W. The same distance buys very different longitude at different latitudes.
GVasfXQiwu5WCmmQOWWR: Air flows from the subtropical high-pressure belt toward the equatorial trough, and Coriolis deflects it to the LEFT in the southern hemisphere, turning a southerly flow into a south-easterly. So the southern-hemisphere trades are the south-east trades, the mirror image of the north-east trades of the northern hemisphere. The two meet at the ITCZ.
GVdayAVoLSJSi0RwsgAF: SSR is a secondary radar: the ground station interrogates and the aircraft transponder REPLIES on a different frequency (1030 MHz up, 1090 MHz down). Weather radar and surface movement radar are primary radars relying on reflected energy, and GPS is a passive one-way receive-only system.
GVzy34aXoQuzkg7H2suc: For a non-precision or circling approach, the Minimum Descent Height (MDH) cannot be lower than the Obstacle Clearance Height (OCH). The OCH sets the absolute floor based on obstacle clearance requirements.
GW8t2nfYKCqLjioH9F9O: ICAO Doc 4444 states that during a radar approach, the pilot should be advised to consider a missed approach if the aircraft is not visible on radar for a significant interval during the last 2 NM. This ensures guidance through the critical final segment.
GX4vyEWXEyaPxJHOxgA7: A stimulus must first exceed the absolute threshold of the sense organ before anything can be perceived, and changes must exceed the difference threshold before they can be discriminated. Stimulus intensity is therefore treated here as the foundation on which the later stages of perception are built; the memory-based options describe the interpretation that follows.
GXG3SBZNY5yn5HJluzaz: Take the quoted figures as signed components on the TAS: 490 - 20 = 470 kt out and 490 + 40 = 530 kt back. PET = D x H / (O + H) = 1000 x 530 / 1000 = 530 NM from A. Note the two groundspeeds sum to 1000, so the answer equals the groundspeed home. The PET always lies towards the end that is slower to reach, so a PET beyond the midpoint is the expected shape when the outbound leg is the slow one.
GXMnxEXmMqRhN0uzAtCF: A continuous loop is a length of sensing element run round the compartment, whose electrical properties change when any part of it is heated. It responds to a general rise in temperature as readily as to a local fire, so it serves as an overheat as well as a fire detector.
GXwR4k9AloXcsXYpmBoA: Pulling the handle isolates the engine and arms the bottles: the low pressure fuel valve closes (1), the bleed, isolation and de-icing valves close (4), the generator is taken off line (5) and the extinguisher circuit is armed (3). The agent is not released until the crew presses the discharge switch.
GYjcQRsTWFg9K7503XOi: 8000 ft is the maximum normal cabin altitude of a transport aeroplane precisely because efficiency is unimpaired there. Above 10 000 ft crew oxygen becomes mandatory, and by 14 000 ft judgement, night vision and useful work are all measurably degraded even though the individual may feel fine.
GZQsL7Ft09bWfbB9fPbr: Accelerometers on the engine casing sense the vibration produced by an out-of-balance rotor, and the signal is filtered to the shaft frequency so that N1 and N2 imbalance can be told apart. A rising trend indicates blade damage, contamination or a failing bearing before anything else shows.
GZrNJZXojFW5Z5uluzbV: On a Lambert the cone cuts the sphere at the two standard parallels, where the scale is exact. Between them the chart lies inside the sphere so the scale is too small, reaching its MINIMUM at the parallel of origin midway between them; outside them it is too large. Total variation across a normal chart band is well under 1 percent.
Gay3Y6Tn3O9gnCUNr2hl: Pressure altitude is the altitude in the standard atmosphere at which the pressure equals the pressure actually being measured - which is exactly what the altimeter reads with 1013.25 set. It is a way of expressing a pressure as a height, not a measurement of the real height.
GbDoOt7zs5nVNigh4zfB: Pilot's vertigo is the general term for the dizziness and disorientation produced when the vestibular system is given conflicting or ambiguous inputs - classically by moving the head during a turn, which stimulates a second pair of semicircular canals and produces a violent sensation of tumbling. Nystagmus is the associated eye movement, not the sensation itself.
GbGKAVpWnqSt4OLpOSNV: As angle of attack increases the oncoming flow meets the aerofoil from further below, so the stagnation point migrates DOWN and aft along the lower surface. At the same time the suction peak on the upper surface sharpens and moves FORWARD toward the leading edge, which is also why the centre of pressure moves forward on a cambered section. Stagnation point movement is what a flapper-switch stall warner senses.
GbxidmXrmg0nOMcUWdJr: ICAO Annex 7 prohibits registration mark combinations that might be confused with urgent or distress signals. TTT is the urgency signal in Morse code and must not be used as a registration mark combination.
GcK1TmTjzcKwTIsNtuFB: The ATC term 'radar contact' means the aircraft has been identified on the radar display and radar flight instructions will be provided until radar identification is terminated. It confirms both identification and the start of radar-based service.
GcQLhngv6U9y6g8UyoEY: In a two-step treatment the holdover clock starts at the BEGINNING of the second step, when the anti-icing fluid starts going on. It is a deliberately conservative reference: by the time the last surface is treated some of that protection has already been used up, which is why the timing is taken from the start rather than the end.
GcwhktudayHTU9fy7Gni: The certification scale runs minor, major, hazardous, catastrophic. A minor failure produces only a slight increase in crew workload and a slight reduction in safety margins - the crew can cope without difficulty. Physical discomfort or a significant workload increase defines the major case.
GdGPbkUFMP1BI9Qj0hRE: As the centre of pressure moves aft, the distance between it and the CG grows, lengthening the arm of the restoring moment. A larger restoring moment for a given pitch disturbance is by definition greater static longitudinal STABILITY. The same rearward shift is what produces the nose-down Mach tuck, so the aeroplane becomes both more stable and harder to hold in trim.
Ge4lSCS68ochWEILoSEF: A Mode A reply carries an identity code but no altitude, so TCAS gets range and rough bearing but nothing in the vertical. Without the intruder's level it cannot compute a vertical separation and therefore cannot issue a resolution advisory - only a traffic advisory to prompt a visual search.
Ge5DFsFX3nHMFdOhCG0C: ICAO Annex 2: in mountainous areas where no State minimum IFR altitude is established, an IFR flight shall maintain at least 2000 ft above the highest obstacle within 8 km of the estimated position. For non-mountainous terrain the minimum is 1000 ft within 8 km.
Ge8FlHinKPARXKWnuwa9: A straight line on a polar stereographic chart is very nearly a great circle, and the small departure grows with the change of longitude spanned. With an earth convergence of 20 degrees at 60N the two points are more than 20 degrees of longitude apart - several hundred miles - so a maximum separation of about 30 NM between the true great circle and the plotted straight line is the right order of magnitude. Note that this question offers 4.0 NM twice, which is a defect in the option list.
GeIad0eMxGOjLHS7DwZo: Two autopilots give no spare channel for the landing, so the system is fail-passive: any failure produces a clean disconnect without a significant deviation, but the automatics can no longer complete the landing. Three channels are needed before a system can be fail-operational.
GeJ9iWuIjRinUAB99TuH: Paradoxical or REM sleep is named for the contradiction between a brain that looks awake on the EEG and a body that is effectively paralysed. Its signature is bursts of rapid eye movement, accompanied by irregular pulse and respiration and by dreaming. It is associated with mental and emotional recuperation and with consolidating learning; physical restoration belongs to the deep slow-wave stages.
GeKGAABYvcaNz6o7iI3C: Wake vortices are a by-product of lift, so they start when the wing takes the weight at rotation and stop when the weight returns to the wheels at touchdown. The ground roll before rotation and after touchdown produces jet blast but no wake.
GevaIlZruo4eOl3qAWx1: The alerting hierarchy is warning, caution, advisory. An advisory requires the crew to be aware of a condition and may require them to do something about it later, but nothing has to be done now - which is why it is presented without red or amber and without an aural alert.
GezCEspJNJqZRc2sw1Be: ICAO standard holding patterns use right-hand turns unless otherwise published. All turns in the holding pattern, after initial entry, should be to the right unless the chart or ATC specifies left-hand turns.
GfGHRmuYDSJlDBkshg6z: Equalising middle-ear pressure through the Eustachian tube prevents the eardrum from being stretched, which is what causes pain, temporary hearing loss and, in the extreme, rupture. Equalisation is hardest on descent, not climb, and difficulty comes with rapid rather than slow pressure changes - a gentle descent gives the tube time to work.
GfoqG6oJW1ee9a9PhK8t: ICAO groups aircraft for wake turbulence by maximum certificated take-off mass: HEAVY at 136 000 kg or more, MEDIUM from 7000 kg up to but not including 136 000 kg, and LIGHT at 7000 kg or less.
Gfp17JgT0hUZr2oQnlXB: Dry chemical powder interrupts the combustion chain reaction and is non-conductive, so it works on all four - paper and plastic (class A), hydrocarbons (class B) and live electrical equipment. Burning metals are the exclusion, and the residue and loss of visibility are why powder is not used on the flight deck.
GgBi4kwXNEgkkq1Dkf0q: Standard procedures make performance consistent: the same action is done the same way every time, which reduces the mental effort of deciding how, makes the other pilot's actions predictable and therefore monitorable, and cuts the error rate. That predictability is the point - a crew who have never flown together can still work as one.
GgS6rHDQTJ7nqawRdGSX: In a strapdown system both gyros and accelerometers are bolted rigidly to the airframe, with no gimbals: the stable platform exists only as a mathematical transformation in the computer. That is what makes ring laser gyros practical, since they must cope with full aircraft rates rather than sitting on a levelled platform.
GgxaRtssyYa2Kd5ucd0f: The radar wake minima are 4 NM for a MEDIUM behind a HEAVY at some ATS units, 5 NM for a MEDIUM behind a HEAVY generally and for a LIGHT behind a MEDIUM, and 6 NM for a LIGHT behind a HEAVY. Of the crossing cases offered, the LIGHT following a MEDIUM within 1000 ft vertically is the 5 NM case.
GgynjrFZZqnsyHBDjcdv: A healthy adult at rest breathes about 12-20 times a minute. Sustained rates well above this without a matching increase in metabolic demand indicate hyperventilation, and the depth of each breath matters as much as the rate, since it is total ventilation relative to CO2 production that sets the blood CO2 level.
GhV71AsbHi9CrclQ40BN: Presbycusis, the sensorineural hearing loss of ageing, begins at the high frequencies and works downwards. Because consonants carry most of the high-frequency energy in speech, the first practical complaint is difficulty understanding words - particularly in noise or over the radio - rather than any sense that sounds have become quieter.
GhgX1qnSLfTidp6DHY0B: Equivalent airspeed is defined as the speed that would produce the same dynamic pressure at standard sea level density, so where the actual density is that value - standard conditions at sea level - EAS and TAS are identical. Everywhere else TAS exceeds EAS.
Gi1T4Ezd1rYyS5ycCEOt: Earth distance = chart length x scale denominator = 4.2 cm x 1 600 000 = 6 720 000 cm = 67 200 m. Dividing by 1852 gives about 36.3 NM. The 67.20 option is that same figure left in kilometres and mislabelled as nautical miles.
GkmGA3vfITt0RvY9Yvzx: A Boeing CDU offers four ways to CREATE a waypoint that is not in the database: place bearing/distance from a known identifier, the intersection of two place bearings, an along-track displacement from an existing waypoint, and raw latitude/longitude. Entering an existing waypoint by NAME is not creating one, which is what makes that option wrong.
Gld4zfyyYe61ionmKOYx: Wind shear is defined by the rate of change: a substantial change of wind velocity and/or direction over a SHORT distance, in the vertical or the horizontal plane. Spread the same change over a large distance and it becomes a gentle gradient the aeroplane absorbs without difficulty.
GmOnNNG4zMx9cb9FV83V: The number of hand extinguishers is scheduled against the approved seating capacity, rising one at a time through the bands: three from 61 to 200 seats, four from 201 to 300, five from 301 to 400 and six from 401 to 500.
GnbuPjVdI7dQfh81gjQC: A core temperature of 39°C is already well outside the narrow band in which the body works properly: concentration, judgement and reaction time deteriorate and physical work capacity falls, along with dehydration from the sweating that accompanies it. Clinical effects begin well below 39°C, and apathy and collapse come later still.
GneXNFeQqykj114z47mK: The peak temperature is reached in the primary zone of the combustion chamber, where the flame burns at close to the stoichiometric ratio - far hotter than any material could survive. Dilution air added down the flame tube brings it back to what the turbine can take, so the gas is cooler at the chamber outlet than inside it.
GnihuWZFRavNNKmIJBP8: The autothrottle controls thrust, so its modes are a thrust setting expressed as N1 (1) or a speed to be held with thrust (3). N2 is not a thrust-rating parameter, and the autothrottle is an independent system which can be engaged or disengaged separately from the autopilot.
GoSpYoy3q12S1LTFZ1N6: A propeller aeroplane's fuel flow is broadly proportional to POWER, and power is drag times speed - so best range means least drag per mile, which is the (L/D)max condition. In level flight lift equals weight, so maximum L/D and minimum drag are the same point. Note the contrast with a JET, whose fuel flow follows thrust and whose best range lies at a higher speed, around 1.32 x VMD.
GoU0HWDUS2iq8r0lFXMX: Angle of attack is measured by an airflow sensor: either a vane on a shaft which weathercocks into the flow and drives a synchro (3), or a slotted conical probe which rotates until the pressures at its two slots are equal (2). It cannot be derived inertially, because the air's own motion is unknown to an inertial system.
Gpo81lJ7ZADvC7VRw1rl: In the resistance phase the initial adrenaline surge has passed and the body settles into a sustained defence, with cortisol mobilising energy by converting fat and protein into glucose. This is what lets an individual keep functioning through a prolonged demand - it can last a long time, which is precisely why the exhaustion that follows arrives without warning.
Gq8s7FtghKDm9rgEcLpv: A flight director is a computer, which works out the attitude required to achieve the selected mode, and a display of that command - the command bars on the attitude indicator. The autopilot and autothrottle may follow the same computation but are separate systems; the director works perfectly well with both off.
GqaWkUInjL6nWZIuUY1i: The row for this question is corrupted in the source data - the tail of the stem has been parsed into the option list - so the options cannot be matched to the question. The underlying point, from the intact sibling qDiwJtdgs0Pmh6jRqmMS: all four agents work on a class A fire - water (the preferred agent, because it cools), CO2, dry chemical and halon.
GrNBdKk2D73i0VfQ8DqG: Autofeather is armed for take-off and landing, the phases in which an engine failure at high power leaves no time to identify and feather manually and in which the drag of a windmilling propeller would be most damaging to performance. It is disarmed in the cruise so that it cannot act on a transient.
GrklhhKX20bj0vYZqb4k: ICAO Annex 6 requires that weight records (after weighing and CG determination) be preserved for a period of 3 months. This is the minimum retention period for such operational records.
Grtm8iqHm7HrcggBWEo5: ICAO Doc 4444 requires a minimum radar separation of 1.0 NM when independent parallel approaches are being conducted, until aircraft are established on the ILS localizer or MLS final approach track.
GsLT0LdMhrqBByHB5EhI: The crew needs to know that the system has pressure, that it has fluid and that it is not overheating, so pressure, quantity and temperature are the parameters displayed. Viscosity and pump speed are not measured, and pump output is inferred from the pressure.
GtI2rkzGx8oEZ6G7ODvp: A non-cantilever, or braced, wing carries part of its load through external struts or wires to the fuselage, so the wing structure itself can be lighter. The penalty is the drag of the bracing, which is why the arrangement survives only on light and slow aeroplanes.
GtNXKYFoQaXm1dzGvTwP: An aneroid capsule is a thin flexible chamber suited to the smallest pressures, a bellows has more stiffness and covers the middle range, and a Bourdon tube is a stiff curved tube for the high pressures of hydraulic and fuel systems - so the order of increasing pressure is capsule, bellows, Bourdon tube.
Gu8wMMqNXTCVjY911I8s: The ceiling set by pressurisation is where the maximum differential the structure can take, added to the highest cabin altitude that may be scheduled, no longer reaches the outside pressure. Both halves matter, which is why a higher permitted cabin altitude and a stronger fuselage both raise the ceiling.
GubcKBU3bOTacv7fKyIR: Altitude hold is a proportional-plus-rate loop: the computer measures how far the aircraft is from the selected altitude (1) and commands a pitch attitude (4) that will return it there without overshoot, the attitude term providing the damping. Engine speed and ground speed play no part.
GvfsUMHWR5Yk8BuZrLkA: The five recognised hazardous attitudes are anti-authority (the rules do not apply to me), impulsiveness (do something, quickly), invulnerability (it will not happen to me), macho (I can do it) and resignation (there is nothing I can do). Each has a standard antidote, and recognising which one is operating is the first step in countering it.
Gx1YPicT3hRojv9z9NKU: Spare fuses for in-flight replacement must number 10% of those of each rating, or three of each rating, whichever is the GREATER. The minimum of three is what protects an aeroplane carrying only a few fuses of some particular rating.
GyVB6R8ENhqRp124Qg1z: A LIGHT following a MEDIUM on approach takes 3 minutes - the longest of the approach wake minima - because the light aeroplane has the least roll authority to resist a vortex. A MEDIUM or LIGHT following a HEAVY is separated by 2 minutes.
Gz6qrNt8GKE7WkRz6YG7: Controlled flight into terrain was the largest single category of hull loss until the ground proximity warning system was mandated, after which CFIT accidents fell sharply through the 1980s. TCAS addressed a different and rarer risk and came later; SSR and DME are not warning systems at all.
H0SKls1l5Vrg8WlUo4WG: Thirst is a symptom of dehydration already established rather than a warning of it (2), and dehydration produces dizziness, headache, fatigue and reduced concentration (3). Statement 1 is false - cabin humidity in cruise falls to around 10-20%, far below comfort level - and statement 4 is nonsense, since no tolerance to dehydration is built by drinking less.
H12n0hMmuGg2ElLHQnjA: The earth is an oblate spheroid, so a meridian is slightly shorter than the equator: half a meridian is about 20 004 km against 20 038 km for half the equator. Any pole-to-pole route between these two antipodal points is therefore about 34 km shorter than the equatorial route, and north and south are identical.
H1yT7XBkwYd5J3y6BrtF: Holding the highest possible altitude on one engine means minimising the thrust required, and thrust required is at its least where DRAG is at its least - the angle of attack giving (L/D)max. Any other speed needs more thrust than the remaining engine can spare for level flight, so the aeroplane will drift down further. Long range speed is faster than this and would cost altitude.
H2Cu3Hv9h9hf3qJDLGVM: The interrogation and the reply are 63 MHz apart, so the aircraft receiver is simply not listening on the frequency its own interrogator transmits and cannot see the ground reflection. The paired pulses and the jittered recurrence rate solve a different problem: they let the aircraft recognise which replies from a shared transponder are answers to its own interrogations.
H2GkZmnKx1z4PqPsI8Rg: The erection system must keep the gyro's spin axis aligned with the local vertical. In an electric horizon two mercury switches - one for each axis - sense any tilt and switch current to the corresponding torque motor, which applies a precessing torque that brings the gyro back upright.
H2JhHqH4XRIQVvKMwHKY: A 5.2 percent gradient means 5.2 ft of height for every 100 ft of ground distance. 7 NM is 7 x 6076 = 42 500 ft, so the height is 0.052 x 42 500 = about 2210 ft. The useful shortcut: on a 3 degree (5.2 percent) path the height is about 300 ft per NM.
H2QKD2feCplnfDkQLYX9: The wind from 210 is on the port quarter of the 265 heading, so it pushes the aircraft right and takes a little speed off. Resolving the vectors gives a track of about 271 and a groundspeed of about 272 kt, i.e. about 6 degrees of starboard drift.
H2zUL4duSM6RIWZ0TMgH: For two-engined Performance Class B or C aeroplanes without ETOPS approval, the limit is 120 minutes at the one-engine-inoperative cruising speed or 300 NM, whichever is LESS. Performance Class A twins with 20 or more seats or above 45 360 kg are held to 60 minutes instead.
H3onSbHK6ZCrkWMRR2gC: Special VFR may not be COMMENCED when the visibility is below 3 km, and may not be continued below 1.5 km. Both figures come from JAR-OPS 1.465, and which one a question wants depends on whether it asks about starting or continuing.
H4TR0BYB5gjFKsAi1eut: Fatigue life is consumed by cycles, above all the pressurisation cycle, and the certificated life is calculated for an assumed mix of sector lengths. Flying many short sectors instead of a few long ones uses up that life far faster than the flying hours suggest, so the aeroplane reaches its structural limit prematurely.
H4jRAf6rtOkVpG37xqlZ: The packs deliver a substantially fixed mass flow and the outflow valve modulates to hold the scheduled cabin altitude, so in the steady state exactly as much air leaves as enters. The valve sits partly open doing that - fully closed or fully open would mean the cabin was descending or climbing.
H4xF5Hix8tlKVBlZO4Sq: Under ICAO Annex 17 and the Tokyo Convention, the Contracting State in which an act of unlawful interference occurs - typically where the aircraft lands - takes responsibility for the safety of passengers and crew and for their onward journey. The operator and commander have duties too, but the obligation to protect and to enable continuation rests with that State.
H51uW1U4lZUaeUrapIf5: The Aerodrome Reference Code consists of a number (1-4, based on reference field length) and a letter (A-F, based on wingspan and outer main gear wheel span). Valid combinations include 2B but not 5E or 6D, as numbers only go to 4.
H5G1v2ydhYyTo5kRc2Lt: Vortex strength follows the lift coefficient the wing is working at, so for a given aeroplane the worst case is high mass with low airspeed - the wing must produce a lot of lift at a large angle of attack. HEAVY, CLEAN and SLOW is the standard summary.
H5GSWupTBdTofh3w9CBl: A firewall must contain a fire for a defined period without failing, so it is made of stainless steel or titanium - materials that keep their strength at flame temperatures. Aluminium would melt, and composites would burn through.
H5roLpzbDL6Y8ZLik4sj: A forward centre of gravity increases the distance to the neutral point, so the restoring moment in pitch is large and the aeroplane is very stable. The price is that a large elevator deflection and a large stick force are needed to change attitude, which is what the forward limit is set to keep manageable.
H6FFxpi8hkFGsc0l4F5j: The phrase 'in still air' means this is a measurement of the surrounding atmosphere rather than of a moving parcel, so it is by definition the environmental lapse rate - the actual observed temperature profile, which varies with time and place and can take any value. The adiabatic rates are fixed parcel-process constants: the dry rate is exactly 1 C per 100 m and the saturated rate is always less than that, so neither can be 1.2 C per 100 m.
H6O5AYVxOYhZujaIL9JE: The scheduled number of hand extinguishers is one for 7 to 30 seats and two for 31 to 60, so an aeroplane approved for exactly 31 passengers falls into the second band and requires two, conveniently located in the cabin.
H6qh1LzJZ8lbXzXGaIf1: Social motives distort decisions. Wanting to be accepted by the crew, to be seen as the leader, or simply to avoid an argument pushes an individual towards endorsing what others have already proposed rather than towards evaluating it. This is the mechanism behind conformity and groupthink, and it is why an explicit invitation to disagree is part of a good briefing.
H70JoPZh18pVicz6Oiv1: The minimum a system must do is tell the crew when it has failed, because a decision built on information the crew believes to be valid but is not is exactly how wrong decisions are made. Tolerating a deviation, reporting it or correcting it are all more capable behaviours, but announcing its own malfunction is the irreducible requirement.
H7Ffg0XquaYFpZ1t87xz: The 250 hPa surface lies near 34,000 ft in the standard atmosphere, between the 300 hPa chart at about FL300 and the 200 hPa chart at about FL390. It is a commonly used chart for jet cruise levels. In practice the actual height varies with the mean temperature of the layer below: higher over warm air, lower over cold air.
H7JMGdFn6yA4yvbMUVr1: The ITCZ is the belt where the two trade wind systems converge, forcing deep ascent in warm, extremely moist air, so cumulonimbus with very high tops occur frequently and are its defining hazard. It is an area of low pressure but of HIGH relative humidity, and it migrates seasonally with the sun, though it never shifts entirely into one hemisphere - over the oceans it stays close to the equator all year.
H7krdZ1vuswgiFSaEgde: The flux valve's output can be used by a slaved gyro compass or a flux gate system (2) and is accurate to a fraction of a degree because it is fixed in a wingtip or fin, well away from the aircraft's own magnetism, and has no moving parts (4). It is a detector in its own right, not fed from the standby compass, and it is a three-legged spider rather than a pair of bars.
H98XWGF69wEd3cGMRl6M: A 600 kg package on a 750 kg/m2 floor needs at least 600/750 = 0.8 square metres of contact area. Of the pallets offered, 40 cm by 200 cm gives exactly 0.8 m2, which is the smallest that will do; anything less concentrates the load beyond the limit.
H9QPIhxzhsQnxOGbApLu: Around a high the air curves anticyclonically, so in the rotating frame the centrifugal force acts outward - the same direction as the pressure gradient force, which also points outward from the high. A larger total outward force needs a larger inward Coriolis force to balance it, and Coriolis is proportional to speed, so the gradient wind is SUPER-geostrophic. Around a low the centrifugal force opposes the pressure gradient force and the gradient wind is sub-geostrophic.
H9RFA2nvisDOgRgLGt5g: The wind from 210 is on the port quarter of the 265 heading, so the aircraft drifts right and loses a little speed. Resolving the vectors gives a track of about 271 and a groundspeed of about 272 kt. Note the track is to the RIGHT of the heading, so any option below 265 can be discarded at once.
HASyRxazDq7xgMurZt3y: Descending into denser air puts more mass of air through the engine for the same throttle position, so the fuel flow must be increased to keep the fuel-air ratio where it was. That is why the mixture is enriched in the descent just as it is leaned in the climb.
HAwN09icu26Z8454zLT8: A track of 270 on a great circle is the VERTEX, the most northerly point of the route in the northern hemisphere. Past it the latitude can only decrease, and in the northern hemisphere a westbound great circle track decreases as the flight runs west, so both the track angle and the latitude fall.
HBeW0ZUX4W1AGZZ9aiwj: In Class C airspace below 10,000 ft AMSL, IFR flights are subject to the standard 250 kt IAS speed limitation. This applies to both IFR and VFR traffic in most jurisdictions.
HCsAbKQ44mM7ERiHXL3s: Category I requires an RVR of not less than 550 m (or visibility not less than 800 m) with a decision height not lower than 200 ft. Category II halves the RVR to 300 m, and Category IIIA takes it to 200 m.
HFC9VPiQcTqvwX6W7D79: Faraday's law: relative motion between a conductor and a magnetic field induces an electromotive force in the conductor, proportional to the rate at which flux is cut. That is the principle of every generator and alternator, and of the magneto and the tachogenerator as well.
HFIle6ZgXWHKgk1pYesh: On a transverse Mercator the cylinder touches the globe along one chosen meridian, so the scale is exactly correct along that meridian of tangency and expands away from it as the secant of the great circle distance from it. That is why the projection is used for narrow north/south strips and why UTM is divided into 6 degree zones.
HFRRpbtvV61nI8v7MOs9: ICAO Doc 8168 (PANS-OPS) specifies the minimum obstacle clearance (MOC) for the initial approach segment primary area as 300 m (984 ft). The intermediate segment MOC is 150 m and the final approach segment varies by approach type.
HGCmc0rN8g0ChaQJTOl6: Torque is measured where it is transmitted, in the reduction gearbox between engine and propeller - typically from the axial load a helical gear generates, sensed as an oil pressure. The propeller itself and the accessory gearbox carry no useful measure of the shaft power being delivered.
HGWTZIFlLPWPVdImISU4: The descent is 33 000 - 10 000 = 23 000 ft, and 65 NM at 330 kt takes 65/330 x 60 = about 11.8 minutes. So the rate of descent needed is 23 000 / 11.8 = about 1950 ft/min. Work the time from the groundspeed first; the height is the easy part.
HGqDi19XPxlUWiehQwML: On an enroute chart the larger figure printed against an airway segment is the Minimum Enroute Altitude, the lowest altitude that guarantees both obstacle clearance and navigation signal coverage for the whole segment. The smaller figure with the 'a' suffix is the minimum obstacle clearance altitude, which guarantees clearance but not signal coverage.
HHUjW8LVHgpJza6McSIT: The CSD's own oil does the work and takes the heat, so the two things that will kill it are running hot and running dry. Oil over-temperature and low oil pressure are therefore the parameters annunciated, and either of them calls for the drive to be disconnected before it seizes.
HHqMuIXEHt5j4VyIcaDC: Accelerometers measure acceleration and nothing else. Integrating once gives the change in velocity and hence ground speed; integrating again gives distance travelled and hence position. Both integrations need a starting value, which is why alignment requires the aircraft to be stationary at a known position.
HImlNIgmEKGerz0AIJCh: As the air is compressed its density rises, so for the same mass flow it needs less area. The annulus and the blades are therefore made progressively smaller towards the rear, which keeps the axial velocity roughly constant along the compressor - the condition each stage was designed for.
HIvAZOeETECQGyYgiEAu: Add the empty mass and optional equipment to the occupants and cargo to get the zero fuel mass, then add the fuel remaining at landing - the block fuel less the trip fuel - to obtain the landing mass. (Note that the arithmetic from the figures as printed does not land exactly on any of the options offered, so this row's data are not fully self-consistent.)
HJUXDQUAII8Ixjc5x0TD: With irreversible actuators the surface loads are taken by the actuator and none reaches the control column, so the pilot would have no feel and nothing to warn him of speed or load factor. An artificial feel unit is therefore mandatory, generating a force that varies with dynamic pressure and control deflection.
HJh8jYSBQn4ibe3AgQ0T: Some national authorities credit 100% of MPA co-pilot time towards total flight time for a higher grade licence. This contrasts with the ICAO Annex 1 standard of 50% credit. The answer depends on the regulatory framework being tested.
HLWBQWQbw6jbBrmrarsq: An adiabatic process involves no exchange of heat with the surroundings, and while the parcel stays unsaturated it is fully reversible. It cools at 1 C per 100 m on the way up and warms at exactly the same rate on the way back down, so it returns to its starting temperature. Had it been taken ABOVE the condensation level, latent heat release would have made the process irreversible and it would have returned warmer - the Foehn effect.
HLYRF8V2OzK4PWUskoao: The crossover altitude is where the constant-IAS schedule and the constant-Mach schedule give the same true airspeed. A HIGHER climb IAS reaches any given Mach number at a LOWER altitude, so raising the IAS from 280 to 290 while holding M0.74 brings the crossover DOWN. Above the crossover the aeroplane flies Mach, below it flies IAS.
HLaqTFm2YgY98mlcm9Cp: Vortex generators are small vanes that trip the boundary layer turbulent, mixing high-energy free-stream air down toward the skin. That extra energy allows the layer to survive the steep adverse pressure gradient behind a shock wave, so shock-induced separation - and the Mach buffet and control degradation that follow - is delayed to a higher Mach number. They cost a little parasite drag, which is a price worth paying.
HLvDtNUWH5kGBSiKotdR: The tropopause is the boundary between the troposphere, in which temperature falls with height and virtually all weather occurs, and the stratosphere above, in which the temperature is first isothermal and then increases. Its height varies from about 8 km over the poles to 16-18 km over the equator, and it acts as a stable lid on convection.
HM8Ldck0t5ulogVs6CcR: At 35,000 ft the time of useful consciousness is of the order of a minute, and a rapid loss of cabin pressure shortens it because alveolar oxygen pressure falls instantly and gas is driven out of the lungs. That is why the oxygen mask goes on before anything else is done, and why the emergency descent follows immediately.
HMeY9CRFwT4SxA5MTXe2: The certification demonstration requires the full complement of passengers and crew to be evacuated within 90 seconds using only half the exits, on the assumption that the others may be unusable. That requirement, rather than any simple headcount rule, is what determines the number and size of the exits.
HMi6ZJVWOYOUHcr091jf: Fail safe design provides more than one path for the load (1), so that if one member fails the others carry it until the damage is found - the principle of redundancy (4). It is the alternative to safe life, in which a single member is simply retired after a calculated number of cycles.
HMkg2iZlkU6GnEAkGl68: The wind from 030 is about 55 degrees off the port bow of the 085 course, giving a crosswind of 100 x sin55 = 82 kt from the left, so the heading is turned about 10 degrees left to 075. The headwind of 100 x cos55 = 57 kt brings the groundspeed to about 405 kt, so 265 NM takes about 39 minutes.
HMnBqLZEWItqg75MRZzM: Cowl flaps control the volume of cooling air passing over the cylinders, so they are opened when the cylinder head temperature rises - at high power and low airspeed in the climb - and closed in the cruise to reduce drag. Oil temperature is controlled separately by the oil cooler flap.
HNgYFd6tlNijL60yWy8Y: Stress is not the event but the person's reaction to the demands placed on him, which is why the same situation affects two people differently. Obligations a person imposes on himself are among the commonest stressors, some stress is necessary for good performance, and stressors may be physical, psychological or social.
HNmPSYkZXjMyNXMEUbl4: A negative differential would collapse the fuselage inwards, since the structure is designed for pressure from the inside. The inward or negative relief valve opens as soon as the outside pressure exceeds the cabin pressure, letting air in and preventing the differential from reversing.
HOMbpNuzCI4siTfP0msT: Both hemispheres have jet streams, and both have westerly and easterly ones. The polar front and subtropical jets are westerly and occur in each hemisphere. The tropical easterly jet is a summer feature over southern Asia and Africa, which places it in the northern hemisphere, so the northern hemisphere carries both westerly and easterly jets.
HOcfKe50MyhDCOwDJzyp: A fuse works by melting a link and must be replaced once it has operated, so statement I is correct. A circuit breaker uses a thermal or magnetic trip and can be reset by hand, which is why statement II is wrong - and why breakers, not fuses, are used where a reset may be needed in flight.
HPe8TBfGQgOwmHGb5Fmn: Track 207 against heading 206 is just 1 degree of right drift, and the groundspeed is 5 kt below the TAS, so the wind is a light headwind almost straight down the nose. Resolving the vectors gives a wind from about 180 degrees at 5 kt.
HPtwa8GFt4IgK9mCFKdY: Capacitance is proportional to the plate area and to the permittivity of the dielectric between them, and inversely proportional to their separation. In a fuel probe the area and spacing are fixed, so the capacitance varies with the permittivity - which changes as fuel replaces air between the tubes.
HQCRhfELoDczv8iHUrs0: A battery's capacity is the product of current and time it can sustain, so it is quoted in ampere-hours - a 40 Ah battery will in principle deliver 2 amps for 20 hours. The rating assumes a defined discharge rate, because a very heavy discharge yields fewer ampere-hours than a light one.
HRs58F3v464GGG9EZQb4: The constant speed drive absorbs the variation in engine speed and turns the generator at a fixed speed, so the output frequency stays at 400 Hz whatever the engine is doing. Voltage is controlled separately by the regulator acting on the field.
HSPxlMrvHTEJTBwWCCsa: Groundspeed out is 470 + 55 = 525 kt and home is 470 - 75 = 395 kt. PET from A = D x H / (O + H) = 2900 x 395 / 920 = about 1245 NM, which at 525 kt takes about 2 h 22 min. Added to 1435 that gives 1657. Note the PET is short of the midpoint because the return leg is the slow one.
HSgGTA4ESgp3oXaWX6Hz: Whether a situation produces stress depends on how the individual appraises it - the demand as he perceives it, weighed against the resources he believes he has. Tiredness, the environment and individual susceptibility all modify that appraisal, but it is the interpretation itself that determines whether stress is experienced and how severe it is.
HTJHQcQkhht3VXZXbXv5: The dewpoint is the temperature to which air must be cooled to saturate it, so the temperature-dewpoint spread is a direct measure of how far the air is from saturation. Dry air has to be cooled a long way, giving a large spread; moist air is already close to saturation, giving a small one. The absolute temperature is irrelevant - very cold air can be saturated and very warm air can be bone dry.
HTJnYoMvBRTXiQsRwdd5: The change of longitude from 010E to 030W is 40 degrees, because the two straddle the Greenwich meridian and therefore add. Chart convergency = dlong x n, so n = 30 / 40 = 0.75. That constant of the cone corresponds to a parallel of origin of arcsin(0.75), about 48.6N.
HTs54Jle780KBneqMqpZ: For a jet, thrust available is roughly constant with speed, so the maximum EXCESS thrust - and hence the best climb ANGLE - occurs where drag is least, at VMD. Maximum endurance for a jet is also at VMD, since fuel flow follows thrust. Maximum range lies higher, at about 1.32 x VMD. So the ascending order is Vs, then the max angle of climb speed, then the max range speed.
HUWb7tXOAtPwvO31uVlr: At low rotor speeds the compressor is far from its design point: the rear stages choke, the axial velocity through the front stages falls and their blades stall. Bleed valves opened between the spools dump some of the flow overboard, unloading the front stages and restoring the stall margin.
HVuwXZk9FAhVsIGf5dBr: Warm sector air is tropical maritime: warm, very moist and stable, which over the sea or in winter gives stratus, drizzle and poor visibility. Over a strongly heated summer continent, however, surface heating destabilises the lowest layers, breaks up the stratus and converts it into fair weather cumulus with good visibility. The season and the land surface are what change the answer here.
HW4yHVEwAcgogqtb2Lpr: What makes hypoxia lethal is not the physical symptoms but the euphoria and loss of judgement that come first: the pilot feels well, is satisfied with his performance and therefore takes no action - and may resist the suggestion that anything is wrong. Any symptom that felt unpleasant would at least prompt a response.
HWozcyoejXvpkVVCfFLS: PAPI consists of a single wing bar of 4 sharp-transition multi-lamp or paired units equally spaced. Two wing bars would be a T-VASIS or AT-VASIS system.
HXDBJXOgP51BeSbSabhB: The impulse coupling is needed only at cranking speed. Once the engine is running, centrifugal force throws the flyweights outwards so that the pawls no longer engage, and the magneto is then driven directly with its normal advanced timing.
HYUh7PmEVbNefShahoBd: Frequency equals the number of pole pairs multiplied by the speed in revolutions per second, so it is fixed by the machine's construction and its rotational speed. That is why holding 400 Hz means holding the generator's speed constant, which is the constant speed drive's job.
HYbaxQ2f7Wz54qwr96zA: Anti-collision strobes reflecting off cloud produce a rapid flicker in the cockpit, which is uncomfortable, disorienting and in susceptible individuals can trigger nausea or even a seizure. The remedy is to switch the strobes off while in cloud and back on in clear air. Dimming the cockpit lights does nothing about the external source.
HZj2oGa2plYubXBQTWbf: DSRTK/STS displays the DESIRED TRACK, the initial great circle track to the next waypoint, alongside system status. TK/GS shows the track being made good and groundspeed, XTK/TKE shows how far off track and by what angle, and HDG/DA shows heading and drift angle.
HZrtr8LIf3IdCxIZdwfv: A shock is called NORMAL when it stands perpendicular to the local flow direction, which is what distinguishes it from an oblique shock. Because it is perpendicular, it does not turn the flow - it simply decelerates it from supersonic to subsonic. Across it the static pressure, density and temperature all RISE abruptly; only total pressure falls, and that loss is wave drag.
HZxCyvqH8tFiXqVFkBdK: Schuler tuning is about keeping the computed vertical correct while the vehicle accelerates, and that problem exists whether the vertical is held by gimbals or computed mathematically. So the 84.4 minute Schuler period is applied to gyro-stabilised platforms and strapdown systems alike; only the means of implementing it differs.
HarVNOGKMLHYthLSzIBJ: Magenta is the JAR-25 colour for SELECTED data: the heading bug, selected course, selected altitude and the active flight plan leg. White marks present status and scales, green present-status dynamic data, and amber and red are cautions and warnings.
Hb564MiL8UN8gzBKct3F: A bird hazard is reported to the appropriate ground station IMMEDIATELY, because the next aeroplane on the approach or departure is exposed to the same flock within minutes. The written bird strike report comes afterwards; it does not substitute for the immediate call.
HdEfM08xrdxeuT2HSF0i: The annulus is tapered so that the reducing volume of the air as it is compressed still passes at roughly the same axial velocity - but the taper is fixed and can only be correct at one operating condition, the design point in cruise. Away from it the axial velocity changes, which is why stall margin has to be managed at other ratings.
HdRBlqPfBxZihgpJQRQm: For a 3 degree glide path the rate of descent in feet per minute is about five times the groundspeed in knots, so 120 x 5 = 600 ft/min. The exact form is GS x 101 x tan3 = 636, close enough for the mental sum. Always use groundspeed, not TAS.
He1B3tsWq5cki1OfVHpD: The pump sits in the tank and the fuel flowing through it carries away the heat its motor generates. That is why a boost pump must not be run dry - without fuel around it the motor overheats, and an overheating electric motor inside a fuel tank is exactly the hazard the design is meant to avoid.
HeFdi2MwIY6ibwgN6zjR: The cumulus, or building, stage is defined by updraughts throughout the cell, drawing in warm moist air while the cloud grows vertically, with all precipitation still held aloft. Rain or hail at the surface marks the start of the MATURE stage, and frequent lightning and roll cloud also belong to the mature stage, once downdraughts have developed alongside the updraughts.
HeQ5R38dA17G3Z2kzvLV: Trimming for a higher speed means trimming nose-DOWN, which requires the elevator to sit further down. A trim tab always works in the OPPOSITE sense to the surface it drives: deflecting the tab UP generates a download at the tab that levers the elevator DOWN. So the visible change is an up-deflected tab with the elevator further down.
HfJIO2yqZG1pARbhDmv9: The wind from 045 is on the starboard quarter of the 317 heading, so it pushes the aircraft left with almost no change in speed. Resolving the vectors gives about 5 degrees of port drift with the groundspeed still about 470 kt.
HfpelHyizQD3jQy2oFSw: The otolith organs sense the direction of the resultant of gravity and acceleration and cannot tell one from the other. A deceleration in level flight tilts that resultant backwards, exactly as a nose-down pitch would, so the pilot feels the nose has dropped and may raise it - the somatogravic illusion, whose more dangerous form is the false climb sensation on acceleration.
HgXZDz2pIm7eP9njeDsS: The command bar is proportional guidance: how far it is displaced tells the pilot how large a control input is needed as well as in which direction, so following it smoothly captures the path without overshoot. It is not a repeat of any raw deviation, which is displayed separately.
Hh0HlBEHDvMNc8JSJZgW: Higher pressure altitude means lower density, which reduces thrust and requires a higher TAS to achieve the lift-off IAS - so the take-off distance lengthens and the mass that fits within the available field length falls. The climb-limited mass falls too. Pressure altitude penalises essentially every take-off limit; only the tyre-speed limit can behave differently.
HhIiP0YbVpHczeVtvUBf: Above 25 000 ft the time of useful consciousness after a decompression is measured in seconds, so the flight crew's masks must be quick-donning - deployable and delivering oxygen with one hand in under 5 seconds, without dislodging spectacles.
Hi08B8FZHCVlwaWWHz5g: ATT is the reversionary mode used when navigation has been lost, typically after a power interruption. It gives attitude and, once the crew inserts the heading, heading as well, but no position, groundspeed or track. It keeps the flight instruments alive; it does not keep the aircraft navigating.
HjHI0vqUIwfEwe5i5txm: Both statements are correct. Flutter is a divergent oscillation driven by the coupling of aerodynamic, inertial and elastic forces, and it only occurs above a critical speed - so reducing IAS immediately is the correct and only response. Stiffening the structure raises that critical speed, which is why flutter resistance is designed in through wing stiffness and mass balancing of control surfaces.
HkHDiHbgjIa0u2iLjQ29: On a light twin the blue radial line marks Vyse, the best rate of climb speed with one engine inoperative - the speed to fly to get the most out of the aeroplane after an engine failure. The red radial marks VMCA, the minimum control speed.
HkM70wWrp5e3EizznikA: An aneroid altimeter simply displays static pressure on an altitude scale. With a uniform pressure pattern and no convective activity, the pressure at a fixed point changes by only a fraction of a hectopascal over ten minutes, which is a handful of feet - too small to be visible on the instrument. Rapid or fluctuating indications on the ground would signal a passing front, a thunderstorm gust front, or an instrument fault.
HllM85Y3WWaOz2DKfvpq: The jet core sits at the level where the horizontal temperature gradient changes sign - below the core the cold air is on the polar side, above it the gradient reverses - so at core level there is effectively no horizontal temperature gradient. Wind speed is proportional to the slope of the pressure surfaces, so the maximum wind occurs exactly where that slope is greatest, which is at the core.
HmCdaYMSfHVd27SfAjat: First the DR run: with about 10 kt of tailwind component the planned groundspeed is about 130 kt, so in 15 minutes the DR position is about 32.5 NM along track. Being 2.5 NM ahead of it puts the aircraft 35 NM along and 3 NM off, leaving 15 NM to run. Track error = 3/35 x 60 = 5 degrees, closing angle = 3/15 x 60 = 12 degrees, so the total alteration is 17 degrees.
HmGYNnZnLitbXHJUkMjb: The JAR-OPS limit is 0.2 promille - 20 milligrams of alcohol per 100 millilitres of blood - for flight and cabin crew, a quarter of the common 80 mg driving limit, and it applies alongside the eight-hour minimum between drinking and duty. The low figure reflects the fact that judgement, night vision and vestibular function are affected well below the driving limit.
Hp9QZXMGywbcLL9Uip7t: Runway threshold identification lights (RTIL) are flashing white lights at each side of the threshold. They provide rapid visual identification of the approach end of the runway.
HpA3jVtLtmyiEKnqLRpP: ICAO Doc 4444 specifies 20 NM as the longitudinal DME-based separation minimum for two aircraft at the same level using the same on-track DME station, with no speed differential.
HpO4TuqvlMRkecZzvP9n: Bending the head down during a turn brings a second pair of semicircular canals into the plane of rotation while the first pair is still responding, and the brain reads the combination as violent tumbling in a quite different axis. The Coriolis illusion is one of the most powerful in flight and has caused loss of control, which is why nothing is retrieved from the floor in a turn.
HpaLvfIDCtCNVnBMPk67: Ignition must be established before fuel arrives, or the fuel simply collects in the engine and lights violently when it eventually finds the igniter - a wet start. The igniters are therefore selected on as the start lever is moved and the fuel valve opens, and they stay on until the engine is self-sustaining.
Hpfe1HnplGpcaidW8LxX: The gas and fluid sides of an accumulator are separated by a piston or diaphragm which transmits pressure but not fluid, so once the system is pressurised above the pre-charge both sides read the same. The gauge therefore shows 3000 psi; the 1000 psi pre-charge appears only when the system is depressurised.
