HpvYV7c7GtvDcZRTNzu7: TCAS depends on the aircraft's own Mode S transponder both to interrogate other aircraft and to be interrogated by them, so a transponder failure takes TCAS with it. The pair is a single functional system, which is why the transponder is a dispatch item for TCAS operation.
HqBJ3KsWujx4uBSxcHuF: METARs at major European aerodromes are issued half-hourly, normally at H+20 and H+50. Elsewhere hourly issue is common. A SPECI is issued in between whenever a significant change occurs - for example visibility, RVR, wind or cloud crossing an operationally important threshold, or the onset of thunderstorms or freezing precipitation.
Hr3oSY8xDUsxxsqGlME4: ICAO Doc 4444 allows 2-minute separation between departing aircraft on the same track when the preceding aircraft is 40 kt or more faster than the following aircraft. For a 20 kt differential, 5 minutes is required.
HrKUy3wHtxL0KSVAuWa4: Decompression sickness requires the ambient pressure to fall far enough for dissolved nitrogen to come out of solution, and in practice that means cabin altitudes above about 18,000 ft - so a pressurisation failure at high level is the aviation scenario. Weather pressure differences are far too small, and a descent raises the pressure and relieves the problem.
Hrd09rAYTD7dRXpY1hCD: Under the semi-circular rule a magnetic course of 200 falls in the 180 to 359 half, which takes the EVEN flight levels: FL300, FL320, FL340 and so on in RVSM airspace. Note that both FL300 and FL320 satisfy the rule as offered here, so read this one as a test of which half of the circle 200 falls in rather than of a single unique level. FL290 and FL310 belong to the 000-179 half.
Ht94gkhjJ3qw6QtrCqbp: During independent parallel approaches, a minimum vertical separation of 300 m (1000 ft) should be maintained until aircraft are established on the ILS localizer or MLS final approach track.
HtNgisuQNeyijHz0mjiS: Time = distance / groundspeed = 1920 / 435 = 4.41 hours. The decimal 0.41 of an hour is about 25 minutes, so the answer is 4 HR 25 MIN. Reading the decimal as minutes would give the 4 h 10 distractor.
HtcAuwQ8aJgWP5wTdnSp: Aerodynamic balance uses the airflow itself to reduce the hinge moment the pilot must overcome: servo and spring tabs generate an aerodynamic force that helps move the surface, and a seal between the wing trailing edge and the control surface leading edge preserves the pressure differential that assists deflection. MASS balance is a different thing entirely - a weight forward of the hinge line, fitted to prevent flutter, not to reduce control forces.
Htrs6oPblabUdKqQJTpb: Where the thrust available curve crosses the drag (thrust required) curve, thrust exactly equals drag, so there is no unbalanced force along the flight path - the aeroplane is in equilibrium at constant speed in level flight. There are normally two such intersections, one on each side of VMD: a low-speed one behind the drag curve and a high-speed one, the maximum level speed.
HuQo0labUgFej1VE5DW7: Convert to true first: 215(M) with 21W variation gives 194(T). The island is 45 degrees right of the nose, so it bears 239(T) from the aircraft, and the bearing of the AIRCRAFT FROM the island is the reciprocal, 239 + 180 = 419, i.e. 059.
HuRQ2Xi6S5NfufD0Qzt9: Henry's Law states that the quantity of a gas dissolved in a liquid is proportional to the partial pressure of that gas above it. Reduce the pressure and the excess gas - nitrogen, in the body's case - comes out of solution as bubbles. Boyle's Law governs trapped gas expanding, and Dalton's the partial pressures in a mixture.
Hue3fu99J4B8OK0MpSX4: Adverse yaw arises because the down-going aileron adds more induced drag than the up-going one removes, yawing the aeroplane away from the turn. Differential deflection fixes it at source by rigging the UP-going aileron to travel further than the down-going one, equalising the drag. Frise ailerons and rudder-aileron interconnects achieve the same end by other means.
HupKl60ybuCDNJ8LXX83: Hypovigilance - a drop in the level of alertness and monitoring - can set in at any point in a flight. It is favoured by low workload, monotony, fatigue and the small hours of the body clock, but it is not confined to the end of a sector and it affects everyone, not merely certain personalities. Its danger is that the affected person does not notice it.
Hv5TrpZBZbc9XssTPk1u: By Boyle's Law a fixed mass of gas expands as pressure falls, so gas in the stomach and intestines expands on climb - roughly doubling in volume between sea level and 18,000 ft. The result is abdominal distension and pain, which is why gas-producing food and carbonated drinks are avoided before flight.
HvMQ5HebLgPAxBRJ2by3: Under clear anticyclonic skies the surface wind has a marked diurnal cycle. Daytime heating drives convection, which mixes faster-moving air down from above the friction layer, so the surface wind is strongest in the early afternoon and veers toward the gradient direction (in the northern hemisphere), reducing the cross-isobar angle. At night the surface layer decouples under the radiation inversion, and the wind falls light and backs.
HwMsniLtO9xcrmN5TcwL: DME measures SLANT range, so directly overhead the reading is the aircraft's height above the station: 36 000 ft / 6076 = about 6 NM. This is why DME never reads zero overhead, and why the slant range error is at its worst close in and at high level.
HwRM6eviO3y4DidU3dOS: Work everything into true. Compass 090 with 2W deviation is 088 magnetic, and with 12E variation that is 100 true. The 070 radial outbound is a magnetic track of 070, hence 082 true, so there is 18 degrees of port drift. Groundspeed is 14 NM in 6 minutes = 140 kt. Resolving the vectors gives a wind from about 158 degrees at about 51 kt.
HwfqB6xt4YZBLdL1jWZw: The Coriolis illusion arises when a head movement out of the plane of an existing rotation brings a second, and often a third, semicircular canal into stimulation while the first is still responding. The brain cannot reconcile the inputs and interprets them as tumbling in an entirely different axis - a sensation powerful enough to cause loss of control.
Hwng48mUc0CFlYmGVHmO: All three describe genuine stress conditions. Stress appears when the plan has to be revised and no solution is immediately available (1), when the demands of the situation exceed the individual's capability - the classic case with an inexperienced pilot (2) - and when the pilot believes he will not be able to find a solution at all (3), since it is the appraisal of not coping that generates the stress.
HwqkGpqaPDMNurqiXUhr: A flight director is a computer, which works out the attitude required to achieve the selected mode, and a display of that command - the command bars. The autopilot and autothrottle may follow the same computation but are separate systems, and the director is used constantly for hand flying with both off.
HxgVbKRyqqLDCQQuEgFD: Climb gradient is height gained divided by horizontal distance travelled through the AIR, expressed as a percentage - an air-mass quantity, so it is unaffected by wind. Only when the gradient is measured over the GROUND does wind matter, and it is the ground gradient that determines obstacle clearance. Rate of climb, by contrast, is height gained per unit time.
HyOJbQHqZg0nrB2CMyUv: Personality traits are the enduring characteristics of an individual and are essentially stable in adulthood - which is why selection can usefully test for them and why training cannot be expected to change them. What can be changed is attitude, which is learned and situation-specific, and behaviour, which is what CRM training actually targets.
HyVwp5ClfnpHonBuTGHH: Acceleration and deceleration errors arise because the pendulous magnet system is displaced fore and aft, and that displacement only produces a turning moment when the magnet lies east-west. On a southerly heading the magnet is aligned with the acceleration, so there is no turning moment and no apparent turn.
Hyf846tMJLNZzTpfYLgd: Wake strength follows the lift coefficient, which means slow, heavy and clean - the wing working hard at a high angle of attack. Thrust plays no part: the wake is a product of lift, not of engine power, which is why a heavy just after rotation is the classic hazard.
Hz3Mt7yGF8v91ouk9b9M: Mach number is true airspeed divided by the local speed of sound, and the speed of sound falls as the air gets colder. Climbing below the tropopause at a constant Mach number therefore means the true airspeed must fall with it, in proportion to the square root of the absolute temperature.
HzWWBtpTeaOfPQYHiT8p: ICAO Annex 12 colour codes for droppable SAR containers: yellow for blankets and protective clothing, blue for food and water, red for medical supplies, and black for miscellaneous equipment.
Hzilznt4aauAPPAitgUV: The classic source is the piston-engine cabin heater, which warms air by passing it over the exhaust manifold: a crack or leak lets exhaust gas, and with it carbon monoxide, straight into the cabin. Because the gas is colourless and odourless there is no warning, which is why a suspicion of it means heater off, fresh air on and land.
I0UIZRIeHZE17M77CJLd: The reservoir is pressurised so that the pump always has a positive head at its inlet and cannot cavitate at altitude, and engine bleed air is the convenient source. The pressure is low - a few pounds per square inch - and is regulated and relieved so that the reservoir itself is not overstressed.
I0af6DSzRxAS7uLaZYis: ICAO Doc 8168 specifies a minimum obstacle clearance of 300 m (984 ft) in the primary area of the initial approach segment. This is higher than the intermediate (150 m) and final approach (non-precision: varies) segment clearances.
I1JP7okftWTqVbCP8vi6: Swirling debris on final marks a thermal, and a thermal is rising air that will balloon the glider above the intended path while its outflow lower down can produce a sudden sink and airspeed loss on the far side. Closing the spoilers restores the glide performance in hand, and the extra airspeed provides a margin against the shear and sink - the same reasoning as adding a wind gradient allowance.
I1Q9dDhMlpRp7cCRvsEY: The mixture control varies the amount of fuel reaching the main discharge tube for a given airflow, either by a needle in the fuel passage or by applying back-suction to the float chamber. It does not touch the air side - the throttle butterfly does that, and the two are operated independently.
I3GV6LfMAIirxsWO0Rem: The autokinetic illusion depends on there being no frame of reference for the eye to anchor to, so the cure is to supply one: keep scanning rather than staring, and take in other references inside and outside the cockpit, including peripheral cues, so the light is seen in relation to something fixed. Staring at it - with either eye - is exactly what produces the effect.
I3Zqrh2zXXcwJlS5rtwE: From 010E to 030W is 40 degrees of longitude, because the two longitudes straddle Greenwich and therefore add. The constant of the cone n = convergency / dlong = 30 / 40 = 0.75, which corresponds to a parallel of origin of about 48.6 degrees.
I3hTEHlYh00YIqrAe46e: The figure came from what is normally loaded on this route rather than from today's flight preparation - the pilot substituted a frequently used value for a calculation he had not yet done. That is frequency or habit bias: the brain offers the most often used answer, and it feels right precisely because it usually is. It is not group pressure, and no data had yet been selected or confirmed.
I5QDTK7xDoeVTygashSq: Departure = dlong in minutes x cos(latitude), so dlong = 280 / cos45 = 280 / 0.7071 = 396 minutes = 6 degrees 36 minutes. B is east of A, so A is 6 36 west of B: 45 15 E minus 6 36 gives 38 39 E.
I6ivxB6tgBglyowHgkuF: Pushing the rpm lever forward commands HIGH rpm, which the governor achieves by selecting FINE pitch. A fine-pitched propeller windmilling at idle presents a large effective disc to the airflow and generates considerable drag, so total drag rises, L/D falls and the rate of descent increases. This is why the forced-landing drill selects COARSE pitch - to minimise windmilling drag and stretch the glide.
I7KHUTTVAq2p5ca4ayzL: The ILS localiser works between 108 and 112 MHz, which corresponds to wavelengths of around 2.7 metres - the metric band. The glideslope, at 329 to 335 MHz, is shorter, but the system is identified by its localiser frequency, which is what the pilot tunes.
I7Wdvx9HHL0MMbaN8Vgt: If a control, a connector or a procedure permits a wrong operation, that wrong operation will eventually be performed - which is why design out, rather than train around, is the first principle of error management. The other three statements are all false: expectation strongly shapes perception, motivation affects performance, and stress responses vary widely between individuals.
I7wHY2G6VPZpvdVGtV84: Take-off fuel is 17,830 + 9,030 = 26,860 kg. The performance limit gives 89,200 - 26,860 - 40,970 = 21,370 kg; the ramp limit gives 89,930 - 27,460 - 40,970 = 21,500 kg; the landing limit gives 71,520 - 9,030 - 40,970 = 21,520 kg; and the zero fuel limit gives 62,050 - 40,970 = 21,080 kg, which is the lowest and therefore governs.
I89YSEmICfdkoSJhDZ3v: Isolated from daylight, clocks and social cues, the human body clock free-runs on a period of about 25 hours - slightly longer than the solar day. Daily zeitgebers normally entrain it to 24 hours, and the direction of that natural drift is why a westward phase delay is easier to adapt to than an eastward phase advance.
I8BV41mebHbCwbneCB37: To act as a flight instructor for PPL issue, you must hold a valid licence plus a flight instructor rating. A CPL alone without an instructor rating does not authorise flight instruction.
I8G5oqqnWC420oVlzA3M: CRM aims at crew effectiveness: it works on attitudes to safety, on communication, leadership, workload management and decision making, so that the resources available - people, equipment and information - are actually used. It does not try to change personality, which is stable, and it is training for every crew member, not remedial treatment for problem individuals.
I8zFsgCn0WlaA5eaYUpQ: Convert to true first: with 5W variation the true track is 310 and the true heading is 296, so there is 14 degrees of right drift. Groundspeed is 50 NM in 12 minutes = 250 kt. Resolving the 296/225 air vector against the 310/250 ground vector gives a wind from about 190 degrees at 63 kt.
I9HCtecFmQt0d7pS4xnG: ICAO Annex 1 allows medical examination deferment of a single period of six months for non-commercial flight crew in remote areas. For commercial crew, the deferment is limited to three months.
IAYeWjzaaIfbR4T7TjiA: Dutch roll is a coupled lateral-directional oscillation arising from strong dihedral effect relative to directional stability, and it has nothing to do with compressibility - it can occur at any speed. Mach buffet, shock stall and tuck under all require a shock wave, and a shock cannot exist until the local flow reaches M1.0, which is by definition the critical Mach number.
IAgI3sy4LKSFGX7F8TTT: Category I is flown to a decision height not lower than 200 ft with an RVR of not less than 550 m, or a visibility of not less than 800 m. 350 m and 300 m belong to Category II, and 200 m to Category IIIA.
IB8Psxuaqbf5ZTDYfJEJ: ICAO Annex 11 requires the lower limit of a Control Area (CTA) to be not less than 200 metres above ground or water. This provides minimum separation between uncontrolled surface airspace and the CTA.
ICNNwdHWa4tyrvSPigAl: The fuel-cooled oil cooler does two jobs at once: the fuel takes heat out of the oil, and the oil warms the fuel enough to keep any water in it from freezing into ice crystals that would block the filter. One heat exchanger therefore serves both the oil cooling and the fuel de-icing requirement.
ICdO9yAb31xs3ENuPFIe: Cruise cabin humidity falls to around 10-20%, so fluid is lost steadily through the lungs and skin. Thirst appears only once dehydration is established, so the drink has to be taken before it is felt. Water is what is needed: coffee and tea are diuretics, and no healthy person compensates for this automatically.
IChBM9XcKuCJR44hCFIu: Reconcile the units first: 83 Imperial gallons at 4.55 litres is 377 litres, which is 377 / 3.78 = about 100 US gallons. At 22 US-GAL per hour the endurance is 100 / 22 = 4.53 hours = 4 HR 32 MIN. Treating the two gallons as the same gives 3 h 46, which is the trap.
IDCHQ5thixJ1NSrQ1eMe: As Mach number rises toward Mcrit the aft shift of the centre of pressure produces a nose-down tuck, which means the pilot has to PUSH less - or even pull - as speed increases: the stick force gradient goes flat or reverses, destroying apparent speed stability. The Mach trimmer senses Mach number and applies an automatic nose-up input to restore a positive stick force gradient. It corrects the trim change, not the drag or the buffet.
IEUfZKu8Eco71hPHE51C: The obliquity of the ecliptic, the angle between the plane of the earth's orbit and the plane of the equator, is about 23.5 degrees. It is what limits the sun's declination to 23.5N and 23.5S, fixes the tropics at those latitudes and the polar circles at 66.5, and produces the seasons.
IFDoZZSRvgch6b89DNAE: The atmosphere is nearly transparent to incoming solar radiation, so it is warmed from below rather than directly by the sun. Convection carries sensible heat upward from the heated surface, and condensation releases the latent heat that was absorbed when the water evaporated, depositing it aloft where the cloud forms. Evaporation and vaporisation do the opposite - they absorb heat and cool their surroundings.
IFtYnzA8G80AiYkMoL20: Sweepback exists to raise the critical Mach number: only the airflow component perpendicular to the quarter-chord line does the aerodynamic work, so the effective velocity over the section is reduced by the cosine of the sweep angle and the flow reaches M1.0 only at a higher free-stream Mach number. The penalties are a HIGHER stalling speed, tip-stall tendencies, and a strong dihedral effect that encourages Dutch roll.
IGKjOB7sSZOVe40aI0Ku: Track angle error uses the distance RUN, not the distance remaining: 4 NM off after 75 NM gives 4/75 x 60 = about 3 degrees right. The distance to go, 15 NM, would be used for the closing angle if the question had asked what alteration is needed to reach B.
IGqfLZ0CpdqmcYYzQ6Ot: A sudden, obvious collapse is at least recognised at once and the other pilot takes over. The insidious case - the pilot who is still apparently functioning but whose judgement, attention or accuracy is quietly degrading from hypoxia, illness or a subtle stroke - is far more dangerous, because nobody realises the aircraft is now effectively single-crewed with an unreliable second opinion.
IHy7OYG0B3dTCx4Lbblf: Take-off fuel is 550 - 50 = 500 kg. The zero fuel limit allows 3,500 - 2,000 = 1,500 kg of payload, but the take-off limit allows only 3,500 - 500 - 2,000 = 1,000 kg. The lower of the two governs, so 1,000 kg.
IIhoI8RDMIiybcPLP3er: The vestibular apparatus of each inner ear comprises the three semicircular canals, which sense angular acceleration, and the two otolith organs, the utricle and the saccule, which sense linear acceleration and the direction of gravity. Ventricles are chambers of the heart and the brain and have nothing to do with it.
IJGzYEBlI9WLKL2FXtR5: Power depends on the mass of air the engine can take in, and that falls with density as the aircraft climbs - roughly 3% per 1,000 ft in an unsupercharged engine. Temperature and humidity modify the density, but it is the density itself that determines the power.
IJPzezETUeluzJG8PuTu: A weight-shift wing carries substantial washout, so the tips are set at a much lower angle of attack than the root. When the root stalls the tips are still flying, which preserves roll damping and generates the nose-down pitching moment that begins the recovery automatically. That built-in tip margin is the basic stall-safety feature of the flexible-wing planform.
IJe1tEXQrvtEBrHfg2Jy: The rotating-tyre threshold is about 9 times the square root of the tyre pressure in psi: 9 x root 206 gives roughly 129 kt. Worth knowing that a wheel held by the brakes and no longer rotating hydroplanes earlier - the accepted figure is about 7.7 times the square root of the pressure, near 110 kt at this pressure - which is why heavy braking on a flooded runway is counter-productive until the wheels are rolling.
IJzSZoSX7TXNXGEht5ri: During independent parallel approaches, vectoring should establish the aircraft on the localizer in level flight for at least 2.0 NM prior to glide path intercept. This stabilisation distance ensures reliable localizer tracking.
ILIYe8zprnhR4JG6ez3W: A higher V1 means accelerating further before the decision point, so more distance is used getting there and more speed - hence more kinetic energy - has to be dissipated in the stop. The accelerate-stop distance therefore lengthens. The continued-take-off distances all SHORTEN with a higher V1, because the failure is recognised closer to rotation. This opposition is what makes V1 a balancing act between the stop case and the go case.
ILQZ7e1lvZddrR4wdfcc: Three extinguishers cover the 61-200 seat band, so exactly 200 seats requires three. The count moves to four at 201 and then rises once per 100 seats.
ILeGVDr7VLPg3NJDk3qG: The five classic modes are excessive descent rate (1), excessive terrain closure rate (2), altitude loss after take-off or go-around (3), unsafe terrain clearance for the gear and flap configuration (4) and excessive deviation below the glideslope (5). Airbrake position is not a GPWS input.
ILplJdjHOOs6zIGZuHkb: Status is the standing a person holds, role is the function he is performing. A senior captain flying as copilot to a more junior commander has high status but the subordinate role, and the mismatch can distort the authority gradient in both directions - the junior commander reluctant to direct, the senior first officer reluctant to follow. The other options involve no such clash.
IMrQJQ52Vr3SG48iiCRH: A cabin descending in level flight means the outflow valve is closing when it should not, so the cabin pressure rises while the outside pressure is unchanged and the differential grows. It will keep growing until the safety relief valves lift to protect the structure.
IOVUIaJVRQeIF6GAWkR9: The erection system uses a pendulous device to find the vertical, and in a sustained turn that pendulum is displaced by the centrifugal effect, so the erector slowly precesses the gyro towards a false vertical. After three quarters of a turn the accumulated error shows as an apparent nose-up attitude with an exaggerated bank.
IOj8s6hTh98aa97f4neA: Changing from IFR to VFR requires the pilot-in-command to initiate it with a message containing the specific expression 'cancelling my IFR flight.' ATC cannot unilaterally change a flight from IFR to VFR.
IPefYQvkrnwnBtDZNzaW: Smoke and fumes drills start the same way everywhere: oxygen mask ON and set to 100%, smoke goggles ON, crew communication established. Only then does the crew begin isolating packs or recirculation fans to find the source. Diagnosis first is the wrong order - fumes can incapacitate the crew in the time it takes to work out where they are coming from.
IQ261aZD6UuAb1hAZ3hw: The altimeter is a static instrument: an evacuated capsule expands as the pressure around it falls, and the movement drives the pointers. Only the airspeed indicator needs pitot pressure, which is why a blocked static affects the altimeter and vertical speed indicator while a blocked pitot does not.
IQ3h85Ee2WluKoyiIjnb: The MMEL is the manufacturer's document, produced by the type certificate holder and approved for the type. The operator's MEL is derived from it and may be more restrictive but never less.
IQXkMuiuiVKvGuQcoSei: The indicator shows how large the vibration is - its amplitude - after the accelerometer signal has been filtered to the frequency corresponding to the spool of interest, so that N1 and N2 imbalance can be told apart. The frequency is known already; what the crew needs is whether the amplitude is rising.
IQjiUmEtez9SMhhBXVXL: Static stability is about the INITIAL response: the aeroplane starts back toward its original condition, so it is statically stable - if it were statically unstable it would diverge rather than oscillate. Dynamic stability is about what happens over time: an oscillation of constant amplitude neither damps nor diverges, which is dynamically NEUTRAL. Note that static stability is a prerequisite for dynamic stability, but not a guarantee of it.
IQujQtMrGuh6k4Xsy7h1: The primary duty of a radar unit is to provide radar separation between aircraft. Assisting with navigation, equipment failures, or weather avoidance are secondary functions.
ISZg1DLjETMT4iH9dDTF: A microburst is intense but very short-lived: the damaging phase lasts typically 1-5 minutes, within an outflow less than 4 km across. That brevity is what makes it so hazardous - it can form and strike the approach path between one aircraft and the next, so a preceding aircraft's smooth approach is no guarantee. Longer-lived, larger downbursts are classed as macrobursts.
ISl53KMmQaIpSo0FEg49: Energy comes from the three macronutrients: carbohydrates, which are the quickest source and the brain's preferred fuel, fats, which are the densest store, and proteins, which the body will burn if it must although their main job is building and repair. Vitamins and minerals are essential in small amounts but supply no energy at all.
ISyR001LGF4Gk9fFwwto: The operator must satisfy itself on acceptance that the consignment is not forbidden and is correctly classified, packed, marked, labelled and documented - that is the purpose of the acceptance checklist. The shipper certifies this initially on the shipper's declaration, and the commander must be told what is aboard.
ITXgMiVbClkxxJ41myFq: Only HF is refracted usefully by the ionosphere, which is what gives it intercontinental range by sky wave. VHF and UHF pass straight through into space, so they are line of sight, and VLF is guided in the duct between earth and ionosphere rather than refracted by it.
ITgInuSUXbfx8uo08seI: In an aircraft fire it is the smoke that kills, not the flame. Burning cabin furnishings, insulation and wiring release carbon monoxide, hydrogen cyanide and irritant gases that incapacitate within a couple of breaths and kill long before the fire reaches the occupant. This is why smoke hoods, cabin materials standards and rapid evacuation matter so much.
IUI4kfWnPAxc9eJBn2fD: The FMS provides lateral and vertical guidance for procedures it can construct from its own database and its own position solution - RNAV approaches (1) and overlays of VOR and VOR/DME procedures (3). Precision approach radar is a ground-controlled talk-down, and MLS needs its own dedicated receiver.
IUTzvf0dfuE4dxSRk1U8: Spoilers are hinged panels on the UPPER surface which destroy lift and add drag when raised. Raised together they act as speed brakes or lift dumpers; raised on one wing only they assist the ailerons in roll - so the deflection may be symmetrical or asymmetrical depending on the function.
IUaND9Fx6buHywTQByiR: The final approach segment is where alignment and descent for landing are made. It extends from the FAF/FAP to the MAP (missed approach point) or the runway.
IVCZ9mgUfpsD6OczoSeN: On NORMAL the diluter demand regulator meters cabin air into the oxygen on a schedule set by cabin altitude, so as the cabin climbs the proportion of oxygen rises until, at around 30,000 ft cabin altitude, it reaches 100%. Diluting at lower altitudes is what makes the bottled supply last.
IVZ9ZFdNK7Y1x6rUBpB9: Cognitive illusions arise not in the senses but in the interpretation: the brain constructs a model of the outside world from incomplete cues, and where the cues are unusual - a sloping runway, an unfamiliar runway width, haze - the constructed model is wrong even though the raw sensory data are accurate. Sensory conflict illusions are the separate, vestibular category.
IVaGpnowQjcVc77AlSNy: The flight director recomputes continuously, so the command bars always show the best thing to do from where the aircraft is at this instant - not a fixed path laid down when the mode was selected. That is why following the bars smoothly produces a capture without overshoot whatever the starting geometry.
IW5b89IjoHHhm1Bdjnwj: Proprioception reports the direction of the resultant force acting on the body, and it cannot distinguish that resultant from gravity - a sustained acceleration feels exactly like a tilt. With no outside visual reference to resolve the ambiguity, the seat-of-the-pants sense is worthless for orientation in IMC and must be deliberately disregarded in favour of the instruments.
IWA5AO2cgICofsFUQbgz: Wake strength follows the lift coefficient the wing is working at, so the worst generator is large, heavy, slow and CLEAN - a heavy aeroplane just after rotation or on final before the flaps come out. Flaps disrupt the vortex pattern, and higher speed means a lower lift coefficient for the same weight.
IWMqdLssvkAPn6M0lLU4: NAT MNPS airspace is the block from FL285 to FL420. The usable levels within it, FL290 to FL410, are the RVSM levels to which the MNPS navigation accuracy requirements attach.
IWN0vil6MrdGkbjH8dDm: The gyro provides short-term steadiness with its spin axis horizontal (1), held there by an erection mechanism (4), while a flux valve senses the earth's field (3) and a torque motor precesses the gyro slowly onto that magnetic heading (5). IWRF5HyJ10nFQoWBivTV: Induced drag is proportional to lift squared divided by speed squared, so both effects work the same way: flying FASTER means a smaller lift coefficient and much less induced drag, and being LIGHTER means less lift required and therefore less induced drag. IWVPj1PMbUXz3WaF9qY5: Needle right means the aircraft is turning right. Ball right means it has slipped to the inside of the turn, which happens when the bank is greater than the rate of turn requires - too much bank for the turn being flown. The remedy is to reduce bank or increase the rate.
IXCruPNwYymawegbsp4j: A spar is a beam: booms or girders top and bottom to take the bending as tension and compression, joined by a web to take the shear between them. Ribs give the aerofoil shape and stiffeners support the skin; neither is part of the spar.

IXmPtl4N7y6zCxEVLN1p: Attention is a limited pool drawn on by every task that requires conscious processing, so two genuinely attention-demanding tasks cannot be run at once - what looks like it is rapid switching, and each task suffers. IY0Z9vsO1ISHgLhaGLYh: In the PAPI system, two red units nearest the runway and two white units farthest from the runway indicates the aircraft is on or close to the correct approach slope. All red means too low; all white means too high.
IYJHhtE5sEldrkZSCOBy: Under +Gz the blood is driven towards the feet and the pressure in the retinal arteries falls. IYZyenEni2kveNFHMYaf: A rearward centre of gravity shortens the arm from the centre of gravity to the tailplane, so the same elevator deflection produces a larger pitching moment and the aeroplane rotates readily - too readily. IYgQOEny6YviBE3qej9u: Power depends on the mass of oxygen in the charge, so the best conditions are the densest air: cold and at high pressure. Water vapour is less dense than air and displaces oxygen, so dry air is better than humid - and hot, high and humid is the worst combination of all.
IZLaGmOYyB8SDlpH631T: The turn needle shows RATE OF TURN, and the aeroplane is flying straight, so it reads zero. IZfs2guCRXonvcfJGbNM: The critical (stalling) angle of attack is a fixed aerodynamic property of the aerofoil and configuration - typically around 15-16 degrees for a conventional section - and it does not change with weight, CG position, load factor or altitude. IbWC8uPPZpVqqD4qYTeK: A public address system is required once the maximum approved passenger seating configuration exceeds 19 - the same threshold that triggers the requirement for cabin crew. Below that the commander can be heard directly.
IcevsOOaWUuq3kBroXPQ: Competence is the best defence against stress, because a situation only stresses a pilot who doubts his ability to handle it. IcoTcoFGm0kzxqRgo81J: Taking air from the compressor removes mass flow that would have passed through the turbine, so to hold the commanded thrust the fuel control adds fuel. Ie2vOmT6QszfBUATZPB7: More than 3 mm of water makes the runway CONTAMINATED, with the performance penalties and reduced V1 that go with it. A film too thin to be measured but enough to look shiny is WET, and moisture that does not make the surface shiny is DAMP.
IfJszpDsmdKAliiJt2ln: Under JAR-FCL, single-pilot single-engine class ratings are valid for two years. After age 40, some national regulations reduce this to one year, but the base JAR-FCL validity is two years.
IfQQ0oQHnCQYS1LZRaSl: An output peripheral takes data from the computer and presents it, which is what a display screen does. A keyboard is an input device, and disk drives both read and write, so they are storage rather than purely input or output.
Ig8RUASLeDjHcKe2vcIv: Sound intensity is measured in decibels, a logarithmic scale in which every 10 dB represents a tenfold increase in power. Frequency, the pitch of the sound, is measured in hertz or cycles per second, and the curie is a unit of radioactivity.

IgS0YAZPxP4EgUE8AICw: A clearance that expires at a given time means if the aircraft is not airborne by that time, the clearance is void and a new clearance must be obtained. The pilot does not need to return to the ramp.
Ihcqvp4VMqATIUQkyboM: A three-phase tachogenerator feeds a small synchronous motor in the instrument, which therefore turns at a speed locked to the supply frequency and hence to engine speed, and that motor drives a magnetic drag-cup element to move the pointer. IhsaMKVxLANlBMjLeq3E: Learning is shaped by what follows the attempt. IjaSiAwUPgqWnw1hNgP6: The descent is 35 000 - 8000 = 27 000 ft, which at a maximum of 1800 ft/min takes 15 minutes. At 276 kt the aircraft covers 276 x 15/60 = 69 NM in that time, so descent must start no later than 69 NM out. Any closer and the required rate exceeds the maximum.
Ik0TMdtbTruiPYP0PNRf: Time pressure destroys the ability to analyse, so the analysis has to be done in advance. IooxAfWF8zwwY6LtupR8: Coaction is the mode in which crew members work in parallel on their own tasks but towards a single shared objective - each doing his own part of the same job. Ip5Yekr6iIove5XsF0lI: A gas-filled sensor tube works by the pressure rise its charge produces when heated, so the only realistic test is to heat it - a test circuit passes current through a heater element along the tube, raising the pressure and operating the switch. IpFfJ4M5sO4fAT61MTSS: VA is the speed at which the aeroplane stalls at exactly the limit manoeuvring load factor, and since stall speed rises with the square root of load factor, VA = VS x sqrt(n). IpKE59SKt5kjNXzurYNw: The flight mode annunciator runs across the top of the primary flight display, showing the engaged and armed autothrottle, pitch and roll modes. IpNVDiSN0XWjvZWkFD5R: Paralleling two generators whose voltages differ would produce a heavy circulating current, so the differential voltage relay compares the two outputs and will not allow the paralleling contactor to close until they are within a small tolerance of each other.

Iq1TBrr4T3VAkcYXPI7B: The accelerometer signal contains vibration from both spools at once, so it is passed through band-pass filters tuned to the N1 and N2 frequencies. IqL8mhrs8Oa5mwQrhuVr: The earth is flattened at the poles, so a minute of latitude is shortest at the equator, about 1843 m, and longest at the poles, about 1862 m. It passes through the defined nautical mile of 1852 m at about 45 degrees, which is why that value was chosen as the standard.
IqP0TYhpzIhoQlZwfYoI: Carbon dioxide is a powerful cerebral vasodilator, so washing it out by over-breathing constricts the vessels supplying the brain and cuts the blood flow through them - by as much as a third. IqyK4ZK4hLMLFneqycwt: Hypoxia produces fatigue, euphoria with impaired judgement and loss of concentration, along with headache, cyanosis and eventually unconsciousness. Ir9DgtQW1WNdNqH3MkbN: Mach number is TAS divided by the local speed of sound, and the speed of sound depends only on temperature. Ir9u6SXShq8feS4ReUcj: A flammable gas fire is a class B fire, and it must be smothered or the chemical reaction interrupted - which is what carbon dioxide and the halons such as BCF do. Water would spread it and, on a hot surface, flash to steam, so it is never used on flammable liquids or gases.
IrKI8BjA6OYbD4GpmWQQ: Differential pressure is cabin pressure minus outside pressure. In level flight the outside pressure is fixed, so a rising cabin altitude means a falling cabin pressure and therefore a smaller differential - which is what a leak or an open outflow valve produces.
IsBCu3KEASjf7XFpuhjd: Electrical heating is used where the area is small and where ice must be prevented rather than shed - pitot heads, static ports, drain masts and windscreens are heated continuously so that ice never forms on them. IsBuHxpg6ZW6TOJal80T: ICAO Doc 4444: the final vector for localizer intercept shall enable the aircraft to intercept at an angle not greater than 30 degrees. This prevents overshooting the localizer beam.
IsNY6tVXP3NB35Dw5AGM: Stress arises from appraisal, not from the event: the individual weighs what he thinks the situation demands against what he thinks he can do about it, and both halves of that judgement are subjective. IsNuqfKgpnN8g4wRPk2c: Use the 1-in-60 rule twice. Track error = 6 NM in 40 NM run = 9 degrees, and closing angle = 6 NM in the 60 NM remaining = 6 degrees. IsYkbZwHUNXzkUSCRGtn: The fuel heater sits on the engine, upstream of the main fuel filter, and uses engine bleed air or hot oil to warm the fuel just enough to stop ice crystals forming and blocking the filter. IsgKqO8almFEpodOir1p: At -44C the local speed of sound is 38.94 x root(229) = about 589 kt, so M0.86 is a TAS of 507 kt and, with 110 kt of headwind, a groundspeed of 397 kt. 420 NM at 397 kt takes 63.5 minutes; 5 minutes more is 68.5 minutes, needing a groundspeed of 368 kt, hence a TAS of 478 kt and a Mach number of 478/589 = about 0.81.

Iu8VGznRMfRir98o46yd: With all long-range navigation gone and no instructions from ATC, the contingency procedure puts the aeroplane at a level 500 ft away from the one in use below FL410 - between the levels the organised track structure has allocated - together with a lateral offset. IuaHp9EWIGjGyZD1uOKE: Diving loads the tissues with nitrogen dissolved at greater than atmospheric pressure, and it takes time to wash out again. Iup2VcSh6AzZ7gCu1u0y: The wind from 220 is on the starboard quarter of the 090 heading, so it adds a tailwind component of about 20 kt and pushes the aircraft slightly north. Resolving the vectors gives a groundspeed of about 220 kt. A wind on the quarter always gives a groundspeed above TAS.
IuzzUnGUxLgsW6cz8gY0: A trim tab is deflected to hold the control surface where it is wanted with no force on the cockpit control, so the pilot can release the column and the aeroplane stays where it was put. IxgrJyFFxmV754cvZ50T: Climbing at a constant Mach number, the falling density outweighs the small fall in the speed of sound, so the dynamic pressure decreases steadily. IxvUwSMofzewgY8udLfO: Latent heat is released whenever a substance moves to a more ordered state: gas to liquid (condensation), liquid to solid (freezing) and gas to solid (deposition, or sublimation in the meteorological sense). IzHf756ZfBCie5OPyGa5: Projectiles showing red and green lights/stars at 10-second intervals is a signal that the aircraft is flying in or about to enter a restricted, prohibited, or danger area. The aircraft should take remedial action.

J47jv5JS6gsi2d0MMI9e: The main factor dictating the design of instrument departure procedures is the terrain surrounding the aerodrome. Obstacle clearance gradients and turning points are designed around terrain constraints.

J4Kl85OyDAqfdXVXoEWY: Deep slow-wave sleep is when the body repairs itself: growth hormone is released, tissue is rebuilt and the brain's own energy reserves are restored. J5JOv23RGYyrMXa0wvuV: Boost pumps deliver fuel to the engine feed lines at a positive pressure, which both guarantees supply to the engine-driven pump and keeps the line pressure above the fuel's vapour pressure so that vapour bubbles do not form. The two effects are aspects of the same function.

J6o5gjf9apVpxHy9zgNg: A brake fire is fought with dry chemical powder or with an atomised water spray applied from a distance. J7ATVW7MInMYGorjYGyK: The wind from 300 is about 67 degrees off the port bow of the 007 track, giving a crosswind of 80 x sin67 = about 74 kt from the left and a headwind of 80 x cos67 = about 31 kt. The heading is therefore about 9 degrees left of track, 358, and the groundspeed is about 428 kt.
J7a49Ztlmd66u5TrTSzP: ATC clearances are issued to achieve separation between controlled flights. This is the primary purpose. FIS, alerting, and advisory services are provided through other mechanisms.
J7fy825G5jnwxLpkHr6o: Low contrast strips out the cues the brain uses for distance and closure - texture, sharpness of edges, apparent contrast against the background - so an approaching object's speed and size cannot be judged reliably. J7pUjbgFAuz7IC5DXxK2: With an engine out the aeroplane must descend to a lower altitude where the remaining engines can sustain level flight, and it flies there at a less efficient combination of speed and altitude. J9NFRk9fPFUy5dmKe3jk: A gaseous system carries as much oxygen as the cylinders hold, so its duration is set by bottle size rather than by a fixed burn time (1); it can be turned on and off and used again (3); and the flow can be regulated to altitude and demand (5). J9UqKuXtw4YtFzdVlc0f: ICAO Doc 4444 prohibits speed adjustment requests after the aircraft has passed 4 NM from the threshold on final approach. This protects the stabilised approach.
J9WOrV7KwvJPE0zVFVGC: The crank assembly is the rotating and reciprocating group that turns combustion pressure into rotation: the pistons, the connecting rods and the crankshaft. The crankcase is the structure that contains it, and the camshaft and valve gear are the separate valve train.
J9aU0UEd5mdjU1hJEmBs: Stall speed rises with the SQUARE ROOT of the load factor. At 60 degrees of bank n = 1/cos 60 = 2.0, and the square root of 2 is 1.41 - so the stall speed increases by 41%. JBUvclcCJ8EeoPFxjHey: An illusion is by definition a false interpretation of the outside world, so the answer is to stop using the outside world and fly the instruments, which are not subject to it. JBYKYqfkiSxFrQuRYhsX: Halon breaks the combustion chain reaction, so it works on solids, flammable liquids and gases, and is safe on live electrical equipment because it does not conduct. Burning metals are the exception: they sustain their own oxidation and need a dedicated class D agent.

JCS8muYI1JawvcxdS4I7: The sideslip index below the roll pointer is driven by lateral acceleration measured by the inertial reference system, so it is a computed quantity rather than a mechanical ball. JCnpoZzvNewl7D51L0xt: The ram air turbine deploys into the airstream when the normal sources fail and drives a pump or generator, providing enough power to work the primary flight controls and essential systems. It is a get-you-down provision, not enough for the gear, brakes or high-lift devices.

JDuwjJlFOvfnvwaeLIfz: Dry chemical powder interrupts the combustion chain reaction and is non-conductive, so it covers class A solids, class B liquids and electrical fires. Burning metals are excluded - ordinary powder can react with them, and they require a dedicated class D agent.
JEiuF3KxCYcjy33ru74I: Pressure altitude is by definition the altitude indicated with 1013.25 set, so if the subscale is at 1013.25 and the needle reads 16,000 ft, the pressure altitude is 16,000 ft. QNH and temperature affect the true altitude, not the pressure altitude.
JFPR0x4gXUzdGBw0VdLy: Tingling in the fingers, toes and around the mouth occurs in both conditions, which is one reason they are so easily confused in the air - and why the drill is to assume hypoxia first, use oxygen, and then reduce the breathing rate if the symptoms persist. JFprE7msTMGrXGVYEryK: In a bootstrap system the bleed air is cooled in the primary heat exchanger, compressed further by the cold air unit's compressor, cooled again in the secondary heat exchanger, and only then expanded through the turbine. JFq8UWdHXt7bVopehgvD: A parallel of latitude cuts every meridian at 90 degrees, a constant angle, which is the definition of a rhumb line. Only the equator is also a great circle; every other parallel is a small circle, so following one is not the shortest route between its endpoints.
JG8Fm45ZArtUK15TJcif: An impending stall demands immediate action, so it is a warning: the stick shaker operates and, on many types, an aural and a red visual alert accompany it. A caution would imply that action could wait, which at the stall it cannot.

JIVkOrn7hXUj8qlmjGY7: Time of Useful Consciousness is the interval from the loss of an adequate oxygen supply to the point at which the individual can no longer act usefully - it is about the ability to take corrective action, not about awareness of the problem, and it ends well before actual unconsciousness. JIthLHiu8wNNB44Nj9Jr: Reinforcing a successful attempt strengthens the correct response and shows the learner exactly what to repeat, which is why instructors are taught to praise specifically and immediately. JJe1FdEHDYPfKPzTv0i2: The wind from 160 is on the port quarter of the 305 track, so it pushes the aircraft right and adds speed. Because fuel expands as it warms, the same volume represents a different mass at different temperatures - which is why a float gauge reading has to be converted using a density figure before it means anything operationally.
JM2DcBbHrNsrhnZBl6HI: Stress describes the individual's reaction to the demands placed on him rather than the demands themselves - which is why the same circumstances affect two people differently. Some stress is needed for optimum performance, stressors include psychological and social factors as well as physical ones, and self-imposed obligations are among the commonest of all.
JNROhbtkYKrdWEQIixUY: Smoke detection is fitted where a fire would otherwise be unseen and where people cannot go - the cargo and baggage compartments, along with lavatories and avionics bays. Engine nacelles and wheel wells use heat-sensing fire and overheat detection instead, and fuel tanks have no detection at all.
JOBVoURnu21P7GNhhtsi: Vapour lock is fuel boiling in the line before it reaches the carburettor: heat, low pressure or a volatile fuel produces bubbles that the pump cannot shift, and the flow to the engine is interrupted. It is a hot-day, high-altitude problem, which is why boost pumps are run for take-off and climb.
JOIHINTdapnMJdx1Eyz4: IAS 210 at FL140 with OAT -5C gives a TAS of about 264 kt, so with 35 kt of headwind the groundspeed is about 229 kt and 150 NM takes about 39 minutes. Five minutes more is 44 minutes, needing a groundspeed of about 203 kt, hence a TAS of about 238 kt. Converting back at the same density ratio gives an IAS of about 190 kt, a reduction of about 20 kt.
JOSD8zLp01sMeBq2i1Hc: The probe measures capacitance, which depends on the permittivity of whatever lies between the tubes. Water has a far higher permittivity than fuel, so the gauge reads a large but meaningless figure - not zero, and not the right mass either. It is one reason tanks are drained and checked for water.
JPUrDJIdZ2uyucYvQOUi: Krueger flaps are leading edge devices hinged at their forward edge, folding out and down from the lower surface. They are normally fitted inboard, between the fuselage and the engine, where a slat track would interfere with the pylon, with slats outboard of them.
JPjmLqP0c6dxCvi2XCa8: Nimbostratus is a deep, dense, extensive layer cloud whose base is low and whose top can reach medium levels, so it holds a large amount of water and gives continuous, often heavy, rain or snow over a wide area. Stratus and stratocumulus are shallow and give at most drizzle or light precipitation, and cirrostratus is thin high ice cloud giving none at all.
JPptneA6mnNDxgwCmmn1: Winding the subscale up tells the instrument that the sea level pressure is higher, so the pressure it is sensing corresponds to a greater height above that datum and the indication rises. The rule of thumb is roughly 30 ft per hectopascal, or 1,000 ft per inch of mercury.
JQmo5SO3TLy1YRYWPcfj: Latent errors are the decisions and conditions built into the system in advance - a poor design, an ambiguous procedure, a training gap, a management priority - which lie dormant until circumstances allow them to combine with an active error and cause damage. The delay between creation and consequence is exactly what makes them hard to identify and why they survive so long.
JREm3foVmB3IFnmxdO2A: Radiation fog needs four things together: a clear sky, so the ground can radiate its heat away; a light wind of a few knots, to mix the cooling through a shallow layer without dispersing it; moist air, so only a little cooling is needed to reach the dewpoint; and a long night. Cloud cover blocks the radiational cooling, strong wind lifts the layer into stratus, and dry air never reaches saturation.
JRa1nLKTpvcSJSsij2Su: A leg between two waypoints is flown as a great circle, the shortest path over the earth, so the track angle changes continuously along it. That is why the FMS displays a track that differs at each end of a long leg and why the map shows a curved line on some projections.
JRo64S4JnMEIe01Bx7Iz: The area rule states that transonic wave drag depends chiefly on how the total cross-sectional area of the whole aircraft varies along its length, so that distribution must change as smoothly as possible. Waisting the fuselage where the wing joins - the classic 'coke bottle' shape - compensates for the wing's area and smooths the curve, cutting WAVE drag substantially. It has no effect on induced, form or skin friction drag.
JSKEiqDlpm5EAlwZMzf8: SSR interrogations from the ground go out on 1030 MHz and the airborne transponder replies on 1090 MHz. Keeping the two frequencies apart is what lets the aircraft ignore its own transmissions and the ground station distinguish replies from interrogations.
JToqCkJ8HBRWmupwAe4a: Cylinder head temperature is measured with a thermocouple - a washer or bayonet of two dissimilar metals fitted under a spark plug or into the head. It generates its own EMF, so it needs no power supply, and it copes with the temperature range involved.
JTwzGHB7PY58WKQT57xb: The control segment - the master station and its monitoring stations - tracks the satellites, monitors their health and clocks, and uploads corrected ephemeris and clock data. It does not build or launch them, and Selective Availability, the deliberate degradation, was switched off in 2000 and is not what the segment is FOR.
JU2oUSE5wxqYKisgeXmi: The take-off alternate must be reachable within 60 minutes at the ONE-ENGINE-INOPERATIVE cruising speed in still air. The situation it covers is an engine failure at or just after V1, so the speed used must be the speed the aeroplane will actually have.
JUMJmRrs3iQXUIOEgICw: ICAO Annex 7 specifies that marks under the wings of heavier-than-air aircraft shall have a minimum height of 50 cm.
JVcWIJb0fA2wejfV0Gro: The Coriolis effect is the classic producer of true vertigo in flight: a head movement out of the plane of an existing rotation stimulates additional semicircular canals and the brain reads the combination as tumbling in a completely different axis, with dizziness and nausea. The autokinetic and elevator illusions are visual and otolith effects respectively and do not produce spinning vertigo.
JVg2yRCoZzKvROyNruxI: The passenger mask is a continuous flow type with a rebreather bag: oxygen flows into the bag at a fixed rate and the wearer draws it in mixed with cabin air through the ports round the mask. It is not a sealed mask and there is no demand or pressure function.
JWhIo2cd5D8hMkTLAdYr: ICAO Annex 15 states that identification numbers for prohibited, restricted, and danger areas shall not be re-used for at least 3 months after cancellation. This prevents confusion with recently cancelled areas.
JXwHWywe5pyun1G2uMlK: Airmass thunderstorms in Central Europe are triggered by surface heating, and the surface goes on gaining more heat than it loses until mid-afternoon. Convection therefore peaks around 1400-1600 local, with the cells decaying in the evening once the heating source is removed. Frontal thunderstorms, driven by mechanical lifting rather than heating, have no such diurnal preference.
JYPIDBgYFr4podXtTZza: Bonding ties every metallic part together at a low resistance, so that all components sit at the same potential (2) and there is a defined earth return for the electrical system (4). Electrolytic corrosion occurs between DISSIMILAR metals, and bonding connects rather than isolates.
JYPqqGokNXqpHscSv0CI: A servomechanism is a closed loop position or rate control in which a small input controls a large output and feedback keeps the output proportional to the demand. An amplifier gives gain without the loop, and an autopilot is a particular application built from several servomechanisms.
JYyqhRcNOFLRPkU5R2Yj: The SERVICE ceiling is defined by a residual all-engines rate of climb of 100 ft/min - a practical figure, since the absolute ceiling (zero rate of climb) would take infinite time to reach and leaves no manoeuvre capability at all. Both fall as weight or temperature increase, since both reduce the excess thrust available.
JZoNA3kJYNtvio7GGCmK: The certification scale runs minor, major, hazardous, catastrophic. A hazardous failure is one short of catastrophic: a large reduction in functional capabilities or safety margins, with serious or fatal injury to a small number of occupants. Hull loss defines the catastrophic case.
JaWGHTJyX8GVU6pqI9If: Location indicators are listed in the GEN part of the AIP. GEN contains reference tables and general information applicable across the entire publication.
JbJemwm2Var2RRxg1gGH: Valve timing is advanced and retarded beyond the theoretical dead centres, and ignition is advanced, because gas has inertia and combustion takes time. Opening the exhaust early, closing the inlet late and lighting the charge before top dead centre all improve cylinder filling and the pressure history, raising overall efficiency.
JboyByaG4oDsZu2iyIXH: The MMEL is produced by the manufacturer as type certificate holder and approved for the type by the Authority. The operator's MEL is then derived from it and may be more restrictive but never less.
JcP9TP7DnMULfSAKhiOn: ICAO Annex 15 requires each State to provide an Integrated Aeronautical Information Package comprising the AIP, AIP Amendments, AIP Supplements, NOTAMs, Pre-flight Information Bulletins, and AICs.
JcbSpKk6STp1WF0cutHv: A non-synergetic cockpit is one where the crew have stopped working as a crew: members withdraw into their own tasks, communication is vague or absent, and errors are not caught because nobody is monitoring anyone else. It is dangerous precisely because everyone assumes someone else has checked, and it can arise from an over-authoritarian atmosphere as easily as from an over-relaxed one.
JcvWa9KJ9B2ZLlHvstiL: The tyre speed limit is a structural limit on how fast the tyre carcass may rotate, so it constrains the GROUNDSPEED at which the aeroplane leaves the ground - that is, VLOF expressed as a groundspeed. Airspeed is irrelevant to the tyre. A strong tailwind or a hot-and-high aerodrome both raise the groundspeed for a given IAS, which is when tyre speed becomes limiting.
JcyTGbME6MT5XNOC1LzW: The rule is about capability, not about treatment: an operator may not fly into expected or actual icing conditions unless the aeroplane is CERTIFICATED and EQUIPPED for them. Ground de-icing deals with contamination already present and does nothing for the ice the aeroplane will meet in flight.
JdLrBcfu76sfZz5RvYhw: Above 200 seats the extinguisher requirement rises once per 100 seats: four for 201-300, five for 301-400, six for 401-500, seven for 501-600 and eight above that.
Je9V13cpaXn3OGsJqfzP: Baffles divide the tank into bays so that the fuel cannot surge freely: they stop it running outboard in a turn or sideslip, which would move the centre of gravity, unport the pumps and change the wing bending relief. They also stiffen the tank structure against the fuel's inertia.
JeT4jVcyMbqgbCkXaxZU: Each of Rasmussen's control modes produces its own error type. The skill-based mode, being automatic, produces routine errors and handling slips. The knowledge-based mode, where the operator must reason a new solution out, produces creative errors. The rule-based mode works by applying stored technical know-how to a recognised situation, so its errors are errors of technical knowledge - the wrong rule chosen, or the right rule applied to the wrong situation.
JfjaLoHniBlZJtA4Z31m: Slats give the largest single CLmax increment of any high-lift device, because they act on the mechanism that actually limits CLmax - boundary layer separation - by ducting high-energy air onto the upper surface and RAISING the stalling angle of attack by 5-10 degrees. Trailing-edge flaps raise CLmax by adding camber but LOWER the stalling angle, and each successive flap stage yields less lift and more drag than the one before.
JfxdsPWjVyNS5GkaTYBE: Normal adult arterial pressure is about 120 mmHg systolic over 80 mmHg diastolic. Sustained readings well above this indicate hypertension, which is a licensing concern because it is symptomless yet raises the risk of stroke and coronary disease - which is why blood pressure is measured at every medical.
Jg8dcLFFuBMshuBZH013: Fatigue is divided into acute, which builds within a duty period or a day and is relieved by a normal rest, and chronic, which accumulates over weeks when recovery is repeatedly incomplete and is not relieved by a single night's sleep. The distinction matters because chronic fatigue is not obvious to the person who has it.
Jhfn3s0ACTr4BsYlfdmu: The bow wave is a detached shock standing ahead of the aeroplane, and it appears once the FREE STREAM reaches M1.0 - at that point pressure disturbances can no longer propagate ahead of the aircraft and pile up into a shock. Note the distinction from Mcrit, which is where the LOCAL flow somewhere on the airframe first reaches M1.0 and a shock forms ON the surface.
JiLZRW0mFKBBkteOowss: The turbine and compressor of a cold air unit sit on a common shaft, so the air expanding through the turbine gives up energy to drive the compressor - and air that does work in expanding comes out much colder. The refrigeration is produced by that expansion, which is why the unit needs no refrigerant.
Jjk9gNd6q1alqULTeaOx: Noise damage is done to the hair cells on the basilar membrane inside the cochlea, which are destroyed by excessive vibration and do not regenerate. The result is a permanent sensorineural loss, typically notched around 4 kHz. The eardrum and ossicles are damaged by blast or by pressure differentials rather than by sustained noise.
Jjm5GofAonWpQbEbvBcD: The extra fuel does not burn; it absorbs heat as it vaporises and leaves with the exhaust, so the charge and the cylinder head run cooler. That matters in the climb, where power is high and the cooling airflow is poor - which is why full rich is used even though it wastes fuel.
Jk9czcBII7DIjEswoL5t: The command bar shows the roll attitude required, so when a new heading is selected it commands a bank towards it. Once the pilot has rolled to the bank angle the computer wants, the bar centres and stays centred through the turn - it is a command, not a display of how far there is to go.
JkPBN009VKHxT1MnEQvq: The vertical speed indicator works entirely on static pressure: the capsule is fed static directly and the case through a calibrated leak, so the difference between them measures how fast the static pressure is changing. Pitot pressure plays no part.
JkPgMni4Tqg6p4Say25j: VMO is a structural limit set by dynamic pressure, which is what calibrated airspeed measures - and equivalent airspeed is the same quantity with the compressibility correction applied. Either expresses the limit as a fixed value; true airspeed would not, since the same TAS gives different loads at different densities.
JlBhLpCtZ6ZdYKhf32wv: A period at idle lets the turbine discs, casings and shafts cool at similar rates so the clearances close evenly. Shutting down straight from high power leaves hot rotors inside cooler casings, and the differential contraction can nip the blades or bow the shaft.
JlwHgRPqAvHZpFsO5SvU: 7500 is the unlawful interference (hijack) code. 7600 is radio communication failure and 7700 is a general emergency; 7800 is not an assigned code at all.
JmgaW36MGCh60aI3TL1p: The subtropical high-pressure belt lies at about 25-35 degrees in each hemisphere, where the poleward-moving upper branch of the Hadley cell descends. That subsidence gives the belt its clear skies, light variable winds (the horse latitudes) and the world's great deserts. The trade winds flow out of it toward the equator and the westerlies toward the poles.
JmiwNxCij1WamViimnym: Moving the CG aft shortens the moment arm to the tailplane, so a given elevator deflection produces more pitching moment and less stick force is needed per g. Beyond the aft limit that stick force per g falls below the certified minimum, leaving the aeroplane dangerously easy to over-stress with almost no force cue that it is happening. Static longitudinal stability falls too, and spin recovery becomes worse, not better.
JmnUHTkCEYLhwz4PbJgS: In a stabilised platform the gyros hold the platform fixed relative to the earth's frame while the aircraft manoeuvres around it, so the accelerometers measure in a set of axes entirely independent of the aircraft's own. That is exactly what distinguishes it from a strapdown system.
JnikOwpDGDuME5ISKC4D: With nitrogen removed from the inspired gas, alveolar oxygen pressure is ambient pressure less water vapour and carbon dioxide, which keeps oxygenation adequate up to about 40,000 ft. Above that, ambient pressure is too low even for pure oxygen and positive-pressure breathing becomes necessary.
Jnvzd4DArTHLcJ8VR2O1: Alignment works by sensing the earth's rotation against a stationary platform, so it must be complete and NAV selected BEFORE the aircraft moves off the gate. Loading passengers and freight rocks the airframe but does not translate it, so alignment can run during loading; any actual movement corrupts it.
JoWbQTwPjFMDCAn0Labb: In a synergetic cockpit the captain remains the decision maker - the responsibility cannot be delegated - but the decision is informed by the whole crew's input, so the outcome is better than any one member could produce. Deciding alone wastes the resource, delegating the decision abandons command, and assuming that agreement makes discussion unnecessary is how crews miss things.
Jot7ZSs0Lys0x4IOUEyV: Clear ice comes from LARGE supercooled drops, typically at temperatures between 0 C and about -10 C. A large drop releases enough latent heat as it starts to freeze that only part of it solidifies on impact; the rest runs back over the surface and freezes progressively, producing a dense, transparent, tenacious sheet that spreads well aft of the leading edge. Small drops freeze instantly and give opaque rime instead.
JpVIJeHTwtco6TvpvJPz: Noise cannot drive the choice of landing runway unless that runway offers the approach guidance the arrival needs - an ILS or a visual approach slope system. The wind cases quoted are all within the limits that permit noise-preferential use: crosswind up to 15 kt including gusts and tailwind up to 5 kt including gusts.
Jpgq5NDZgrGJJxt4i8p8: In a southerly Foehn the air has dropped its moisture as precipitation on the Italian side, then descends the northern slopes warming at the dry adiabatic rate. It arrives warm, very dry and cloud-free, so visibility on the north side becomes exceptional. The strong downslope flow over rough terrain, with its rotors and mountain waves, makes turbulence the main hazard - not icing or precipitation, both of which are on the southern side.
Jqfp1JjBho0wREwewzMs: For required cabin crew in an unpressurised aeroplane: the entire flight time above a cabin pressure altitude of 13 000 ft, plus any period exceeding 30 minutes in the band above 10 000 ft up to 13 000 ft. Flight deck occupants on duty have the stricter rule - the entire time above 10 000 ft with no concession.
JqqIqHuH2voOAVC40aVq: In Class B airspace at or above 3050 m (10,000 ft), VMC minima are 8 km visibility with 1500 m horizontal and 1000 ft (300 m) vertical distance from clouds. Below 10,000 ft in Class B, the requirement may be 'clear of clouds' depending on the regulatory framework.
JqwskIkhMt8rOhAPEJve: Lift and drag are defined relative to the RELATIVE AIRFLOW, not to the airframe or the horizon: drag acts parallel to it, opposing the motion, and lift perpendicular to it. This is why the lift vector rotates with the flight path - tilted forward in a climb, and tilted into the turn when banked, which is what provides the turning force.
JrQYR1XIcxHnhKHmJxjw: Stall speed rises with the square root of load factor: Vs(n) = Vs x sqrt(n) = 100 x sqrt(1.5) = 100 x 1.22 = 122 kt. Note that 1.5 g corresponds to about 48 degrees of bank in a level turn, and that the relationship is the reason a steep turn at low speed is so much more hazardous than the bank angle alone suggests.
JrTlmd3tc9nzF7NEOZLD: A fusible plug in the wheel rim melts at a set temperature and lets the tyre deflate in a controlled way, so an overheated brake cannot burst the tyre and throw debris. It is why an aircraft with hot brakes is approached from fore and aft rather than from the side.
Jrjz3LAy4JISDUoocRE8: Control wheel steering lets the pilot manoeuvre through the autopilot: moving the normal control wheel commands a new attitude, which the autopilot then holds when the wheel is released. It is a way of flying with the autopilot engaged rather than a way of disengaging it.
JsncCDijGbgk1y5ZbVrh: Both statements are wrong. The core's job is structural - it separates the two skins so that they act as the flanges of a deep, light beam, and it carries the shear between them. And a sandwich panel is poor at taking concentrated loads, which crush the core; point loads must be introduced through local inserts or solid laminate.
JtBDMpYWFnR426Ss1qny: The two positions are on the same parallel, so the rhumb line distance is the departure: dlong from 002 30 E to 007 30 W is 10 degrees = 600 minutes, and departure = 600 x cos60 = 300 NM. The longitudes straddle Greenwich, so they add rather than subtract.
JtNGf9RnfQn3yDlPl4mn: V2 must be at least 1.1 VMCA - a 10% margin - so that adequate directional control remains available with the critical engine inoperative during the second segment climb. V2 must simultaneously satisfy the stall margin requirement (1.2 VS or 1.13 VSR depending on the aeroplane), and the higher of the two floors governs. At high flap settings VMCA is often the binding one.
Ju4Imj67h6NzHsJdcB7P: Power depends on the mass of air the engine can take in, and that falls with density as the aircraft climbs - roughly 3% per 1,000 ft in an unsupercharged engine. Temperature and humidity modify the density, but it is the density itself that governs.
JuBKTV5kBvaqNptLVCib: On NORMAL the diluter demand regulator meters cabin air into the oxygen on a schedule set by cabin altitude, so as the cabin climbs the proportion of oxygen rises until it reaches 100% at around 30,000 ft cabin altitude. Diluting at lower altitudes is what makes the supply last.
Jv5QpktQCqC4YwmjdJi0: Rule-based behaviour works by matching the situation to a stored if-then rule. When no stored rule fits, or the rule tried does not work, the operator has to fall back on knowledge-based reasoning from first principles - slow, effortful and error-prone, but the only option for a genuinely novel problem.
JvAJS5IgOkW3zAsD6J7J: Attention is highest at the start of a list and declines through it, so the items that matter most go first. Sequence is therefore central to checklist design, along with the flow of the panel and the logic of the actions - a checklist is an ordered instrument, not an inventory.
Jw6N0MOgyjNZZkBjfrY0: With the pitot blocked the total pressure is trapped while the static pressure rises in the descent, so the indicated difference shrinks and the airspeed indicator under-reads (2). Flying to hold the indication constant therefore means accelerating steadily, and VMO can be exceeded without any warning from the instrument (3).
Jx1RANreeHzJRO05waBn: Alcohol is metabolised at a roughly constant rate of about 15 mg per 100 ml of blood per hour, regardless of coffee, food or exercise, so 60 mg/100 ml takes about four hours to clear. Note that clearing the blood is not the same as being fit to fly - the hangover effects and the eight-hour rule outlast the alcohol itself.
Jx3pExsSMSYDIQI012zT: All four are recognised types. Statement 1 is hypoxic hypoxia, from low inspired oxygen pressure; statement 2 is anaemic or hypaemic hypoxia, with carriage capacity lost to carbon monoxide; statement 3 is stagnant hypoxia, where the blood does not reach the tissue; and statement 4 is histotoxic hypoxia, where the cell cannot use the oxygen it receives.
JyHrtClEwcRxr8BtoP2o: Descending at constant indicated airspeed the true airspeed falls, because the same dynamic pressure needs a lower true speed in denser air. The speed of sound rises as the air warms, so the Mach number - a falling TAS over a rising speed of sound - falls faster still. Both decrease.
JzUgWHk7lP5WNnvCvMh9: The MEL is approved by the Authority of the operator's own State - the Authority the operator answers to and which oversees its Operations Manual. The State of manufacture and the States overflown have no role in approving it.
JzXOwIilIA75yshJQtdj: Cumulonimbus is the only cloud that routinely occupies all three levels at once: its base is typically low, at 1000-5000 ft, and its top can reach FL450 or higher, spreading into the characteristic anvil of ice crystals. That is why CB is treated separately in reports and why CAVOK is prohibited when any CB is present, at any level.
K1OYHpbLPCogeHWBqrfd: The governor holds RPM constant, so as forward speed rises the blade must be coarsened to keep the same angle of attack and absorb the same power. Blade angle therefore increases with true airspeed, which is why the propeller is at fine pitch for take-off and coarse for the cruise.
K2rIgxjp1wz9Q0ErpxQl: The datum is the reference plane from which all arms are measured, chosen by the manufacturer for convenience - often ahead of the nose so that every arm is positive. It has no physical or aerodynamic significance and need not lie on the aircraft at all.
K3RAsGvyLUIrW7CiZ1Nr: To execute public transport flights with an ATPL, the minimum age is 21 years and the pilot must not have attained 60 (for single-pilot ops). Some jurisdictions allow multi-crew ops until 65.
K3Tmuy4mJ57W5lkmEbED: Lift means higher pressure beneath the wing than above it, and at the tip - where the two regions meet around the end of the wing - the air simply flows from high to low pressure: from BENEATH the wing, around the WING TIP, to the top. That escaping flow rolls up into the tip vortex, which induces downwash over the wing and is the source of induced drag.
K4KwOSxvVhhBajEA3ymP: An INS derives track and groundspeed from its own accelerometers alone. Supply it with TAS and it can subtract the air vector from the ground vector to display the wind velocity. IAS or Mach on their own will not do, because the wind triangle needs a true airspeed.
K5NwHO2WAwBPP5Dkj2oH: A control zone (CTR) is a controlled airspace extending upwards from the surface of the earth to a specified upper limit. A control area (CTA) extends from a specified lower limit, not from the surface.
K5i9nV7oXxgJrYPLUC2K: The take-off alternate must be accessible within 60 minutes at the SINGLE-ENGINE cruising speed in still air. The whole point of the alternate is an engine failure at or after V1, so an all-engines speed would nominate an aerodrome the aeroplane cannot in fact reach in the time.
K5kFAMSuBz3LSyY6k3Cn: The space segment's job is simply to transmit: each satellite broadcasts ranging codes and a navigation message from which a receiver derives time, position and velocity. The satellites do not compute anyone's position and do not monitor themselves; that monitoring is the control segment's task.
K6kvOHl2GUXgRnI0kGzH: When a visual approach is cleared, the key condition is that ATC continues to provide separation from other controlled traffic. The pilot maintains visual reference, but ATC separation responsibility continues.
K6v9jqAyXxzjUCXYcVdW: A LIGHT following a MEDIUM on the same runway, or on parallel runways less than 760 m apart, requires 5 NM radar separation. The other wake radar minima are 4 NM for a MEDIUM behind a HEAVY at some units, 5 NM generally, and 6 NM for a LIGHT behind a HEAVY.
K7DGof0sjDbUAuokk93U: With no surrounding frame of reference the brain attributes the eye's own small involuntary movements to the light, so a single fixed light stared at in the dark appears to drift or manoeuvre. Pilots have followed such a light believing it to be another aircraft. Continuing to scan, rather than fixating, prevents it.
K7W4JF50H4pcw5Y52mju: Nitrogen dissolved in the tissues during a dive must be washed out before ambient pressure is reduced again, and the standard figure is a 24-hour delay before flight - longer only after dives that required decompression stops. Flying sooner risks decompression sickness at cabin altitudes that would otherwise be perfectly safe.
K8W0YZV4SEEyaH1noLt1: Night currency requirements specify take-offs and landings must be in the same category, class, and type of aircraft (if a type rating is required) to ensure the pilot has recent experience in that specific aircraft.
K8soEEdp4NjcWsk0SY9l: Hyperventilation is a shortage of carbon dioxide driven by emotional arousal, so the treatment attacks both: deliberately slowing the breathing raises the CO2 again, and talking through the procedure aloud both paces the breathing and calms the arousal that started it. An oxygen mask addresses the wrong gas, and the Valsalva manoeuvre is for the ears.
K8wuFpxt28vEMQt9CPXJ: The boundary layer next to the skin is slowed by friction, so a pitot head immersed in it would sense less than the true total pressure. Mounting it on a mast clear of the surface puts the opening in undisturbed flow, which is what makes the reading valid.
KA7lTih7XYBlpv7AKcOk: Middle-ear barotrauma happens when the Eustachian tube cannot admit air fast enough during descent, so the higher ambient pressure forces the drum inwards. A respiratory infection swells the tube lining and makes it far more likely, which is why flying with a heavy cold is inadvisable. Climb is normally safe because expanding air vents itself.
KARhYPfKOaynPWg3e5Cq: Disorientation is a false interpretation of bodily sensations, and the only reliable reference is the instrument panel. The drill is to establish a systematic scan, believe the instruments, disregard the sensations however convincing they feel, and keep head movements to a minimum. Looking outside for confirmation is what prolongs it.
KAeR8od1qy1oTeSdyvXs: For aeroplanes first issued with a Certificate of Airworthiness after 1 June 1990 the FDR threshold is a maximum certificated take-off mass above 5700 kg. Earlier aeroplanes were caught only at higher masses, which is why the older 27 000 kg figure still turns up in questions.
KAwzfcI28Sdvlmq2Rl1H: Boost pumps deliver tens of pounds per square inch - enough to hold the feed line pressure comfortably above the fuel's vapour pressure at altitude and to give the engine-driven pump a positive inlet head. The very high pressures are produced downstream by the engine's own high pressure pump.
KB4vzPXhHxYDuaYdLY5O: In a high bypass engine most of the air passes around the core, and that cold stream produces roughly 75-80% of the total thrust. The core exists largely to drive the fan - moving a large mass of air slowly is more efficient than a small mass quickly.
KBHtKJc8U6vWpbfuNSUi: In an impulse stage all the expansion happens in the nozzle guide vanes, so the pressure drops across them and the gas leaves as a high velocity jet. The rotor blades are symmetrical buckets which merely turn that jet and absorb its momentum, so the pressure across them stays constant.
KBcHffyIiqsj2e2c7HoO: The mean sun moves 15 degrees per hour and 15 minutes of arc per minute of time. So 8 hours gives 120 degrees and 8 minutes gives 2 degrees, a total of 122 degrees. Working in the same 15-to-1 ratio converts any time interval into arc.
KDd5g3OjhAxVnIYLxWL4: TCAS symbology escalates with threat: a hollow diamond for other traffic, a filled diamond for proximate traffic, a filled amber circle for a traffic advisory, and a filled red square for the intruder that has caused a resolution advisory.
KDfonxhU1Vh5UIr87emV: With the aeroplane still on stand, the failure is a dispatch question, and the document that answers it is the Minimum Equipment List - which items may be inoperative, under what conditions, and with what operational or maintenance procedures. KE20nxOFXNUM52fTJQgk: The certification limit is a cabin pressure altitude of 8,000 ft in normal operation, which keeps everyone on board within the indifferent stage of hypoxia. That figure, together with the maximum differential the fuselage can take, is what sets the aircraft's certificated ceiling.
KEGNgAeX10B8Iei6RzcL: An aft centre of gravity in the cruise requires the rotor disc to be tilted further forward to hold the attitude, so the cyclic sits nearer its forward stop and the flapping loads in the head are higher.
