KEXqkED33z3bwdcg7cmL: The bootstrap order after the primary heat exchanger is compressor, secondary heat exchanger, turbine: the air is compressed further, cooled again while it is at high pressure, and only then expanded. Compressing before expanding is what makes the temperature drop across the turbine so large.
KEa51sCK8ufBBFPdFz8Z: Adverse yaw arises because the down-going aileron generates more induced drag than the up-going one removes, yawing the aeroplane away from the intended turn. Differential rigging fixes it at source: the UP-going aileron is made to travel further than the down-going one, so the extra parasite drag it creates balances the extra induced drag on the other wing. Frise ailerons and rudder-aileron interconnects achieve the same end differently.
KEo94YYcMf08S59VBV5D: Position error arises because the static port cannot be placed where the pressure is exactly free-stream static: the local pressure field around the fuselage differs from it, and by an amount that changes with speed and configuration. It is corrected by calibration, not by the instrument.
KFZ7rZemAuRHnbN7xIih: Automatic dependent surveillance means the aircraft reports its own position, derived from its navigation systems, to the controller over the data link without being asked. It replaces radar where there is none - over oceans and remote areas - which is what allows separation minima there to be reduced.
KFnwEIAoudTnDGFsVtV3: The ground-air visual signal code for 'Affirmative' (YES) is the letter Y. X means 'Require assistance', N means 'Negative' (NO), and V means 'Require assistance'.
KHj1Bb15bitu6Qnd2lfJ: Latent errors sit in the system undetected for a period (1), showing themselves only when a particular combination of circumstances arises (2), and in the meantime they encourage a false confidence, since nothing has gone wrong so the system appears sound (4). Statement 3 is the opposite of the truth: they are exactly what the front-line operator cannot see.
KHoXeaW9oHougr1RPnfU: A 5.2 percent gradient means 5.2 ft of height per 100 ft of ground distance. 7 NM is 7 x 6076 = 42 500 ft, so the height is 0.052 x 42 500 = about 2210 ft. The shortcut worth carrying: a 3 degree (5.2 percent) path is about 300 ft per NM.
KINy2istrzfIuL0SfogJ: Both figures are altitudes on the same QNH, so the QNH cancels and is a distractor. The climb is 7500 - 1500 = 6000 ft, and 15 NM at 120 kt takes 7.5 minutes, so the minimum rate of climb is 6000 / 7.5 = 800 ft/min.
KIoqH6HnMH43HO2mRXeF: Effectiveness comes from balancing what the individual needs and wants against what the situation actually demands and allows. Repressing needs altogether is unsustainable, independence from the environment is impossible, and attempting to exceed one's own capabilities is how limits are discovered the hard way. Knowing and working within them is what makes performance reliable.
KJCzVleq06f6BCNrOQfV: Phosphate ester fluids are irritant to skin and particularly to eyes, and they attack paint and some plastics, so gloves and goggles are used and spillages are cleaned up promptly. They are chosen precisely because they are fire RESISTANT, which is why the fire risk answer is wrong.
KKDWZGm9xiAUCgm3sLTm: Calibrated airspeed is indicated airspeed with the two airframe and instrument errors removed: instrument error, from the mechanism itself, and position or pressure error, from the imperfect siting of the static source. Compressibility and density corrections come later, converting CAS to EAS and then to TAS.
KKLuVN9zyCCJYJg4J8HE: A transverse Mercator has its cylinder tangential along a meridian rather than the equator, so scale stays nearly constant in a narrow band running north/south. That makes it the projection for maps of large north/south extent and the basis of the UTM grid.
KM8LltZGcXULpqQcLhjg: All three are correct and all three are decision traps. The first information received frames how everything after it is judged - the primacy effect. Once a decision has been made, contradictory evidence is discounted rather than weighed - confirmation bias. And stress narrows attention so that less information reaches the decision maker at exactly the moment more is needed.
KMhJBNAx2XYYTHAA95Fd: Cholera is spread by the faecal-oral route, through water or food contaminated by infected material, which is why the tropical rule is to drink only sealed or boiled water and to eat only what has been cooked or peeled. It is not airborne, not spread by insects and not acquired through wounds.
KMoOHOKHQ5BiRfbqi5p4: Above 10,000 ft the immediate threat after a decompression is hypoxia, and the time of useful consciousness may be seconds, so the first action must be to get oxygen on - masks on before anything else, including the descent. The emergency descent follows, but it takes time and cannot itself be relied upon to prevent hypoxia.
KMzunkLC4wqMttlYaRmw: The seasons come from the 23.5 degree tilt of the earth's axis relative to the plane of its orbit, which changes the sun's declination through the year and with it the sun's elevation and the length of the day. The varying earth-sun distance is a much smaller effect and works the wrong way for northern seasons.
KNwVH8hOkwvPGaIquOnL: Both statements are wrong. REM sleep is associated with mental and emotional recuperation and with consolidating memory, while physical restoration belongs to the deep slow-wave stages - so it does not refresh the body. And REM increases rather than decreases as the night goes on, the later cycles being dominated by it, which is why a shortened sleep costs disproportionately much REM.
KP8ftZfUKlELRYZY9qCo: IAS 200 at FL120 with OAT -5C gives a TAS of about 242 kt, so with a 30 kt tailwind the groundspeed is about 272 kt and 100 NM takes about 22 minutes. Five minutes more is 27 minutes, needing a groundspeed of about 222 kt, hence a TAS of about 192 kt; converting back at the same density ratio gives an IAS of about 159 kt.
KPCaVwT3QtiWGxHTn6TY: A rate one turn is 3 degrees per second, so 30 seconds is 90 degrees and the actual heading becomes 225. Turning right from 135 the aircraft passes through SOUTH, and in the northern hemisphere a turn through south makes the compass LEAD the aircraft, so it reads more than 225. Turns through north lag; turns through south lead.
KQTEBpJRGHcgp43gsXB5: 70 m/sec is 70 x 3600 = 252 000 m per hour = 252 km/h, and dividing by 1.852 gives about 136 kt. A useful approximation: 1 m/sec is very nearly 2 kt.
KQw2XMulsUxJRkd5NCyr: Loads are connected in parallel across the bus-bar so that each sees the full bus voltage and each can be switched independently. Turning a load off simply removes its share of the current, leaving the voltage and the other loads unaffected - which is why a series arrangement would be unusable.
KQw9BP9KrYp1cNun6VR4: Descending at constant calibrated airspeed the true airspeed falls, because the same dynamic pressure is produced by a lower true speed in denser air, while the speed of sound rises as the air warms. Mach number is the ratio of the two, so it decreases.
KR6w3aQqn4Y60bG06qW1: A Special Air Report section I contains the position report including aircraft identification, height, position, and time. Section II contains the weather observations.
KRMsvuU3AdYnVoRMMfvI: The chain is IAS, corrected for instrument and position error to give CAS, then for compressibility to give EAS - so EAS is IAS with all three corrections applied. Density is the remaining correction, converting EAS to TAS.
KRNTLKFWlXr9wGA7cr1x: The retina is one of the most oxygen-hungry tissues in the body and night vision is measurably degraded from about 5,000 ft, so at 10,000 ft at night a fall in acuity is a hypoxia effect. Supplemental oxygen restores it within a minute or two. Scanning technique and cockpit lighting matter as well, but they will not recover acuity that has been lost to lack of oxygen.
KRZQSmBqQvvCTGFlXQpa: An IFR flight may be planned without a destination alternate only if the required conditions are forecast to prevail from 1 hour BEFORE to 1 hour AFTER the estimated time of arrival. The window is symmetrical, which is what makes the asymmetric options wrong.
KRiDGNrDl4xFn1aHCted: ICAO Annex 14 specifies that centreline and crossbar lights of a CAT I precision approach lighting system are fixed lights showing variable white intensity, not green or flashing.
KRtasC1D1jMR56Jn4woq: Octane rating measures a fuel's resistance to detonation, not its energy content - which is much the same for all grades. A higher rating allows a higher compression ratio or more boost without the end gas igniting spontaneously, which is why the specified grade must never be reduced.
KSXqtCV0iDMYTT9SSOCZ: The heart muscle cannot take oxygen from the blood passing through its chambers; it is supplied by the coronary arteries, which branch off the aorta immediately above the aortic valve. Narrowing of those arteries starves the muscle - angina on exertion, and infarction when a branch closes completely - which is why they dominate aeromedical cardiovascular screening.
KTbspAuuS8D8358cFZR0: This row is corrupted: the first sentence of the stem, which gave a relative bearing of 315 from the same NDB at 0830, has been lost, so as printed only one bearing remains. KTrH0PZWrgmlkREG1GWs: Aerodontalgia is toothache caused by pressure change acting on gas trapped under a filling, in a decayed cavity or around an abscess. It is commonest on climb, as the trapped gas expands, but it can equally occur on descent when the outside pressure rises against gas that cannot equalise, so the answer is yes.
KUdU4aQF0tmZrl8TAI1w: TCAS transmits an interrogation and times the reply from the intruder's transponder, exactly as DME does against a ground station. Range comes from that round-trip delay, altitude from the content of the reply and rough bearing from the directional antenna.
KUn78s3ZmjZzjVs5oLKm: Adverse yaw is the yaw AWAY from the intended turn caused by the down-going aileron producing more induced drag than the up-going one. Differential deflection cures it by making the up-going aileron travel further, so its extra parasite drag offsets the other wing's extra induced drag. Aileron reversal is a high-speed wing-twisting problem, cured by inboard ailerons and spoilers instead.
KUqZMdLCoRFxG4WRfgz6: In an unpressurised aeroplane the cabin altitude is the flight altitude, so above 13,000 ft every occupant must be supplied with oxygen for the whole time spent there. Between 10,000 and 13,000 ft the requirement applies only to the time in excess of 30 minutes.
KXEwVhFGUqfJ0GC27mhC: All four are environmental stressors acting on the crew in the cockpit: noise and vibration, which fatigue and interfere with communication; acceleration, which loads the body directly; radiation, which increases with altitude and latitude; and extreme temperatures, which degrade both physical and mental performance. They act in addition to the psychological and physiological stressors the individual brings with him.
KXMQEV4d95D0KKSpQKKw: Freezing rain requires a warm layer aloft above a sub-freezing layer at low level. Precipitation leaves the cloud as liquid rain in the warm layer, then descends into air below 0 C where it becomes supercooled but stays liquid, and freezes instantly on striking the airframe or the ground. That structure is typical ahead of a winter warm front, and it produces the most severe icing conditions there are.
KXR4mVjq4tnoffKBM7Ys: Minimum fuel for a given distance means the greatest distance per kilogram of fuel - maximum specific range, which is the maximum range procedure. Long range cruise deliberately gives up 1% of that in exchange for speed, and maximum endurance maximises TIME aloft rather than distance, so it is the wrong target entirely when the aim is to get somewhere on the least fuel.
KXnGjY2d62x6kkRUjR91: The escape manoeuvre is maximum available thrust, pitch up toward the stick shaker, and CONFIGURATION UNCHANGED - gear and flaps stay where they are, speed brakes retracted. Changing configuration mid-shear costs lift or drag at the worst moment, and chasing best lift-to-drag speed surrenders the height the manoeuvre exists to protect.
KYJpdp17r2DDpcYqzJXQ: The sea breeze is a shallow daytime circulation driven by the land heating faster than the sea, typically confined to the lowest 1000-3000 ft and extending 10-20 NM inland, with a compensating return flow above it. It occurs at any latitude where a sufficient land-sea temperature difference develops - it is common in the tropics - and it dies away at night, when the weaker land breeze replaces it.
KZXAZYQdVNpWmtgUEtNp: The difference between a flight level and true altitude has two independent causes: the pressure error, which depends on how far QNH differs from 1013, and the temperature error, which depends on the deviation from ISA. With QNH unknown you cannot separate the two, so a 100 ft discrepancy could arise from either or from both cancelling partially. No conclusion about the temperature is possible.
KaBrIVhjPnMv9otQJLbd: Hailstone size depends on updraught strength, because the stone must be held aloft above the freezing level long enough to accrete successive layers of ice. Only a severe thunderstorm has updraughts strong enough to produce large stones. Hail occurs in airmass as well as frontal storms and at all latitudes where deep convection occurs, and large stones are typically layered, alternating clear and opaque ice.
KaQnP3u2diFNylRMeFtW: An oblique Mercator has its cylinder tangential along a chosen GREAT CIRCLE rather than along the equator or a meridian, so scale stays nearly constant in a narrow band either side of that particular route. That makes it the projection used for a strip chart of one specific long-haul great circle track.
KaehvX1B2EoZ3WdBB2Te: An isothermal layer has an environmental lapse rate of zero, which is far less than either adiabatic rate. A parcel displaced upward cools at its adiabatic rate while the surroundings do not cool at all, so the parcel immediately becomes colder and denser than its environment and sinks back: absolutely stable. Inversions, where temperature actually increases with height, are more stable still.
KahAj1SkcQ8UDwuIzat6: The green starboard light and the red port light each cover 110 degrees, from dead ahead to 20 degrees behind the beam on their own side; the white tail light covers the remaining 140 degrees. That is how an observer works out the relative direction of an aircraft at night.
KaseNVV9exE3ec4mIBLC: The laissez-faire captain simply does not exercise command: decisions, choices and actions are left to whoever takes them, without direction, without allocation of tasks and without anyone taking responsibility for the outcome. It is as dangerous as autocracy in the opposite direction, because nobody is coordinating and nobody knows who is doing what.
KbdfjwuLeNbWEN6lGIfk: Primary radar depends on a REFLECTED echo, so the signal is attenuated on the way out and again on the way back, making range vary with the FOURTH root of power. Doubling the range therefore needs 2 to the fourth = 16 times the power. Contrast a beacon, which is one-way, and where doubling range needs only 4 times the power.
Kbh22DZWphHiXhq4kULY: With the CG BEHIND the centre of pressure, the wing's lift acts ahead of the CG and produces a nose-UP moment about it. Balancing that requires a nose-down moment from the tail, and since the tailplane sits aft of the CG, that means an UPWARD tail load. This is the aft-CG case, and the reason an aft CG reduces trim drag: the tailplane helps carry the weight instead of pushing down against it.
KbqS4g0zJ2rVYR7sm8tl: Arctic air is the coldest classification of all, originating over the permanently ice-covered polar regions north of about 70 degrees, where the surface radiates heat away all winter and the source air can reach -40 C or below. Polar air, whether maritime or continental, comes from lower latitudes and is less extreme, and tropical continental air is hot and dry.
KcIJWm7bkFDFQhj2n7nY: Filters are fitted in the pressure line, to protect the actuators and valves from debris the pump may shed, and in the return line, to catch the wear particles the system generates before they reach the reservoir and the pump inlet. Both are needed because contamination is generated at both ends.
Kcz3rWqextnaJxflx4is: Take-off performance must be computed from the ACTUAL conditions, not standard ones: airport elevation and runway slope are physical properties of the runway, pressure altitude and outside air temperature together determine the density that governs thrust and lift, and the wind components determine the groundspeed and hence the distances. Using standard temperature or standard pressure would invalidate the whole calculation.
KdXRj9NXASr4UpEzXS8R: Newton's second law gives force = mass x acceleration, so the SI unit of force is the kilogram-metre per second squared, named the newton. For comparison: the pascal is N/m2 (pressure), the joule is N m (work or energy) and the watt is J/s (power). Reading off the base units is the fastest way to identify which quantity is meant.
KdwpXmRCm6ncbbCLdxpl: ICAO Annex 1: for night privileges on a CPL, the applicant must complete at least 5 hours night flight time including 5 take-offs and 5 landings as PIC.
KfKqfClzLISH2X8FWJws: The definition of a dangerous good for air transport comes from the ICAO Technical Instructions (Doc 9284), which implement Annex 18. The IATA regulations restate them for industry use and are not the defining instrument.
KfjJjjaEzoPUdm9OsxUJ: Hydrocarbons in contact with high-concentration oxygen can ignite spontaneously, without any spark, and the reaction is violent. Oxygen systems are therefore assembled with oxygen-clean tools and components, and servicing is never done with greasy hands or lubricated fittings.
Kg69CxfqVqOu9bFaTFIj: The horizontal component H is greatest at the magnetic equator and falls to zero at the magnetic poles, where the field is entirely vertical. So it DECREASES with increasing magnetic latitude, and is very small near the poles, which is why a direct reading compass is useless there.
Kg8s8WIcFkmSqNCcacGM: Time of useful consciousness collapses at extreme altitude: around a minute at 35,000 ft, but only a handful of seconds above 40,000 ft, because the alveolar oxygen pressure falls below that of venous blood and oxygen actually diffuses out of the blood into the lungs. At 43,000 ft there is time for nothing except the mask.
Kgkwq4K9qaS2a1xyws64: Oxygen is carried bound to haemoglobin, and haemoglobin is contained within the red blood cells - about 98% of the oxygen in blood travels this way, with only a trace dissolved in plasma. White cells handle defence and platelets handle clotting.
Kgv4pnierjPeijo4ORM2: The change of longitude straddles the 180 meridian: 16 03 to reach it plus 8 13 beyond, i.e. 24 15 = 1455.4 minutes. The rhumb line distance is therefore 1455.4 x cos56 = about 814 NM, not 1455.4 - that figure is the dlong in minutes, offered as a trap. For the great circle, the vertex is at the mid-longitude, where the eastbound track is 090, and convergency from there to B is about 10 degrees; eastbound in the southern hemisphere the track decreases, so at B it is about 080.
KgxtTNedDNakM8IBgNoj: The inertial reference system supplies attitude and heading, and the autopilot needs exactly that to close its inner stabilisation loops. Stall warning works from angle of attack, GPWS from radio height and barometric rate, and TCAS from transponder replies - none of them needs IRS attitude.
KhHhc68zcVGIVJp5n35y: Hyperventilation tetany is the muscular spasm produced by a carbon dioxide level that has fallen too far, so the fastest remedy is to put CO2 back. Rebreathing exhaled air from a bag does that within a few breaths. Talking the person into slower breathing also works but takes far longer, and holding the breath is not controllable in someone already in spasm.
KhTVfiCd0qHCbZm3xUIT: The perceptual threshold is the minimum stimulus intensity that can be detected, so raising it means a stronger stimulus is now needed - the organ has become less sensitive. Thresholds rise with fatigue, with adaptation to a continuous stimulus and with age, which is why a warning tone that was obvious at the start of a duty may not be noticed at the end of it.
KiUyvRTKhrLGzSHvPyic: Minimum Sector Altitudes are established within 25 NM of the IAF/navigation facility. This radius provides adequate obstacle clearance for aircraft in the terminal area before beginning an approach procedure.
KiVSIX4BEVD7bM5DW4mw: Blood glucose is kept stable by eating regularly and by a balanced diet containing complex carbohydrates that release glucose slowly. Skipping meals is what produces the headache, poor concentration, shakiness and irritability of hypoglycaemia, and a sugar snack makes matters worse by provoking an insulin surge and a rebound fall.
KjKcpiMVZOkeZ3ImSPDn: Groundspeed is 105 NM in 21 minutes = 300 kt, and CAS 200 at FL120 in ISA gives a TAS of about 240 kt. Applying the 15W variation, the true track is 207 and the true heading 200, so there is 7 degrees of right drift. Resolving the vectors gives a wind from about 050 at 70 kt.
Kko1K0QoB7nDyqX8T5GK: Drag = CD x 1/2 rho V2 x S, in which density appears to the FIRST power. Halving the density therefore halves the drag - a factor of 2. It is SPEED that appears squared; confusing the two is what produces the square-root and fourth-power distractors.
KlOIRboMCf9BsdNqjTEx: Mercator scale expands as the secant of latitude, so the scale DENOMINATOR shrinks by the cosine: 3 704 000 x cos60 = 1 852 000, i.e. 1 : 1 852 000. A smaller denominator means a larger scale, which is exactly what expansion away from the equator produces.
KlRzbEc35McHrZBBPSLe: Turboprops have little bleed air to spare, so wing leading edges are protected by pneumatic boots which are inflated periodically to crack and shed the ice that has formed. Jets, with plenty of bleed air, use hot air anti-icing instead and prevent the ice from forming at all.
KlbJ090n3x11KdfZwwSr: Only RVR or visibility governs whether the final approach may be continued; the reported CEILING is not part of the operating minima for a non-precision approach. With 1800 m reported against a 1500 m requirement, the approach may be continued whatever the ceiling - and it is the MDH, together with the visual reference actually acquired, that decides whether it may be completed.
KluLUeJxEVCLTEf2eif2: After an emergency landing that requires an evacuation, the aeroplane stops where it is and everything is shut down - engines, APU, systems. It is not taxied clear: running engines and live electrics next to passengers on the ground, and possibly next to spilled fuel, are a direct hazard.
KmrmGRygqxbIzuGrT40K: The healthy young human ear responds from about 20 Hz to about 20,000 Hz, and speech occupies roughly 500 Hz to 4 kHz within that range. The upper limit falls steadily with age - presbycusis - and with noise exposure, which is why high-frequency loss shows first as difficulty understanding speech.
Kn5tElYO5pfo5G5fXMf9: During start and at low rotor speeds the LP compressor delivers more air than the HP compressor can swallow, so the LP stages and the fan stall. The bypass valve opens to spill that surplus, restoring the axial velocity through the low pressure stages until the engine has accelerated.
KoGBWLnvSzG80Hl8LD2S: 185 NM is 185 x 1852 = 342 620 m = 34 262 000 cm. Scale = 4.89 / 34 262 000, which is about 1 : 7 000 000. Always convert the earth distance into the same units as the chart measurement before dividing.
KoKwxhxaSdu3QLu7Nps6: A magnetic course of 180 falls in the 180 to 359 half of the semi-circular rule, which takes the EVEN thousands of feet: FL100, FL120, FL140 and so on. Note that 180 itself belongs to the westbound half, since the eastbound half is 000 to 179 inclusive.
KoeIwzyuN5Nqa7dsZvXm: The brain depends almost entirely on glucose, so a falling blood sugar shows first as headache, poor concentration, slowed thinking and irritability, along with shakiness, sweating and hunger. The visual complaints in the other options belong to presbyopia, to fatigue or to other conditions.
KpG7uGUcpnDGtlHkvjW1: Stability is defined by how the atmosphere responds to a displaced parcel. In a stable air mass a rising parcel cools faster than its surroundings, becomes colder and denser than them, and so decelerates and sinks back - the vertical motion weakens and dies. A lapse rate of exactly 1 C per 100 m is the dry adiabatic rate, which gives NEUTRAL stability, and a rapid decrease of temperature with height indicates instability.
KpOsfGqfqAXTnrRiIhZ7: ICAO Doc 4444 allows 10 NM DME longitudinal separation when the leading aircraft maintains 20 kt or more TAS faster than the following aircraft. A 10 kt differential is insufficient for the 10 NM minimum.
KpRFPtihOJmB5Gbz3GTx: ICAO Annex 2: an intercepted aircraft shall attempt contact on 121.5 MHz, and if unsuccessful, repeat on 243 MHz. These are the international emergency frequencies for VHF and UHF respectively.
KqMUZdH8kjE4VqK7GPA0: Both low pressure and low temperature make the aircraft lower than the altimeter indicates. A QNH below 1013 puts the 1013 datum below sea level, so a flight level sits lower than its nominal altitude, and colder-than-ISA air contracts, lowering it further. A cold low combines both errors in the dangerous direction. The mnemonic is 'from high to low, or hot to cold, look out below'.
KqRjohBBRaR3VQHx29TG: When subjected to unlawful interference (hijacking), the transponder should be set to code 7500. Code 7700 is for general emergency, and 7600 is for communication failure.
Kr8i42W0JwD8Na9tkpoA: A series of red flashes from the control tower to an aircraft in the circuit means the airport is not available for landing. This is a stronger signal than a steady red light (continue circling).
KrBZ2gMKazbGjOn5Tn6z: Role is what a person does - the set of behaviours and functions attached to the job being performed. Status is where a person stands - the hierarchical position and the recognition the group gives it. The two normally match, and it is when they do not, as when a senior captain flies as copilot, that the authority gradient is distorted.
Ks9gKPKcUkpk36hKMzY2: Where air traffic flow management applies, the flight plan must be filed at least 3 hours before the estimated off-blocks time so a slot can be calculated. The general rule elsewhere is 60 minutes, not 10; repetitive flight plans are for IFR flights only; and a flight plan is required for far more than just crossing an FIR boundary.
Ks9pUcqRKyVBGByvtI2R: A gust front is the leading edge of the cold downdraught outflow spreading away from a thunderstorm at the surface. It can run 15-20 NM ahead of the cell, so it is met in apparently clear air well before the storm itself, and it produces a sudden wind shift, a sharp increase in speed, a temperature drop and severe low-level shear - often marked by a roll cloud along its leading edge.
KsnyTmkarjlw9150fkrB: Cardiac output at rest is about 5 litres a minute - roughly 70 ml per beat at 70 beats a minute, or the whole blood volume once a minute. It can rise fivefold in hard exercise, through increases in both stroke volume and heart rate.
Ksvk8OaCW5PC20LUs7l8: At 35,000 ft the time of useful consciousness is of the order of half a minute to a minute, and a rapid decompression shortens it because gas is driven out of the lungs and the alveolar oxygen pressure collapses immediately. There is no time to work out what has happened: the mask goes on first, then the descent.
Kt3m7xz67idnrfd1Mq5X: A damaged or leaking package of dangerous goods must not travel: the commander ensures it is removed and the area made safe. Recording the damage on the notification to captain or on the shipper's declaration documents the problem without removing the hazard.
Ku6yF4bQ2fwR4bl7xMQa: Nothing else can be done by an unconscious crew, and the time of useful consciousness at cruise levels is measured in seconds. Masks on and oxygen flow confirmed therefore precedes everything - the emergency descent, the distress call and any assessment of damage all follow once the crew's own oxygen supply is secure.
KuNY1VbDdLqoYYTlRVT6: Apparent drift in azimuth is 15 x sine of the latitude degrees per hour, so at 60° it is 15 x 0.866 = 13°/hr. In the northern hemisphere the apparent rotation is clockwise as seen by the observer, so the drift appears to the right.
KvXAvslhXrXACp2H7TeL: The night cruise is the classic hypovigilance trap - low workload, low stimulation and often the low point of the body clock. Raising the cockpit lighting increases the general level of arousal and helps keep alertness up. Dimming it would improve night vision outside but deepen exactly the drowsiness that is the greater risk here.
KveM6e4g3YnNlsRkvP3V: Differential pressure is cabin pressure minus outside pressure. In level flight the outside pressure is fixed, so a rising cabin altitude means a falling cabin pressure and therefore a smaller differential - which is what a leak or an open outflow valve produces.
KveaiDNL2n1AzyQGrRqd: Mode 3 monitors barometric altitude after take-off or a go-around and announces 'DON'T SINK' if the aircraft begins to lose height while still low. It is a caution repeated until the sink is corrected; it does not escalate to the pull-up warning, which belongs to Modes 1 and 2.
KvqxpnsUeZmq3Aoy2Zc2: Pressure at any level is simply the weight of the air above it, so it must always decrease with height. The rate is not constant, however: it is about 1 hPa per 27 ft near sea level but around 1 hPa per 50 ft at 18,000 ft, because the air aloft is less dense. Diurnal and seasonal pressure variations exist but are small and not universal.
KwTg7NfPJ01RhLPVgWsl: Differential pressure is cabin pressure minus ambient. In level flight the ambient is fixed, so a rising cabin altitude means falling cabin pressure and therefore a falling differential - the signature of a leak or a failing pressurisation system.
Kwct9rllLycmmsjbzhQ9: Alignment works by sensing the earth's rotation and gravity, both of which are tiny signals, so any movement of the aircraft swamps them. Ky7bKeNdpD7VVzN7uIXy: Pressure falls steadily as an active cold front approaches, then rises sharply once it has passed. An altimeter reads height above the pressure datum set on its subscale, so falling ambient pressure makes it read HIGHER even though the aircraft has not moved. KyFHgl8azJ2Fc1GdYiDb: Take the quoted figures as signed components on the TAS: 490 - 20 = 470 kt out and 490 + 40 = 530 kt back. PET = D x H / (O + H) = 1000 x 530 / 1000 = 530 NM from A. The two groundspeeds happen to sum to 1000, so the answer equals the groundspeed home. A PET beyond the midpoint is exactly what a slow outbound leg produces.
Kz4C6pAgm4kPz26zbfIH: A LIGHT following a MEDIUM on the same runway, or on parallel runways less than 760 m apart, requires 5 NM of radar separation. The other wake radar minima are 5 NM for a MEDIUM behind a HEAVY and 6 NM for a LIGHT behind a HEAVY.
KzxO5YT9EOfb3as7KHND: An inertial reference system integrates accelerations, so it produces position (1), ground speed (3), track, drift and true heading (4), along with attitude. It cannot produce altitude, because the vertical channel is unstable without external damping - barometric altitude comes from the air data system.
L1FCyyfTqJIJTJi1Slk0: Crossing the date line WESTBOUND you gain a day, so the date increases; eastbound you lose a day and the date decreases. This is the opposite of the clock change on the same crossing, and it is the whole reason the date line exists.
L1hEu64xVgNYLQmOXOw9: 2000 ft AGL is above the friction layer, so the wind there is the gradient wind. Reversing the standard over-land friction rule - surface wind backed 30 degrees and roughly half the speed - means going up you VEER about 30 degrees and DOUBLE the speed. 190 becomes about 220 and 15 kt becomes about 30 kt, giving 22030KT. Over the sea the correction would be only about 10 degrees and a smaller speed change.
L3MHcipLh9MLr8rJi3tv: Leaning towards the chemically correct mixture removes the excess fuel that was cooling the charge, so the combustion temperature rises and with it the cylinder head temperature - which may reach its limit before the fuel flow is at its most economical. That is why leaning is done against the temperature limits.
L3rTjneHO4XWveYL3bCl: The feel unit is connected in parallel with the irreversible actuator: the actuator moves the surface and the feel unit, independently, generates a force at the control column that varies with dynamic pressure and control deflection. In series it would simply be back-driven and produce nothing.
L3uN6m3dCP8H7ubVlhiH: Latent errors are built into the system in advance - by design, procedure, training or management decisions - and lie dormant until circumstances let them combine with an active error. The gap in time between when the condition was created and when it finally causes damage is what makes them so hard to trace back and so easy to leave in place.
L45Gm9C0B6dYKigT36XH: The three cockpit types described by the authority gradient are autocratic, where the captain decides everything and the crew is unused; laissez-faire, where nobody exercises command and coordination collapses; and synergistic, where the captain decides but the crew contributes, and the result exceeds what either could produce alone.
L4ESJzLlV8cEkpo8sQT2: All three are true. Smoking is a major independent risk factor for coronary heart disease (1); the carbon monoxide it produces occupies haemoglobin and so raises the smoker's physiological altitude several thousand feet above the cabin altitude (2); and the link with lung cancer is among the best established in medicine (3).
L5SGnyLHYX6yHlU01T2p: Secondary controls change the aircraft's lift and drag characteristics rather than controlling its attitude - speed brakes (2) and the lift-augmentation devices, flaps and slats (3). The elevator and the roll spoiler both control the aircraft about an axis, so they are primary.
L6M8O4SlQjBHbv8xohWb: The rods are the photoreceptors of night vision: they contain rhodopsin, are far more sensitive to light than the cones, and give no colour and poor resolution. L7Inv1rOAfZWmxuw2ump: A LIGHT aeroplane following either a MEDIUM or a HEAVY on approach to the same runway takes 3 minutes. The 2-minute case is a MEDIUM following a HEAVY - the light aeroplane gets the longer interval because it has the least roll authority to resist a vortex.
L7ojXDBO1Y6NGETpbFg9: Two steps, in order. True heading = magnetic heading minus west variation = 060 - 8 = 052. True track = true heading plus right drift = 052 + 4 = 056. Applying the drift before the variation, or with the wrong sign, produces every one of the other options.
L89jLlzM4CneWRkHgiEC: In procedure B the aeroplane climbs at V2 + 10 to 20 kt to 1000 ft, then lowers the nose to accelerate and retract flap while maintaining a positive climb, reaching en-route climb speed by 3000 ft. L8T7ZQZo1rmnGiQLBNG6: DME (Distance Measuring Equipment) operates in the UHF band using decimetric wavelengths (around 1 GHz frequency range). This is the L-band portion of the radio spectrum.
L8Wfqox4dAdvXgYMLPgh: A wet lease supplies aircraft AND crew, and the aeroplane is operated under the AOC of the LESSOR, who keeps operational control. A dry lease is the aircraft alone, operated under the lessee's AOC.
L8ofocOWj4LGQMBRFJAR: Mode 3 monitors barometric altitude after take-off or a go-around and announces 'DON'T SINK' if the aircraft begins to lose height while still low and in a climb configuration. Excessive descent rate is Mode 1, and configuration warnings are Mode 4.
L9Ty7wwDenkSSpe8igw4: Approach control should transmit an Expected Approach Time when holding of 10 minutes or more is anticipated. During visual approaches the pilot is not maintaining own separation in all classes — ATC still provides separation in Class C.
LAFRA0809N61EtpzkMtT: Life rafts become mandatory beyond 400 NM or 120 minutes at cruising speed, whichever is the LESSER, for aeroplanes able to continue the flight with the critical power unit inoperative. Aeroplanes without that capability are limited to 100 NM or 30 minutes.
LAi2fCjsAovW5NtsfdUz: Ambition of that intensity turns the flight deck into a place to prove something. The individual competes rather than cooperates, resists correction because it reflects on him, and takes on tasks he should share - all of which damages the crew climate. It also makes failure harder to handle, since the self-image depends on succeeding.
LAxGxZkUOu25fYsTP935: Convert to true first: 355(M) with 15E variation gives 010(T). The feature is 30 degrees left of the nose, so it bears 340(T) from the aircraft, and the bearing of the AIRCRAFT FROM the feature is the reciprocal, 340 - 180 = 160.
LBNDgpe38tmnaroJQhoF: Density is mass per unit volume, so kg/m3 - ISA sea-level density is 1.225 kg/m3. Force follows from F = ma, so its unit is the newton (kg m/s2). The distractors mix mass and force units: a kilogram is a mass, not a force, and N/m3 would be a weight density rather than a mass density.
LBNi2phWNnwwwbCXBmK6: Altocumulus lenticularis is the classic standing lenticular cloud that forms at the crest of a mountain wave, where air rising in the wave cools to saturation. The cloud appears stationary while the air flows through it. Its presence means a stable layer, a strong cross-ridge wind and a standing wave train downwind, with the associated severe turbulence in the rotor zone beneath.
LBUY9E74p2Gs7kkml6m3: ISA temperature falls at 1.98 C per 1000 ft, so at FL100 it is 15 - 19.8 = about -5 C. Air 10 C warmer than standard therefore reads -5 + 10 = +5 C. This ISA-deviation calculation is the basis for both altimeter temperature corrections and true airspeed computations.
LBe6VrXpMTjF7uzB6LZ6: The descent is 35 000 - 8000 = 27 000 ft, and 85 NM at 340 kt takes exactly 15 minutes, so the minimum rate of descent is 27 000 / 15 = 1800 ft/min. Work out the time available from the groundspeed before touching the height.
LCUFYJoP5i2Ww97aQduF: The real GPS error sources are satellite clock error, ephemeris (orbital position) error and atmospheric propagation delay, plus receiver noise and multipath at the aircraft end. 'Satellite to ground time lag' is not an error at all - it is the very quantity the system measures to obtain range.
LDQ4eqFEXIVFy7ylIq0H: Acceleration error comes from the compass magnet being tilted by dip, and at the magnetic equator the dip is zero, so the magnet stays horizontal and there is no acceleration error on any heading. LDUFQS2uGWsbRvB5E6I5: Presbycusis is the gradual sensorineural hearing loss that comes with age, affecting the high frequencies first and progressing downwards. It is universal to some degree, aggravated by a lifetime of noise exposure, and shows first as difficulty understanding speech in noise. Presbyopia is the analogous age-related loss of near vision.
LDdK7Azb8OIJygndpVLu: Within MNPS airspace - above FL285 - the minimum lateral separation is 60 NM, which is also the spacing between organised tracks. That figure is only achievable because MNPS approval guarantees the navigation accuracy behind it.
LDsqcrFOr3E1yvRL1zIb: In a cabin filled with smoke the overhead lighting is invisible from a crouching position, so a second marking system is provided at floor level - lights or photoluminescent strips leading to each exit, with the exit itself distinctively marked. It supplements the overhead system rather than replacing it.
LDuwYeRP0OGvmqK69Qy5: A directional gyro suffers apparent wander because the earth turns beneath it (1) and because the aircraft moves over the earth, changing the local vertical (2); gimballing error when the aircraft is banked or pitched (3); and real wander from bearing friction and imbalance (5). North change is a magnetic compass effect, not a gyro one.
LEWECNCkcsOzU7qE818Z: The constant speed drive is a variable-ratio hydro-mechanical transmission between the engine gearbox and the generator: whatever the engine speed does, the generator turns at the fixed speed that produces 400 Hz. It cannot and does not alter the engine's speed.
LEqZg4lBu47K1oAFFd25: A right-hand arrow of conspicuous colour displayed in the signal area indicates that turns in the aerodrome circuit are to be made to the right, both before landing and after take-off.
LF275sDzFqsYUCyRKQfz: H marks the highest wake turbulence category in the ICAO scheme used on the flight plan: LIGHT at 7000 kg or less, MEDIUM between 7000 kg and 136 000 kg, and HEAVY at 136 000 kg or more of maximum certificated TAKE-OFF mass. Watch the numbers and the mass type in the other options, both of which are altered.
LFCBM6ppTbRw1AzUT7fz: In a reversible system the connection between the surface and the cockpit control works both ways, so the aerodynamic loads on the surface are felt naturally at the control column. Artificial feel is only needed when an irreversible power unit takes those loads and leaves the pilot with nothing.
LFpFUgpfUeEK6SZIEbP0: The switch stops the magneto by earthing its primary circuit, so the contact breaker can no longer interrupt the current and no high voltage is generated. That is why a broken earth lead leaves the magneto live whatever the switch position, and why a propeller is always treated as live.
LG6d3Qw08wYaSe9f2hkx: A synergetic cockpit keeps command intact while using the whole crew: the captain decides, but the crew have prepared and contributed to the decision (1), and leadership flexes with the situation, moving between directive and permissive as circumstances require (4). Minimal delegation and minimal communication are marks of the autocratic cockpit instead.
LHIpxlZy98VIdjzGGT95: Both are wrong. A divergent duct slows the flow and converts velocity into static pressure, so the speed decreases rather than increases. And total pressure cannot rise in a duct that does no work on the air - it stays constant apart from small friction losses.
LHJ0v2U33Ha070WEbGEx: Two limits must both be satisfied. The running-metre limit is the mass divided by the crate's length, and the area limit is the mass divided by its base area. Only the 400 kg crate of 1.2 by 1.2 m passes both: 400/1.2 = 333 kg/m against the 350 limit, and 400/1.44 = 278 kg/m2 against the 300 limit.
LHPRjiGkaIxJ7uUoExxH: Advection fog forms when relatively warm, moist air is carried horizontally over a colder surface and is cooled from below to its dewpoint. Unlike radiation fog it needs a wind - 10 kt is ideal, since some turbulence is required to deepen the fog - it forms over the sea, and it persists day and night.
LHPVckrna7w4IHuvDNCc: The two adaptations are wildly asymmetric. Adapting to bright light is almost immediate - the pupil constricts and the cones take over within about ten seconds - whereas regenerating the rhodopsin needed for full dark adaptation takes around 30 minutes. That asymmetry is why one careless flash of white light costs half an hour of night vision.
LHv0pa0kLiCluo1GIMSq: A fail-operational system has enough redundancy to complete the landing automatically after a single failure (3), but with that failure absorbed the remaining capability is only fail-passive (1) - a second failure will produce a clean disconnect and the landing will then have to be flown manually.
LIHy4fX4EujiI1J7WTf6: Isochrone construction alternates air positions and ground positions: from a point K on the air isochrone you apply the wind vector for that interval - the mean wind acting from the preceding ground isochrone - to reach K' on the ground isochrone. Repeating this interval by interval builds the minimum time track.
LIuy09Lg2kuvZZrTLhVP: A directional gyro must hold its axis fixed in space while the aircraft manoeuvres around it, which requires two degrees of freedom. LIyt7ZXSh009W6ykvLHK: Cruise cabin humidity is around 10-20%, so fluid is lost steadily and concentration suffers before thirst is felt. The remedy is regular, sufficient still water or soft drinks: carbonated drinks release gas that expands as cabin pressure falls, and coffee and tea are diuretics that work against the intention.
LJ5hzkGkLEx6oQGHofBB: A microburst is a column of descending air that strikes the surface and spreads out radially, so at low level the wind DIVERGES from the centre. The impact of that descending air also produces a small local pressure rise of a few hectopascals - the mesohigh beneath the downdraught.
LJM41IZhgLZow9sqhTAu: Coaction is the mode in which crew members work side by side on their own tasks but towards a single shared objective. It is distinct from full cooperation, where the actions themselves are interdependent and must be continuously coordinated, and from parallel work towards separate individual goals, which is not teamwork at all.
LK1QTaKxG4wpu1OT9aKz: Chart convergency on a Lambert is dlong x n, where n is the constant of the cone, a single fixed number for the whole sheet. So it is CONSTANT with latitude. LKInrHbfepVVWBQxIrMf: With EPR held constant the thrust still falls as altitude increases, because the air is thinner and the mass flow smaller (1). And because EPR measures what the engine is actually producing rather than how fast it is turning, the same EPR gives the same thrust as the engine deteriorates with age (3) - which is why it is preferred as a thrust-setting parameter.
LL8zZu3P6AeaiBHwS7xm: Convert to true first: with 15E variation the true track is 225 and the true heading 230, so there is 5 degrees of port drift. Groundspeed is 64 NM in 12 minutes = 320 kt. LLc3SxNRELpVy0GI9LrL: A fusible plug in the wheel melts at a set temperature and lets the tyre deflate in a controlled way, so an overheated brake cannot burst the tyre and throw debris. It does nothing to stop the brakes overheating - it simply removes the consequence.
LLf7WAkZcOWPWfnH5y4i: Climbing at a constant IAS, the temperature falls so the speed of sound falls, while the TAS for a given IAS rises steadily as density drops. Both effects push the Mach number up, so it climbs continuously through the climb and MMO is the limit that will be reached. This is why climb schedules are flown at constant IAS to a crossover altitude and then at constant Mach.
LMJ2I6qBIp15C2buXIf4: Filters, relief valves, bypass valves and fire shut-off valves are all there to protect the system and the aircraft from the consequences of a failure. Pumps are usually engine-driven, a return line leak still empties the reservoir, and the reservoir is pressurised by air rather than through a nitrogen-charged membrane.
LMolw3pwLIbQjTMhW8Wv: Full dark adaptation takes about 25-30 minutes as the rods regenerate their rhodopsin, with the largest part of the gain in the first 20. LNJsz0BQSymlJCzCfuBh: ICAO Annex 1: a CPL(A) applicant needs 200 hours flight time or 150 hours if completed during an approved integrated course. The integrated course credit reduces the total requirement.
LNk0kDFJ7ARXYy57jDlg: The descent is 33 000 - 10 000 = 23 000 ft, and 65 NM at 330 kt takes 65/330 x 60 = about 11.8 minutes, so the rate of descent needed is 23 000 / 11.8 = about 1950 ft/min.
LNoPFuVVY4KVVbLVibG8: The event button writes a marker into the data stream so that an investigator can find the moment of interest immediately instead of searching hours of recording. It does not stop, rewind or alter the recording, which continues normally throughout.
LO0xR8OMQiFM7aqfu7HS: Maximum gliding distance requires the shallowest glide angle, which occurs at (L/D)max - and total drag is at its minimum exactly where induced drag and parasite drag are EQUAL. LO2hHr34j0OLeumEaIKi: As the core temperature falls the victim becomes apathetic and content, then drowsy - and in that state stops doing anything about his situation. The danger is precisely that hypothermia feels tolerable while it is disabling: there is no distress to prompt action, and the person quietly stops helping himself before losing consciousness.
LONyz7DiJttQligTAhMH: CAT is generated by wind shear, and shear is greatest where the jet is sharply curved - around a deep trough - because the flow must change speed and direction rapidly. LOrKxQuyOVY9PrVt6jPn: By definition a downburst counts as a microburst when its damaging outflow spans no more than 4 km; anything larger is a macroburst. LPSNN74TH5dgOePNUJb1: Data link traffic can be carried over VHF where the aircraft is within line of sight of a ground station, over HF in remote and polar regions, and by satellite almost anywhere. The communications management unit selects between them automatically according to coverage and cost.
LPn4h63vKHUdoSskapgy: In cold weather the true altitude is lower than the indicated altitude, so published approach minima and step-down altitudes must be increased. The FMS temperature compensation function applies that correction to the vertical profile automatically, using the reported aerodrome temperature.
LQ2XBqCZZXXnV9Hw3gD9: Where maintenance is carried out to an approved programme by an approved organisation, the certificate of airworthiness carries a three-year validity, renewed on evidence of continued compliance. The renewal checks that the maintenance system is still being followed rather than re-certifying the aeroplane.
LQSjuX6fYjvRFdZdgDTE: An aircraft in the traffic pattern indicating difficulties that compel landing without requiring immediate assistance does so by repeatedly switching landing lights on and off.
LQtw9ofEf5z5zpheniwN: The autothrottle holds a speed the crew has selected, and in the cruise that speed is expressed either as an indicated airspeed or as a Mach number, depending on the level. True airspeed is not a value the autothrottle can hold, because nothing in the loop measures it directly.
LSkJ6AXW7UjqEQ8ukuB8: The logon tells the ATC centre who the aircraft is and what data link capability it has - CPDLC, ADS, or both - so that the centre knows what services it can offer. Nothing operational can be exchanged until that connection has been established and accepted.
LSsCtmbqNPMgd2sPa7XU: Statement I is wrong: a lower pressure altitude means denser air, greater mass flow and therefore MORE thrust available, not less. LTEzZe3gXRA7uvmqqYRv: Body parts have natural frequencies in the range of roughly 1 to 100 Hz - the abdomen around 4-8 Hz, the head and eyeballs somewhat higher - and vibration at those frequencies drives them into resonance, producing discomfort, blurred vision, difficulty reading instruments and fatigue. Frequencies well above this band are perceived as sound rather than as vibration.
LU3fybb7tZBdm3RqMjEA: NDBs work in the LF and MF bands, roughly 190 to 1750 kHz, which corresponds to kilometric and hectometric wavelengths. Those long waves follow the surface as a ground wave, giving the ADF range beyond line of sight - and also its night effect and vulnerability to thunderstorms.
LUL1TjdhtQV5HEM52Pwd: The five recognised hazardous attitudes are anti-authority, impulsivity, invulnerability, macho and resignation, each with its own antidote. Domination is a leadership style rather than one of the five, and while an overbearing captain is a CRM problem, it is not a member of this particular set.
LUYLXXfRckQKJr3bHy1w: A frequency wild generator is driven directly by the engine with no constant speed drive, so its output frequency rises and falls with engine speed. That is acceptable for loads that do not care about frequency - resistive heating, and rectified supplies - which is exactly what such systems feed.
LUibqVbnuc0r6Skt5QVZ: A package of dangerous goods that appears damaged must be removed, and the commander ensures arrangements are made for that. Documenting the damage while carrying the package anyway leaves the hazard aboard.
LUn5W9oakWdph9cp3KNR: A hydraulic fluid must flow readily through long, narrow lines and small orifices, so a low viscosity is wanted to keep pumping losses and response times down. The compromise is that it must still be viscous enough to seal and lubricate, and its viscosity must not change too much with temperature.
LUt0jaJM1PSe416YlWtC: For an aeroplane with three or more engines the take-off alternate must be within two hours at the one-engine-inoperative cruising speed in still air; a twin is limited to one hour on the same basis. The speed is always the engine-out speed, because that is the condition in which the aeroplane would go there.
LUuIJR1VqfENw7fsBaMw: On an aeroplane certificated for single-pilot operation, VFR public transport may be flown by one pilot up to the duration limit, beyond which a second pilot is required - the limiting factor is fatigue and workload over a long sector rather than the aeroplane itself. LVjU7WpGat8pHVVO9Rkg: A fixed-pitch propeller is optimised for one combination of airspeed and rpm and its efficiency falls away sharply either side of it. A constant-speed unit varies blade angle to hold the selected rpm, so the blades stay near their best angle of attack throughout climb, cruise and descent. Its PEAK efficiency is no higher than a fixed-pitch prop's - it simply maintains near-peak efficiency across a far wider range.
LW5ndXahwD6Eb45eAybS: The respiratory centre monitors carbon dioxide, sensed through the pH it produces: a rise drives breathing up, a fall shuts it down. Oxygen is only a weak backup stimulus at low levels, which is why hypoxia produces no air hunger and gives no warning, and why hyperventilation continues until the CO2 has fallen far enough to cause symptoms.
LWa9BqNsAwyxgF7DgNks: Breathing 100% oxygen keeps alveolar oxygen pressure adequate up to about 38-40,000 ft. Above that, ambient pressure is simply too low, and oxygen must be delivered under positive pressure - pressure breathing - to force enough into the lungs. Below that altitude 100% oxygen at ambient pressure is sufficient.
LWaKlD2t75HfJUUDAdyc: ICAO Doc 4444 specifies a minimum radar separation of 3.0 NM between aircraft on the same localizer course. For adjacent parallel localizer courses, different minima apply.
LWqk4EF2wPXJs7fd84bb: All four matter. Wind sets the groundspeed and hence the trip fuel, forecast weather drives the choice of alternate and the alternate fuel, and any foreseeable airborne delay or landing delay has to be carried as additional fuel. Fuel planning is a forecast exercise, not just an arithmetic one.
LXUm7Em29OwvlTXIRIq8: Contour heights on upper-air charts are given in DECAMETRES (tens of metres), so 552 means the 500 hPa surface lies 5520 m above mean sea level at every point on that line. Higher values indicate a warmer, deeper air column beneath; lower values indicate colder air. The label is a height, not a pressure - the pressure is 500 hPa everywhere on the chart.
LXtLqST5zIOjowefsZwg: The first casualty of alcohol is judgement, and specifically the normal caution that stops a pilot doing something rash - the effect appears at concentrations far below those producing obvious impairment, and the pilot does not notice it. Nothing accelerates elimination, which proceeds at about 15 mg/100 ml per hour; oxygen and coffee produce an alert drunk, not a sober one.
LYDhIXaK6QcHBPLtlokv: The LIGHT wake turbulence category covers a maximum certificated take-off mass of 7000 kg or less. MEDIUM runs from there to 136 000 kg and HEAVY is 136 000 kg or more. The 5700 kg figure belongs to a different classification, the light aeroplane definition, and is the trap here.
LYMU5Twu9OoXqUbZsljh: In an unpressurised aeroplane the cabin altitude is the flight altitude, so above 13,000 ft every occupant must be supplied with oxygen for the whole time spent there. Between 10,000 and 13,000 ft only a proportion of the passengers need be supplied, and then only for the time in excess of 30 minutes.
LYUEahcIoG5HDag5LR0I: A smoke mask must seal against smoke as well as supply oxygen, so it covers the whole face, protecting the eyes as well as the airway, and delivers oxygen on demand rather than continuously. A continuous flow through a full-face mask would exhaust the supply far too quickly.
LZ7skFpNhiDsmjWZhwR0: Tropopause height follows the depth and warmth of the troposphere beneath it, so travelling from the equator to the pole the tropopause DESCENDS, from about 16-18 km to about 8 km. LZKssNsjWmupX4ogoxFV: Speed is distance per unit time, so integrating speed with respect to time gives the distance covered. Adding that distance to the starting position gives the present position, which is the next step - the integration itself yields distance travelled.
LZyQO5uPhdXeIpF3buv3: Metabolism is the whole set of chemical processes by which cells release energy from food and use it to build and maintain tissue. LaAT02awwgE8926vMPAx: CO2 displaces oxygen and leaves no conductive residue, so it can be used across all five: paper, fabric and wood (class A), hydrocarbons (class B) and live electrical equipment. Its weakness is that it does not cool, so a deep-seated class A fire can re-ignite; its absolute exclusion is burning metal.
LaKeTBfEK4XnglSGmDfs: A tailpipe fire during start is unburnt fuel alight in the jet pipe, outside the fire detection and extinguishing zones, so the bottles would deliver agent to the wrong place. Abort the start and motor the engine dry - starter on, fuel and ignition off - so the airflow carries the burning fuel out of the tailpipe.
LakOdMNrlbFejjYlEKY2: One knot is about 101 ft per minute along the path, so 300 kt is about 30 400 ft/min. A 6 percent gradient loses 6 ft per 100 ft flown, so the rate of descent is 0.06 x 30 400 = about 1800 ft/min. The short form: rate of descent = groundspeed x gradient percent x 1.01.
LdLcbFsF0mkGiV3IKQaj: Selective Availability was a deliberate degradation applied by the US Department of Defense: the satellite clock data and ephemeris broadcast on the civil C/A code were dithered so that civil position accuracy fell to about 100 m. All the satellites remained available; only the accuracy was manipulated. SA was switched off in May 2000.
LdjLFbh72U4zw9XPWSx8: The take-off alternate limit scales with the number of engines: one hour for a twin, two hours for an aeroplane with three or more engines - in both cases at the ONE-ENGINE-INOPERATIVE cruising speed in still air, because an engine failure is the reason for going there.
Le3IQeOT6z0qY4aHqiqJ: Those symptoms in a stressful approach are the classic hyperventilation picture, and the cause is over-breathing driven by anxiety. The remedy is to take conscious control of the rate and depth of breathing and slow it deliberately, which lets the carbon dioxide level recover. Oxygen addresses the wrong gas, and the Valsalva manoeuvre is for the ears.
Le6LKcsIagQXsJQ4mtCZ: Endurance is time aloft, so it is fuel on board divided by fuel flow. LeZ37VHOaqltKdDpxV2r: About 90% of bird strikes happen below 500 m (roughly 1500 ft), which is why take-off, initial climb, approach and landing carry nearly all the risk and why bird control concentrates on the aerodrome and its surroundings.
Lf5Ih2tvB5q65lWFjqdC: Acceleration integrated once gives velocity and twice gives distance, so the double integration of the east/west accelerometer output is distance east/west. Lf6BANSzIcpwulHoTi0r: The directive force that aligns a compass is the HORIZONTAL component of the earth's field, and it falls as magnetic latitude increases, reaching zero at the magnetic poles. Lfm7hkVW2m9OUgOHvcGl: In non-RVSM airspace above FL 290, an aircraft subjected to unlawful interference that cannot communicate with ATS should fly at a level differing from normal IFR cruising levels by 500 ft below FL 290 or 1000 ft above FL 290.
LfyQJYZ8ky2o9cH64Snk: The flight data recorder must retain at least the last 25 hours of operation. The cockpit voice recorder is the one measured in minutes or a couple of hours - 30 minutes for aeroplanes certificated before 1 April 1998, two hours after.
LhNuRuYoTpRXxEz0W8ir: Maximum zero fuel mass is the greatest mass the aeroplane may have with no usable fuel aboard - everything else included: structure, crew, equipment and the whole traffic load. It exists because fuel in the wings relieves wing root bending, so the wing is most heavily loaded when the tanks are empty.
LibZtxSBed6tZojUChSl: Evacuation procedures are operator procedures and live in the Operations Manual, where crew duties, commands and cabin drills are set out. The Flight Manual is an aircraft document carrying limitations and performance, not operator cabin procedures.
LieFdoSQihekTnatt7re: Ice is made from local water and is not sterilised by freezing, so it carries exactly the contamination that avoiding the water was meant to avoid. The general rule is boil it, cook it, peel it or forget it - cooked food is safe, and it is the uncooked and the unpeeled that are not.
LisK0svobclUg9jRBThk: Note the stem says TRUE altitude, not pressure altitude. At -32C the air is about ISA-29, so a true altitude of 9000 ft sits at a pressure altitude of roughly 10 200 ft. LjRfvgmyVrS3EJCUu66B: Oxygen is carried for emergencies: to keep everyone conscious after a loss of cabin pressure (1), and to protect the crew from smoke or toxic fumes (the fourth statement). It is not used in normal operation to supply the cabin, which is fed with ordinary air by the packs.
Lk4eML8Xi3kAiiuiaPaW: Turbulence and gusts produce transient losses of indicated airspeed and transient increases in load factor, both of which erode the margin above the stall. Adding an increment to VREF - typically half the steady headwind plus the full gust factor, up to a defined maximum - restores that margin. The cost is a longer landing distance, which is why the increment is capped.
LkDtV7axChDVbFvuXlB2: 49 NM is 49 x 1852 = 90 748 m = 9 074 800 cm. Scale = 7 / 9 074 800, which is about 1 : 1 300 000. Converting the earth distance to centimetres before dividing is what keeps the powers of ten straight.
Lkr3YQ0OwFYQoMRbzfmU: The flow accelerates most where the aerofoil is thickest and the curvature greatest, which on a swept wing is the upper surface near the WING ROOT. That is therefore where the local flow first reaches M1.0 and the first shock wave forms - by definition, at the critical Mach number. As Mach increases further the shock strengthens and moves aft and outboard.
LlgnyOI1v7fZHzmyotLX: Night vision depends on rhodopsin in the rods, which is bleached by light and takes up to 30 minutes to regenerate fully. Once adapted the eye is extremely sensitive - it detects lightning and brief light sources readily, which is the problem, since a single bright flash destroys the adaptation and the 30 minutes must be served again.
Llm3nOH7CDw196VASdKO: Two tasks can be combined only when at least one of them runs automatically and needs almost no attention. For a trained pilot, holding straight and level by hand is skill-based and largely automatic, so a problem can be worked on at the same time. The other pairings each demand conscious processing twice over and interfere directly.
Lm221jgOYbIwhZVBxdBy: Longitudinal separation over the North Atlantic is maintained by the Mach number technique, so turbo-jets are cleared and flown at an assigned MACH number and any change must be coordinated with ATC. Holding the assigned Mach keeps the time interval between aircraft constant without radar.
Lm9nKGURpEO2EYgC5zly: Use the 1-in-60 rule twice. Track error = 3 NM in the 30 NM run = 6 degrees. Closing angle = 3 NM in the 90 NM remaining = 2 degrees. Turning by the track error alone only parallels the intended track, so the alteration to reach B is 6 + 2 = 8 degrees right.
Lmgp0pIAV1Dz0YvKyV0s: The semicircular canals respond only to angular acceleration - the fluid lags when rotation starts or stops and deflects the cupula. At a constant rate of turn the fluid catches up and the sensation fades, which is why a sustained turn comes to feel like straight flight and why rolling out then feels like a turn in the opposite direction.
Ln7TLuTEUvQcF8xPCFFi: Envelope protection keeps the aircraft within its own aerodynamic and structural limits, so what it needs to know is how the aircraft is flying: angle of attack (3) and bank angle (4), along with speed and load factor. GPWS and ACAS deal with external hazards and feed nothing into the protection laws.
Ln9HKBlmDuOj2csLzypR: Once aligned, the computer must keep the platform level and pointing north as the earth turns and the aircraft moves over it. It does that by sending torquing signals - rate corrections - to the gyros, so the platform is continuously precessed at exactly the right rate. The accelerometer outputs travel in the opposite direction, from platform to computer.
LnUHBY4jDMqlCmJLK3sB: Hydroplaning speed is about 9 times the square root of the tyre pressure in psi. 10.8 bar is roughly 157 psi, and 9 x 12.5 gives about 112 kt, so the risk begins around 113 kt.
Lo700m22G68g1qGbh0Ud: Distance covered is 445 x 3 = 1335 km = 1335 / 1.852 = 721 NM, which at 60 NM per degree is 12 degrees of latitude. Starting at 10N and tracking south, 12 degrees takes the aircraft across the equator to 02S.
LoLkPeyYqs5EMLY7uKC8: Antihistamines act on the central nervous system as well as on the allergic response, and the aviation objection to them is sedation: drowsiness, dizziness, slowed reactions and blurred vision. They do not cause hypoglycaemia, hyperventilation or flatulence, so only the first statement applies.
Lq58CDH4U81j6MaPgXsB: After a communications failure the aeroplane continues in accordance with the LAST oceanic clearance received and acknowledged, so ATC can predict where it will be and protect that airspace. Reverting to a filed route the controller has already superseded puts the aeroplane where nobody is looking for it.
LqBFkowoQxgw3QMrImXP: A worn pump has increased internal clearances, so more of the oil it moves leaks back past the gears instead of being delivered, and the pressure it can generate falls. A restriction downstream would raise the pressure at the gauge, not lower it.
LqGqKD4i7GTHLK3UMGPC: At -30C the local speed of sound is 38.94 x root(243) = about 607 kt, so M0.83 is 504 kt, and with zero wind that is also the groundspeed. 360 NM takes 42.9 minutes; five minutes more is 47.9 minutes, needing 451 kt, which is 451 / 607 = M0.74. The local speed of sound does not change, so only the Mach number moves.
LqhWqjBjDN3jx9JkZcfo: Homeostasis is the maintenance of a stable internal environment - temperature, blood glucose, pH, fluid balance - in the face of changing external conditions, through continuous automatic regulation. Stress can be understood as the state that arises when the demands on those regulating systems approach or exceed their capacity.
LrJqWIlvHVaJFIHbB4Vr: A check valve, or non-return valve, allows flow in one direction and blocks it in the other - exactly what a diode does with current. They are used to prevent a failed component or a depressurised branch from draining the rest of the system backwards.
LrVblqi8kHf0KFkhk3qa: ICAO Annex 1: medical exam deferment for non-commercial crew is a single period of six months. Two consecutive periods or periods longer than six months are not permitted.
LrfenUExUp2PSVPGwjgf: The high-range radio altimeter used for cruise levels works at a few hundred megahertz, giving wavelengths of the order of a metre or less - decimetric. The low-range altimeter used for approach and flare works around 4.3 GHz, in the centimetric band, for the precision the flare requires.
Lrzd7WaKeAbyBJbgjoYC: The wind from 359 is almost exactly behind the 180 heading, so it is a near pure tailwind: the track stays at about 180 and the groundspeed rises from 198 to about 223 kt. Any option showing a groundspeed at or below the TAS can be discarded at once.
LsUJWBn4F0HjT7qr9Hw4: The QNH is identical at both ends, so there is no pressure change to explain the drift. A constant flight level follows a constant-pressure surface, and that surface rises over warmer air because warm air is less dense and expands. A steadily increasing true altitude at a fixed flight level therefore means the air is progressively warmer along the route. Nothing is wrong and no action is needed.
LsUOXiQKS7etHlDAaKwp: A cold pool, or cut-off low, is a detached mass of cold air in the middle and upper troposphere. Being cold and dense it depresses the pressure surfaces above it, so it shows clearly as a closed low centre on an upper chart such as the 500 hPa, while at the surface the pressure pattern may be almost featureless. Cold aloft over warmer air below means a steep lapse rate, hence instability, showers and thunderstorms.
LscytmO2QeLvfEtuvR3J: JAR-FCL instructor categories: FI(A), TRI(A), CRI(A), IRI(A) ratings, plus SFI and MCCI authorisations. Examiners (FE, TRE, CRE, IRE) are separate categories.
LvCCQtM1bKEfSTSLHuUv: The extra fuel does not burn; it absorbs heat as it vaporises and leaves with the exhaust, so the charge and the cylinder head run cooler. That matters in the climb, where power is high and the cooling airflow is poor, which is why full rich is used even though it wastes fuel.
LvHAV1u3xHsaihfwjvyA: In a steady climb the excess of thrust over drag lifts the weight up the slope, so sin(gamma) = (T - D)/W, and for small angles the sine is close to the tangent - which is the gradient. Expressed as a percentage: gradient = ((T - D)/W) x 100. Note that LIFT does not appear: in a climb it merely balances the component of weight perpendicular to the flight path.
Lw0KbhLXs7rn2clUUhIU: Endurance for a PSR uses only the fuel you may actually burn: 15 000 - 3500 = 11 500 kg at 2150 kg/h = 5.35 hours. Groundspeed out is 425 - 30 = 395 kt and home is 430 + 20 = 450 kt. Time to the PSR = E x H / (O + H) = 5.35 x 450 / 845 = about 2 h 51 min.
LwGAiZPFaDuig2mCI47i: Cabotage refers to domestic air services — commercial air transport between two points within the same country. Under the Chicago Convention, cabotage rights are reserved to national carriers.
Lwob9b4qTx0ZY9UXhBUp: Variation is a property of the EARTH's field at a place, so it is the same whatever the aircraft is doing or what compass is fitted, but it changes slowly year by year as the magnetic poles wander. Dependence on heading is deviation, not variation.
LxIdDW2EvtLE12AAWMMu: Convert to true first: 355(M) with 15E variation gives 010(T). The island is 30 degrees right of the nose, so it bears 040(T) from the aircraft, and the bearing of the AIRCRAFT FROM the island is the reciprocal, 040 + 180 = 220.
LxjW7lydd0inyzdiLQNG: Mach number is true airspeed divided by the local speed of sound, and the speed of sound depends only on temperature. Indicated and calibrated airspeeds measure dynamic pressure and cannot be compared with a speed of sound directly.
LyE1krU59GTxa1gglbT4: Recent experience is three take-offs and three landings within the preceding 90 days, on the type or in an approved simulator of the type. Both halves matter: the count is three, not six, and the window is 90 days, not six months.
LydfTe21c598veXWIPe5: Motivation raises the level of arousal, and arousal is what determines alertness and the readiness to act. Because performance follows the inverted-U, the relationship is useful up to a point: motivation lifts a bored crew member out of underload, but very high motivation can push arousal past the optimum and narrow attention.
Lzr5xCHzhlnWJ0nIPMFW: The balanced V1 is where the accelerate-stop and accelerate-go distances are equal, and that crossing point is the MINIMUM field length that satisfies both cases. So even when the take-off is limited by climb performance rather than by runway length, choosing the balanced V1 leaves the largest possible margin between the field length required and the runway available.
M0595gXZP7nKaPq0dAD3: Vertical wind shear is the change of the HORIZONTAL wind - in speed, direction or both - with height. It is what produces clear air turbulence at jet stream level and the low-level shear encountered on approach beneath an inversion or a thunderstorm outflow. A change of the horizontal wind with horizontal distance is horizontal shear, a different quantity.
M07NpMrsCpuYDuzdy6iY: Excessive noise destroys the hair cells on the basilar membrane inside the cochlea, and those cells do not regenerate. The resulting sensorineural loss is permanent, painless and cumulative, typically notched around 4 kHz, which is why hearing protection is mandatory around aircraft. The eardrum and ossicles are damaged by pressure or blast rather than by sustained noise.
M0BmVLZeN68BSg6Y35g4: Both are correct. Irreversible powered controls are held rigid by their own actuators, which are hydraulically locked, so the wind cannot move them and no gust lock is needed. Manually operated controls can be slammed against their stops by a gust on the ground, so they must be locked.
M0KkxDqUaojV5PLHUHYz: With the centre passing to the SOUTH, the observer is on the northern side of an anticlockwise circulation throughout. Take the three stages: with the low approaching to the south-west the wind is south-easterly; as the centre passes due south it becomes easterly; and as the low departs to the south-east it becomes north-easterly. SE to E to NE is an anticlockwise change of direction, i.e. continuously backing. Had the centre passed to the north, the wind would have veered.
M0cmseplFs1seCBRReQR: A machmeter is fed from the pitot and static system, so it inherits the position error of the static source: the pressure sensed is not quite free-stream static, and the indicated Mach number is in error accordingly. It has no subscale to set, and being a ratio of pressures it is not affected by temperature or density directly.
M0i95dEQwwgw4ASoKU9I: The descent is 35 000 - 11 000 = 24 000 ft, and 100 NM at 335 kt takes 100/335 x 60 = about 17.9 minutes, so the minimum rate of descent is 24 000 / 17.9 = about 1340 ft/min.
M1IvVD6sCQ4Y0u5KmpCD: Use the standard lapse rate of about 2 C per 1000 ft. The air is 2 C below zero, so the 0 C level lies 2 / 2 = 1000 ft BELOW the aircraft: FL120 - 1000 ft = FL110. M1Kv8hYM9YGyLFeR4zDy: The wake turbulence category filed in the flight plan is M (Medium) for a maximum certificated take-off mass of 7000 kg or more but less than 136 000 kg. H is 136 000 kg or more, L is 7000 kg or less, and S is not a wake category at all.
M2kmlOjpYqO2lJ9gdEM6: PSR = E x O x H / (O + H) = 9 x 435 x 385 / 820 = about 1838 NM. The 1760 NM to R plays no part, and note the PSR here lies BEYOND R, which is perfectly possible: the endurance simply allows the aircraft to go past R and still return to Q.
M347FIncjvxSNs6En5vA: A thick, blunt aerofoil deflects the airflow well ahead of itself, and small droplets have little inertia so they follow the streamlines around it. A thin, sharp profile disturbs the flow much less, so the droplets carry straight on and strike the surface: its catch efficiency is higher. This is why thin high-speed wings, tailplanes and antennae ice up faster than a thick wing in the same cloud.
M3g6voUPyhw715o4kGO2: Anything that reduces the circulation's ability to keep blood at head level lowers G tolerance: a low blood sugar leaves the brain with no reserve, obesity and poor fitness impair cardiovascular response, and hypoxia means the blood that does arrive carries too little oxygen. M4SE02rb8zg8fvieJTdQ: Convergency over the leg is dlong x sin latitude = 20.5 x sin60 = about 17.8 degrees, so the track changes by about 8.9 degrees from A to the mid-meridian. M4kd4BAtsXmDeT6zUIXj: Crosswind = wind speed x sine of the angle between wind and runway. The angle is 280 - 230 = 50 degrees, so the crosswind is 40 x sin50 = 40 x 0.766 = about 31 kt. Both values are true, so no variation is involved.
M6xtr2Pzz2iheBTAF0TE: In the northern hemisphere Coriolis deflects moving air to the right, which makes the circulation around a low anticlockwise; friction in the boundary layer then turns the surface wind across the isobars toward the centre. M9bSo29mPIeWdgPr48y1: Automatic trim runs the stabiliser so that the elevator is left streamlined and the autopilot's servo is unloaded. The consequence is that at disconnect the pilot takes over an aeroplane which is in trim, with no residual force on the control column and no sudden pitch change.
M9c5hwpNcKTf3MYNuGD6: In the PAPI system, 2 red nearest + 2 white farthest = on or close to the correct approach slope. All red = below slope, all white = above slope, 3 red + 1 white = slightly below.
MA2E7jfVC2tTibRuuB6b: A control zone (CTR) extends upwards from the surface to a specified upper limit. A control area (CTA) extends from a specified lower limit above the earth, not from the surface.
MAE6JXZhVlWKHd01pCLt: As keyed, the loss of radio updating is annunciated to the crew, and the practical consequence is what matters: the FMC position then rests on the IRS alone and begins to drift at roughly 2 NM per hour, so navigation accuracy must be cross-checked by other means. MAI375oFeH8tQySZ40JQ: Carbon monoxide and altitude attack the same thing - the amount of oxygen delivered to the tissues - so their effects compound. A carboxyhaemoglobin level that produces only mild symptoms at sea level becomes seriously disabling at altitude, where the haemoglobin that remains available is already carrying less oxygen.
MAZMCnynT6mtw24onJ20: With the pitot blocked the total pressure is trapped while the static pressure rises in the descent, so the difference between them shrinks and the indication falls - the airspeed indicator under-reads. The danger is that the aeroplane may be accelerating while the instrument shows it slowing.
MAto3lOnd419MqqrNN0c: An inverter converts DC into AC, which is what a DC-primary aeroplane needs to run AC instruments, and what any aeroplane needs to feed essential AC loads from the battery when generation is lost. A transformer rectifier does the opposite.
MAxSni7UyjfIAVswzSF5: With manifold pressure and RPM held constant, the charge entering the cylinder is denser at altitude because the induction air is colder, so a slightly greater mass of air is trapped for the same pressure. That, together with the reduced exhaust back pressure, is why power creeps up by about 1% per 1,000 ft.
MAyocnaSpyOhrXL2YQLt: The navigation display presents the horizontal situation: the active flight plan, with weather radar returns, terrain from the EGPWS database and TCAS traffic overlaid on the same map. MCZrWdzqjmXys9Tss0qz: The receiver is blanked while the transmitter is radiating, so PULSE LENGTH sets the minimum measurable range. Timebase length only affects what is displayed, not what can be measured.
MChElv7GKrbhb7BS7h3k: Conversion angle is 270 - 266.2 = 3.8 degrees, so convergency is twice that, 7.6 degrees. MDZuGqRdHBxEtTGnZvjP: An inertial reference system integrates accelerations, so it produces attitude (1), position (3), ground speed, track and heading. It cannot produce barometric altitude, because the vertical channel is unstable without external damping, and it has no temperature sensor at all.
MDaUDgusQjeNwzFx4FDY: Speaking and listening draw on the same limited attentional pool as flying and monitoring, so communication competes directly with the task in hand. That is the rationale for the sterile cockpit below 10,000 ft, and it is why message length, clarity and precision all deteriorate exactly when workload is highest.
MEAnXfMY2FGe2gYtS34B: The Eustachian tube, running from the middle ear to the nasopharynx, is the only path by which middle-ear pressure can follow the ambient.
