UOS0DLXUsCNwdx1y13eo: Final reserve fuel for an aeroplane with RECIPROCATING engines is 45 minutes at holding speed. The 30 minute figure, at 1500 ft above aerodrome elevation, applies to turbine aeroplanes. Keeping the two straight is the whole point of the question.
UOlj7zHicosqv8w3GcGb: The yaw damper works through a series actuator, so it moves the rudder without moving the pedals and the crew would otherwise have no idea what it was doing. The indicator displays that rudder movement, which is how a runaway or a failed damper is recognised.
UPM8T8ktFjv818s4sGZk: Bleed air is taken from a compressor stage chosen so that the pressure is adequate without wasting more work than necessary, with a changeover between stages as engine power varies. Taking it from a later stage costs more performance, so the higher stage is used only when the lower one cannot deliver enough.
UPMS19vOlXId16L2wbRf: The bends are joint pain - shoulders, elbows and knees - produced by nitrogen bubbles forming in and around the joint as the ambient pressure falls. It is the commonest form of altitude decompression sickness. The chokes are chest pain and cough, and neurological involvement is the separate and more serious form.
UPobQ1RWaTUQkoty5lys: ICAO Annex 14: two parallel runways are designated L and R (left and right) when viewed from the approach direction. Three parallels use L, C (centre), and R.
UPzYdqaJ1kYcTK6uOWCI: Filters, pressure relief valves, bypasses and the fire shut-off valve are all there to protect the system and the aircraft from the consequences of a failure. Pumps are usually engine-driven, the reservoir is pressurised with air rather than serving as a pressure reserve, and regulation applies to the whole system.
UQ0h0yLQkhOXCqo69Eht: The night-time (eastbound) organised track structure is valid at 30W from about 0100 to 0800 UTC, and the day-time westbound structure from about 1130 to 1900 UTC. The two windows follow the traffic peaks in each direction.
UQNEPB2xTBzUGYkGCJJs: The FMS provides lateral and vertical guidance for non-precision approaches - RNAV, and overlays of VOR, NDB and VOR/DME procedures - using its own position solution. Precision approaches require a ground-based beam and a dedicated receiver, which is a different system entirely.
URAOdlfnDs4DkzjytAH9: A significant weather chart is a fixed-time forecast: it shows the significant weather expected AT the validity time printed on the chart, not averaged over a window and not an observation. Charts are issued for standard times (typically 0000, 0600, 1200 and 1800 UTC) and depict fronts, CB and thunderstorm areas, moderate or severe turbulence and icing, jet cores, tropopause heights and the freezing level.
URLHICnLGdXspKDJZ6Zk: An accumulator is a gas-charged vessel connected to the pressure line: the gas is compressed as fluid enters, so the accumulator holds a quantity of fluid under pressure. That stored energy smooths pressure surges and provides a reserve for emergency braking.
US4MYYczqfxCsogQU1Xt: First-aid oxygen is sized on 2% of the passengers but never fewer than one, so eight passengers requires one. The supply covers the remainder of the flight after a decompression in which the cabin altitude exceeded 8000 ft - the point at which some passengers will need treatment even after the descent.
US5f1y4ds4Pt7HOOyrMK: Convergence on a polar stereographic chart is the full change of longitude between the position and the grid datum meridian - 166 degrees between 140E and 054W. Applied to a true course of 330 degrees this gives a grid heading of 330 + 166 = 496, that is 136 degrees.
USXVf7glbkfrEDXVVwTy: An inertial reference system integrates accelerations, so it produces position (1), true heading (4), attitude, ground speed, track and drift. Total pressure and air temperature are air data quantities, measured by probes the IRS does not have.
UTTCNw7go0GgWJC9lN5L: Raw fuel sprayed into the cylinders is a solvent: it washes the oil film off the cylinder walls, so the first turns of the engine run metal on metal and score the bores. That is the mechanical damage that makes over-priming expensive as well as a fire risk.
UUqGED2u8E0I5Q9vhcRb: Take the shear, not the surface wind. Departing runway 27 you climb from a 5 kt headwind into a 30 kt tailwind - a 35 kt loss of airspeed at 300 ft, the classic decreasing-performance shear. Departing runway 09 accepts a 5 kt tailwind on the ground and then climbs into a 30 kt headwind, so performance IMPROVES through the inversion. Accepting the small tailwind is by far the safer trade.
UV74vkM4f1JJiljxFRg3: The FMS computes the aircraft position from its navigation sensors (1), holds and manages the lateral flight plan (3), and predicts and monitors fuel (4). Traffic alerting belongs to TCAS, an entirely separate system with its own antennas and processor.
UV8YsV6hjnAyDLmzOH8H: Negative habit transfer is the reappearance of a well-learned action from a previous type in a new aircraft where it is now wrong - the fuel lever moved to the position that used to mean ON. It is favoured by stress, distraction and relaxed attention. Confusing left with right is an action slip, and missing a checklist item is a lapse.
UV8Za2kugxHYqOzdkhTi: Mach number is a ratio of the aircraft's real speed through the air to the speed at which pressure disturbances travel in that air, so it is TAS divided by the local speed of sound. Both terms fall with temperature, which is why Mach number rises in the climb at constant TAS.
UVDecLCibhuZvwk8fUWb: Transport aeroplanes use multiple disc brakes: a stack of alternate rotors keyed to the wheel and stators keyed to the axle, squeezed together by hydraulic pistons. Stacking discs gives an enormous friction area and heat sink in the small space inside the wheel.
UWF01tNZITVgBXnlPuCe: Both points are on the 70S parallel with 90 degrees of longitude between them, so the vertex is at the mid-longitude 015E where the eastbound track is 090. A is 45 degrees west of that, and convergency of 45 x sin70 is about 42 degrees; eastbound in the SOUTHERN hemisphere the track decreases along the route, so at A it is about 090 + 42 = 132.
UWMh5Ff4KQc7nTJZDjXc: A sudden and obvious collapse is at least recognised immediately, and the other pilot takes over. The insidious case - the pilot still apparently functioning while judgement, attention or accuracy quietly degrade from hypoxia, illness or a subtle stroke - is far more dangerous, because nobody realises the aircraft has effectively become single-crewed with an unreliable second opinion.
UXYKIxvEf61ZqdUwoie4: Airborne weather radar detects precipitation-sized particles by the energy they reflect, and reflectivity rises very steeply with droplet size and with the liquid state - so it maps zones of rain and wet hail and their intensity, colour-coded by returned power. It does NOT see cloud droplets, dry snow, dry hail or clear air turbulence, which is why radar-quiet does not mean hazard-free.
UZJPDwCZaZqEpBpMVY6W: For a modern aeroplane the flight data recorder is required above a maximum certificated take-off mass of 5700 kg. The 27 000 kg figure belongs to the older rule that applied to turbine aeroplanes certificated before 1 April 1998.
UZmykmcNeUZf7lAPhTiz: The dry operating mass is the empty mass plus the operational items, 44 800 + 2 300 = 47 100 kg. The traffic load is what is left up to the zero fuel limit: 65 500 - 47 100 = 18 400 kg. The crew mass is already inside the operational items and must not be subtracted twice.
UZxby9WbAW9BJvHNwWem: The vertical channel of an inertial system is unstable: an error in indicated altitude produces an error in the computed gravity correction which drives the altitude further out, so the divergence grows exponentially. This is why the vertical channel is always damped with barometric altitude.
UaAzjeAjh2VraCu1lnvY: Windscreens are heated electrically by a transparent conducting film laminated into the glass, controlled to hold the panel at a set temperature. The heat also keeps the interlayer warm and pliable, which is what gives the screen its bird-strike resistance.
UaenEsaMwmxgwBhuaNOv: Warming air raises its saturation capacity steeply while the amount of vapour actually present is unchanged, so the ratio - the relative humidity - falls. This is why the afternoon is normally the driest part of the day in relative terms, and why heating an aircraft cabin makes it feel dry. Cooling does the reverse, raising relative humidity to 100% at the dewpoint.
Ub4FMYq9I1aVqAU4YqUp: A small red band inside the green arc marks a speed range in which the engine, propeller or airframe suffers a resonant vibration. Transit through it is permitted but continuous operation is not, because the fatigue damage accumulates rapidly.
Ub8OVprDZfggPg3fVzak: Cardiac output at rest is about 5 litres a minute - roughly 70 ml per beat at about 70 beats a minute, which circulates the whole blood volume once a minute. Hard exercise can raise it about fivefold through increases in both stroke volume and heart rate.
UbVkCBuZaVin0dzW74nz: Composition is constant but pressure is not. By Dalton's Law each gas exerts a partial pressure equal to its fraction of the total, so 21% of a falling total pressure is a falling oxygen partial pressure. At 30,000 ft the total is about a third of sea level, so the oxygen partial pressure is about a third of its sea-level value - which is why hypoxia occurs while the percentage is unchanged.
UcEVzHBAQrOAxnHzN3hs: ICAO was established by the Chicago Convention of 1944. The Convention on International Civil Aviation was signed in Chicago on December 7, 1944.
UcJzPXwqaYFUOMp287Z7: In a full automatic landing the automatics fly the approach, the flare and the touchdown and then the rollout mode steers the aeroplane along the centreline with rudder and nosewheel, in some installations until the aircraft is stopped. Disconnecting at decision height or at the flare would be an autocoupled approach, not an autoland.
Ucm2rwIzJZIQ6f07P5Wk: The service ceiling is where the rate of climb has fallen to 100 ft/min, and rate of climb depends on excess POWER divided by weight. A lighter aeroplane needs less lift, produces less induced drag and therefore has more excess power available - so it can maintain 100 ft/min to a GREATER altitude. Reducing mass always raises both the service and the absolute ceiling.
UdraN7Jehi4FzbiGJXY3: ICAO Annex 8: the State of Design must ensure a continuing structural integrity programme, including corrosion prevention, for aeroplanes over 5,700 kg maximum certificated take-off mass.
UeUV4QcB67iaiI2lUrwA: A DR position is built by applying the FORECAST wind to heading, TAS and time, so if the actual wind differs from the forecast the aircraft ends up somewhere other than the DR position. That difference is exactly what a fix reveals, and why the wind is then revised for the rest of the leg.
UeznZkiNa9oA54dE1mp7: Both statements are correct. In ground effect the surface suppresses the tip vortices, so downwash is reduced, the effective angle of attack is greater and CL is higher while induced drag is much lower. LEAVING ground effect removes those benefits: at the same geometric angle of attack the lift coefficient falls and the induced drag coefficient rises - which is why an aeroplane that got airborne prematurely in ground effect may sink back as it climbs out of it.
UfG91jvG6KJVcpKgp9nX: A selector valve routes pressure to one side of an actuator and connects the other side to return, so it decides in which direction, and whether, the jack moves. Relieving excess pressure is the relief valve's job and supply selection is done elsewhere.
UgBluCkHHHb10WkuNa0H: A gust changes the angle of attack, and the lift change that follows is proportional to the wing's LIFT CURVE SLOPE. Sweeping the wing reduces that slope, because only the flow component perpendicular to the quarter-chord line does the aerodynamic work - so the same gust produces a smaller lift change and a lower load factor. This gust alleviation is a useful secondary benefit of sweep.
UgDDy80qAHnMFUtCC9RH: First-aid or therapeutic oxygen is carried for a passenger who is taken ill in flight, or who needs oxygen after a decompression once the emergency supply has run out. It is delivered at a therapeutic rate for a comparatively long time, unlike the emergency drop-out masks.
UgbIAOC87f4ZnyPq12Uh: Pressing force trim release disconnects or unloads the feel and centring springs, so the controls become free and the pilot's input is not fought by the spring. Releasing the button re-datums the springs at the new position, which is how the trim is set.
UgdK35bviyattPz2ffxt: A current-carrying conductor in a magnetic field experiences a force at right angles to both, given by Fleming's left-hand rule and the product of flux density, current and length. It is the principle of every electric motor and of moving-coil instruments.
Uh66LoZA5R3uiMLN0qQr: Where the situation offers no tolerance for error - a single wrong entry or selection will have consequences - the defence is systematic cross-monitoring: one crew member independently checks what the other has done, every time, as a matter of procedure rather than of suspicion. Applied consistently it catches the error before it takes effect, which is what error tolerance is unable to do here.
Uh81wYvd1LgLrwMgQOv7: Two things forbid this boarding. The certificate allows eight occupants including the pilot, and one crew member plus six adults plus two children makes nine. And children of 5 and 6 are not infants: each needs their own seat and their own restraint, so sharing a seat and a belt is not permissible in any case.
UhkDqqrWTzm0W2rwexvo: In a steady descent the weight resolves into a component perpendicular to the flight path, balanced by lift, and a component along it. Lift therefore equals W cos(gamma), which is always LESS than the weight - equivalently, weight is greater than lift. At a 1000 ft/min descent at 160 kt the angle is only about 3.5 degrees, so the difference is small, but the relationship holds in any descent.
Uj7YThKTjwPwPhjJ1mEQ: A fixed-pitch propeller has one blade angle, so it can only be optimised for a single flight condition - and one designed for cruise achieves its best blade angle of attack, and hence its best efficiency, in stabilised cruising flight. Away from that point efficiency falls off: at low forward speed with the same rpm the helix angle flattens and the blade angle of attack RISES, so it is higher during the ground run, not lower.
Uk6wOGoYJjvUUBCNpnYj: A decreasing headwind is a decreasing-performance shear: airspeed falls, lift falls with it and the aeroplane descends BELOW the climb-out path. Both halves move together, so a combination pairing 'above the path' with 'decreasing airspeed' can be discarded immediately.
UkMArMC4mLgvzGdBAoek: In a sustained spin the fluid in the semicircular canals catches up and the sensation of rotation fades. On recovery the fluid overshoots and signals rotation the other way, so the pilot feels he has entered a spin in the opposite direction and 'corrects' by re-applying the original spin input - which is why the spin is never recovered and the name is what it is.
UkNnYpVTu8wME1BFehdq: Cigarette smoke contains carbon monoxide, which occupies haemoglobin that would otherwise carry oxygen, so a smoker's effective or physiological altitude is several thousand feet above the cabin altitude before he ever leaves the ground. CO binds around 200-250 times more readily than oxygen, not five times, and it certainly has physiological effects in the presence of oxygen.
UkrOEFS8eWNMTzCEcS5p: With earth rate compensated, the gyro holds its direction in space and an autopilot coupled to it flies the shortest path across the surface - a great circle. Following a rhumb line instead would require the heading reference to rotate with the local meridian all the way along the route.
UkuyGrDWRzN6BnZjV4zs: The severity classification runs minor, major, hazardous, catastrophic. A catastrophic failure condition is one which would prevent continued safe flight and landing, with multiple fatalities and, for the flight crew, fatalities or incapacitation. Excessive workload and physical distress define the hazardous level below it.
Ul2GtXHR038beD3hbgz2: An inverter turns DC into AC. It is the only way of running AC instruments and equipment from a DC-primary system, or of feeding essential AC loads from the battery after a total generation failure. A transformer rectifier does the reverse.
UnTAUnvpnjKFA5a68WIe: Optimum altitude - where specific range is greatest - rises continuously as fuel burns off, because a lighter aeroplane reaches its optimum lift coefficient in thinner air. Since ATC assigns discrete flight levels rather than allowing a continuous cruise climb, the aeroplane climbs in steps to stay as close to that rising optimum as possible. It is a fuel-economy technique, and it applies squarely to jets.
UnfbNNaYQzbUycIajFZk: Octane rating measures resistance to detonation, and detonation is provoked by high pressure and temperature at the end of the compression stroke. A fuel with a higher rating therefore permits a higher compression ratio - which is why high-performance engines specify high-grade fuel and are damaged by anything lower.
Ung19E8mcWDOZTmkTxAW: In a servo tab system the pilot's controls drive only the tab, and the main surface is free to float on its hinge. On the ground with little or no airflow there is nothing to position it, so the surface hangs wherever gravity and any local wind leave it - and a tailwind can blow it hard against its stops. This is why such aircraft have gust locks and why control checks must be done with care.
UnsELlZDVyLu3G5dQb1L: The 35 ft is a genuine vertical clearance: the minimum distance between the LOWEST part of the aeroplane and every obstacle within the obstacle accountability area, measured against the NET flight path (the gross gradient reduced by a mandatory margin). It is not a height at which any configuration or thrust change occurs - those are defined separately by the segment structure.
UnuuvihqnUi2FVrch7gR: Weight = 50,000 kg x 10 = 500,000 N, and total thrust = 2 x 60,000 = 120,000 N. In a climb the lift is close to the weight, so drag = W/(L/D) = 500,000/12 = 41,667 N. Then gradient = (T - D)/W = (120,000 - 41,667)/500,000 = 0.157, i.e. 15.7%. Note the two traps: use BOTH engines' thrust, and derive drag from the L/D ratio rather than guessing it.
UoAg5XoX6Xy851O7klGh: Contamination adds displacement drag as the wheels plough through the slush or wet snow, plus spray impingement drag on the airframe, both of which slow the acceleration and LENGTHEN the take-off distance. It also degrades braking should the take-off be rejected. This is why contaminated-runway take-off performance is separately certified and why reduced thrust is prohibited.
UoMEjTK05tYE5yDh7WZd: In a level turn the lift must support the weight and provide the turning force, so L = W / cos(bank). At 45 degrees, cos 45 = 0.707, giving L = 50,000 / 0.707 = about 70,700 N - a load factor of 1.41. Useful reference points: 30 degrees gives n = 1.15, 45 degrees n = 1.41 and 60 degrees n = 2.0.
UoSmp56Ji8U5laaEpNSP: The computer works from the flight plan the crew has entered (1), from the air data computer for altitude, speed and temperature (2), from its own computed position (3) and from the navigation database (5). It carries no terrain database - that belongs to the enhanced GPWS.
UogzzdVqNa35rLgBxFlG: Smoke rises and fills the cabin from the ceiling down, so overhead lighting is obscured just when it is needed. Floor proximity marking gives a visual guide at knee height or below, leading to the exits and identifying them, when the overhead lighting can no longer be seen.
UookqwE9bkUnu210FcwQ: A series-wound motor has its field in series with the armature, so the field strength rises with the current and the machine produces very high torque at zero and low speed. That is exactly what is needed to break a cold engine away, and its tendency to overspeed when unloaded is unimportant here.
UpSwH2pLDCbCXQD6FktT: Circling visibility is 1500 m for Category A, 1600 m for B, 2400 m for C and 3600 m for D. A Category D aeroplane - VAT 141 to 165 kt - therefore needs at least 3600 m.
Upk0RhldAiScL7g9J4xs: The terrain picture is drawn by comparing the stored terrain database with the aircraft's computed position, so any position error displaces the whole picture. The terrain shown will then not match what is really around the aeroplane, which is why EGPWS accuracy depends on the quality of the navigation solution.
Uq9XxbEh2y00aNg4QAtp: The autothrottle holds a Mach number (2) or an indicated airspeed (3) in the speed modes, and a fixed thrust in the N1 or EPR modes (4). It cannot hold a true airspeed, because TAS is not directly sensed and is not a quantity the aeroplane is flown to.
UqabDOgTk5Xbv8VdFdEx: More flap means a higher CLmax, so the approach and touchdown speeds are lower and less energy has to be dissipated - the landing distance shortens. But more flap also means far more drag, so if a go-around becomes necessary the climb gradient available is significantly worse. That is precisely the trade a full-flap landing makes: runway length gained, go-around performance given up.
Uqq5kuqEEHKi5gDmzDuC: In a constant Mach climb the true airspeed follows the falling speed of sound while the air density falls faster still, so the dynamic pressure - and with it the calibrated airspeed - decreases. The reverse happens in a constant Mach descent, which is why the climb is flown on CAS first and Mach above the changeover.
Ur2yMejwIZ4pRqz9JR8L: An input peripheral passes data into the computer, and a keyboard does nothing else. A screen is an output device; disk and diskette drives are storage devices which both read and write, so they are neither purely input nor purely output.
UrTLd4CnHpYnumIAnfaD: A diesel injects fuel directly into the cylinder, so there is no venturi and no fuel vaporising in the induction air - the two things that cause carburettor icing. With that mechanism absent, intake heating is needed only for airframe icing conditions.
UrjYnP9gaINVrouyThN0: The eye scans in a series of short jerks called saccades, with brief fixations between them - vision is effectively suppressed during the jerk itself, so an object is only actually seen during a pause. The continuous, stable picture we experience is constructed from those samples in the visual cortex, which is why effective lookout means deliberate pauses rather than a smooth sweep.
UrwvLUQLTsKtH4ueP8qg: ATC separation methods are: vertical separation, horizontal separation (lateral and longitudinal), and composite separation (combining reduced vertical with reduced horizontal).
UsF9kj1WodlTNkMjb1JP: On a Direct Mercator the meridians are forced parallel and the parallels spread towards the poles, so a great circle, which bows towards the nearer pole on the earth, plots as a curve CONCAVE to the equator. The exceptions are the equator itself and the meridians, which are great circles drawn straight.
UsWpgfwsUlJeOuRALm9X: A persistent loss of excitation means the machine can no longer support its share of the load, so the protection removes it completely: it trips the exciter control relay to kill the field, opens the generator breaker to take it off its own bus, and opens the tie breaker so the healthy generator is not dragged down through the tie.
UsfIXHZeU62X334lCemd: Longitudinal separation over the North Atlantic is maintained by the Mach number technique, so aircraft are cleared and flown at an assigned MACH number and any change must be coordinated. Holding the assigned Mach keeps the time interval between aircraft constant without radar.
UsfqXenBAIDEMzI5GKZ5: Decode it group by group: 0400 is the meteorological visibility of 400 m; R16/1000N is the RVR for runway 16, 1000 m with no distinct change; FZFG is freezing fog; VV003 is a vertical visibility of 300 FEET (cloud heights are always in feet); and M02/M02 gives a temperature and dewpoint of -2 C each. Note R14/P1500 means the RVR exceeds 1500 m, so quoting it as exactly 1500 would be wrong.
UsjqnCFq6YkzYAc28UzO: Work outwards in order. Magnetic heading = compass heading plus deviation = 252 - 3W = 249. True heading = magnetic heading plus east variation = 249 + 22 = 271. True track = true heading plus right drift = 271 + 9 = 280.
Ut5NXu9DGfbwdegMhvpm: Differential pressure is the difference between the pressure inside the cabin and the ambient pressure outside at the aircraft's actual altitude. It is what the structure has to carry, so it is limited by a maximum differential relief valve - typically around 8 to 9 psi.
UtB79UZP3zEzAo1Wf6iR: Moving the entire stabiliser provides far greater trim authority than a small tab on the elevator - essential on a large transport, which must be trimmed across an enormous range of speed, weight, CG and configuration. It also leaves the full elevator travel available for manoeuvring rather than spending part of it on trim. The costs are complexity and weight, and it does not change the aeroplane's stability.
UtOPuRrc7cnbDWpOgR6p: All four must be demonstrated: no fire hazard from the system or its operation, the fuel discharging clear of every part of the aeroplane, no fumes entering the aeroplane, and no adverse effect on controllability. Jettison puts a large quantity of fuel into the airflow right beside the airframe, so each of those is a genuine failure mode.
UunmEcE6Vyg4licyRVtD: In a FADEC installation the thrust levers drive resolvers or potentiometers whose output goes to the electronic engine control as an electrical signal, with no cables, rods or hydromechanical link to the engine. The signal is sent to both channels of the FADEC, not one, so that a channel failure does not lose it.
UvQfGSZb5PFDJFD1ymqd: Air taken from the compressor is air that never reaches the turbine, so the pressure at the exhaust falls and the engine pressure ratio with it. To hold the same thrust the fuel control adds fuel, and with less air to cool the turbine the exhaust gas temperature rises - which is why bleeds are a real performance and life penalty.
UwBxsQdsRUnQNsloZJtU: The wind from 310 is on the port quarter of the 075 heading, so it pushes the aircraft right and adds a little speed. Resolving the vectors gives a track of about 084 and a groundspeed of about 108 kt, i.e. about 9 degrees of starboard drift.
UwVQOaFOqRelyy28JYqS: Alcohol needs no digestion: it is absorbed directly through the stomach and intestinal walls into the bloodstream, which is why it acts so quickly. Food slows absorption but does not reduce the total amount absorbed, the JAA limit is 20 mg per 100 ml, and alcohol suppresses REM sleep in particular, which is why sleep after drinking is unrefreshing.
Ux2CaT9l3JJrviJAtiYP: A gas turbine is controlled by fuel flow alone: more fuel raises the turbine gas temperature, the rotor accelerates and both airflow and pressure ratio rise with it. The bleed valves and variable vanes only keep the compressor working at the right match point as this happens.
UxPNfLnlWISUGB7oRckB: Position error arises because the pressure at the static port is not exactly free-stream static, and how far it departs depends on the flow field round the fuselage - which is governed by Mach number, and changes sharply near the transonic range. Corrections are therefore tabulated against Mach.
Uxy0JN6CTpeYVLIjbedz: The planned track runs down the 073W meridian, and the aircraft is at 073 10 W, i.e. 10 minutes of longitude off it. Ten minutes of longitude at 62N is 10 x cos62 = about 4.7 NM. The aircraft is tracking SOUTH and lies to the west of the meridian, so the track is off to its left and the displacement is 4.7 NM RIGHT of track.
Uy54niApORzBxbUwWZiN: JAR-OPS 1.465 forbids commencing a special VFR flight when the visibility is below 3 km, and requires it to be discontinued below 1.5 km. Note also that the VFR visibility requirement at and above 10 000 ft is 8 km, not 5 km - which is what makes the class E option wrong.
UyjvGn5CyQu6XqEtulCK: Behaviour is what can be observed - the outward result of a stable personality interacting with learned attitudes and the situation of the moment. Because attitudes and situations can change, behaviour is adaptable, which is exactly why CRM training targets behaviour and attitudes rather than personality, which is not.
UylAxgfXvscAbRGNsHlo: Turning right from 330 to 040 passes through NORTH, and in the northern hemisphere a turn through north makes the compass UNDER-indicate the turn. Liquid swirl drags the card round in the same direction as the turn, which reduces its movement relative to the lubber line and makes the under-indication worse. Through south the compass over-indicates and swirl reduces the error.
UzrX3QqCHTo9CMFGNQvO: Typhoons are the north-west Pacific's tropical revolving storms, and the season runs broadly July to November with a peak around August-September, when the sea surface temperature is highest after a full summer of heating. Southern Japan lies on the recurvature track, where storms turn north and then north-east into the mid-latitude westerlies.
UzwHahCz8qMQaM9VNNmP: ICAO Annex 1: IR applicants need 50 hours cross-country as PIC in aeroplanes or helicopters, of which 10 hours in aeroplanes.
V13TUWGtil4shfY3K4uG: The Rescue Coordination Centre (RCC) promotes efficient SAR organisation within each SAR region.
V1MHtPEAIhmzk9m1v9n8: A visual approach is performed when part or all of the instrument approach is not completed and the approach is executed with visual reference to terrain.
V1qBuT9dX2dBLvgZY3w8: Time = distance / groundspeed = 480 / 95 = 5.05 hours. The decimal 0.05 of an hour is about 3 minutes, so 5 HR 03 MIN. All four options are within 10 minutes of each other, so the decimal conversion has to be done properly.
V1xbLmjRKUJbJk6UtzeJ: Note that this row is corrupted in the source data - the text of two later questions has been parsed into the last option - so the option list reads oddly. The substance: Halon 1211 (BCF) interrupts the combustion chain reaction rather than cooling or smothering, so it covers all five cases here - paper, fabric and wood (class A), hydrocarbons (class B) and live electrical equipment, being non-conductive.
V39iTQVCvS0NSAbOMVfU: Take-off fuel is 650 - 50 = 600 kg. The zero fuel limit allows 5 200 - 3 000 = 2 200 kg of payload, but the take-off limit allows only 5 200 - 3 000 - 600 = 1 600 kg. The lower of the two governs, so the payload available is 1 600 kg.
V483A0GLb31cHmK2o8Y4: TCAS interrogates the transponders of other aircraft and works entirely on their replies - it is not a radar and has no ground input. An aircraft with no transponder, or with it switched off, is completely invisible to it.
V4QTHiIeNGFZVo8isC4c: For a turbojet the landing distance required must not exceed 60% of the landing distance available on a dry runway: 0.60 x 2400 = 1440 m. A turboprop would be allowed 70%, and a further 15% is applied to the required distance if the runway is expected to be wet.
V4enAtKTazn1RukO4J56: One crash axe or crowbar is required on the flight deck of every aeroplane. Above 200 approved passenger seats a second is required in the aftmost galley area, so an aeroplane with 201 seats carries two.

VDlJtjAO9CaSjOUxy6NZ: Dry air is 78.10% nitrogen, 20.95% oxygen, 0.92% argon and the other rare gases, and 0.03% carbon dioxide - so nitrogen matches D, oxygen C, carbon dioxide A and the rare gases B. VF6QJzmr9jfJ8VJDGyOa: A turbulent boundary layer continuously mixes fast free-stream air down toward the surface, so the velocity climbs very steeply in the first fraction of a millimetre before levelling off. VFtZrn9uSWqd968haMkt: Intake pressure is an absolute pressure and is sensed by an evacuated aneroid capsule which expands or contracts with it, its movement being converted to an electrical signal for the EPR computation. A Bourdon tube is for high pressures such as hydraulic and oil.
VG0mvJBQrKNDXBjsTSIq: An increasing headwind is an increasing-performance shear: airspeed rises, lift rises with it and the aeroplane goes ABOVE the intended path. VHN5DcBbAXvszo7bxhAh: Commercial aviation loses roughly fifty aircraft a year worldwide in accidents, a figure that has stayed broadly stable while traffic has grown, so the rate per flight has fallen. VHXUvsc8SA8VXyDeiAnM: Radial acceleration in flight acts along the vertical body axis. VHx6SW9cRMX5XQbslyDz: Cumulonimbus capillatus is the mature form of a thunderstorm cell: the top has glaciated into ice crystals and lost its sharp cauliflower outline, taking on a fibrous, striated, hair-like appearance, usually spread into the classic anvil (incus). VIe7EC4C73WRs8x8brMj: At FL410 the aeroplane sits on the boundary between the two separation regimes: climbing enters the 2000 ft regime, so climb 1000 ft to sit midway, while descending stays in the 1000 ft RVSM regime, so descend 500 ft. VJdk6KhKmNjCC2ZcWiD2: A static inverter takes DC in and delivers AC out, doing electronically what a rotary inverter used to do with a motor and an alternator on one shaft. It is what allows the battery to feed essential AC loads.

VO6FPuLph1bcKjM3dU9l: The buffet onset boundary chart plots the LOW-SPEED and HIGH-SPEED (Mach) buffet boundaries against weight, altitude and load factor - so it shows the Mach range within which the aeroplane can be flown buffet-free, and how that range narrows with height. VPWKrl6Wij6rJhBVyanA: A stereotype substitutes an assumption about a category for observation of the individual, so the person in front of us is judged by what we expect of his nationality, rank, age or type rather than by what he actually does - and the assumption survives contact, because contrary evidence is explained away. VPcbLyxgEkZC3X27YjWj: An active cold front undercuts unstable warm air on a steep slope of about 1:50, forcing rapid ascent. VQHqYC2t4RhGI9PGbGuK: Aircraft systems work at high pressure - typically 3 000 psi and above - because that keeps jacks and pipes small and light, and they must also deliver a large flow, because surfaces, gear and brakes have to move quickly. Pressure alone would give powerful but slow operation.

VRDmOkt1AVDorTezm9Tz: As the aeroplane climbs the falling air density would reduce the mass of air the cylinders receive and with it the power. The turbocharger compresses the induction air back to sea level pressure, so full power is maintained up to the critical altitude.

VRUTW0a5I0YbxVkpYpi0: Hyperventilation is ventilation of the lungs in excess of metabolic need - breathing too fast or too deeply for the amount of carbon dioxide the body is producing. VW5hbq5mWC82XlDrOUq6: The crossfeed manifold links every tank to every engine, so any engine can be fed from any tank. It is what allows a lateral imbalance to be corrected, or the fuel of a shut-down engine to be used by the others.

VcB1k6DHXUkSNYIxYATf: The approach is flown at a target speed, so the autothrottle works in SPEED mode, opening and closing the throttles to hold the selected IAS while the autopilot flies the beam. A fixed thrust mode could not hold the speed as the drag changes with configuration.

Vd54lSk4cSVSIjRjfewt: An aeroplane in flight is supported by the air rather than pivoted anywhere, so any unbalanced moment rotates it about its CENTRE OF GRAVITY - the point through which its mass is effectively concentrated. VepsMukNrZqH1by571ya: D-ATIS is simply the ATIS delivered by datalink and printed or displayed in the cockpit, rather than listened to on a VHF frequency. It removes transcription errors and frees the crew from copying the broadcast while flying.

Vf9BwcvppMfRh5IEpJxN: Drag depends on the dynamic pressure and the drag coefficient, and IAS is itself a direct measure of dynamic pressure. VhIWxzAMfTb1V0NREeaX: A hot wheel vents its energy along the AXLE line - a fuse plug releasing or a tyre bursting throws material sideways - so fireguards and ground crew approach only from the front or the rear. The parking brake is also released, with chocks in place, so the discs can cool.

VhnW1nE1kNidPhDT9SvD: A forward CG lengthens the moment arm between the CG and the tailplane, so the tailplane's own moment about the CG is larger - but the wing's restoring moment is larger still, and the aeroplane is correspondingly more stable and more reluctant to change attitude. ViAFofdElu3OI38S260B: Disorientation is favoured by the absence of a reliable visual reference or by conflict between references: flying in IMC removes the visual cue (1), repeatedly transferring between outside and instrument references sets up conflicting inputs (2), and a cold can block one ear so that it equalises unevenly, producing alternobaric vertigo (4). Vkbx0mb2I5TCPLwYFldw: Anti-icing fluid is designed to shear off progressively during the take-off roll, and the requirement is that the aerodynamic surfaces are clean of it by ROTATION - the moment the wing has to work at a high angle of attack. VlVgkxRvlu68Q6mTeNGM: Hypoxia starves the brain and the retina first, so the picture is visual disturbance, loss of concentration and euphoria with impaired judgement, followed by headache, cyanosis and unconsciousness. The bends and barotitis are pressure effects, and hypothermia is unrelated.

Vnt3MEJxkr9g63GTAjvT: The CDU produces two levels of message: ALERTING, which needs action and lights the master caution or the CDU annunciator, and ADVISORY, which is information only. Alerting takes priority, so the order is alerting then advisory.

VqIbHFqhWVCvURDqnmIm: High stress narrows the attentional field onto one or two salient items - attentional tunnelling - so everything outside that narrow band is simply not processed. Vqj4oQ6JoEFQiVGpAjEw: The recorder captures everything the crew could hear or say: radio transmissions and receptions, the aural environment and voices on the flight deck, interphone conversations, and the navigation and approach aid identifiers fed to headsets or speakers. All four are required, on separate channels.
VrNcvzYSPSSsf5hiXeSq: Breathing beyond metabolic need washes carbon dioxide out of the blood, and since dissolved CO2 forms carbonic acid, losing it raises the pH - the blood becomes more alkaline, a respiratory alkalosis. The acid-base balance certainly does change, and cerebral blood pressure and flow fall rather than rise, because CO2 is a cerebral vasodilator.
VrmTQ70lDnrp3Ats80vP: Optimum altitude is by definition the altitude at which specific air range is greatest for the current mass, so the economical plan keeps the aeroplane at or about it. As fuel burns off the mass falls and the optimum rises, which is why the plan is a series of step climbs following that rising optimum rather than one level held for the whole cruise.
VsXkJeVgrwUoD7jQuSxC: Altocumulus lenticularis is the standing lens-shaped cloud that forms at the crest of a mountain wave, where the rising air cools to saturation; it appears stationary while the air flows through it. Its presence confirms a stable layer, a strong cross-ridge wind and a standing wave train downwind, with severe turbulence in the rotor zone beneath the wave crests.
VsnL3CZcAoUxOTDMctEj: An IFR flight may be planned without a destination alternate only if the required conditions are forecast from 1 hour BEFORE to 1 hour AFTER the estimated time of arrival. The window is symmetrical, which is what makes the asymmetric options wrong.
VtAowZ101sjhyah19uEK: QFE is QNH reduced by the pressure equivalent of the aerodrome elevation. Using the stated 1 hPa = 8 m, 200 m corresponds to 200 / 8 = 25 hPa. QFE = 1015 - 25 = 990 hPa. The 8 m per hPa figure is the metric equivalent of the familiar 27 ft per hPa, and like it applies only near sea level.
VtaaGvmmH6LwRtoToinh: The number of dispensing units and outlets must exceed the number of SEATS by at least 10%. It is calculated on seats rather than on booked passengers, and the surplus covers cabin crew moving about and anyone away from their own seat when the masks drop.
VtsEWD7RmMzjJb4fofpl: Carboxyhaemoglobin is cleared slowly - hours of half-life breathing air, and days for full recovery from a significant exposure - so an affected crew member cannot simply return to duty when the symptoms ease. The body gives no distinctive early warning, breathing is not stimulated because the CO2 level is normal, and the vague headache and nausea produced are not euphoria.
Vu1O4emvkEPEL2YDd4Lq: A standard operating procedure works only if both pilots hold the same version of it, because its whole value is that each can predict and monitor what the other will do. It must therefore be shared and kept current as it changes. Tailoring it to individual preference destroys exactly the predictability that makes monitoring possible.
VuXutnMk7Y1jAU0BY1bV: Work from track to compass in order. True heading = true track minus right drift = 352 - 10 = 342. Magnetic heading = true heading plus west variation = 342 + 11 = 353. Compass heading = magnetic heading minus deviation = 353 - (-5) = 358.
VuZZpuUmcc4ZNvOzVjhC: A static inverter is fed with DC and delivers AC, using solid-state switching instead of the motor-alternator set it replaced. It is what allows the battery to supply essential AC loads such as the standby instruments after a generation failure.
VvF33cUj54m4j4hkckeJ: The second, striped or barber-pole needle is driven by the machmeter mechanism and shows the maximum operating speed, moving down the dial as altitude increases and the Mach limit becomes the governing one. VNE is a fixed red radial line on light aircraft instruments, not a moving pointer.
Vvkr9h0Pn8llJZlxs2Cq: Electrical heating is used where the area is small and the power demand modest - pitot heads, static ports, angle of attack vanes, drain masts and windscreens. Large surfaces such as wing and fin leading edges need far more energy than the generators could supply, so they use hot air or boots.
Vx8KxZVgTmGMvVBd5Fdv: A tubeless tyre must be mounted on a wheel able to hold the pressure itself, seals against the rim rather than around a valve stem, deflates rather than bursting when punctured because there is no tube to split, and has no tube to chafe against the casing and generate heat.
VxBXxiRBIqRrqAVjDvSW: Earth distance = chart length x scale denominator = 3.8 cm x 1 000 000 = 3 800 000 cm = 38 000 m, which is 38 000 / 1852 = about 20.5 NM. A handy check for a 1:1 000 000 chart: 1 cm is very nearly 5.4 NM.
Vy1F6YfMfRdH4Hvtdipx: By Dalton's Law each gas exerts a partial pressure equal to its fraction of the total, and the fraction of oxygen does not change with altitude. Halving the total pressure therefore halves the oxygen partial pressure. Blood saturation does not fall by half, because the dissociation curve is not linear - it is around 72% at 18,000 ft.
VyHgRYc7fNQrW4HRh6NE: With an irreversible system no aerodynamic load reaches the pilot's controls - the actuator absorbs it all - so the controls would be weightless and it would be possible to overstress the aeroplane without noticing. An artificial feel system is therefore mandatory, giving forces that rise with speed and deflection.
VybbzcoGwOnlfmuN8pfs: A fixed pitch propeller can be at its best blade angle at only one combination of speed and RPM. A constant speed unit varies the pitch to keep the blades at an efficient angle of attack throughout the climb, cruise and descent, so efficiency is higher across the whole operating range rather than at a single design point.
VyyWZ20PeD6IcIhnDsgF: An under-inflated tyre bulges so that the shoulders carry more of the load than the centre of the tread, and they wear accordingly - an over-inflated tyre wears in the centre for the same reason. The soft tyre also flexes more, runs hot and hydroplanes at a lower speed.
VzbHnB45FCkLht40EJKF: The schedule reaches three extinguishers at 61 to 200 seats and then adds one for each further 100 seats: four to 300, five to 400, six to 500, seven to 600 and eight above 600.
W1Z2YqmiFRtI4Y1JbsRT: A series of red flashes to an aircraft on the ground means 'taxi clear of the landing area in use.' The aircraft must vacate promptly.
W3Gwl6Se5S8bnIpImunf: At 25,000 ft the time of useful consciousness is of the order of a few minutes, and it varies considerably with what the individual is doing - physical activity raises oxygen consumption and can halve it. That is why the drill after a decompression is mask on first and no exertion, and why the figure is quoted as a range rather than a number.
W3TIw6fZteqqBsIV5Rek: A minimum time track is computed for one particular journey on one particular day, from that day's wind field. It is not a published route and has no fixed validity period - fly the same city pair tomorrow and the track will be different.
W3VX0BNOxx22G5ASm2eq: Above 10,000 ft the immediate threat after a decompression is hypoxia, and the time of useful consciousness at cruise levels is measured in seconds. The procedure must therefore deliver oxygen at once - masks on before anything else. The emergency descent follows, but it takes time and cannot by itself prevent hypoxia.
W3ndd4etLcero6d3iwaQ: Viscous hydroplaning needs only a thin film of water, but it needs a SMOOTH, contaminated surface - typically a touchdown zone polished by rubber deposits - where the film cannot escape through the surface texture. Rough or grooved surfaces drain and break the film, which is why grooving is the standard remedy.
W3sAtQVSkhWXSZyvKiJV: A rapid decompression drops the pressure faster than the air can be replaced, so the temperature falls with it and the moisture in the cabin air condenses into mist. A slow decompression gives none of those signs, which is why the cabin altimeter and the cabin rate of climb are what detect it.
W3vV9JPPgOzXGock3g54: The impulse coupling holds the magnet back against a spring as the engine turns slowly, then releases it to flick through at speed. That produces both a hot spark and a retarded one, which is what a cold engine needs to avoid kicking back against the starter.
W411aRs3KlEQEU4rPtU4: Full harness as well as lap belt is required for take-off, for landing and whenever the commander judges it necessary in the interest of safety. During taxi and the other phases the seat belt alone suffices - the harness exists for the phases where a sudden deceleration is credible.
W417H85GvvTCtvCXUGfo: The crossfeed manifold connects all the tanks to all the engines, so any engine can be supplied from any tank. It is used to correct a lateral imbalance and to burn the fuel of a shut-down engine.
W4X3koQO0CSFfFj9DNw1: The pressure drop lets nitrogen dissolved in the body's tissues and fluids come out of solution as bubbles, in accordance with Henry's Law, producing the bends, the chokes and in severe cases gas embolism. Air rushes out of the cabin rather than in, the temperature falls sharply as the gas expands, and passenger masks drop but oxygen flow is not automatic on every type.
W4cDMznVmpnKjSEZI32L: Carbon dioxide crosses the alveolar membrane by passive diffusion down its partial-pressure gradient, from about 46 mmHg in the arriving venous blood to about 40 mmHg in the alveolar gas. Nothing pumps it; the gradient does the work, which is why anything that impairs the membrane or the gradient impairs gas exchange.
W4ov2NRAD6yi2d0DI6ca: In a pure impulse turbine the whole pressure drop occurs in the nozzle guide vanes, which convert it into a high velocity jet; the rotor blades merely change the direction of that jet and absorb its momentum, with no further expansion between them. A reaction turbine expands in the rotor as well.
W4thrZMrOBgIb9JXmTw4: Passenger masks are continuous-flow units that mix CABIN AIR with oxygen, so in a smoke-filled cabin they would deliver the smoke as well - they offer no protection against fumes. Only the crew's smoke masks and protective breathing equipment supply oxygen isolated from cabin air.
W5EsUe4Qpk011JBQ1R6F: Maximum differential is around 8 to 9 psi on modern transports, which holds a cabin altitude near 8 000 ft at 40 000 ft. It is limited by the strength and fatigue life of the fuselage, and protected by a maximum differential relief valve.
W5LGbLulKDkP1iXU0Dfl: Around 70% of what passes between people is carried non-verbally - posture, gesture, facial expression, tone of voice, timing and silence. It is learned rather than inherited, it can be trained, and where it contradicts the words it is usually the non-verbal message that is believed, which is why a reassuring statement delivered tensely does not reassure.
W5gILZRlRz13awnz1H4e: 7700 is the general emergency code. Learn the trio together: 7500 unlawful interference, 7600 radio communication failure, 7700 emergency. 7000 is the European VFR conspicuity code and signals nothing abnormal.
W6DmlP7fvfHNyYlRNkch: Capacitive reactance is inversely proportional to frequency, so raising the frequency lowers the opposition and, at a fixed applied voltage, the current increases. A capacitor passes high frequencies readily and blocks DC altogether.
W6NI4mrRjoIRtOs2gq09: A crew member who is physically present but mentally elsewhere is worse than useless under high workload: he is assumed to be monitoring and is not, so the cross-check the other pilot is relying on does not exist. Humour, sensitivity and discipline may each be helpful or unhelpful in context, but disengagement removes the second crew member entirely.
W7mdCwa3iq36wm2YTCH4: The autobrake stays in until the crew takes over: pressing the brake pedals, or moving the selector to off, disarms it. It is deliberate that it cannot cancel itself at some speed, because the crew must be the ones who decide the aeroplane is under control.
W7prm6jpJwvky6psNj2K: The wind from 090 is well onto the port quarter of the 216 heading, so it pushes the aircraft left in bearing terms and adds a lot of speed. Resolving the vectors gives a track of about 230 and a groundspeed of about 196 kt, so about 15 degrees of drift and 41 kt gained on the TAS.
W8HLOTKocQRsB7oxetjV: The rejected take-off drill begins by closing the thrust levers - removing the force that is accelerating the aeroplane must come first, and it also arms the automatic ground spoilers and autobrake logic on many types. Braking, spoilers and reverse then follow in quick succession. The certified accelerate-stop distance assumes this sequence, which is why deviating from it invalidates the calculation.
W8NmBCLyfjwxmSxyHgNZ: The FMC computes a radio position from DME/DME where two or more DMEs give good geometry, and falls back to VOR/DME where they do not. DME/DME is preferred because two ranges cross more sharply than a range and a bearing, but it is not the only method available.
W8foAsBO4nG7kp2mVXU9: The tank is vented so that the pressure inside it stays close to the pressure at the pump and cannot build up as the oil heats and the blow-by gases from the crankcase accumulate. Without the vent the tank would pressurise and force oil out through the seals.
W9onlbPa5HyoZP8Rzmg4: ICAO was established by the Chicago Convention of 1944, signed on December 7, 1944.
WABflo6a25q4ivVu4nKM: A parallel actuator is connected directly into the control run, so when it moves the surface it moves the column or wheel with it and the crew can see and feel what the autopilot is doing. A series actuator is deliberately arranged not to move the controls, which is why it is limited to small, fast inputs like the yaw damper.
WATKjNHvZKWcLRJ2Tubr: The display colour convention makes green the engaged or active mode and white or cyan the armed mode, so that a glance at the flight mode annunciator distinguishes what is happening now from what will happen at capture. Amber is caution and red is warning.
WArq4Qr3KyCVJTVrHG8V: The directive force is the HORIZONTAL component of the earth's field, the part that actually turns the compass needle into the magnetic meridian. It is greatest near the magnetic equator and falls to zero at the magnetic poles, so it decreases, not increases, with latitude.
WBHhyNHbWeDNW1Us3S3E: On a transverse Mercator the cylinder touches the globe along one chosen meridian, so the scale is exactly correct along that meridian of tangency and expands away from it. That is why the projection suits narrow north/south strips and why UTM divides the world into 6 degree zones.
WBNIfokQhcSXQTyJUCBC: Chemical generators are used where a lightweight, self-contained supply is needed at each seat row and in the lavatories, and in the smoke hoods. The flight deck uses a gaseous system, because the crew need diluter demand regulators, a controllable supply and a duration a candle cannot give.
WBOD1I3MHIjis7ulKLZ0: Sweeping a wing reduces the effective airflow over the aerofoil section by the cosine of the sweep angle, which lowers the CLmax achievable and therefore RAISES the stall speed. So reducing the sweep angle lowers the stall speed. T-tails, anhedral and dihedral affect stability and stall behaviour but not the stalling speed itself, which is governed by CLmax and wing loading.
WCDOr24YAFTjvXtTmyXc: Aerodromes keep grass long - around 15-20 cm - precisely because flocking birds avoid it: they cannot see approaching predators and cannot forage easily. Short mown grass, edible refuse and standing water all attract them.
WCsddF9YpYVFxBSFeTfq: The disconnect is a mechanical latch that is deliberately one-way: once the drive is broken it can only be relatched on the ground with the engine stopped, by a maintenance action. That prevents a crew from reconnecting a drive that has been disconnected for a real fault such as loss of oil.
WDHo7kv4TJZs6ViHELjH: A convergent nozzle accelerates a subsonic flow, and the energy for that acceleration comes out of the gas itself: as velocity rises, static pressure and static temperature both fall. The total temperature is unchanged - the heat has simply been converted into kinetic energy.
WDgEIKrjqT2rYNR5OsP0: After sustaining damage, the aircraft may resume flight if the State of registry considers the damage such that the aircraft is still airworthy. The State of registry makes this determination.
WEbL13uS86xbBxkcQCJj: In Class E, the 250 kt IAS speed limit applies to both IFR and VFR flights up to FL 100 (10,000 ft). Above FL 100, no Class E speed limit applies.
WF7xxVhcATzJRmLxIIQs: ICAO Annex 14: the fixed-distance marking commences at 300 m from the threshold. This marking aids pilots in judging landing distance.
WFIw2k6Xd5naVGn9Cs5R: Tar is the condensed particulate fraction of tobacco smoke and carries the carcinogens that damage cell DNA and produce lung cancer. Nicotine is the addictive stimulant, carbon monoxide is what occupies the haemoglobin and raises the smoker's physiological altitude, and lead is not a constituent - three distinct hazards from the same cigarette.
WFiJRXl5TcBXiDU3VvkK: Long-term memory has effectively unlimited capacity and holds material for a lifetime, so neither storage time nor quantity constrains it. The limitation is access: material that is not periodically recalled becomes progressively harder to retrieve, which is why recency requirements and regular practice of emergency drills exist.
WGr04phn9rw6nFad3I4S: Landing mass is take-off mass less the fuel burnt on the way, so LM = TOM - trip fuel is true by definition of the terms. The others are not identities: reserve fuel is not what is left of the whole take-off mass, the maximum zero fuel mass is a limit rather than a sum, and the maximum take-off mass is a structural limit unrelated to how much fuel would fit.
WHRJEZIY0p6z93CfFN3m: ICAO Doc 4444: landing clearance or alternative should be passed to the aircraft before it reaches 2 NM from touchdown during a radar approach.
WHp4oryirmExaunMoCtN: Where there is no outer marker or equivalent, the commit point becomes a height: the approach may not be continued below 1000 ft above the aerodrome when the reported RVR or visibility is below minima. It is the same principle as the outer marker rule, expressed as an altitude.
WHtCPF8fyoOuybEoCVqP: Steady, continuous precipitation comes from stratiform cloud formed by gentle, widespread ascent in STABLE air, so there is little vertical motion and hence little turbulence, and the precipitation covers a large area and changes only slowly. Showery precipitation is the convective counterpart: brief, sharply varying and locally intense, with the turbulence that the updraughts imply.
WI3A3m8ZHX3Yiq7UfUKP: Useful load is everything above the dry operating mass that the aeroplane is carrying: the traffic load of passengers, baggage and cargo, plus the usable fuel. It is what remains of the maximum take-off mass once the aeroplane and its operational items are accounted for.
WIp2eMzZBVAxNt98c1pW: Alignment first levels the platform on the local vertical (1), then gyrocompasses to find true north from the horizontal component of earth rate (2), and in doing so establishes the latitude, since the earth rate components depend on it (3). Longitude cannot be sensed at all and must be entered by the crew.
WIreiiL0cySTPv0nFm7O: The alignment computation uses LATITUDE to interpret the earth's rotation rate it senses, so a 10 degree latitude error corrupts the gyro-compassing and the system rejects it. Longitude plays no part in that computation, so a longitude error passes unnoticed and simply displaces every position by the same amount for the whole flight.
WIx1Ub33MNxloOhXcyDr: The aerodynamic centre is defined as the point about which the pitching moment coefficient stays CONSTANT as the angle of attack changes - for a subsonic aerofoil it lies at about 25% chord, moving to about 50% in supersonic flow. Working moments about this fixed point is what makes stability analysis tractable, since the centre of pressure itself moves with angle of attack.
WJWqUWDtOoXpZHQ3jRKY: The whole point of VDF is that all the special equipment is on the GROUND: the aircraft needs nothing beyond its ordinary VHF radio, which makes VDF the classic fallback when the aircraft's own navigation equipment has failed. The trade-off is that it is controller-interpreted, so it does require ATC.
WJeteE9YLHICr1g3EEV7: A pressurised transport fuselage is semi-monocoque: the skin carries the pressure and shear loads, while frames hold the section and stringers carry bending and stabilise the skin against buckling. A pure monocoque would be prohibitively heavy at that size, and a truss structure could not be pressurised efficiently.
WKScT7X5jh9xNDmCZ4qH: Surface movement radar uses very short wavelengths in the SHF band and a scanner turning at about 60 rpm, so the picture refreshes about once a second. The resolution is fine enough that the shape of a return can SOMETIMES suggest the type of aircraft, though it is not a reliable identification.
WL3ftROpzPS4jrQBYxZ5: The 200 hPa surface lies near 39,000 ft, which is above the ISA tropopause at 36,090 ft, so the standard temperature there is the constant tropopause value of -56.5 C. A reading of -55 C is therefore within about 1.5 C of standard - well inside plus or minus 5 C. Always compare an upper-air temperature with the ISA value for that level rather than judging the raw number.
WLJ0nq27CCbz27jOiYTd: On east-west NAT tracks south of 70N, position reports are made every 10 degrees of longitude between 5W and 65W. North of 70N the interval opens to 20 degrees because the meridians converge.
WLhcJJKk2Fxsmfgy7E5s: Lift acts upwards along the wing and the wing is a cantilever from the root, so the wing bends upwards: the upper surface is shortened and goes into compression, and the lower surface is stretched into tension. That reverses in a negative-g manoeuvre or when the aircraft is on the ground.
WMhjdUs5XpllXlmEbWHW: If an ATC clearance is unsuitable, the PIC may request and, if practicable, obtain an amended clearance. The pilot is never obligated to accept an unsafe clearance.
WNS2MkbmeGgHHZH8qU8C: The wind from 160 is on the port quarter of the 305 track, so it pushes the aircraft right and adds speed. The crosswind is about 10 kt, giving about 4 degrees of drift correction to the left, so the heading is about 301, and the tailwind component of about 15 kt brings the groundspeed to about 169 kt.
WNdeJmoCmTWK2DQ1Jx0l: Carriage of dangerous goods requires the operator to be approved and to comply with the ICAO Technical Instructions - classification, packing, labelling, documentation, loading, notification to the commander and crew training. Passengers may be carried on the same flight, and no separate government permission is needed for each shipment.
WNj0qGuQWIBB4zsi4nFC: A weak mixture burns slowly and hot, so the end gas sits at high temperature for longer and is more likely to explode spontaneously. High compression, high charge temperature, advanced timing and low grade fuel all do the same thing - retarding the timing and a high octane fuel make detonation less likely, not more.
WOwmvTDDVdZbqbimcavW: The alert exists to warn of a disagreement between the reverser and its lever: doors unlocked or moving when the lever is stowed (1), or doors failing to deploy when the lever is selected (2 in the sense of statement 3). Doors locked when stowed and deployed when selected are the two normal conditions and generate no alert.
WOzbtbL4BjEOz75HD5Ou: The centre of gravity is 15% of the mean aerodynamic chord aft of its leading edge: 0.15 x 134.5 = 20.18 inches. The leading edge itself is 625.6 inches from the datum, so the CG is 625.6 + 20.18 = 645.78 inches aft of the datum. The 20.18 figure alone is the distance from the leading edge of MAC, not from the datum.
WPQ3fucGuBDX5Lo0bOl7: Kepler's first law: each planet moves in an ELLIPSE with the sun at one FOCUS, not at the centre. The earth's orbit is only slightly eccentric, which is why the sun-earth distance varies by about 3 percent between January and July.
WQOQF6pH7mI5RZ6HcG9r: The first thing alcohol removes is the normal caution that stops a pilot doing something rash, and it does so at concentrations far below those causing obvious impairment - and without the pilot noticing. Nothing accelerates elimination, which runs at about 15 mg/100 ml per hour; coffee and oxygen produce an alert drunk, not a sober one.
WQwun0TXVRx6dpeDWSox: Carburettor ice depends on the temperature drop produced inside the venturi by the pressure fall and by fuel vaporisation - as much as 20 to 25°C. Moist air at +20 or +25°C outside can therefore be taken below freezing inside the carburettor, which is why carburettor ice is a summer hazard as well as a winter one.
WSDL3ytAECMAoqwiTl4b: With the aileron's centre of gravity aft of the hinge, its inertia makes it lag behind the wing's motion: when the wing bends down the aileron is left behind and deflects upwards, which increases the download and drives the wing further down. That is the coupling which produces flutter, and mass balancing ahead of the hinge removes it.
WSU3aqomy6oRKTkOPVgE: A flat rated engine holds a constant thrust up to its flat rating temperature by having thrust in hand on a cooler day. Above that temperature there is no margin left and the engine can only be operated to its temperature limit, so the available thrust falls off with rising OAT.
WT8RsR7ctOZBkodmnVvt: The air-ground datalink is carried by commercial service providers - principally SITA and ARINC - whose ground networks interconnect so that a message continues to reach the aircraft as it moves between coverage areas and between centres. Neither the airline's own network nor the public mobile networks provide it.
WTOt7jHKqPECp0vdG1Nv: When the system is pressurised, fluid leaves the reservoir to fill the accumulators and the pressure side of the actuators, so the reservoir contents drop slightly. That is why the quantity must be read under the conditions the manual specifies, and why a full-looking reservoir with the system depressurised proves nothing.
WU1BKY2aYdbq1C9hEIbs: If intercepted and the interceptor's signals conflict with ATC instructions, follow the intercepting aircraft's visual signals. Interception signals take priority.
WUWguQbxiTRxx1ucwgBd: VA is defined as the speed at which the aeroplane stalls at exactly the manoeuvring LIMIT load factor - 2.5 for a large transport, 3.8 for a light aeroplane in the normal category. Below VA a single full elevator deflection therefore stalls the wing before it can overstress the structure. The ULTIMATE load factor (1.5 times the limit) is a structural design figure and plays no part in defining VA.
WUdiardHTCSnawsv1pc7: Exhaust gas temperature peaks at the chemically correct mixture and falls off either side of it, so the gauge lets the pilot lean precisely - to peak EGT, or to a stated number of degrees rich or lean of it - instead of guessing. It is a mixture instrument, not a temperature control.
WW4siCqBmabgNcNmQCYy: General information, instructions and procedures for carrying dangerous goods live in the operator's Operations Manual, which is where crew and ground staff find what to do. The Technical Instructions are the regulatory source behind it, and the AOC records that the operator is approved to carry them.
WWY1B3JqT2NESYxHaOWF: Catastrophic is the top of the severity scale: the failure would prevent continued safe flight and landing and the aeroplane would be lost. The lesser classes are described in terms of reductions in functional capability and safety margins.
WX3HwqWakSk3LGgBVVGV: Stable stratiform cloud has small droplets - roughly 0.002 to 0.03 mm - and icing is most likely between 0 C and -15 C, becoming rare below about -18 C because most of the water is already frozen. Cumuliform cloud is the opposite case: larger droplets and icing possible over a much wider temperature range.
WXCzCg8v8CPYz4n6UhU6: The radio altimeter transmits a continuous wave in the 4200 to 4400 MHz band whose frequency is swept up and down. The signal returning from the ground was transmitted a moment earlier, so its frequency differs from the one being transmitted now, and that difference is directly proportional to the height.
WXsHtm4f5c1VsUdqoZvu: The lift is distributed along the span but the whole of it has to be carried across the root, so the bending moment accumulates inboard and is greatest at the root. That is why the wing structure is deepest there, and why fuel in the wings is valuable - its weight relieves part of the bending.
WY2AI1zZr4Hx9HCpYoKb: Hydroplaning speed is about 9 times the square root of the tyre pressure in psi. 16 bar is roughly 232 psi, and 9 x 15.2 gives about 137 kt, so the risk starts near 138 kt. It depends on tyre pressure alone - not on crosswind, and not on aircraft mass.
WYvLAnAkMjb2pE2LyN0c: The warm front cloud sequence approaching from the cold side runs CI, CS, AS, NS. Seeing it in REVERSE - nimbostratus first, then altostratus, cirrostratus and cirrus - means you are flying out from under the frontal cloud shield into the cold air AHEAD of the warm front. Leaving warm air for cold air means the outside temperature falls. Strong gusty winds would be the signature of a cold front, which has quite different cloud.
WZuvwyVZKxkYLJtno1gn: Excessive rate of descent is mode 1. Its initial alert is the repeated 'SINK RATE' caution, and if the descent is not arrested the warning escalates to the hard 'WHOOP WHOOP PULL UP'. 'DON'T SINK' belongs to mode 3 and 'TOO LOW GEAR' to mode 4.
WapdhF7KPy2dcpi2LMbR: Arousal rises in both cases - the physiological response to a demanding situation is much the same whether the appraisal is positive or negative. What differs is the interpretation: eustress for the pilot who reads it as a challenge, distress for the one who reads it as a threat, and it is the appraisal, not the event, that determines which.
WbRsIugKOYwFv00oq8HT: A cold engine needs an over-rich mixture because only the lightest fractions of the fuel vaporise, so extra fuel must be supplied to get a combustible mixture at the plug. At idle the extra fuel also carries heat away, and a lean idle would run hot and rough.
Wbx918uZDqC5z6desIIp: For a MEDIUM following a HEAVY on approach to the same runway, ICAO requires 5 NM (9.3 km) radar separation, or 2 minutes where time is used. The 6 NM / 3 minute pairing belongs to a LIGHT following a HEAVY.
WcnZqN5wnqH0oFa4IJbX: If visual contact is lost on the downwind leg during circling, initiate the missed approach procedure. Requesting an amended clearance is not practical when you've lost the visual reference.

XEN1xd7cjtY1uNlMgUvv: In still air each vortex moves outward from the aircraft's path at about 5 kt, so the pair separates symmetrically to either side of the runway and sinks. It is a crosswind that breaks the symmetry, holding one vortex over the runway while carrying the other clear.

XFuNN199DqPfutoYicAV: The fan is on the same shaft as the low pressure compressor and is driven by the low pressure turbine, the last and largest turbine stages. That allows the fan to run slowly, which is what a large diameter demands, while the core spool runs fast.
XGQJhf6JnqfbzOAX4H1H: The phugoid is the long-period pitch mode, a slow exchange of speed for height in which the angle of attack barely changes - period typically 40-60 seconds. XH0ohppksIGhKKvWW1rA: The body clock shifts at roughly a day per time zone, so after three days in Moscow it has largely adapted to Moscow time. XJIJ5iW6X7rEfaHP24Qu: Cost index is the ratio of the time-related operating cost to the cost of fuel. A high index tells the FMS that time is expensive and it computes fast speeds; an index of zero tells it to fly for minimum fuel regardless of the time taken.

XMVohUjg9QY6HaIUyc9S: Bimetallic switches are wired in parallel, so that any one of them detecting the fire completes the circuit and gives the warning, and a break in the loop does not disable the rest. XMcocveuZB70VrISX7EI: Manifold pressure is an absolute pressure, so the gauge uses an evacuated aneroid capsule that expands and contracts with it and reads correctly whatever the ambient pressure. That is why it shows the local barometric pressure with the engine stopped.
XMxmG63luF2sfmXKe1J8: Compare the sounding with ISA at each level. ISA at 10,000 ft is -4.8 C against an observed -2 C, and the whole column runs 3-12 C warmer than standard. XOU4a8Tzm9nYUEIUW6Qg: For an aeroplane certificated above 25 000 ft the crew oxygen supply must in no case be less than two hours - the time allowed for a descent and diversion after a decompression at high level. Aeroplanes certificated to 25 000 ft or below need a minimum of 30 minutes.
XPaYNDiNS9HW4ya4sd3A: An attitude indicator needs two degrees of freedom, given by two gimbal rings, so that the aircraft can pitch and roll around a spin axis that stays fixed. XPwtz09Cz1BGElRL7qsN: A strapdown system bolts the gyros and accelerometers rigidly to the airframe, with the stable platform existing only as a mathematical transformation in the computer. XQnQqrG9YMdsW7AN0JzK: In PANS-OPS, DER stands for Departure End of Runway — the reference point from which obstacle clearance surfaces begin.
XR218yj9VIBYjRadwALb: Losing 15 000 ft at 3000 ft/min takes 5 minutes, and with no wind the aircraft covers 320 x 5/60 = about 26.7 NM in that time. Find the time from the height and the rate, then the distance from the groundspeed.
XR5jXfe3qAP67y12rTK5: The aeroplane never moves, so only earth rate applies - no transport wander. XROziW1iJueqAoJIcjSn: On a night approach over water or featureless ground the only visual cue is the aerodrome lighting, and with no intervening texture or horizon the pilot reads it as being nearer and lower - feeling higher than he is. XRSsc75ufdUOHXkYzIH4: Stress narrows the individual's own capacity at exactly the moment more capacity is needed, so the answer is to draw on what is outside him: the other pilot, the cabin crew, air traffic control, the company, the manuals and the automation. XRZqGjPH4dswepc6TihG: An INS flies the great circle, which between two points on the same parallel bows towards the nearer pole, so in the southern hemisphere the aircraft is slightly SOUTH of 60S at the mid-longitude. XS5gXJNe0fQncGpy7yjM: A cold pool is a mass of cold air aloft. XS8jtnYBEDM7RldIRE6Y: IFR comm failure in VMC: continue in VMC and land as soon as practicable. The 'continue at assigned level/route' procedure applies in IMC, not VMC.
XS9NW9xOSQkrGD2owrS1: The MEL is a DISPATCH document: it governs the decision to depart, made on stand before the aeroplane starts to taxi. Once the aeroplane moves under its own power the flight has begun and failures are handled by the abnormal and emergency procedures instead.
XStjHVwtSPXz7uY2VBRL: Deviation is the angle between magnetic north and COMPASS north, caused by the aircraft's own magnetism. Variation is the angle between true and magnetic north, and compass error is the two combined.
XSxVWRbiA5Qw3RnbZRfP: The starter drives the high pressure spool, so N2 accelerates first and normally. XTD1w7rjMxHyqjl4NtCa: Tropopause height follows the depth and warmth of the troposphere beneath it, so it is lowest over the cold poles - about 8 km - and highest over the warm equator, at 16-18 km, with about 11 km in mid-latitudes. XTVBbQkn8S2s6a2OsoC6: The crankshaft, through the connecting rods, converts the pistons' reciprocating motion into rotation. The camshaft is driven from it and operates the valves, and the reduction gear, if fitted, simply slows the propeller relative to the crank.
XTaT8WubAGMJZcLJ0lYo: Hypovigilance is an under-arousal problem: monotony (1), fatigue and sleep debt (2) and a lack of external stimulation (3) all lower the level of alertness until monitoring effectively stops. XUpR07788JdsEXRCGwcZ: AIRAC is the system of advance notification using common effective dates. It identifies operationally significant changes distributed in advance.
XUyvhmuVwygrEvtHYBFY: Induced drag originates at the WING TIP, where air spills from the high-pressure lower surface around the tip to the low-pressure upper surface and rolls up into the tip vortex. XV7hCl5mr9KajkvIKgdU: Hill or orographic fog is simply cloud that forms when moist air is forced up a slope and cools to its dewpoint, and to those on the hill it appears as fog. XWa4eaq33lOVsM9ggDeD: The COMMANDER makes the final determination that the load and its distribution keep the aeroplane within its mass and balance limits, and signs the documentation to confirm acceptance. XWgKDtYUNUS39lBUNB2I: Stall speed rises with the SQUARE ROOT of the load factor: Vs(n) = Vs x sqrt(n) = 100 x sqrt(2) = 141 kt. A load factor of 2 corresponds to a 60 degree bank in a level turn, so the familiar result follows - a 60 degree turn raises the stall speed by 41%.
XWr1KA3IQLLAbWP9npmG: The MEL is written by the OPERATOR from the manufacturer's MMEL and approved by the Authority. It may be MORE restrictive than the MMEL - reflecting the operator's routes, fit and training - but never less.

XYHkMNmURX8wuRDDNt7Z: After takeoff, passengers should be told to keep seat belts fastened while seated. Additional announcements about oxygen and smoke detectors are made separately.
XYb4WP4V1fGI6xT41xMq: Vortex generators re-energise the boundary layer so it can survive the steep adverse pressure gradient behind a shock wave, which delays shock-induced separation and cuts the associated transonic drag rise. XYx3KDUJwPfucLfoGPKz: The agonic line is the particular isogonal along which variation is ZERO, i.e. where true and magnetic north coincide. Lines of equal dip are isoclinals and the zero-dip one is the aclinic line, better known as the magnetic equator.
XZIrEEo7cvuXcqWeT89X: Hydroplaning speed is about 9 times the square root of the tyre pressure in psi. 10 bar is roughly 145 psi, and 9 x 12 gives about 108 kt. XZMZNgLbePZobwYJKdCF: Bonding straps join every part of the airframe electrically so that static charge cannot build up between them and discharge as a spark. Xbv2jmekG6bt1UbSAIfd: JAR-FCL: class ratings cover single-pilot aeroplanes not requiring type ratings, including any other type as considered necessary by the authority.
Xc8qne8C225ZnPQ12crx: Anti-collision strobes reflecting off cloud produce a rapid, bright flicker in the cockpit that is disorienting, can induce nausea and in susceptible individuals can trigger a seizure. XcR0d5IDRHtj7hO3Tf5E: Rule-based errors are failures in the selection or use of a stored procedure: applying a rule that is itself wrong for the situation (2), or misapplying a rule that would have been right (4). XcYN2yiTUCWTEgrDF6uJ: The two adaptations are wildly asymmetric. XemQOTCX8Ye35pA9uA7w: Take-off mass is the dry operating mass plus the traffic load plus the fuel, so the dry operating mass is 66 700 - 14 200 - 10 500 = 42 000 kg. The crew mass is already included within the dry operating mass and must not be deducted again.
XfzYTKb6pUYaSRxJkcD3: An inversion is very stable and prevents vertical exchange between the air beneath it and the air above. XghJxhLNW2I9pRkX0cJd: Each large thrust change takes the disc and blades through a full cycle of thermal and centrifugal stress, and it is the number of those cycles, not the hours run, that consumes low cycle fatigue life. Xgyhdo3zZlMmg8da00q5: Judgement is the process by which a pilot recognises a situation, evaluates the risk in it and chooses a course of action, drawing on knowledge, skill, experience and his own attitude to risk. XhzE6mJSfqUA6cN7plV8: The command bars do not display deviation - they display what to do about it. The horizontal bar tells the pilot which way and how much to pitch in order to regain and hold the computed path, having already combined the raw deviation with attitude and rate information.
XiGu68XP1VMCDUlZubDd: A cold swells the linings of both the Eustachian tube and the sinus openings, so neither the middle ear nor the sinuses can equalise. XiQVaU8ZbiW3Y4NXwyNc: A co-pilot performing PIC duties under supervision is credited in full with flight time towards a higher grade licence.
XiooL3Z9NVYK06ua2Xx1: With the centre of gravity aft the tail has to produce less download, so less lift is needed from the wing and both induced drag and trim drag fall. XjEhjkDnuifNmL9sSwD5: Anti-collision lights should be displayed on the ground when engines are running. This warns ground personnel of operating engines.

Xk9Jjjdsv5OkxcpmEQjR: The Second Freedom of the Air: right to land in another State for a technical stop (refuelling/maintenance) without commercial traffic.
XkXHUpRuwWVh2G3RKMqL: If another aircraft is on a collision course, there will be no apparent relative motion — it stays at the same position in your windshield while getting larger.
XkjvCl5eWPc8dnEDtXHJ: Time of Useful Consciousness is the interval from the onset of an inadequate oxygen supply to the point at which the individual can no longer act usefully - it ends with the loss of the ability to take corrective action, well before actual unconsciousness. XlECLnP0ccA13QU9ecsy: Work everything into true. Compass 090 with 2W deviation is 088 magnetic, and with 12E variation that is 100 true. XmXMMrEPFHeC1s3kZAHr: Bird strike risk is concentrated close to the ground - the great majority occur below about 150 m (500 ft) and roughly 90% below 500 m. That is why the exposure is on take-off, initial climb, approach and landing, and why bird control is an aerodrome activity.

XnPu6j0quWhiClnKC3rl: Empty mass covers the airframe, engines, fixed equipment and unusable fluids. Adding the operational items - crew, their baggage, catering, water, documentation - gives the dry operating mass, so the empty mass is one component of it.
