An error is an unintended deviation from what was meant; a violation is an intended deviation from what is required. The distinction matters because the two need entirely different remedies.
heEL9jGEJduCzPXVaKQX: The manoeuvring limit load factor is a fixed figure laid down in the regulations - 2.5 for a large transport aeroplane. The gust limit load factor is CALCULATED, and depends on wing loading, lift curve slope, aspect ratio, airspeed and altitude, so it varies from aeroplane to aeroplane and from moment to moment. In a severe gust at high speed it can exceed the manoeuvring figure, which is why the gust envelope may extend outside the manoeuvring envelope.
heF2ng2JFagPM8qUFzxn: Work in pressures. A cabin at 14 000 ft sits at about 8.6 psi, and with the differential limited to 3 psi the ambient pressure outside cannot fall below about 5.6 psi. That pressure corresponds to roughly 24 500 ft, which is therefore the highest usable flight altitude with the defect.
heT3PtQL5UyY9M5Dym24: In an unpressurised aeroplane the cabin is at the flight altitude, so the crew are exposed directly to it. Flight deck occupants on duty must therefore be supplied with supplemental oxygen for the whole of any period spent above 10 000 ft - a lower threshold than the passengers', because the crew's performance is what keeps the aeroplane flying.
hf2kSCw2kKBsXqpSwzyT: This question refers to a TAF extract that this text-only version cannot show, so learn the method instead. Read the TAF's validity period, then work through the base forecast and any BECMG, TEMPO and PROB groups that are in force at the time asked for, taking the LOWEST visibility that applies at that moment. TEMPO and PROB groups do count towards a minimum, and a BECMG group's change is complete only at the end of its period.
hgIqMobOJGry4dpcLvLn: Protective breathing equipment is a smoke hood with its own oxygen supply and a full face seal, so the wearer breathes nothing from the cabin at all. It is for fighting fires and dealing with fumes, not for decompression, which is what the fixed oxygen system covers.
hgNNMtoY0lbdXwcKTxTi: Automatic trim runs the stabiliser to take the standing load off the elevator servo (1), and the by-product is that the aeroplane is correctly trimmed if the autopilot disconnects, so the controls do not snatch (2). It does not adjust the aeroplane's stability, which is a matter of design and centre of gravity.
hggvGoGWGh9pab2f0wFg: The booster keeps the fuel in the line above its vapour pressure, so it cannot boil into a vapour lock at altitude or when hot, and it delivers a positive head to the engine-driven high pressure pump so that it cannot cavitate. Refuelling is done through a separate pressure system.
hhY9CGvc7kffyTvQzyP6: Once running, the ignition is entirely self-contained: the magneto's rotating permanent magnet induces the primary current in its own coil. That is why the engine keeps running with the master switch off and why the propeller must always be treated as live.
hhj0Y4CzTcixPEOyOG8G: The wind from 140 is on the port quarter of the 278 heading, so it pushes the aircraft right and adds speed. Resolving the vectors gives a track of about 283 and a groundspeed of about 150 kt, i.e. about 5 degrees of starboard drift and 15 kt gained on the TAS.
hikdf70QIqTZTsKTYNE7: ICAO Annex 3 requires RVR to be reported throughout any period in which either the meteorological visibility or the RVR itself falls below 1500 m. That 1500 m threshold is the trigger, not 800 m - though 800 m is a familiar figure elsewhere, as the usual visibility below which low-visibility procedures are considered. RVR appears only in METAR and SPECI.
hilIb7e3lj0xsJ37If0z: ICAO Annex 15 states that a checklist of NOTAMs currently in force should be issued at intervals of not more than one month. The 28-day AIRAC cycle is a separate scheduling mechanism.
hj2PYM6PEYFiyCV2lXVP: An inverter turns DC into AC, which is what allows AC instruments and equipment to be run in a DC-primary aeroplane, and essential AC loads to be fed from the battery after a generation failure. A transformer rectifier does the opposite.
hjlQ8LOMNp9dX2VpdRoX: Ohm's law says current equals voltage divided by resistance, so for a fixed resistance the current is directly proportional to the applied voltage and inversely proportional to the resistance. Power is the product of voltage and current, and rises with the square of the current.
hkDdTF9UtEFG2Xlw9OaN: The rotor of an alternator carries the field winding, and a field must be a steady magnetic field, so it is fed with direct current - through slip rings on a simple machine, or from the rotating rectifier on a brushless one. The alternating current is generated in the stationary stator windings.
hkwwm8GKEvsPX3uNfKH0: Power required is drag multiplied by speed, so the minimum of that product occurs at a LOWER speed than the minimum of drag alone - typically about 76% of VMD. Minimum power is the speed for maximum endurance in a PROPELLER aeroplane and for minimum rate of descent in a glide; minimum drag is the speed for maximum endurance in a JET. The two are distinct and minimum power is always the slower.
hlazHrpyQworWG9uUDpq: Starting takes a large amount out of the battery, so a heavy charge immediately afterwards is exactly what should be seen, tapering off over the next few minutes as the battery recovers. It is a charge rate that stays high which points to a battery fault or an over-enthusiastic regulator.
hmrbYBBgNejPxgfpnfSC: Drag = CD x 1/2 rho V2 x S, so drag varies with the SQUARE of airspeed. A fourfold increase in velocity therefore multiplies the drag by 4 squared = 16. It is worth noting the contrast with FRONTAL AREA, which appears to the first power - tripling the area only triples the drag.
hms1FvUiOVjZjBCEOomu: The rods and cones are impaired by anything reducing their oxygen supply or poisoning them: hypoxia, carbon monoxide, alcohol, nicotine and many drugs, and G forces which reduce retinal blood pressure and cause greyout. Speed of travel by itself has no effect at all on the photoreceptors.
hnLE3j5Ny3n6DYutiI1o: The gauge is tapped into the induction manifold, downstream of the throttle and close to the inlet valve, and reads absolute pressure. That is why it shows ambient pressure with the engine stopped and falls below it as the throttle is closed.
hnSTawB5UMzGoDgvDAXo: Selye's definition: stress is the non-specific response of the body to any demand placed upon it - non-specific because the same pattern of adrenaline release, raised heart rate and mobilisation follows whatever the demand happens to be. The demands themselves are the stressors; the response is the stress.
hnai52uUYJwcoXbFyyLK: On a positively cambered aerofoil, increasing the angle of attack sharpens the suction peak on the upper surface and draws it toward the leading edge, so the centre of pressure moves FORWARD. Because the CP moves toward the leading edge as lift increases, a cambered wing on its own is longitudinally unstable - which is one reason a tailplane is needed. At the stall the CP then jumps sharply aft.
ho0oMPHtLLfJLpdyeskT: Air data is needed all over the aeroplane: the transponder reports pressure altitude from it (1), the EFIS displays altitude, airspeed and Mach from it (2), and the autoflight system uses it for every speed and altitude mode (3). One computer feeding a data bus is what keeps all of them consistent.
ho6p03vPuzZwCu4zCsTF: Noise damage depends on the product of intensity and exposure time - a very loud noise for a short period does as much harm as a moderate one for a long period, which is why exposure limits are stated as a level together with a permitted duration. The damage is cumulative and permanent, so each exposure adds to the last.
ho8xnIPv42iTxRkW5END: A spinning rotor has two properties: rigidity, the tendency to keep its axis pointing in the same direction in space, and precession, the movement of the axis at right angles to an applied force. Everything a gyro instrument does follows from those two.
hoZu8yoPtGmVXHIT8KWM: Unstable air is well mixed by convection, so haze, smoke and moisture are dispersed vertically instead of accumulating near the surface, and visibility between clouds is normally very good. What ruins it, briefly and locally, is the heavy shower precipitation the convective cloud produces. Drizzle, haze and low stratus are all products of STABLE air, where the lack of mixing traps everything in the lower layers.
hphVEgThWySyFHj6lFJl: A single spool engine has one shaft, so the compressor and turbine are rigidly joined and turn at the same speed. The penalty is that neither can run at its own best speed, which is why multi-spool engines were developed.
hr5xhNatqTcZp8Jcqwci: Report B says it explicitly: SCT040CB reports cumulonimbus already present at 4000 ft, the temperature-dewpoint spread of 26/18 shows a warm, moist and unstable airmass, and the TEMPO group forecasts 24018G30 with TS - gusts to 30 kt and thunderstorms. The other reports show layered stratiform cloud, low cloud with improving visibility, or snow, all with NOSIG or a benign trend.
hrWJ61ylUYtEmS0l4snc: ICAO Doc 4444 requires the Expected Approach Time (EAT) to be transmitted when the expected holding time is 10 minutes or more. For shorter delays, EAT communication is at ATC discretion.
hshac3UiLPMos5uPM7om: Short-notice unserviceability of a navigation aid is exactly what a NOTAM is for: it carries temporary or short-term changes that arrive too late for the AIP. The AIP holds the permanent picture, a SIGMET carries en-route weather, and an ATC broadcast is not a planning document.
htBooyNRatgnxIbGUIUs: Track 066 against heading 074 is 8 degrees of port drift, and the groundspeed of 242 kt exceeds the TAS of 230 kt, so the wind is on the starboard quarter. Resolving the vectors gives a wind from due south at about 35 kt, i.e. 180/35.
hutR2dJZmwvOoghSkEkx: The blade angle is fixed for the cruise, where the forward speed is high. At the start of the take-off run the forward speed is nearly zero, so the airflow meets the blade almost head-on and the angle of attack is very high - close to the stall, which is why a fixed pitch cruise propeller gives such poor acceleration.
huvDAeuWzkMMxqDy3IaE: Situational awareness is the correspondence between the pilot's mental picture and the real situation - perception matching reality. A vivid but wrong picture is not awareness but its most dangerous absence. Vigilance, attention and alertness are the mechanisms that build and maintain it, not the awareness itself.
huxYKo8R7yQehSoagSh5: ICAO Doc 4444 states that a pilot may expect to receive landing clearance or an alternative instruction before the aircraft reaches 2 NM from the touchdown point during a radar approach.
hve44tMaCZneYZ96LFIJ: 25 000 ft is the threshold: above it, the flight crew's masks must be quick-donning, because the time of useful consciousness after a rapid decompression at higher levels leaves no margin for fitting a conventional mask.
hvqbAcjCKh9aFlw3BKDw: CRM and MCC are about the crew as a unit: how the available people, equipment and information are actually used together, through communication, leadership, workload sharing and decision making. Individual technical proficiency is the business of type training; what these courses add is the performance of the crew as a whole.
hwpIcot946nVKoMSYDGr: The primary exchanger takes the heat out of the engine bleed air before it reaches the air cycle machine, and the secondary takes out the heat of compression added by the machine's own compressor. Both reject that heat to ram air, and cooling at both points is what makes the expansion across the turbine so effective.
hwypX9nxinNKc1EURJxd: For aeroplanes above 5700 kg first issued with a Certificate of Airworthiness before 1 April 1998 the CVR must retain the last 30 minutes. Aeroplanes certificated on or after that date require two hours, and the 25-hour figure belongs to the FDR.
hyZHPFiqnSvMuN5mKUBU: The standard erect spin recovery is: close the throttle, centralise the AILERONS, apply full opposite rudder, then move the control column progressively FORWARD to unstall the wing, and centralise the rudder as rotation stops. Ailerons must be neutral because any deflection at high alpha aggravates the autorotation, and the stick goes forward - holding it fully aft is what sustains the spin.
hylbI0usK8HBTCxmVdlD: Wavelength is the speed of light divided by the frequency: 300 000 000 divided by 121 950 000 gives about 2.46 metres. All the VHF communication band lies close to this figure, which is why the aerials are the length they are.
hyz0Krd87xXA3528joNJ: The forward and aft limits are set by what the tailplane and elevator can cope with: far enough aft to keep adequate stability and far enough forward that there is still elevator authority to flare and to recover from a stall. Those two requirements define the range.
hzgONE6wU2qwKpK4oalD: Hot air is less dense, so although the same volume flows through the venturi it contains less mass of air, while the carburettor goes on metering the same fuel - so the mixture goes rich. That richness, with the reduced power, is why carburettor heat is selected off once the ice has cleared.
i1AdKWEwD0Wqw0v6NP2K: In IMC the vestibular and proprioceptive senses report confidently wrong information and there is nothing useful outside to look at, so the reliable channel is vision directed at the instruments - and at the attitude indicator above all, since it alone shows the aircraft's attitude directly. The illusions are then disregarded whatever they feel like.
i1ROZ9osYmNXxZuHrNHr: Aphelion is the point in the EARTH's orbit furthest from the sun, about 152 million km, reached in early July; perihelion, about 147 million km, is in early January. Note the options that invert the relationship and speak of the sun orbiting the earth.
i2D40X4j7yB6hsVRI2pq: Up to about 10,000-12,000 ft the increases in breathing and heart rate can maintain adequate oxygenation, so a healthy person functions essentially normally - the indifferent and compensatory stages. Above that, compensation can no longer keep pace and performance begins to deteriorate, which is why 10,000 ft is the practical limit without supplemental oxygen.
i3gH8sbdbwMat8hh21Xu: An inverter takes DC in and delivers AC out. It is what allows AC instruments to be run in a DC-primary aeroplane, and essential AC loads to be fed from the battery when all generation is lost; a transformer rectifier does the opposite.
i4YgUWptTlYVcy91kSiP: For Item 15 a change of cruising speed counts once it reaches 5 percent of TAS or 0.01 Mach, and a change of level counts at any change of cruising level. The thresholds are deliberately tight because ATC builds its own estimates and separation on the filed profile.
i5HQmhg5aAMl5Gqnw3YK: The stall depends on angle of attack (1) and on the angle at which the wing stalls, which changes with the flap and slat setting (3). Nothing else is needed - engine speed, attitude and sideslip say nothing about how close the wing is to its stalling angle.
i5RfUZzsarhMZyrp4gQd: The take-off alternate must be within one hour at the SINGLE-ENGINE cruising speed in still air, because the scenario it exists for is an engine failure at or after V1 with a return to the departure aerodrome impossible. Using an all-engines speed would nominate an aerodrome the crippled aeroplane cannot actually reach in the hour.
i6SFEXW8DjbeDpHJ8RnB: The liver breaks down alcohol at a roughly fixed rate of about 0.015% blood alcohol per hour, and nothing accelerates it - not coffee, not food, not exercise, not sleep, not oxygen. Only time works, which is why the regulations specify a minimum interval between drinking and duty rather than a remedy.
i6i386PgFfWWUzUSzhq3: The severity scale runs minor, major, hazardous, catastrophic. A minor failure condition is one which slightly reduces safety margins, slightly increases workload, and at worst causes the occupants some physical discomfort. Distress and injuries define the major level above it.
i6p6FnR1YuQwVttiCXW8: A crash axe or crowbar must be carried on the FLIGHT DECK of aeroplanes above 5700 kg or with more than nine seats. A second one, in the most rearward galley area, becomes necessary only when the maximum approved passenger seating configuration exceeds 200.
i6zX1Vd790HCAqfWCYMM: Radiation fog is caused by the ground losing heat by long-wave radiation on a clear night, cooling the moist air in contact with it below its dewpoint. It requires a clear sky, light wind, high humidity and a long night, and forms over land. Cold air moving over warm ground is unstable and gives convection or steaming fog, and frontal passage gives frontal fog - a different mechanism entirely.
i8IsAgqldvyGhruiM0t6: Loading limitations must include all limiting masses, centres of gravity positions, mass distributions, and floor loadings. All four elements are necessary to verify the aircraft is loaded within its structural envelope.
i8JJ5ZXMgiTM1j43PaWA: Pressure altitude is by definition what the altimeter reads with 1013.25 set, so it is 12 000 ft. The QNH is given only to tempt a correction that this question does not call for - it would be needed for the altitude above sea level, not for the pressure altitude.
i8MMyeNqpI30P7KmvVbU: The command bar tells the pilot what to do, not where the aeroplane is. A bar displaced upward is an instruction to raise the nose, which is what is needed when the aircraft has gone below the glidepath.
i9zfjQ5D7lalMzgjIx7n: Rate of turn depends on how hard the aircraft is turned and how fast it is going: the rate is proportional to the tangent of the bank angle and inversely proportional to the true airspeed. Weight does not appear at all - a light and a heavy aeroplane at the same speed and bank turn at the same rate.
iAHSxYDGbdVWbnfwqfgo: On an RNP 1 route, the designation A342 Z indicates turns should be made within the allowable RNP tolerance using a tangential arc with a radius of 15 NM on routes with turns between 30 and 90 degrees at and below FL 190.
iAaLPPXiPZ7xRSzO9d2a: ICAO defines ETA as the estimated time of arrival at the DESTINATION: for an IFR flight, over the point from which the instrument approach will begin, or over the aerodrome if there is no such navigation aid. The estimate for an en-route point or fix has its own abbreviation, ETO, and elapsed time en route is EET.
iArOAjVfva197aP8tdxg: A long checklist is broken into logical sections so each can be completed without interruption (1); the order follows the panel scan so the eye and hand move naturally and nothing is skipped (4); and critical items are given redundancy through challenge-and-response or a later confirmation (5). Critical items belong at the beginning where attention is highest, and a checklist must never be combined with other tasks.
iBMpsPQRnoHj4I8wfME2: The localiser deviation bar is driven directly by the ILS receiver and knows nothing about the compass card, so with the aircraft on the centreline it centres regardless of what the frozen rose reads. What the frozen card does corrupt is the ORIENTATION of the course arrow, so the display no longer shows the correct fly-left/fly-right sense relative to the aircraft's real heading.
iBbuEU5fsgfy8RGEwbhj: Both statements are correct. VMCL is the minimum control speed in the landing configuration with the critical engine inoperative. Crucially, the certification criterion is not merely holding the aeroplane straight but retaining adequate ROLL capability - the aeroplane must be able to roll from a steady 5 degree sideslip to 20 degrees of bank in not more than 5 seconds - so roll rate can indeed be the limiting factor.
iCRnwPBI1PY7QrSFKFsx: The descent is 29 000 - 8000 = 21 000 ft, and 50 NM at 271 kt takes 50/271 x 60 = about 11.1 minutes. So the minimum rate of descent is 21 000 / 11.1 = about 1900 ft/min. Find the time from the groundspeed first, then divide the height by it.
iCcA6oz3eCsqsdE0pNCf: The CVR duration depends on when the individual Certificate of Airworthiness was first issued: 30 minutes for aeroplanes above 5700 kg certificated before 1 April 1998, and two hours for those certificated on or after that date.
iClF3YKh5YsP1MvxaiAp: The stages of hypoxia run from the indifferent stage to about 10,000 ft, the compensatory stage to about 15,000 ft and the disturbance stage to about 20,000 ft. Beyond that lies the critical stage, where compensation fails, consciousness and judgement go rapidly, and recovery may not follow even if oxygen is restored.
iDFU3dX9P5XVSqZUY3CH: Cruise cabin humidity falls to roughly 5-15%, drier than most deserts, because the air drawn in at altitude holds almost no water. The steady fluid loss that follows produces dehydration with headache, fatigue and reduced concentration, so crews must drink before they feel thirsty. (The option list in this row is a corrupted fragment of a multi-statement item.)
iDbgFoRDNzYK4JrzaiVy: The primary exchanger pre-cools the hot engine bleed air before it enters the pack, and the secondary cools it again after the pack's own compressor has raised its pressure and temperature. Both reject heat to ram air, and the air is at its coldest only after the turbine.
iDmDCxNKKWlsbCvN8lhG: The turbine extracts from the gas stream just enough energy to drive the compressor and the accessories - typically two thirds or more of what the combustion released. What is left over expands through the nozzle to make the thrust.
iEdh1jvTiPRqkx9jlisG: As printed this question has lost the chart it refers to, so no numerical answer can be derived from the stem. Learn the principle instead: on a Lambert, chart convergence is dlong x n where n is the constant of the cone, and earth convergency is dlong x sin(latitude). The two agree only where sin(latitude) = n, i.e. at the parallel of origin, so the latitude is arcsin(constant of the cone).
iEeozKrjjumJNXPByJxT: Pulling up from a dive increases the load factor, and the stall speed rises with the square root of n - so the wing can stall at a much higher speed than its 1g value. This is the accelerated stall. The other options all reduce the stall speed: less weight needs less lift, and retracting spoilers restores lift that had been destroyed. Modest altitude changes have little effect on the stalling IAS.
iEtJkE2X6SFXKbGFfkhq: The symbology escalates with the threat: an open diamond for other traffic, a filled white or cyan diamond for proximate traffic, a filled amber circle for a traffic advisory and a filled red square for the aircraft causing a resolution advisory.
iF6f4w5TxJffpCrI9QU9: NAT MNPS airspace runs from FL285 to FL420. The usable levels inside it - FL290 to FL410 - are the RVSM levels to which the MNPS lateral and vertical accuracy standards attach.
iFpV40bo5MAHkQF46tdF: When an aircraft is well above the PAPI approach slope, all four light units appear white. As the aircraft descends to the correct slope, the two nearest units transition to red while the farthest two remain white.
iFrQdJ0RhFLt5nI9w0hg: Illusions are the normal output of a perceptual system that constructs the world from incomplete cues - they are not a sign of defective senses and they cannot be trained away. What can be done is to recognise the conditions that produce them and to check the constructed picture against instruments that are not subject to it.
iGP8W9dLuNRxaqUIfO8e: Halon 1211 (BCF) interrupts the chemical chain reaction rather than cooling or smothering, so it works across the whole list: paper, fabric and wood (class A), hydrocarbons (class B) and live electrical equipment, being non-conductive. That breadth is why it became the standard cabin extinguisher.
iGh5IQMatmJfWk434GGu: An error of 3 minutes or more in an estimate must be reported to ATS without delay, because longitudinal separation over the North Atlantic is measured in TIME. A slipping estimate directly erodes the separation the controller has applied.
iHm0rOKCi3W2747eOHii: The wind from 040 is on the port bow of the 076 heading, so it pushes the aircraft right and takes speed off. Resolving the vectors gives a track of about 083 and a groundspeed of about 204 kt, i.e. about 7 degrees of starboard drift.
iI1ZPXyeIJK8UE07qxQe: Work outwards in order. True heading = true track minus right drift = 070 - 10 = 060. Magnetic heading = true heading plus west variation = 060 + 30 = 090. Compass heading = magnetic heading minus deviation = 090 - (+1) = 089.
iITdXHfavn6yz9uWmDZF: The first defence against cold is to stop losing heat, and that means intense vasoconstriction of the peripheral vessels, shutting down blood flow to the skin and limbs so the core is preserved. Shivering then generates heat at high metabolic cost. Vasodilatation is the response to heat and would accelerate the loss.
iJamZ6qU8B6zYVt1rf96: At FL60 the density is about 80% of sea level, so TAS exceeds IAS by roughly ten per cent (1). At 100 kt compressibility is negligible, so EAS and CAS are effectively the same (2). And with no instrument or position error the reading is by definition CAS (3).
iKJsnBr3IuueCvE7CqEk: The system operates between about 50 ft and 2 500 ft: below 50 ft a warning would come too late to act on and would nuisance-trigger on every landing, and above 2 500 ft the radio altimeter is out of range and terrain is no longer an immediate threat.
iKh2wjMC7IFObbgBVhHW: A FADEC has its own permanent magnet alternator on the engine, so it and its sensors are powered by the engine itself once it is running. That independence is deliberate: a total loss of aircraft electrical power does not affect engine control.
iKpoXNd0iVj3LfT4k8Xq: In an unpressurised aeroplane, 10% of the passengers must be supplied for the entire flight time LESS the first 30 minutes, in the band above 10 000 ft and up to 13 000 ft. Above 13 000 ft the requirement steps up to 100% of passengers with no grace period.
iM0dAuR9PFJ4aCoElrlB: A red flare directed at an aircraft in flight means 'notwithstanding any previous instructions, do not land for the time being.' This overrides any prior landing clearance.
iME3bVZu3zQ4UBmXNg7j: Calibrated airspeed at a fixed Mach number depends on the static pressure, which falls throughout the climb, so the CAS decreases whatever the temperature is doing. The constant total temperature tells you the static temperature is constant, so the TAS is unchanged - but that has no bearing on the CAS.
iMkjkUMsX1sRNNGAc16f: 730 ft/min x 0.3048 = 222.5 m per minute, and dividing by 60 gives about 3.7 m/sec. A handy approximation to carry: 200 ft/min is almost exactly 1 m/sec.
iN9Ci29W5xaFwPLpuSGk: The First Freedom of the Air is the right to fly over another State's territory without landing. The Second Freedom is the right to land for technical purposes. The Third and Fourth Freedoms cover carrying passengers between States.
iNCy9xuuAaEt8Rm5xinB: A take-off alternate is required whenever the weather or the aeroplane's performance would make it impossible to return to the departure aerodrome - departing with the field below landing minima being the common case. It is not tied to flight duration, over-water distance or the number of engines.
iNbIQwaSPKtFTtGxw9za: The mixture is altered by varying the fuel delivered, either with a needle in the fuel passage or by back-suction on the float chamber. The air side belongs to the throttle alone, and temperature is not a control input at all.
iNm6GtW8l6Pr4wSFXVdc: That wording is the definition of a caution: the crew must know about it at once, and they will have to do something about it, but not immediately. A warning demands immediate recognition and immediate corrective action, and an advisory needs only awareness with action that may or may not follow.
iO6106LCTOJOCJPwMG53: Planned time for 475 NM at 315 kt is 90.5 minutes, so the planned ETA is 1130.5. At 1040 the aircraft has 285 NM still to run and only 50.5 minutes left, so the groundspeed needed is 285 x 60 / 50.5 = about 339 kt, i.e. 340 kt. Always work from the time REMAINING to the planned ETA, not from the average so far.
iOEefglZrv5ox4cqg4y9: In a free turbine engine the power turbine is on its own shaft, aerodynamically coupled to the gas generator but mechanically separate from it. That is what lets the output shaft run at its own speed, or stop altogether with the gas generator still running - the basis of every turboprop and turboshaft rotor drive.
iOHkoNyRdsXoWT2RdwrJ: The inner loop stabilises the aeroplane about its own axes, doing what the pilot's hands do; the outer loop decides where it should be going and commands that inner loop to get there. Guidance always works through stabilisation, never directly on the surfaces.
iOSt3RT8A1tBIpHyRwTd: A gas-filled detector responds to temperature, so testing it means simulating that temperature: heat applied to the sensing element raises the gas pressure and operates the pressure switch, proving the detector as well as the warning circuit.
iOVdu4JGjRwMdqPM1Sl5: Pressure changes act on the air-filled middle ear. If the Eustachian tube cannot equalise fast enough - typically on descent, and especially with a cold - the pressure difference stretches the tympanic membrane, causing pain, hearing loss and possibly rupture. The cochlea and vestibular organs are fluid-filled and are not directly affected by pressure change.
iOc9cbQG8x321CSeesLx: A double white cross displayed horizontally in the signal area indicates glider operations are being conducted. Powered aircraft should exercise caution for glider activity in the vicinity.
iOfJ7VuPbmkCFquDJTHg: Transport wander comes from the aircraft moving over the earth, so the local meridian beneath it changes. How fast that happens depends on how quickly the aeroplane is covering the ground, in what direction, and at what latitude, where the meridians converge more sharply.
iPGfmE6mdXkZGV6105t4: Relative (or percentage) thickness is the maximum thickness of the aerofoil expressed as a percentage of the CHORD - a dimensionless ratio, so aerofoils of different sizes can be compared directly. Typical values run from about 18% on a light aircraft to 8-12% on a transport jet, where thin sections are used to raise the critical Mach number.
iQvTO3El9evyNXGiZqmt: Fuel at take-off is the block fuel less the taxi fuel: 30 000 - 800 = 29 200 kg. The traffic load is then what the take-off limit leaves: 145 000 - 90 000 - 29 200 = 25 800 kg. Using the block fuel instead would give 25 000 kg, which is the answer to a different question.

jE4dIBlDyWYK0qtLDrSw: Jet A freezes at about -40°C against Jet B's -50°C, so Jet A's freezing point is the higher - statement I is correct. jEC3E0AvdqhFfCtiJbHY: Stress arises from appraisal: the individual weighs what he believes the situation demands against what he believes he can do about it, and it is that subjective judgement rather than any objective property of the event which determines whether stress occurs. jG7VkamHQ4LhuN2pX80l: On a high bypass engine most of the thrust is produced by the fan, so reversing the cold stream alone recovers most of the reverse thrust available. A hot stream reverser would add weight, cost and complexity for a small gain, so it is normally omitted.
jGlIaaJQGmSB4L55o9Bh: A large transport aeroplane has to be trimmed over an enormous range of speed, weight and CG, and a small trim tab simply cannot generate enough hinge moment to hold the elevator where it is needed at the extremes - particularly with full flap at a forward CG. jGlrZv8JCIZsqbhvExHC: Alignment does two things: it levels the platform on the local vertical, using the accelerometers to detect any tilt, and it finds true north by gyrocompassing on the horizontal component of the earth's rotation. Only then does the platform know which way its axes point.
jGsIR4PtvMkWUsK7yaCA: A VOR radial is generated AT THE STATION and is referenced to magnetic north there, so the variation needed to convert it to a true bearing for plotting is the one at the VOR. jGyjCnA3Ig0bCKUkgOEh: Alerting Service is provided by the ATS unit responsible for the aircraft at that moment, which may be any ATS unit (ACC, approach, aerodrome). It is not limited to units with 121.5 MHz equipment.
jHpwAAeZgGenUw0aB85P: The IRS position can only be set on the ground during alignment, with the aircraft stationary and its position known. jHukgTTrgJDtDulEUavO: On a Direct Mercator the scale expands as the secant of latitude, so a fixed chart length covers LESS ground the further from the equator you go. jIFj78EpqW9nzWauqIN3: Automating a skill is what buys spare capacity: once the motor programme runs by itself it needs almost no conscious attention, leaving the limited cognitive resource free for monitoring, anticipation and decision making. jIkQGvCQ5gL5rQIjG7ux: Climbing without leaning leaves the mixture progressively richer as the air thins, so the fuel burns incompletely and lays carbon on the plugs. Fouled plugs give rough running and a drop on the magneto check - which is why the mixture is leaned as the aeroplane climbs.

jMO37BEKMuSFAeRDKA1O: A runway wider than the pilot is used to subtends a larger angle, so it looks nearer and lower than it is. Correcting for a height error that does not exist, the pilot flies higher than the correct profile and arrives high and fast - a long landing or an overshoot.
jNQlj6UL4hnGyfTz186a: The TAF is valid 1500-2400. The main body forecasts 9999, meaning 10 km or more. jNpllTVBt8CggWt60B6f: Spanwise flow toward the tips thickens the outboard boundary layer, so a swept wing stalls at the TIPS first. jO5wcmF28v7Ugz9hhY2e: A cabin descending in level flight means the cabin pressure is rising while the outside pressure is unchanged, so the differential is increasing without limit. jOfjCHBVa6wCPDAUhCYx: Climbing at a constant CAS the true airspeed rises as the density falls, while the temperature and with it the speed of sound fall. jPxOTLr7C98pdtL9oSDj: Cigarette smoke contains carbon monoxide, which binds haemoglobin over 200 times more readily than oxygen. jQ3b1gcy0AI0p2UHhFsO: PANS-OPS is explicit that a turn must not be required at the same moment as the power reduction of a noise abatement procedure - two workload peaks and two flight path changes at once is the classic recipe for a mishandled departure. jQWIeP2FFHpofWLLMInD: Freezing precipitation is liquid precipitation that is supercooled when it strikes a surface, so it can only be freezing rain (FZRA) or freezing drizzle (FZDZ). jRaDmEJGyr1W09oJOvBt: At a fixed flight level and Mach number the static pressure and the pressure ratio are both fixed, so the calibrated airspeed - and hence the IAS - is unchanged. The speed of sound rises with temperature, though, so the true airspeed increases.
jRgn6D5mzmBzjRqlv95H: The reduction gear's fixed annulus tries to rotate with the torque being transmitted, and it is held by pistons whose oil pressure is therefore proportional to that torque. jSl1QRZ2KDCITZeZAYg5: The ICAO marshalling signal for 'set/apply brakes' is to raise arm and hand horizontally in front of body with fingers extended, then clench fist. This visually communicates the braking action.
jSwHVUR79g7ZFMVY018W: The pilot-in-command is responsible for ensuring terrain clearance when following an ATC clearance. ATC provides separation from other traffic, but terrain clearance remains the PIC's responsibility.
jTLmfjgEf7xJYONyvpvn: The two positions share the longitude 060 15W and HO is the more northerly, so HO lies due north of YYR, a true bearing of 000. jTQXbmS3lgV804pfTICe: Descend to the lowest safe level - raising the ambient pressure stops the bubbles growing - and land as soon as possible so the casualty can be assessed and, if necessary, recompressed. jTaYr4jtvgmQgPkd1U39: Under JAR-FCL, a CPL(A) applicant completing an integrated course must have at least 150 hours of flight time as pilot of aeroplanes with a JAA-accepted certificate of airworthiness.
jTd5l7goKLBXCjCqWqJS: The four pendulous vanes hang beneath the gyro's outlet ports and are displaced by gravity whenever the gyro tilts, unbalancing the air jets so that the resulting torque precesses the rotor back upright. It is the erection system of an air driven artificial horizon.
jUEtRb2HScrEHGTCBvK0: The respiratory centre is driven principally by the blood carbon dioxide level, sensed as a change in pH: a rise makes the blood more acid and the centre responds by increasing the rate and depth of breathing until the excess is cleared. jUl6XpO6Xx5wRC0SvYEL: ICAO Doc 4444: longitudinal time-based separation at the same level with 20 kt speed differential (leader faster) and frequent position determination = 5 minutes. Without differential = 10 minutes.
jVOfHsdKQKab1xEDBBMx: All six matter: the type and intensity of the precipitation, the ambient temperature, the humidity, the wind, the temperature of the aeroplane's own skin - a cold-soaked wing after a long sector destroys holdover quickly - and the fluid's type, concentration and temperature. jW3eNUD1aMafPkURrmNK: Fail safe means more than one load path, so that when one member cracks the load redistributes into the others and the structure still carries limit load until the damage is found at inspection. It is what removes reliance on any single part never failing.
jWdMF86DiRpaGKPwgfqw: On a 3 degree path the height is about 300 ft per nautical mile, so 2500 ft corresponds to 2500 / 300 = about 8.3 NM from the threshold. The same relationship in reverse gives the familiar rate of descent of about five times the groundspeed.
jX2LS8PGecDNnoCgFuSD: Octane rating measures resistance to detonation, and detonation is provoked by the pressure and temperature reached at the end of the compression stroke. jXIPvTVGSlOyIG9uGgTr: Physiological stressors act on the body itself: noise, heat and cold, humidity, vibration, hunger, thirst, illness and sleep deprivation. jXffBMRvCULcZ7njDyDi: Induced drag coefficient is proportional to CL squared divided by aspect ratio, so a HIGH aspect ratio wing produces LESS induced drag: its tips are a smaller proportion of the span, so the tip vortices influence less of the wing and the downwash is reduced. jXrRRmgLjQidJyHnbMoB: Directly over the beacon the VOR signal is unusable and the deviation swings wildly, so the autopilot ignores it and simply holds the heading it had until valid guidance returns on the other side. jY7PQSOgdRFH1SWGAcSu: ICAO wake turbulence distance-based separation for landing: Heavy preceding Light = 6 NM. This is the minimum radar separation to allow the vortices from the Heavy aircraft to dissipate.
jYEbUqyJ3d4YPyejFcai: The absolute ceiling is the altitude at which the excess thrust or power has fallen to zero, so the rate of climb is theoretically zero and only one speed - where VX and VY have converged - can be flown in level flight. jYVUbs1fbYs9ynYiurVz: Class B is a fire of liquid or liquefiable solid - fuel, oil, grease, paint. Class A is solid organic material, class D covers metals, and electrical fires form their own category because the hazard is the live current, not the fuel.
jYkdDioPcMdQ1ojqqKix: Where the AFM gives no specific wet-runway data, the required landing distance must be increased by 15% over the dry figure. jYtKFNB5FPwUPpIyIOEy: Homeostasis is the maintenance of a stable internal environment - temperature, blood glucose, pH, fluid balance - in the face of changing external conditions, through continuous automatic regulation. jZlC2Hx69EsH4ZDSrYkU: Oil pressure must appear within seconds of the shaft turning, because the bearings are running long before the engine lights up. No rise in oil pressure means the start is abandoned at once - nothing else in the oil system matters so much at that moment.
jZw2ULbbe2XKZ0jjpM2d: Decision height belongs to precision approaches, where the glide path gives vertical guidance and the decision is taken at a height on that path. jaRK7uA0lNtECvfzu3ca: The airflow over the fuselage produces a slight suction inside an unpressurised cabin, so the pressure there is a little lower than true ambient static. Selecting the alternate source therefore feeds the instruments a lower pressure, and the altimeter over-reads slightly.
jbI9ZmsTUW6y6OSetnaF: The GPWS modes cover excessive descent rate (2), altitude loss after take-off or go-around (3), unsafe terrain clearance with the aeroplane not configured for landing (4), excessive terrain closure (5) and descent below the glideslope (6). jbU6oYXz8T3uHsgZ5FZv: In an unpressurised aeroplane, occupants of flight deck seats on flight deck duty must be supplied for the ENTIRE flight time above a cabin pressure altitude of 10 000 ft. jbh3yIeVNW9Fs0Pzk5k8: If an aircraft enters the traffic circuit without authorisation, it shall be permitted to land if its actions indicate it desires to do so. Safety takes priority over procedural compliance.
jbhdZXNVlcoRAvqQOz2w: A Fowler flap moves aft as well as down, so it adds lift well behind the original centre of pressure - shifting the whole lift distribution rearward. jbp8tSGlQNw1ZdCujDgD: For a modern aeroplane the flight data recorder threshold is a maximum certificated take-off mass above 5700 kg. jbqMShmmBFwkl3vB8c3m: Time of useful consciousness is the interval between the onset of an inadequate oxygen supply and the loss of the ability to take corrective action. jc89VQEgs5hiqs6zfh0l: During a rapid acceleration the fuel control must not deliver more fuel than the airflow at that instant can support, or the turbine temperature and back pressure will surge the compressor. jgD0QMSOFn6qmdf3jK1c: Oil, grease and any hydrocarbon will ignite spontaneously in contact with high pressure oxygen - no spark is needed. Every part of an oxygen system must therefore be scrupulously free of grease, and hands and tools must be clean before touching it.
jguptDtt1l7jh5KXejz7: Henry's Law states that the amount of a gas dissolved in a liquid is proportional to the partial pressure of that gas above it. jiasfqyAtY1PuGCPPLrq: A composite is fibres - carbon, glass or aramid - embedded in a matrix, usually an epoxy resin. The fibres carry the load along their length and the matrix holds them in place and transfers load between them; neither is useful without the other.
jipXa5ajr3zO3JlZQVBm: A trough is an elongated extension of low pressure, so air spirals in toward it and converges along the trough line. jjc41PxbsuHeSvYmKG24: Professional aviation communication uses a deliberately restricted, standardised vocabulary in which each term has one meaning, precisely to minimise misunderstanding. jjnU8hwrT647tpZaKhgC: The crew are given the two parameters that show the drive is about to fail: oil over-temperature and low oil pressure. Either one is the signal to disconnect, and disconnecting promptly is what prevents the unit seizing and damaging the engine accessory drive.
jk43Jv11VvTX2tOOrYbx: With no surrounding frame of reference the brain attributes the eye's own small involuntary movements to the light, so a fixed star or distant light stared at in the dark appears to drift or manoeuvre. jkj8tpKaxTYFZbbtKX6q: Frequency is the rate at which pole pairs pass a stator winding, so it is the product of rotor speed and the number of pole pairs and nothing else. Field strength sets the voltage; it has no effect at all on the frequency.
jl219ukxLDIr7fey0Tfc: A tropical revolving storm needs a sea surface temperature of at least about 26.5 C through a deep layer, and the oceans reach that only after a full season of solar heating. jl8YVwEtIr6hW0GvLACp: Water settles out of the fuel overnight as the tanks cool and the temperature falls, so the drains are checked before the first flight of the day, once the aircraft has stood long enough for any water to reach the low point. jlp0SJHxIZZUHdTo5bJ0: NAV is the normal operating mode: alignment is complete, the system is computing position, ground speed, track, drift, heading and attitude, and all of it is available to the crew and to the other systems. The other positions are for alignment and attitude-only reversion.
jm3ZsqOTQvC3y86zlWWh: In Class C airspace below 10,000 ft AMSL, a 250 kt IAS speed limitation applies to both IFR and VFR flights. Some question banks mark this as 'not applicable' based on national variations, but the ICAO standard imposes the 250 kt limit.
jmNfn57lqmmsuIItwGO7: A free turbine has no mechanical connection to the gas generator, so if its load is lost - a shaft failure or a propeller runaway - nothing restrains it and it accelerates until the disc bursts. jmYUAyKrfEuQN0qAZ0mb: Descending at a constant Mach number the temperature rises, so the speed of sound and with it the true airspeed increase; and the density rises faster still, so the dynamic pressure and the indicated airspeed increase too. jmocHjAFNrEraA11hxhF: EPR is turbine discharge pressure divided by engine inlet pressure. jnCKxZi74CYM88dyTGfD: At the equinoxes the sun's declination is passing through zero and changing at its fastest, about 0.4 degrees per day, so the length of day changes most quickly then. jnOU1q1Zmk4UmD2b97iY: Pulling the handle isolates the engine: it shuts the LP fuel valve (1), arms the extinguishers (3), closes the bleed, isolation and de-icing valves so the fire cannot be fed or spread (4), and trips the generator off line (5). jnyB9qXPJKIioWlHPzXy: Pressure falls roughly exponentially with height, so the atmosphere's mass is heavily concentrated near the surface: half of it lies below about 5.5 km, which is close to the 500 hPa level (roughly FL180). jpB6nTyezK8haerS795f: Distance covered is 890 x 1.5 = 1335 km = 1335 / 1.852 = 721 NM, which at 60 NM per degree is 12 degrees of latitude. Starting at 10S and tracking north, 12 degrees takes the aircraft across the equator to 02N.
jpFW0YWwJMobTU2hinoQ: Life jackets for every occupant are required once the aeroplane operates over water beyond gliding distance from land, or more than 50 NM from the shore. The 100 NM and 400 NM figures belong to the separate life-raft rule for extended over-water flight.
jpUb28erduRUVrW1o5A9: After a communications failure the aeroplane continues in accordance with the LAST oceanic clearance received and acknowledged, so that ATC can predict where it is and protect the airspace around it. jpwt1wznvZxzHWhf9AGf: A cold swells the Eustachian tube lining so it cannot open, and descent is the dangerous phase because the tube behaves as a one-way valve: expanding air escapes easily on climb, but on descent the rising outside pressure must be forced in. jqUDmgs0IDqaHUHvUaBN: The FMS depends on the inertial position for its own navigation solution, so losing it degrades the FMS directly. TCAS works on the range and bearing of transponder replies and its own pressure altitude, so it neither knows nor cares where on the earth the aeroplane is.
jrOoV4ZfjunKwQUOB6RK: ANDS: Accelerate North, Decelerate South, on east/west headings in the northern hemisphere. jrZCtAnqHWwRKu4Eqz6O: Pressure receptors in and beneath the skin report the force pressing on the body where it contacts the seat, the floor or the controls - the physical basis of the seat-of-the-pants sense. jrekVMqohwcHoiktEHqI: Each slide carries its own bottle of compressed gas, fired as the slide deploys, so inflation takes a few seconds and depends on nothing else on the aeroplane. That independence is essential - an evacuation may follow a crash in which every aircraft system has failed.
jsMI1dUFdCjJSESPd7JQ: Information concerning charges for aerodromes and air navigation services is published in the AD (Aerodrome) part of the AIP, within each aerodrome's entry.
jtAvnuHvWc8mRxp7e6ZD: Information about prohibited, restricted, and dangerous areas is published in the ENR (En-route) section of the AIP. These areas affect en-route navigation and are listed with their boundaries and activity details.
jtKAAPcKdv2dveqM64QU: The Direct Mercator is cylindrical: a cylinder is wrapped around the earth touching at the equator and the graticule is projected onto it, which is why the meridians come out parallel and the parallels have to be spaced ever wider towards the poles. jtgOAhgyx6junjRzDy2L: The yaw damper needs to know the rate of yaw, which is sensed by a rate gyro, sometimes assisted by a lateral accelerometer sensing sideslip. It then applies rudder proportional to that rate, opposing the Dutch roll before it can build.
jtpU5KiifNpfGsLZoLBI: The yaw damper works through a series actuator, which moves the rudder without moving the pedals, so the crew feel nothing and the damper's continuous small inputs do not shake the cockpit controls. jtz3PL4Et6nU0FHVTvLw: The standard upper-air charts sit at roughly 850 hPa near FL50, 700 hPa near FL100, 500 hPa near FL180, 300 hPa near FL300 and 200 hPa near FL390. jutx7Uynky5Gs6fvOlHw: Capacitive reactance is inversely proportional to frequency, so raising the frequency lowers the opposition and, at a fixed voltage, the current rises. A capacitor passes high frequencies readily and blocks DC completely.
jvC24CLKERU3Lqs7lhrU: A mnemonic packages several items into one retrievable unit, which both defeats the seven-item limit of working memory and gives long-term memory a strong retrieval cue. jvVJjbsmWNrdy6SK18sk: In Class B below 3050 m (10,000 ft) AMSL, VFR minima vary by regulatory framework. Some require 5 km visibility with 1500 m horizontal and 300 m vertical from clouds; others allow 'clear of clouds' in Class B.
jvkRfpwuysKPmQllTjVR: With the centre of gravity aft of the hinge, the aileron's inertia makes it lag behind the wing's motion: as the wing bends up the aileron is left behind and trails down, increasing the lift and driving the wing further up. jw7JP10dQLEY34FC3eqg: Mach number is a function of dynamic pressure divided by static pressure, so the instrument compares the difference between total and static with the static pressure itself. That is why a machmeter needs both a pitot and a static input and no temperature information at all.
jwbs2tRFXCkEwkBXjDnL: A slotted flap does two things at once: hinging down increases the CAMBER of the section, and the slot that opens between the wing and the flap ducts high-energy air from the lower surface onto the flap's upper surface, re-energising the BOUNDARY LAYER so it resists separation. jwjUDUUm0sEU3lE5DV3R: The pressure gradient is the rate at which pressure changes with horizontal distance, so a steep gradient shows on the chart as closely spaced isobars and produces a large pressure gradient force - and therefore a strong wind. jwlG9gkHWSGIuldjVcMB: Angle of attack is the angle between the CHORD LINE of the aerofoil and the RELATIVE AIRFLOW (free stream direction). jwrkVpKYoVmubzxdumXx: Each take-off is one full thermal and centrifugal cycle for the hot section, and it is the number and severity of those cycles that consumes low cycle fatigue life. Taking off at reduced thrust makes every cycle a milder one, which is what buys the extra life.

jxZOMIrtCBbwWQhCBYFH: Experience and repetition are what make an expert fast and efficient: the situation is recognised and the response runs automatically. jxiwLZIPxcNBIiwS1x2Z: Density altitude is pressure altitude corrected for the density actually prevailing - in practice, for the departure of the temperature from standard. jzAxghQ3RdFOEhprWEQy: Human performance is limited by attention and by time, so the way to get the most out of it is to plan ahead, automate what can be automated so it costs no attention, and manage the remaining resources actively as the flight develops. jzK0FSIdQr7cICCj1DVX: The rule is capacity after a loss: the rafts carried must be able to take everyone on board even if the raft with the largest rated capacity is unusable. k0oTTXNIBkneNoHiEnfk: Rasmussen's model classifies behaviour by the level of conscious control it needs: skill-based behaviour runs automatically, rule-based behaviour applies a stored if-then procedure, and knowledge-based behaviour reasons out a novel problem from first principles. k1QAhEENPkiyWsZlNB4U: A DME transponder replies at a fixed capacity of about 2700 pulse pairs per second, and each aircraft consumes roughly 27 of those per second, so the beacon saturates at about 100 aircraft. k1foS7ra7xzj22sP2kqp: The FMS predicts fuel from a performance model, an entered starting quantity and the wind it is seeing, so it is an estimate and it drifts if any of those is wrong. The gauges are the legal and practical source of how much fuel is on board, and the FMS figure is a cross-check.
k2A3zsEZICn72yENO3IF: Most adults need about eight hours a night, with a normal spread of roughly six to nine. k39IMbYWfkBoh8hF6QSf: The wing stalls at an angle of attack, so the system needs only the angle of attack (1) and the configuration (4), because slats and flaps change the angle at which the stall occurs. Weight and bank angle change the speed at which that angle is reached, not the angle itself.
k3d7fLhWtzBZPiaawsSG: ICAO Annex 14 states that aerodrome lights may be turned off provided they can be brought back into operation at least 15 minutes before the expected arrival of an aircraft. Some sources cite one hour.
k3gRrO35P1Ji6LJe7ixJ: The fan is on the same shaft as the low pressure compressor and is driven by the low pressure turbine, the last and largest turbine stages. That lets the large diameter fan turn slowly while the core spool runs fast.
k4z5vWfRDOBtxc7oP9Fn: 757.8 km is 757.8 / 1.852 = 409.2 NM. Departure = dlong in minutes x cos(latitude), so dlong = 409.2 / cos47 = 409.2 / 0.682 = 600 minutes = 10 degrees. The hemisphere makes no difference; only the value of the latitude matters.
k59F0XXL6gq014LeFurL: Judgement and decision making are the first faculties alcohol affects, at concentrations well below those producing obvious impairment and without the drinker noticing. k5Q07ryDxFZZe7WB8Pki: Regression under stress is the reappearance of an older, better-learned response in place of the current correct one - typically a procedure from a previous aircraft type. k5by8TGFwvH97xMSNOdJ: A summer mid-latitude cumulonimbus spans temperatures from well above freezing at its base to below -40 C at its top, so it contains all three phases: ordinary water droplets in the warm lower part, supercooled water droplets in the 0 to -20 C zone, and ice crystals in the glaciated upper part and anvil. k5mMPsLeZZAhjSKjUMOy: If visual contact is lost during circling, the pilot should make an initial climbing turn towards the landing runway to regain a safe altitude, then initiate the published missed approach procedure.
k6K2JSDCFlnjzDv9hybV: A controlled airspace extending upwards from a specified limit above the earth is a Control Area (CTA). An advisory airspace provides advisory service, not ATC. A control zone extends from the surface.
k6XEPg9WMVplasqj5rId: Dalton's Law says that each gas in a mixture exerts a partial pressure proportional to its share. k6bsWEYSfjdftbn3zflh: At a constant Mach number and altitude the thrust required is essentially fixed, so the fuel flow follows the engine's specific fuel consumption - and a turbojet's SFC rises with the square root of the ambient absolute temperature. k6k3w2uL8fCbpLfo7jWJ: ICAO Annex 14: for two parallel runways, L (left) and R (right) are added as viewed from the approach direction. For three parallels, L, C (centre), and R are used.
k7isZT60FIQ7wrqJZfxF: A great circle and a rhumb line coincide along a meridian and along the equator, so a north/south track shows no difference at all. k83e8zBIdo9dhjUqAHpb: Conditional instability means the environmental lapse rate lies BETWEEN the saturated and dry adiabatic rates: SALR < ELR < DALR. k8W4v4VMtsclkMqZiRYV: True altitude needed is 9800 + 2000 = 11 800 ft. kBH21Qm2HQWQhdRgvDyY: The FMC position is a computed best estimate, weighted from IRS, DME/DME, VOR/DME, GPS and, on approach, the ILS. kCEGIzRdKHFEJsVGUJwg: Air conditioning and pressurisation air is bled from the compressor, where the air is already at a useful pressure and temperature. It cannot come from the turbine section, which carries combustion gases, and the fan or bypass duct pressure is far too low for the job.
kCnAVfGAokw2rqoF3oRV: ICAO Doc 4444 allows 80 NM RNAV distance-based separation when aircraft are crossing levels and each reports distance from the same on-track waypoint.
kD1B8HIvPre0T61JldEd: PET distance from A = D x H / (O + H) = 2484 x 500 / 920 = 1350 NM, and the TIME to reach it is that distance at the outbound groundspeed: 1350 / 420 = 3.21 hours = about 193 minutes. The question asks for time, so do not stop at the distance.
kDC6D47eHKzGlWYHEiAb: Experience shows as anticipation: the flight is prepared thoroughly, the likely problems are thought through in advance and the responses are ready before they are needed, so the crew is acting rather than reacting. kDWmGv9KmcQETcE3R4Ev: The instrument is a rate gyro calibrated against a spring, and its relationship between bank, speed and rate of turn is only exact over the speed band for which it was calibrated. kDwmbKDCsAUhkcnPVs5F: Convection over mountains is driven by surface heating, so on an unstable summer day the cumulus builds through the late morning, the cells mature into thunderstorms in the afternoon, and turbulence, downdraughts and reduced visibility peak with them. kDwsjrKO7PyNAQCzjyxT: A second-in-command transitioning to pilot-in-command on the same type must complete an upgrade training program. Initial training is for new types, and recurrent training is for maintaining existing qualifications.

kF2bVf6BdCSj0NLPJD4g: The red or amber indication means the gear is in transit or not locked - the state in which it is unsafe either to land or to assume the gear is up. Green means down and locked and no lights at all means up and locked.
kFATYwS38cBqUC82FjkM: Confirmation bias is the tendency to defend a decision once made: evidence supporting it is accepted readily while evidence that it is going wrong is discounted, explained away or simply not noticed. kFO7h1gNarxKspG8rPwn: The arctic jet is the lowest of the jets, with its core around 20,000 ft (FL200), because the tropopause above the very cold arctic air is itself low. kFaBpRQx8FAoHvOapGmr: Take-off mass is dry operating mass plus traffic load plus fuel, so the dry operating mass is 117 000 - 18 000 - 46 000 = 53 000 kg.
kFe758SQYLu14yKF1FMa: Article 38 of the Chicago Convention requires States to inform ICAO of differences from the standards in any Annex. This is the notification of differences obligation, not about licences or ticket pricing.
kGN5YtjW6GV1hVVq7ziO: Darwin lies on Australia's tropical north coast and is well within the southern-hemisphere cyclone belt. kGsNzjt5gtybPrlWQgMT: The colour convention is red for warnings, which need immediate action, and amber for cautions, which need awareness and later action. Advisory information uses any other colour, usually white or green, which is what keeps red and amber meaningful.
kH4tnJFvLIQGaSshYnGc: Airspeed indicators are calibrated using Saint-Venant's compressible flow relation applied to sea level standard conditions. kIVtshhuDEbWgcyAKcMY: Both statements are wrong. kKW80S3ZQQnwLLb3npz6: A straight line on a polar stereographic chart has a CONSTANT grid track, so it can be computed at any convenient point. kLOMUqvdt5OOGvKEpxmo: The switch is set just below the normal regulated pressure, so the caption appears as soon as the pump can no longer maintain the system - whether from a pump failure, a drive failure or a major leak. Reservoir quantity and accumulator charge are monitored separately.

kMPrjaPbRRwF0OLUTliJ: Permanent approval to carry dangerous goods is granted through the Air Operator Certificate, which lists what the operator is authorised to do. The Certificate of Airworthiness and the Certificate of Registration describe the aircraft, not the operations permitted with it.
kMVtwJu4fxDBTNQQdhrF: Following an accident the operator must preserve the original flight recorder data for 60 days, unless the investigating authority directs otherwise. The recordings are evidence, and 60 days gives the investigators time to secure and read them out.
kMe0bsFIJHhloAiUiicV: The air is at its coldest immediately after the expansion turbine, so that is where the moisture condenses and where the separator is placed to collect it before the air reaches the cabin. Separating any earlier would leave the water still in vapour form.
kNHeybXpz1Fnq5RTYG46: Tornadoes need strong low-level moisture, steep instability and marked vertical wind shear together. kNRC4XqIXh2Ieex5jEwx: The immediate response to an acute stressor is the alarm reaction of Selye's General Adaptation Syndrome: adrenaline is released, heart rate and blood pressure rise, blood is redirected to the muscles and attention sharpens - the body mobilises the resources needed to face the threat. kONMVwM0PqaB5msLLD6W: The chemically correct ratio is about 15:1 by mass, so 9:1 has far more fuel than the air can burn - a rich mixture. It is richer than the best power mixture and will run cool, sooty and rough.
kObQ3tn88jc0oU7mlfvk: A cargo hold fire is starved of air first: turn the hold ventilation OFF, then extinguish. Leaving the airflow running feeds the fire and carries smoke and flame into the rest of the aeroplane.
kPAnNW4u9d0bDwi9nXVf: By Newton's third law, the upward force on the wing must be matched by an equal downward momentum imparted to the air - so lift is produced by accelerating a mass of air DOWNWARDS. kPQTKg11MOCWVQzYt7YK: The international distress frequencies are 121.5 MHz (VHF) and 243.0 MHz (UHF). 2182 kHz is a maritime distress frequency. 2430 kHz is not a standard distress frequency.
kQHPNYfRZz6vWD6j9Hvh: The capsule is evacuated, so it responds only to the pressure outside it, and the case is fed static pressure from the static ports. As the aeroplane climbs and static pressure falls, the capsule expands and drives the pointers up the scale.
kQeGfYl24atAfNRrEu2s: The stabiliser setting is scheduled against CG, and a FORWARD CG calls for a nose-UP setting to assist rotation. kQpWrYMP8NHPa0kaqzHZ: A straight jet of water is for class A solids only - fabric, carpet, paper and wood - which it extinguishes by cooling. On liquids it sinks below the fuel and spreads it, on gases it achieves nothing, and on burning metals such as sodium it reacts violently.
kRLU4BPFMvEiQXHxPlE3: A MEDIUM following a HEAVY on approach to the same runway requires 5 NM (9.3 km) of radar separation, or 2 minutes where time is used. The 6 NM / 3 minute pairing belongs to a LIGHT following a HEAVY.

kS9R3jVwMhykpMzuCip0: Apparent wander is 15° per hour times the sine of the latitude: 15 x sin 45° = 10.6°, near enough 10.5° per hour. In the northern hemisphere the apparent movement is to the right, and the latitude nut is set to cancel it.
kSsldLwTBas5wq5CBBqi: The otolith organs sense the resultant of gravity and acceleration and cannot separate the two. kTrPJqP22XUHfk5FHWG5: Physiological stressors act on the body itself: noise, extremes of temperature, humidity, vibration, hunger, thirst, illness and sleep deprivation. kV3Eb994gBZQFU07ykzS: In a pressurised aeroplane, 100% of the passengers must be supplied for the entire flight time at a cabin pressure altitude above 15 000 ft, and in no case for less than 10 minutes. The 10-minute floor covers the emergency descent itself.
kV6YlGSgSZt23koB1A5W: An induction tachometer measures a frequency, so the reading is unaffected by the resistance of the wiring (1) or by temperature (3), and several indicators can be driven from one transmitter (4) because they respond to the frequency rather than drawing power from it. kVTbHy2vtBnW1XM4H2na: The swirl vanes slow the axial flow so that the flame is not blown downstream (2) and set the air spinning so that it mixes intimately with the atomised fuel (3). kWn0Z0rIGo2pNCijNGoX: ANDS: Accelerate North, Decelerate South on east/west headings in the northern hemisphere. Accelerating on a westerly heading therefore gives an apparent turn towards the NORTH. kXx35bAdWoQipfwihs0V: ICAO Annex 1 requires a CPL applicant to hold a current Class 1 medical assessment. Class 2 is for PPL holders only. The Class 1 standard ensures fitness for commercial operations.
kYFiKkrSPz8i53TR5071: The gas charge makes the accumulator compressible, so it absorbs surges and smooths the pump ripple (1), and it holds a quantity of fluid under pressure that will work the brakes or a few actuations after the pumps have failed (3). kYIZ93cBxnCNef2nX5GK: The flight management system holds the whole route and flies it: the lateral path through LNAV, the vertical profile through VNAV, and on the most capable installations the arrival time as well. kYly9ScfVfqiC19lAMOI: Turbulent mixing keeps the atmosphere homogeneous to about 80 km, so the percentage of oxygen in dry air is the same at every altitude an aeroplane reaches. kZNowWHdiMZ5Z6Gnm0TL: NAT MNPS airspace is the block between FL285 and FL420, extending from 27N to the North Pole. Both dimensions matter: an aeroplane without MNPS approval must stay below FL285, and the lateral limits define where the approval is needed at all.

kZu45FiJW6HtnpSq0Dxs: A static inverter is a solid-state unit which takes DC in and delivers AC out, doing electronically what a motor-alternator set used to do mechanically. It is what allows the battery to feed essential AC loads after a generation failure.
kaBQ8MpNWRiMZpcZqXbS: Safe life means the component is tested to establish a life in hours or cycles, and it is then discarded at a fraction of that life whether or not anything has been found wrong with it. There is no second load path, so the part must simply not be allowed to reach failure.

kadx2I7Ot43Kn1uKKbwV: Two points on the same parallel are joined by a rhumb line, and its length is the departure: 10 degrees = 600 minutes, so departure = 600 x cos60 = 300 NM. The 600 NM option is the value at the equator and the 866 NM option has the cosine applied the wrong way round.
karmx4Yb1boUKNEdpyUE: 1.5 inches is 3.81 cm, and at 1:1 000 000 that represents 3 810 000 cm = 38 100 m on the earth, which is 38 100 / 1852 = about 20.6 NM. A handy check for a 1:1 000 000 chart: 1 cm is very nearly 5.4 NM.
kcFvHD8k2RGwsqpLABjt: Kepler's second law: the sun-earth radius vector sweeps equal AREAS in equal times. The earth therefore moves fastest at perihelion and slowest at aphelion, which is one of the two causes of the equation of time, the other being the tilt of the earth's axis.
kcTk8Vr2MGZovVqIClh2: Smoke detection is fitted where a fire could develop unseen and unreached - the cargo compartments and the lavatories. Wheel wells and nacelles are protected by overheat and fire loops instead, since smoke there would simply blow away.

kdKZWX5HvxdoBvbK1yg1: ICAO Doc 8168 specifies protection areas assume turns at 25 degrees bank or the bank angle for 3 degrees/second rate, whichever is lower, for departure and approach. Circling with prescribed tracks uses 25 degrees, and missed approach uses 15 degrees.

mETLs9zcdpeyMwFWaSoY: A cloud containing only water, with no ice phase, cannot use the Bergeron process, so its droplets can only grow by collision and coalescence.
