pLSghJ2C3pnlmZaLw4pf: Carriage of dangerous goods requires the operator to be approved and to comply with the ICAO Technical Instructions (Doc 9284) - classification, packing, labelling, documentation, loading, notification to the commander and crew training. Passengers may be carried on the same flight, and no per-flight approval of the transport document is required.
pLgv5tNJT38dLOrbcB2W: Envelope protection keeps the aeroplane within its flight limits: bank angle (2), angle of attack (3), speed (4) and pitch attitude (5). Cabin altitude is a pressurisation matter and has nothing to do with the flight control laws.
pLlxHtAdHBp6ZuwS2Rtm: Final reserve fuel for a turbine aeroplane is 30 minutes at holding speed at 1500 ft above AERODROME ELEVATION in standard conditions, calculated at the estimated arrival mass, at the alternate or at the destination when no alternate is required. Note the datum: 1500 ft above the aerodrome, not above mean sea level, which matters at any high-elevation destination.
pNlyHIyjY4u41b0kd86A: With the static blocked, the pressure in the instrument case is frozen at the value it had when the blockage occurred. Climbing, the true static falls while the trapped value stays high, so the difference the instrument sees is too small and the ASI under-reads; descending, the reverse happens and it over-reads.
pOJa5XAOk3i0Xi5GwqPF: Saturation falls as the alveolar oxygen partial pressure falls, which happens as air pressure drops and therefore as altitude increases (1 and 3), and it falls when carbon monoxide occupies haemoglobin that would otherwise carry oxygen (2). Increasing air pressure has the opposite effect, raising both the partial pressure and the saturation.
pP19lNJKl2UzPxSvrxSm: All four are used. A magnetic sensor gives an induced AC signal whose frequency follows the speed, a DC generator gives a voltage proportional to speed, and single-phase and three-phase AC generators give an output whose frequency does the same. Frequency-based types are the more accurate.
pPCzoKuKIhm64LsnqhTH: The extinguisher table runs one for 7-30 seats, two for 31-60, three for 61-200, then four for 201-300 with one more per hundred seats after that.
pPRpgTXr4Ld2Y2npDgll: The intruder's transponder reports its pressure altitude in the reply, and your system compares that with your own pressure altitude. Because both are referenced to 1013 hPa, any error in the setting cancels out - which is why the vertical separation TCAS computes is reliable.
pQLUDd9HYyoFA7efX0uT: The airspeed indicator is calibrated for sea level standard density, so with those exact conditions the calibrated airspeed and the true airspeed are the same. Anywhere else the thinner air makes the TAS the greater of the two.
pRseAama1V0lACVfNPTk: An inertial system integrates accelerations, so it produces ground speed (3), true track (4), position, attitude, true heading and drift. Mach number is an air data quantity and satellite tracking belongs to the GPS receiver.
pSPBc4vkiwdxNPwnxlP7: Automation offloads work to the machine, so the pilot's remaining actions become highly routine and run at the skill-based level with little conscious monitoring. Skill-based behaviour is efficient but vulnerable to slips - the right intention carried out with the wrong action. Mistakes, by contrast, are failures of planning at the rule- or knowledge-based level.
pSTs8PyTHUd5JB358aHb: Selye's General Adaptation Syndrome runs alarm, in which adrenaline mobilises the body; resistance, in which an elevated but sustainable level of coping is held, largely by cortisol; and exhaustion, in which the reserves are spent and performance and health break down. The response is the same whatever the stressor, which is what 'non-specific' means.
pSYliTqBfRtomO0vPU0K: During an IFR arrival in VMC, the pilot-in-command is responsible for traffic avoidance. In VMC, the see-and-avoid principle applies even for IFR flights.
pTDWiC95NlUGTsOkfIuO: A thermal or heat low is created by intense surface heating, which requires a surface that warms rapidly - land - and strong insolation - summer. The heated air expands and rises, lowering the surface pressure and drawing in a converging inflow. The sea has a huge heat capacity and warms far too slowly to do this. The Iberian and Saharan summer heat lows, and the monsoon low over India, are the classic examples.
pUL5e27Ke8LW8kCwlW6m: Guidance is the outer loop: it decides what attitude is needed to follow the chosen path - a heading, a level, a beam or a route - and commands the stabilisation loops to produce it. Stability functions merely hold the aeroplane steady about its axes.
pUQvQntrrcMUvmeZgBP2: The system waits for proof that the aeroplane is really on the ground, and wheel spin-up is that proof: the main wheels accelerating to ground speed cannot happen in the air. The spoilers then deploy immediately, putting the weight on the wheels so that the brakes can work.
pUrjiFsJjDNvtKvT6tFt: Magnesium alloy is the lightest structural metal available and is stiff enough for a casing that carries no primary flight load, so gearbox and accessory casings are made of it. Its poor corrosion resistance is dealt with by protective treatment.
pVlTPQT5JRoF4cKN6226: Emergency messages, including MAYDAY, are sent as controller-pilot datalink messages, which is the application carrying the crew's own communications with ATC. Automatic dependent surveillance reports position automatically and carries no crew message.
pVnuYxSLlAeJjkiFyal8: The SNOWTAM braking action scale runs from 0.40 and above (good) down through medium/good, medium and medium/poor, with 0.25 and below reported as POOR. The descriptive term is what the crew relates to landing performance data.
pXskwZXvsrzFhS7Twj92: The local speed of sound depends only on temperature: LSS = 38.94 x root(218) = about 576 kt. TAS = Mach x LSS = 0.80 x 576 = about 461 kt. The flight level affects the answer only through the temperature that goes with it, and here the temperature is given directly.
paeWrru1ORefM02HFhkm: As the parcel rises it expands and cools, but no water is added or removed, so the mass of vapour it carries per unit mass of air is unchanged: specific humidity and mixing ratio stay constant. What changes is how close that fixed amount is to saturation, because the saturation capacity falls steeply as the parcel cools - so RELATIVE humidity rises, reaching 100% at the condensation level.
pbRxzH8y4og5oAGo9Lvq: Sublimation is the change of state directly between vapour and ice without passing through the liquid phase, and in meteorological usage the term covers both directions. It is the process that builds cirrus, that deposits hoar frost on a cold airframe, and by which ice crystals grow at the expense of supercooled droplets in the Bergeron process that produces most mid-latitude precipitation.
pbat5gMiWU42iEcMFmab: Hyperventilation is a carbon dioxide deficit driven by over-breathing, so the remedy is to take conscious control of the rate and depth of breathing and slow it deliberately, letting the CO2 level recover. Oxygen addresses the wrong gas, the Valsalva manoeuvre is for the ears, and descending does nothing about the ventilation.
pc0UhC6EYAjgrXM7Gjn9: All three are true: an aircraft without a working transponder is invisible to TCAS (1), the system interrogates other aircraft directly and needs no ground input (2), and it takes radio height so that advisories can be inhibited close to the ground (3).
pd5a7iR1HjAfhovgxADA: Mode C transponder with altitude reporting should be operated continuously unless otherwise directed by ATC. ATC may instruct 'stop squawk Mode C' in specific situations.
pdcMMpG0nTlPG6okEv5n: Changing the subscale changes the reading by about 27 ft per hPa. Going from 1013 to 1000 is a decrease of 13 hPa, so the indication falls by 13 x 27 = 351 ft: 8000 - 351 = about 7650 ft. With QNH below 1013 the QNH altitude is always lower than the corresponding flight level - the aircraft is closer to the ground than the flight level number suggests.
pemFH0Imh3f9WudMe3fN: When an alternate airport has no ICAO identifier, ZZZZ goes in box 16 and the name is given in box 18 using ALTN/ (not DEGT/). DEGT is not a valid ICAO flight plan indicator.
piaRTAv5jcUwfK0XCsSH: As printed this question gives no starting altitude, so it cannot be worked as stated - from sea level the answer would be about 6.7 NM, which is not offered. Learn the method: time = height to climb / rate of climb, then distance = groundspeed x time. Here the groundspeed is 100 - 20 = 80 kt, so every 1000 ft of climb at 1000 ft/min costs about 1.3 NM of ground distance.
pib0aSgkhi5rOCyh4YO2: The State in which the aircraft lands after an act of unlawful interference must notify, by the most expeditious means, the State of Registry, the State of the Operator and ICAO, in addition to the States whose citizens are aboard. The JAA is a regional body with no role in that notification chain.
pjtzB2TIxY2ajDQp6RbS: ATC clearances are issued to achieve separation between controlled flights. FIS, alerting, and advisory services are provided through other mechanisms.
pkGilec1S2PqpKVwiEYa: Vortices sink and then drift with the wind, so a wind from the right carries them to the left. Staying on the right - the upwind side - and above the preceding aircraft's path is what keeps you clear.
pkRhyDaDSJQcm1mMK6zi: A 5 degree change in angle of attack raises CL by 5 x 0.09 = 0.45, so the new lift coefficient is 0.4 + 0.45 = 0.85. Because the speed has not changed in that instant, the lift is directly proportional to CL, so the load factor is simply the ratio of the new coefficient to the old: 0.85 / 0.4 = 2.13. Note how a modest gust produces over 2 g - which is why turbulence penetration speed matters.
pm61boHCwMZofpSENXxo: The instantaneous vertical speed indicator adds an accelerometer-driven pump or vane which anticipates the pressure change at the onset of a climb or descent, filling in the lag while the capsule and calibrated leak catch up. It removes the six seconds or so of delay of a plain VSI.
pmZPWq6WuO0ZJnhMU4Ml: Convert to true first: with 15E variation the true track is 225 and the true heading 230, so there is 5 degrees of port drift. Groundspeed is 64 NM in 12 minutes = 320 kt. Resolving the 230/360 air vector against the 225/320 ground vector gives a wind from about 265 degrees at 50 kt.
pn8Dz0uIfpTqoh9eBGet: Tip vortices are produced by the pressure difference that generates LIFT, so they exist from the moment lift is established - at rotation - and cease at touchdown. Drag and wheel spin-up have nothing to do with them.
pnVUyb2WnodPhZsxK9yr: The bars are simply the flight director's display, so switching the flight director off removes them from the attitude display. That is what a pilot does when hand flying without reference to the commands - the autopilot is a separate matter.
pnsBa4ZzLDjUaIbrDVBw: The mental model is built from both directions at once: incoming sensory information supplies what is happening now, and stored experience supplies the framework that gives it meaning and fills the gaps. Neither alone is sufficient, and the fact that experience does the filling is why the model can be confidently wrong.
po5smvfL0ws9x1X8q7zp: The wind from 160 lies 52 degrees off the port bow of the 212 course, so the crosswind is 50 x sin52 = about 39 kt and the headwind is 50 x cos52 = about 31 kt. Allowing about 10 degrees of drift correction, the groundspeed is about 220 x cos10 - 31 = about 186 kt. Course and wind are both magnetic, so no conversion is needed.
poDhuQN3k4K8KHpDLnnP: Dynamic pressure is the pressure rise produced by bringing the flow to rest, which is total pressure minus static pressure at the same point. The ratios in the other options belong to Mach number computation, not to dynamic pressure.
poV9ci3T1GDZxUDAy2cK: Focusing on a near object requires more refraction, so the ciliary muscle contracts, the suspensory ligaments slacken and the elastic lens becomes more convex - more spherical. It flattens again for distance. Age stiffens the lens so it can no longer make this change, which is presbyopia.
poYx7Uu7IlFs2zkMBaZ4: CS-25.113(b) defines the take-off RUN as the distance from brake release to a point equidistant between the point at which VLOF is reached and the point at which the aeroplane is 35 ft above the take-off surface - so half the airborne segment is counted. It is distinct from the take-off DISTANCE, which is measured all the way to the 35 ft screen, and from the accelerate-stop distance.
ppbyNP3z3bnbAtgaIquy: The feathering pump is an electrically driven auxiliary oil pump, because it has to supply pressure to the pitch change mechanism precisely when the engine, and with it the engine-driven pump, has stopped. It is used both to feather and, in reverse of the process, to unfeather.
pqFLNAWOhCd0FnR1Qtva: Air can only be drawn into the cylinders by a pressure difference, and the throttle butterfly adds a further restriction, so the manifold pressure of a running unsupercharged engine is always below ambient. With the engine stopped the gauge simply reads the ambient pressure.
pqXZT6QAETySdxMjI6LN: Statements 2 and 3 are correct: many medicines have effects incompatible with flight safety, and adequate fluid intake matters in a cabin at 5-15% humidity. Statement 1 is wrong because diving loads the tissues with nitrogen and requires a delay of up to 24 hours before flight, and statement 4 is plainly false - diet affects cardiovascular risk, blood glucose stability and night vision among much else.
prfSh7taLdau9m895mXj: A horn balance places part of the control surface area FORWARD of the hinge line, so the airflow acting on it produces a moment that assists the pilot's input and reduces the hinge moment to be overcome. It is a form of aerodynamic balance, aimed at reducing stick forces. MASS balance is a different device entirely - a weight ahead of the hinge fitted to prevent flutter.
ps5NSb0oEJLmyvrVdnXJ: ICAO Annex 2: over mountainous terrain, IFR flights must maintain at least 2000 ft above the highest obstacle within 8 km. The question asks about mountainous areas, so the 2000 ft / 8 km rule applies.
psnHuOlMK7Ha5L4sFApX: DECIDE - Detect, Estimate, Choose, Identify, Do, Evaluate - is a prescriptive generic model: it does not describe how pilots actually decide but sets out the steps they ought to follow, in an order that keeps the analysis complete under time pressure. Its value is that it forces the evaluation step, which is the one most often skipped.
pv7XuBbcfYnNXlrIrhA6: Two corrections. QNH 1032 is 19 hPa above 1013, so the indicated altitude is 10 000 + (19 x 27) = about 10 510 ft. At ISA-15 the aircraft is LOWER than indicated: 4 ft per 1000 ft per degree gives about 630 ft, so the true altitude is about 9880 ft, i.e. approximately 9900 ft. The station being 100 ft below sea level changes the answer by only a few feet.
pwHIfyPumsOaiA01AcTh: Endurance for a PSR uses only the fuel you may actually burn: 15 000 - 3500 = 11 500 kg at 2150 kg/h = 5.35 hours. Groundspeed out is 425 - 30 = 395 kt and home is 430 + 20 = 450 kt. PSR = E x O x H / (O + H) = 5.35 x 395 x 450 / 845 = about 1125 NM.
pz8r8e5S4IffUzdrBk9r: The semicircular canals respond only to angular acceleration - fluid inertia deflects the cupula when rotation starts or stops. At a constant rate of turn the fluid catches up and the sensation fades, which is why a sustained turn comes to feel like straight flight and why rolling out then feels like a turn the other way.
pzagE7Yg0SrN1oTuYlkv: Standard time is whatever a government decides for its territory, so zone boundaries follow national and administrative lines rather than neat 15 degree meridians, and some countries use half-hour or even 45-minute offsets. Nor is the sign always what the longitude suggests: some territories deliberately sit on the far side of the date line from their nominal longitude.
q02QyFbQkbfQzkDxjw9k: BR is mist - a suspension of water droplets reducing visibility to between 1000 m and 5000 m - so the visibility of 2000 m is being reduced by water droplets. Reading the rest: R26R/P1500 means the RVR exceeds the maximum assessable value, while R26L/1500 is exactly 1500, so the two runways differ. The trailing N on each is the tendency indicator meaning No distinct change, which rules out both 'increasing' and 'distinct change'.
q0F07m7hrjnfc91bfPtS: A resolution advisory is a vertical manoeuvre, so the system must know the intruder's altitude - which means the intruder needs at least a mode C transponder. A mode A reply gives identity only, so such an aircraft can generate a traffic advisory but never an RA.
q1BYvxMw93pIRnA1ifqi: Basic mass is the airframe with its standard equipment and the unusable fuel and other unusable fluids, but without the crew, without mission-specific equipment and without payload. It is the fixed starting point to which everything else is added.
q1FWpSoZQf7gq6ym2di9: In a climb the elevator is used to hold the speed, so the autopilot's pitch channel does the CAS or Mach holding while the thrust is fixed (1). Once level, or on the glidepath, the elevator is committed to the path, so speed holding passes to the autothrottle (4).
q1X5h7HOBK3LHESc3RWP: A toothed wheel turning past a magnetised probe induces one pulse per tooth, so the pulse frequency is directly proportional to shaft speed and the electronics simply count it. Being a frequency, the reading is unaffected by line resistance, voltage drop or temperature.
q1Ych9pHBdf8p2qfmOOB: ICAO Doc 4444: ATIS should not be transmitted on the voice channel of an ILS, as this could interfere with identification of the ILS facility during approach. It should use a discrete VHF frequency or VOR voice channel.
q2HjprFuHa00X2vGb3NW: ICAO Annex 15: AIP Supplements are used for temporary changes of long duration (3 months or longer) and short-duration information with extensive text/graphics.
q3Vbs9R2sFx2oUfvAaFh: Hot air is less dense, so although the same volume passes the venturi it contains less mass, while the carburettor goes on metering the same fuel - the mixture goes rich. The volume is unchanged; it is the density that falls.
q4GogE3bGn0ciavC8Tqj: Cabin air comes from the engine compressors, and it arrives hot enough that the problem is cooling it. Heating is simply a matter of adding some of that hot bleed air, through a trim valve, back into the cold air leaving the packs.
q4wBDHs9Oe6PGkSDwVk7: Pressure altitude is by definition what the altimeter reads with 1013.25 set, so it is 11 000 ft. The QNH and the temperature are there to tempt corrections that this question does not call for.
q5soDLzgLRDI3wFgd4Pf: The crossfeed manifold links every tank to every engine, so any engine can be fed from any tank. That is what allows a lateral imbalance to be corrected and the fuel of a shut-down engine to be used by the others.
q70MLGQrhC0l2EMU85Gl: Automatic dependent surveillance works by contract, and there are three kinds: periodic reports at an agreed interval, demand reports when the controller asks, and event reports triggered by something happening - a waypoint change, a level bust or an emergency.
q7emtJJ4bTUCZfHWLR8L: Under gradually increasing +Gz the eye suffers first, because the retinal artery must work against both the blood column and the intra-ocular pressure. Peripheral vision dims - greyout - then vision is lost altogether while consciousness remains, and only at higher G does G-LOC follow. Red-out belongs to negative G.
q8Wg6gaS1XclH0ophIv0: Angle of attack is measured between the aerofoil's CHORD LINE and the RELATIVE UNDISTURBED AIRFLOW. It is referenced to the airflow, not to the airframe or the horizon - which is why an aeroplane can be at a high angle of attack in a nose-down attitude, and why the fixed angle between chord and fuselage is a separate quantity, the angle of incidence.
q8sUbQ7GYigyCjcZIrEI: Warning philosophy - what is annunciated, how it is prioritised, what colours and tones mean and how alerts are grouped - is the conceptual, non-physical part of the system, which the SHELL model calls Software. A mismatch there is a Liveware-Software problem, as distinct from the physical layout of the annunciators, which would be Hardware.
qAIb5KdQFCH6frgKO7dw: Low contrast strips out the cues the brain uses for size, distance and closure - texture, edge sharpness, contrast against the background - so an object's size and its rate of approach cannot be judged reliably. Objects are still detected; they are simply misjudged, which is what makes reduced visibility so productive of visual illusions.
qALHIEtI6vqBmHr8k36k: Altostratus carries the 'alto' prefix, which marks medium-level cloud: a base between about 6500 ft and 23,000 ft in temperate regions. It is a stratiform cloud formed by gentle widespread ascent, typically ahead of a warm front, and it renders the sun as a diffuse bright patch as though seen through ground glass - the standard way of distinguishing it from stratus, through which the sun's outline stays sharp.
qBn5iNLX2D7TcnbjWYQg: The ITCZ follows the overhead sun with a lag, but over the open Atlantic its excursion is small because the ocean's thermal inertia damps the seasonal swing - far less than over the continents. In January it sits at its southernmost Atlantic position, close to and just north of the equator, roughly 0-7 N, moving to about 10 N by July. A Dakar-Rio track crosses it in that band.
qCMHg6UiXEO9DUu37Ha8: Static stability describes the INITIAL tendency after a disturbance, and dynamic stability describes what happens over time. If the aeroplane does not even start back toward its original condition, there is nothing for the motion to converge upon - so a statically unstable aeroplane can NEVER be dynamically stable. Static stability is a necessary condition for dynamic stability, though not a sufficient one.
qDGxwjjRMYg0gHwpmB6T: Air-to-air communication in the NAT is on VHF - the frequency designated worldwide is 123.45 MHz, with 131.8 MHz used in the North Atlantic. 121.5 MHz is the emergency frequency, and 243 MHz is not VHF at all: it is the UHF military guard frequency, the emergency channel's UHF counterpart.
qDVBJAOcD0TblFeQlO6m: Hypoxia tolerance and the symptoms produced vary widely between individuals, and vary in the same individual from day to day with fitness, fatigue, smoking and alcohol - which is why each pilot's own symptom pattern, learned in a chamber, is only a rough guide. No tolerance is built by repeated exposure, and carbon monoxide reduces oxygen carriage rather than protecting the brain.
qDiwJtdgs0Pmh6jRqmMS: A class A fire is burning solid organic material, and all four agents will attack it: water cools it, which is why it is the agent of choice; dry chemical and halon interrupt the chain reaction; and CO2 smothers the flame, though without cooling a deep-seated fire can re-ignite.
qDyCzMbi7h7SnGjIxVTd: Bonding the aircraft to the ground equipment before any filler cap is removed ensures there is no potential difference to arc across once fuel starts flowing and generating static. With everything at the same potential, no spark can occur at the filler.
qEXWlckKTKYL0yK7w8FL: The rods are the most oxygen-hungry element in the visual system, so night vision is the first function to degrade - measurably from about 5,000 ft, well below the altitude at which speech, hearing or coordination are affected. This is why supplemental oxygen is recommended for night flying at otherwise unremarkable altitudes.
qFDad8OXWJxrSjZWPypx: Convergency = change of longitude x sine of the mean latitude = 7 x sin60 = about 6 degrees. The flight is westbound in the southern hemisphere, where the great circle track INCREASES as the flight proceeds, so the track at B is about 6 degrees greater than at A.
qFgXRJ8qjSPVF4FLH2Ep: A thermocouple is made by joining two dissimilar metals - chromel and alumel, for instance - at a junction which generates a small emf depending on its temperature. Two conductors of the same metal would generate nothing at all, whatever the temperature.
qFxPGc95TGSmV2RmyLg5: Controlled flight into terrain was the largest single category of hull loss until the ground proximity warning system was mandated, after which CFIT accidents fell sharply. EFIS and the autoflight system changed how aircraft are flown but did not remove a whole accident category, and ATIS is an information service.
qG9EWms3QqPWC2uqjbo1: The exchanger runs the hot scavenge oil against the cold fuel on its way to the burners, so the oil is cooled with no drag or weight penalty and the heat goes back into the engine with the fuel. Warming the fuel enough to keep ice crystals out of the filter is a useful by-product.
qGOUgNSdelFlaFB1IgJz: Integrating acceleration once gives the change in velocity and twice the change in position, but each integration leaves a constant the mathematics cannot supply. Both the initial velocity and the initial position must therefore be provided - which is why an inertial system must be aligned and given a starting position.
qGRKqTo3ugmRdCvUkb37: ARC and MAP show a sector ahead, about 45° either side of track; ROSE and MAP CENTRED show a full compass rose with the current heading at the top; and PLAN presents the route oriented to true north for reviewing the flight plan. All three are standard EFIS presentations.
qGwuuSrDy926YQ87XYZN: Optimum altitude is where the aeroplane achieves its best specific range for its current weight. A lighter aeroplane needs less lift, so it can reach its optimum lift coefficient in THINNER air - the optimum altitude therefore RISES as fuel burns off. This continuous rise is why step climbs are flown through a long cruise, and why the optimum is always quoted against a weight.
qHTlcwTv0NyPWEf6Imiy: The conventional VOR radiates a limacon pattern that is rotated mechanically or electrically 30 times a second. To a receiver anywhere around the station that rotation appears as a 30 Hz AMPLITUDE modulation whose phase depends on bearing. The reference signal is a separate 30 Hz frequency modulation on a 9960 Hz subcarrier, and the receiver compares the phase of the two.
qHhK466H5Wgd9lw4Guwd: Same latitude means the same LMT of sunrise, so convert. At 040E, LMT is UTC + 2 h 40 min, so 0243 UTC is 0523 LMT. At 035W, LMT is UTC - 2 h 20 min, so the same 0523 LMT occurs at 0743 UTC. The 5 hour difference is simply the 75 degrees of longitude between the two positions.
qHqKpguH7VE5xjpH4QhN: The APU is a small gas turbine driving a generator and supplying bleed air, so it provides both electrical power and air conditioning - on the ground routinely, and in the air within its certificated altitude limits. It supplies no thrust and no hydraulic power of its own.
qHsvdOG3KS9dBFob0MN6: The aeroplane never moves, so there is no transport wander - only earth rate. At 59 degrees 57 minutes N that is 15 x sin(latitude) = about 13 degrees per hour, and over the 2 h 30 min delay the gyro accumulates 13 x 2.5 = 32.5 degrees of apparent wander, in the sense that reduces the reading. The error at the moment of alignment is therefore -32.5 degrees.
qIQI6rcHdPLpaoHqlx4P: Frequency is the rate at which the poles pass the stator windings, so it is set purely by rotational speed and the number of poles. That is why a constant frequency supply needs a constant speed drive - excitation controls the voltage, not the frequency.
qIZR1GVf2tNczwnAndCg: The rule has three elements and all must be present: THREE take-offs and three landings, in an aeroplane or approved simulator OF THE TYPE, within the preceding 90 DAYS. 30 days is not a JAR-OPS recency interval, and a count of 'flights' is not the same as take-offs and landings.
qJ3qwb24OavHPgBSqExk: The constant speed drive is a hydromechanical unit - a variable displacement pump driving a hydraulic motor - fitted between the engine gearbox and the generator, and it can be disconnected from that drive in flight if its oil temperature or pressure goes out of limits. Relatching, not disconnecting, is what has to wait for the ground.
qJORP2sjXm0tOJ05M0Xl: Dry operating mass is the helicopter ready for a particular operation: the crew, their baggage, the equipment that operation requires and the unusable fluids, but no traffic load. It is the fixed base to which payload and fuel are added.
qKFifk1S0SzX51KFsI2o: Stable air resists vertical motion, so any lifting spreads out horizontally instead of building upward, producing flat, layered cloud: stratus, stratocumulus, altostratus, nimbostratus and cirrostratus. Cumuliform cloud - cumulus, cumulonimbus and cirrocumulus - requires instability. Nimbostratus is stratiform despite its depth, because it is formed by gentle widespread ascent rather than convection.
qKqKf8oje4qHHCZMw5Xy: This question depends on a diagram this text-only version cannot show, so learn the method instead. Find the DR position from the planned groundspeed and elapsed time, then compare it with the fix to get the along-track distance run and the across-track error. Track error = across-track error over distance RUN x 60; closing angle = across-track error over distance TO GO x 60; the total heading alteration is the sum of the two, and the new true heading is the old one altered by that amount towards the track.
qKvqDwMDBrN2PJxYv9hZ: In conditions where disorientation is possible the body's orientation senses give confidently wrong information, so the defence is a systematic instrument cross-check established before the problem arises and maintained through it. Hunting for outside cues or trusting the natural senses is precisely what turns an illusion into a loss of control.
qL5caBecg4bC56HkzeMX: In a prolonged turn the canal fluid catches up and the sensation of turning dies away. Rolling out then makes the fluid overshoot and signal a turn the other way, so the pilot feels he is banked in the opposite direction and holds a little bank on to feel level - the leans. It is resolved by believing the attitude indicator, not the sensation.
qLKT8YisqvB6hJtBT5ew: The turbocharger's turbine sits in the exhaust and recovers energy that would otherwise go out of the pipe as heat and noise, so the compression costs very little crankshaft power. A mechanically driven supercharger takes its power directly from the engine.
qMGl6R6gmZNT3bU5tXQd: The sensory threshold is the minimum stimulus intensity a receptor will respond to; below it nothing is detected at all. qMKBuhGPy7QSRherHmSS: Turning right from 330 to 040 passes through NORTH, and in the northern hemisphere a turn through north makes the compass UNDER-indicate the turn. qs1u68jHTyRiJ85m1VTi: Losing height just after take-off or during a go-around is mode 3, and its call is 'DON'T SINK'. 'TOO LOW GEAR' and 'TOO LOW FLAPS' belong to mode 4, which is about being close to the ground in the wrong configuration.

rWxckv8oREtoj1kO19yH: Exhaust gas temperature peaks at the chemically correct mixture and falls away either side of it, so the gauge lets the pilot lean precisely - to peak EGT, or a stated number of degrees rich or lean of it - instead of guessing. It is a mixture instrument.

s262HUuQcbvbmYI7uOwz: When hijacked without regional procedures, the pilot should fly at a level differing from normal IFR cruising levels: 1000 ft above FL 290 in non-RVSM, 500 ft above FL 290 in RVSM, or 500 ft below FL 290.
s2fEhenxAJQj67ap40QY: The five modes are excessive descent rate (1), excessive terrain closure (2), altitude loss after take-off or go-around (3), unsafe terrain clearance with the aeroplane not configured for landing (4) and descent below the glideslope (5). Airbrake position is not monitored.
s31aJcVAVFxigJgG8twZ: Tip vortices induce a downward velocity component over the wing, tilting the local relative airflow downward. u2vv1gkNgcIwkSfotWIN: The basic CG at 25% of a 2 m chord is 0.5 m aft of the leading edge of MAC, so that leading edge is at 3.00 - 0.5 = 2.50 m. Adding 160 kg at 2.5 m and 100 kg of fuel at 3.0 m to the 1 200 kg at 3.0 m gives 4 300 kg m over 1 460 kg, a CG at 2.945 m - which is 0.445 m aft of the leading edge of MAC, or 22%.
u3EAsG0hoQJVt1E2bCkh: Shimmy is the violent sinusoidal weaving of the nose wheel at certain ground speeds (1), and it is damped hydraulically - on a steerable gear by the steering actuator working with its accumulator (4), which resists the rapid movements while still allowing steering. The torque link transmits the twist but does not damp it.
u3aXRrkL04zF6Onkhked: Severe turbulence, including severe CAT, is one of the phenomena for which a SIGMET is mandatory, along with thunderstorms, severe icing, severe mountain wave, volcanic ash, sandstorm and tropical cyclone. A SIGMET is a warning of en-route weather hazardous to aircraft, valid for up to 4 hours (6 for volcanic ash and tropical cyclone). A SPECI is a special observation of aerodrome conditions, and meteorology does not close airspace.
u4prCp6qXXHIF6x49RrR: Automatic dependent surveillance does what its name says: once the contract is established the aircraft reports automatically, with no crew action and nothing for the pilot to select. The ground system defines the contract - periodic, on demand or on event.
u52eNjMGH4T4W7EZxFsX: Bypass ratio is bypass flow divided by core flow, not inlet flow divided by exhaust flow, so the first statement is wrong. But bypass flow and HP compressor flow are exactly the two quantities the ratio needs, so the second is right.
u5DiiqacblfuRYpmhG48: This question needs a chart this text-only version cannot show, but the method is the point. Convert the magnetic heading to true using the chart variation (about 6W here), giving about 034(T), then add the 030 relative bearing to get the true bearing to the feature, about 064(T). The aircraft therefore lies on the reciprocal, 244(T), 80 NM from Lands End: 80 x cos244 = 35 NM south of it and 80 x sin244 = 72 NM west, which at this latitude is about 1 51 of longitude, placing the aircraft near 49 25 N 007 30 W.
u5lIg9U3xyvLMcOPdyYV: Alignment levels the platform on the local vertical (1), gyrocompasses to find true north (2) and in doing so establishes the latitude (3), which it then compares with the latitude the crew entered as a gross error check (6). Longitude cannot be sensed at all and must simply be accepted as entered.
u6Uc0e9A3XwagAfQqti4: A moment is a force multiplied by its arm: 49 000 N acting 7 m from the datum gives 49 000 x 7 = 343 000 Nm. Dividing instead of multiplying would give 7 000, which is what the marked answer amounts to.
u6b2YbVt87Tm3rzPgBVC: ICAO Annex 17: each contracting State shall establish its own national civil aviation security programme. ICAO provides guidelines but each State is responsible for its programme.
u6x3qkGbDyi8uh8PaI2F: A super (deep) stall requires the stalled wing's turbulent wake to blanket the horizontal tail, and a T-TAIL sits exactly in that wake at high angles of attack - the elevator loses effectiveness precisely when it is needed to lower the nose. Combined with a swept wing's tendency to pitch up at the stall, the condition can be stable and unrecoverable, which is why such designs carry stick pushers.
u73HaX2899KkTdMyaapB: Relative humidity is the actual vapour content expressed as a percentage of the saturation capacity at that temperature. If the temperature is held constant, the capacity is fixed, so adding water vapour raises the numerator and therefore raises the relative humidity - up to 100% at saturation. Removing vapour lowers it. Temperature affects it too, by changing the denominator.
uABbv6wZmlP6SEgVRWab: Hypoxic hypoxia is a shortage of oxygen in the inspired gas or at the alveoli, so all three produce it: climbing without supplemental oxygen (1), a failure of the oxygen system that should have supplied it (2), and a loss of cabin pressure at altitude (3). The other forms - anaemic, stagnant and histotoxic - arise further down the chain.
uATPJ051by2GoUK669T9: The hierarchy is warning, caution, advisory, so a caution ranks immediately below a warning: it needs immediate crew awareness and subsequent action, and is presented in amber. Immediate corrective action defines a warning, one level above.
uEJp8pKvA9445oI9wBia: Work the heading into true first: compass 237 with -5 deviation is 232 magnetic, and with 19W variation that is 213 true. The wind from 330 is then on the starboard bow of that heading, so it takes speed off. Resolving the 213/360 air vector against the wind gives a groundspeed of about 403 kt.
uELD3i65FwkZI0iZzzqM: A decreasing headwind is a decreasing-performance shear: airspeed falls, lift falls with it and the aeroplane sinks BELOW the glide path. That is the dangerous direction, and low on the approach it calls for the full escape manoeuvre.
uEp4qTir5cWAm6bXtF7N: Hyperventilation is a carbon dioxide deficit, so the fastest fix is to put CO2 back. Rebreathing exhaled air, which contains 4-5% CO2 against the 0.03% in fresh air, restores the blood level within a few breaths and the symptoms subside. It has nothing to do with oxygen, nitrogen or blood pressure.
uG39kzAAfl1sSSfMR6vL: TEMPO describes temporary fluctuations expected to last LESS THAN ONE HOUR in each instance, and in aggregate less than half of the period covered by the group. If a change is expected to persist for an hour or more, the forecaster must use BECMG or a new time-referenced group instead. That one-hour ceiling is what distinguishes a TEMPO deterioration from a lasting one when assessing alternate requirements.
uGD62oowr75CX65x3TV7: The system compares the actual altitude with the one selected and alerts the crew as they approach it - typically 900 or 750 ft to go - with a light, a tone or both, and again if they subsequently deviate from it. It is a defence against level busts and has no connection with the trim system.
uGKekGZ7Pgwxk9P1t05a: Human factors are cited in the region of 70-80% of aviation accidents, and the figure has been broadly stable for decades while technical causes have fallen away - which is what made human performance a licence subject. The term covers designers, maintainers, controllers and managers as well as flight crew, and applies to commercial and general aviation alike.
uGSVU4yeXHByoXbIbbxx: All propulsion works the same way: a mass of air or gas is accelerated rearwards and the reaction to that acceleration is the thrust. A propeller accelerates a large mass a little, a jet a small mass a great deal - the principle is identical.
uGmJ7tN4RpGodSrV0RY4: A pendulum with a period of 84.4 minutes, the time for a hypothetical satellite to orbit at the earth's surface, stays vertical regardless of the vehicle's acceleration - that is Schuler's principle. Damping is added so any initial error decays instead of oscillating for ever, so the platform is both Schuler tuned AND damped.
uGnnX0a2VbudIkwPJvnZ: Risk-taking rises when the moderating influence of other people is removed: deciding alone means no one challenges the assessment, no one offers the alternative and no one has to be persuaded, so the personal attitude to risk goes unchecked. That is precisely the resource a two-crew flight deck exists to provide.
uHJTnndd5NBrAHK11EWB: Mode 4 covers insufficient terrain clearance when the aeroplane is not configured to land, and its calls are 'TOO LOW GEAR' if the gear is up, 'TOO LOW FLAPS' if the flaps are not set, and 'TOO LOW TERRAIN' when the closure is with the aeroplane clean. 'PULL UP' belongs to modes 1 and 2.
uIKGhTk3zXoef0Fic8fi: Above about 12,000 ft without oxygen the picture is headache, fatigue, dizziness, impaired judgement and loss of fine coordination, with cyanosis and eventually unconsciousness. Judgement deteriorates rather than improves, and breathing quickens rather than slows. (The stem of this row is corrupted by material from an adjacent question.)
uIZ1nb8315baDC6cyQ7n: As the autopilot holds a standing load on the elevator, the auto trim runs the trim tab or the stabiliser to take that load off the servo. The aeroplane is then left correctly trimmed, so the controls do not snatch if the autopilot disconnects.
uIg363ImR4j7zwwl37EP: ICAO Annex 9: documents for aircraft entry/departure are accepted in handwritten block lettering in ink. This allows for flexibility in documentation format.
uItC3g1yge1vMOCqwm1W: Fatigue divides into acute, which builds within a duty period or a day and is relieved by a normal rest, and chronic, which accumulates over weeks when recovery is repeatedly incomplete and is not relieved by a single night's sleep. The distinction matters because chronic fatigue is not obvious to the person who has it.
uJ57qensuXz9wCAGl1vE: Take-off and landing performance calculations must use not more than 50% of a reported headwind and not less than 150% of a reported tailwind. The asymmetry is deliberately conservative: it guards against the headwind dying away or the tailwind being stronger than reported, either of which would lengthen the distances actually required.
uJBauIATnYl6PQV4fruw: Sleep loss produces fatigue, degrades concentration and attention, makes sensory illusions more likely because the tired brain interprets ambiguous input less reliably, and disturbs mood - irritability and low motivation. The effects appear after a single short night, not only beyond 48 hours, and nothing about it aids stress management.
uJNq17rnTc9vd40aW5MQ: Approval to carry dangerous goods is recorded on the Air Operator Certificate, which lists what the operator is authorised to do. The Certificate of Airworthiness and the Certificate of Registration describe the aircraft, not the operations permitted with it.
uK91q5QXI6LjDEuINE6o: Pressure altitude equals true altitude only when the whole atmosphere matches the standard model - that is, sea-level pressure 1013.25 hPa AND the temperature profile matching ISA. Either condition alone is not enough: correct pressure with non-standard temperature still gives a temperature error, and standard temperature with a non-standard QNH still gives a pressure error.
uKQfP9VHqGFRDWQi9oe4: Full dark adaptation takes about 25-30 minutes as the rods regenerate their rhodopsin, with most of the gain in the first 20. It is destroyed within seconds by exposure to bright light and must then be rebuilt from the beginning, which is why cockpit lighting is kept low at night.
uKYES9xWoi5KYSUJEIrw: Hot air is less dense, so although the same volume passes the venturi it carries less mass, while the carburettor goes on metering the same fuel - the mixture goes rich. The volume is unchanged; it is the density that falls.
uL5WMMxsNI3kyZq84EyE: On a polar stereographic chart the convergence between the local meridian and the grid datum meridian is the full change of longitude - 130 degrees between Greenwich and 130E. Applied to a true course of 110 degrees in this southern polar case it gives a grid course of 240 degrees.
uL5Xdq2vAS8xtqh62RXE: Aerodrome traffic is all traffic on the manoeuvring area of an aerodrome and all aircraft flying in the vicinity of the aerodrome. It includes both ground and airborne traffic.
uLuGeeAiOkLfDA0SjmRT: The assigned Mach number is held to the last point specified in the oceanic clearance, because oceanic longitudinal separation is built on the Mach number technique - changing speed early erodes the interval the controller is protecting. Only after that point does the domestic clearance govern.
uMAaW9GDCyVkAX7A7rqf: Sublimation is the change of state directly between solid and vapour, bypassing the liquid phase entirely - and in meteorological usage the term is applied in both directions. It builds cirrus and hoar frost, and it drives the Bergeron process, in which ice crystals grow at the expense of supercooled droplets to produce most mid-latitude precipitation. Solid to liquid is melting, and liquid to vapour is evaporation.
uMRw4PAQYaGw76yxOSZZ: Acceleration displaces the pendulously mounted magnet, and the effect is greatest on easterly and westerly headings. In the northern hemisphere accelerating produces an apparent turn towards the north - the rule remembered as accelerate north, decelerate south.
uNaJyv19em4D9elWUUD6: The needle shows the direction of turn, so a needle to the right means a right turn. The ball has fallen to the INSIDE of that turn, which means the aeroplane is slipping - there is more bank than the rate of turn requires.
uNgXtvIdnvWa8EQu5W5O: A stage is one rotor row followed by one stator row: the rotor accelerates the air and adds energy to it, and the stators then diffuse that velocity into pressure and straighten the flow for the next rotor. Reversing the order would leave the last rotor's swirl uncorrected.
uO0EIXF8XDYM60HEQKcc: Blood pressure is quoted in millimetres of mercury - normally about 120 over 80 - which is a direct reading of the height of the mercury column the pressure will support. The hectopascal and the millibar are used for atmospheric pressure and inches of mercury for altimetry.
uPJl028Z7psdMGe1l51I: Supplemental oxygen is the supply required for operation above a cabin pressure altitude of 10 000 ft, to protect against hypoxia. It is distinct from first-aid oxygen carried for an individual passenger, and from protective breathing equipment used against smoke and fumes.
uPO5d949QbIUDiZ5Ki3m: Aerodrome operating minima for a non-precision approach are expressed as RVR or visibility together with the MDH, and - where they are needed to see the required visual reference from a level-off - cloud conditions. Note the contrast with what governs the approach in flight: only the RVR controls whether it may be commenced and continued, and there is no decision height because there is no glide path.
uQ20T9euyZN6BRrgVWPq: North of 70N the position reporting interval opens to every 20 degrees of longitude, because the meridians converge there and a 10-degree interval would give impractically short legs. South of 70N the interval is 10 degrees.
uR1iQ03tA7zccFfPgmjU: The passenger and cabin crew masks drop automatically when the cabin altitude rises past the trigger height, because the occupants cannot be relied on to act for themselves. The flight crew masks do not drop - they are stowed beside each pilot and must be donned deliberately, within five seconds.
uRJQB5Xy3o5GQq6GJqL8: Machines can only share a load if they are trying to hold the same voltage; any difference makes the higher one carry more than its share and, in the extreme, drive current into the other. The regulators are therefore trimmed to give almost identical output before the busbars are tied.
uSDCLv4HEmoehYz8BzFF: Best glide speed is by definition the speed at which (L/D)max is achieved, so it already gives the maximum distance available - any departure from it, faster OR slower, reduces the glide distance. Raising the pitch attitude slows the aeroplane below best glide, moving it onto the back of the drag curve where induced drag climbs steeply, so the glide angle steepens and the distance shortens.
uSqXNUlTGtKZlwxcHHrx: On a polar stereographic the convergency between meridians is the FULL change of longitude, so a straight line changes its true direction degree for degree with longitude. The mid-meridian of the 120E to 160E leg is 140E, where the eastbound track is 090, and 155E is 15 degrees further east. In the SOUTHERN hemisphere an eastbound track decreases, so it is 090 - 15 = 075.
uTCO803kI7J5QHXFpVs2: The EFIS simply removes what it can no longer compute: with the VOR receiver failed the magenta deviation bar and pointer disappear from the EHSI. There is no flashing pointer or failure bar, and nothing turns red - red is reserved for warnings, not for a lost navigation source.
uTujX4W5m72dPZ0OWt8y: The earth's circumference is about 40 000 km, and the diameter is circumference divided by pi: 40 000 / 3.1416 = about 12 700 km. The 6350 km option is the RADIUS, which is the trap here.
uU7j6LF3oIGMADqcYRxD: Parallels on a Direct Mercator are horizontal straight lines, but their spacing increases towards the poles as the secant of latitude. That expansion is what keeps the projection conformal once the meridians have been forced parallel, and it is why high-latitude areas look grossly enlarged.
uVksJAt9KS60FTR632XY: During a rapid acceleration the fuel control must not deliver more fuel than the airflow at that instant can support, or the turbine temperature and back pressure will surge the compressor. The acceleration control unit within the FCU schedules the fuel against compressor speed and pressure to prevent exactly that.
uWK4rIMvBJI6Akjh6LQ9: A lightning strike or a passage through a severe electrical storm can remagnetise the airframe, so a compass swing is required afterwards. Note the other options: the swing follows a large and PERMANENT change of magnetic latitude rather than preceding one, and it is the carriage of FERROUS freight, not any large load, that matters.
uWZBEFn02XXRFpbpl3L6: Differential pressure is the difference between the pressure inside the cabin and the ambient pressure outside at the aircraft's actual altitude. It is what the structure carries, and it is limited to around 8 to 9 psi by a maximum differential relief valve.
uWnPwPjXIzCkEg2ZlIy1: At a fixed flight level the static pressure is fixed, and both CAS and Mach number are determined by the dynamic and static pressures alone. Holding Mach therefore holds CAS whatever the temperature does - only the true airspeed changes.
uWzqL4CRWU18lLNp3k0c: In steady level flight the lift must equal the weight, and at a constant IAS the dynamic pressure is fixed - so the lift COEFFICIENT is determined and cannot change. Extending flap simply means the same CL is achieved at a lower angle of attack. What does change is CLmax (which is why the stall speed falls) and the drag.
uXZnK5BI4SpW9OqD18mo: The vertical reference is tuned to the Schuler period of about 84 minutes, the period of a pendulum whose length equals the earth's radius, so that an initial error oscillates about the true vertical instead of diverging. Damping is then added so that the oscillation decays rather than persisting.
uY9RIB0braoIbFaulf27: The public address system must be audible and intelligible at every passenger seat, in the toilets, and at cabin crew seats and work stations. The toilets and crew stations matter precisely because that is where someone may be when an evacuation or emergency-landing briefing is broadcast.
uYz0QP6MWDyKjagvOhTF: Climbing without leaning leaves the mixture progressively richer as the air thins, so the fuel burns incompletely and lays carbon on the plugs. Fouled plugs give rough running and a large magneto drop, which is why the mixture is leaned as the aeroplane climbs.
uYznJ3sATbGWpU6e9QYP: Newton's third law: the engine turns the propeller to the right, so the propeller applies an equal and opposite reaction to the airframe, rolling it to the LEFT. The effect is greatest at high power and low airspeed - take-off - where it combines with slipstream effect and asymmetric blade effect to produce the familiar left-yawing and left-rolling tendency countered by right rudder.
ub016FyC4BLGea0u2uKJ: Minimum sink rate is flown at (CL^3/CD^2)max and best glide ANGLE at (CL/CD)max, and the minimum-sink condition always occurs at the LOWER speed - typically around 76% of the best-glide speed. Fly slower to stay airborne longest; fly at best glide to travel furthest. The ordering never reverses between aeroplane types.
ubG9PTZC2E9gOEUBEk7d: Planned time for the first 70 NM at 180 kt is 23.3 minutes; being 3 minutes early makes it 20.3 minutes, so the actual groundspeed is 70 x 60 / 20.3 = about 207 kt. The remaining 250 NM then takes about 73 minutes, a total of about 1 h 33 from 1200, so the revised ETA is 1333 UTC.
uc12aG0NynSjenwq6IJV: Raising the tail tilts the propeller disc, and a tilted spinning disc precesses: the applied force takes effect 90 degrees onward in the direction of rotation, producing a YAW. For a clockwise-turning propeller (seen from the cockpit) that yaw is to the left. Slipstream, torque and asymmetric blade effect are all present too, but they do not depend on raising the tail - precession is the ADDITIONAL effect that appears at that moment.
ucIvaGju9eEPgMnDXtns: A GPS receiver computes height above the WGS-84 ELLIPSOID, a mathematical surface that can differ from mean sea level by tens of metres. That is precisely why approach minima are flown on barometric altitude and why GPS height cannot be used as an altimeter substitute.
ucXL7qPtRhJl05n3gnLb: The shock wave sits upstream of the aileron, and behind it the flow is separated and low in energy, so the aileron is operating in a wake of much reduced pressure and dynamic pressure. On top of that, pressure changes caused by deflecting the aileron cannot propagate FORWARD through the shock, so the surface can only influence the small region behind it instead of altering the pressure distribution over the whole wing. Both effects cut its authority.
ucnk0BaO4yIlAaBRwpNF: Creep is a slow, permanent stretching under sustained tensile stress at high temperature - the material yields gradually rather than springing back. It is cumulative and irreversible, which is why a few seconds over temperature spends part of a turbine blade's life for good.
ud4Zxh1XELfKgLjSBCJ9: ATT is the reversionary mode used when navigation has been lost, typically after a power interruption. It provides attitude and, once the crew inserts the heading, heading as well, but no position, groundspeed or track. It keeps the flight instruments alive; it does not keep the aircraft navigating.
udiHjUck0w9XmLA0q2tN: Fog, snow and haze reduce contrast, and the brain reads low contrast as distance, so objects appear farther away than they are - and, being apparently farther away at the same angular size, larger and slower. The visual approach picture is therefore unreliable in reduced visibility.
ueHZHS8WMKzra3xg7bIW: Runway width is a height cue. A runway wider than the pilot is used to subtends a larger angle, so it looks nearer and lower - the aircraft feels low even on a correct glidepath. Correcting for a height error that does not exist, the pilot flies higher than the proper profile and arrives high, with a long landing.
ufFi3VJ2PcKqxvOlPhs1: With the reported values below minima, an ILS approach may not be continued beyond the outer marker, or below 1000 ft above the aerodrome where there is no outer marker. Fixing a definite commit point means the decision is made before the aeroplane is committed to the final segment.
ufRK796ApNsUEAHJF938: This describes Class D airspace: IFR and VFR permitted, IFR separated from IFR, IFR gets traffic info about VFR, VFR gets traffic info about all other flights.
ug7N1AYiuesqjRMFfoX4: Trip free means the breaker will trip even if the button is held in, so a faulted circuit cannot be kept energised by force. Without that property a crew member could hold a shorted circuit closed and start a fire.
ugLvsA2cjBrsYuu7Nq5E: A vertical gust abruptly changes the angle of attack and therefore the lift, producing a load factor above (or below) 1 - which is why turbulence penetration speeds exist. Note that increasing MASS actually REDUCES the gust load factor, since the increment is inversely proportional to wing loading: a heavier aeroplane has more inertia to resist the gust. CG position and density are not primary factors.
ugLxiF5xvp4eQTcxdhpM: A cruising level in Item 15 is written as F followed by three digits for a flight level, so 32 000 ft pressure altitude is F320. A for altitude in hundreds of feet, S for standard metric level and M for metres are the other forms; FL320 and the bare number are not valid entries.
uge64S6dVw13QEf9uO9K: The altimeter is set to the correct QNH of a sea-level airport, so there is no pressure error - only a temperature error. Air 10 C warmer than ISA is less dense and expands, so the aircraft is physically HIGHER than the altimeter indicates. To be truly at 12,000 ft you read less: correction = 4 ft per 1000 ft per degree = 4 x 10 x 12 = 480 ft, giving 12,000 - 480 = 11,520 ft indicated. Warm air is the safe case; cold air is the dangerous one.
ugfeE6P6iOUk7abcdpHu: Convert the heading first: 255(M) with 40W variation is 215(T). The wind from 235 is then 20 degrees off the STARBOARD bow, so the drift is to the LEFT, and the crosswind of 120 x sin20 = 41 kt against the resulting TAS of about 485 kt gives about 6 degrees. Getting the variation the wrong way round reverses the drift, which is what the mirrored option is there to catch.
uhJuNzHgVJ6VoXZPSRlE: The system needs something to manage and route the messages (1), something for the crew to read and compose them on (2), and a radio to carry them - VHF, HF or satellite (3). All three are essential parts of an airborne datalink installation.
uiNzBDo7eewnollhPXfN: Working out a standard way of handling recurring situations is exactly what procedures are for: it makes performance consistent, predictable and monitorable, and it saves the mental effort of deciding how each time. Flexibility is not lost - the standard approach is the starting point, departed from deliberately when the situation requires it.
uiRy76zjb5hsG0BNe8s6: 1 MIN 45 SEC is 1.75 minutes = 0.02917 hours, so the distance is 135 x 0.02917 = about 3.94 NM. A quick check: at 135 kt the aircraft covers 2.25 NM per minute, and 2.25 x 1.75 = 3.94.
uizs3pRYm7FSIQubi7aa: Exceeding a flight envelope limit is a warning condition requiring immediate action, and warnings are red. Amber would say the crew may act later, which is not true when the aeroplane is already outside its limits.
uj4ji9YCrbKeiiSQbJsc: Each engine has its own warning light, because the crew must know instantly which one is on fire, but one bell is enough - its only job is to attract attention, and the light then says where to look.
ujCpAcNKYIw1mFrrx45M: First the groundspeed: with 5W variation the true track is 002, the wind from 050 gives about 27 kt of headwind, and the groundspeed comes out at about 417 kt, so 3 minutes covers about 21 NM. Then apply the bearings to the TRACK, not the heading: allowing for about 4 degrees of port drift they become 45 degrees and then 90 degrees off track, the classic doubling, so the range abeam equals the 21 NM run.
ujpE74pAT58f06hvS2vl: The friction layer is as deep as turbulence can mix surface drag upward, so it depends on the roughness of the surface (mountains and cities mix far deeper than open sea), the wind speed (stronger wind means more mechanical turbulence), and the stability (an unstable layer mixes readily and deepens the layer, while a stable layer or inversion confines it). Typical depths run from a few hundred feet over the sea at night to several thousand feet over rough terrain by day.
ukAaXupPUKqEnjqiFia7: Hypovigilance is an under-arousal problem, so the remedies are physiological: general fitness, diet and adequate sleep (1), and planned in-flight rest on long sectors so that alertness is restored rather than merely endured (4). Dimming the lighting deepens the drowsiness, and stimulants such as amphetamines are prohibited and simply defer the debt.
ukL5odKHOxRgXDab1E3r: A single spool engine has one shaft, so the compressor and turbine are rigidly joined and turn at exactly the same speed. The penalty is that neither can run at its own best speed, which is why multi-spool engines were developed.
ukLZAAeWvTwYR2l4SJVz: ICAO Annex 2: when two aircraft are approaching head-on, each shall alter heading to the right. This ensures both aircraft turn away from each other.
ulOxlBi22VQCLb9rIEZJ: ICAO was established by the Convention on International Civil Aviation, signed at Chicago in 1944. The Chicago Convention remains the founding document of international civil aviation.
ulfxCPH1gi7dPwdwjkk2: The day-time (westbound) organised track structure is valid at 30W from about 1130 to 1900 UTC. The night-time eastbound structure runs from about 0100 to 0800 UTC, and flights crossing outside both windows fly random routes.
ulkyuQ80D4syk4g9JfUc: Recent SCUBA diving loads the tissues with extra nitrogen (1), body fat holds several times more dissolved nitrogen than lean tissue and releases it slowly, so obesity increases the risk (2), and susceptibility rises with age as the circulation becomes less efficient (3). Height has no bearing on it.
ulovoI2hKSyj8F7W5I7D: In the worst case full go-around thrust alone will not arrest the descent, and the remaining performance has to come from attitude. The technique is to raise the pitch progressively until the stick shaker activates and hold just below that angle, trading airspeed for flight path to escape the downdraught. Fixing a target speed instead surrenders the only margin left.
umHCXtlhggfQynvxxhQ8: Three minutes is the approach minimum for a LIGHT following a MEDIUM - the light aeroplane has the least roll authority to resist a vortex. A MEDIUM or LIGHT following a HEAVY takes two minutes, as do the departure cases using the full runway.
umT25STDXcUA6O8m9KBD: Expectation directs attention: having predicted what will be there, the mind looks for that and processes it preferentially, while alternatives - including the thing that actually happened - go unattended. It is why the standard clearance is heard when a non-standard one was passed, and why readback exists.
uo4iTgvC8vaHFik10dyv: A constant azimuth gyro DRIFT RATE makes the platform's heading error grow in proportion to t, so the cross-track velocity error grows in proportion to t as well, and integrating that gives a position error growing as t SQUARED. That is why azimuth gyro drift is the error source that dominates on a long sector, while a level-gyro error grows only linearly.
upUdI5f3qFZ4qBnRqEkq: Earth distance = chart length x scale denominator = 12 cm x 2 000 000 = 24 000 000 cm = 240 000 m, which is 240 000 / 1852 = about 130 NM. A handy check for a 1:2 000 000 chart: 1 cm is about 10.8 NM.
upXj9caoLdLtXC0cSg4I: Chart (grid) precession is measured against GRID north on the particular chart in use, because the grid is a construction of that chart - a different grid datum meridian gives a different value. Transport wander, by contrast, is measured against true north and is independent of any chart.
uq8FIPGq1FQPgliI4gqE: When a proficiency check is done within 3 months of the previous validity, the new validity runs from the old expiry date. Check done April 15 with old expiry June 30: new validity is June 30 + 6 months = December 31.
url1kssvjnb7lNqJbPm1: Cyanosis is a hypoxia sign, and although 10,000 ft is the usual working limit, individuals vary widely - a passenger who smokes, is anaemic or is unwell can be hypoxic at 9,000 ft. The response is to treat what is in front of you: descend and give oxygen. Waiting because the altitude 'should' be safe is exactly the wrong reasoning.
us5YQVMChTd00WmWkbKa: Wind is air moving from higher to lower pressure, so the fundamental cause is a horizontal pressure difference - itself created by differential heating of the earth's surface. usP2SinyiFfniRaowmVb: Typhoid, cholera and dysentery are all spread by the faecal-oral route through contaminated water or food washed in it - which is why the rule in the tropics is to drink only sealed or boiled water and to avoid ice. Tetanus enters through a wound and hydrophobia (rabies) through a bite.
usWBcvxlFnolDQ43ezsT: Noise damage depends on the product of intensity and exposure time - a very loud noise for a short period does as much harm as a moderate one for a long period, which is why exposure limits are stated as a level together with a permitted duration. utEdjYwgvStDaJjL2pd0: At least one hand extinguisher must be carried on the flight deck, and the passenger compartment is scheduled separately according to the number of seats - one for 7 to 30 seats, two for 31 to 60 and three for 61 to 200. utk6YYlIy2DMBaKqDT9h: The turbine blades are the most highly stressed hot parts in the engine, spinning at enormous centrifugal load, and creep in them is cumulative and irreversible. uuPjGSr00vnHyCmatbZ9: A ring laser gyro measures rotation about the axis perpendicular to its ring, by the frequency difference between two beams travelling in opposite directions round it. Three of them, one per axis, are needed for a complete attitude reference - each senses only its own axis.
uuZifaQIWY9c00V1MmOH: The 5 NM (9.3 km) radar wake minimum applies to a LIGHT following a MEDIUM and to a MEDIUM following a HEAVY. A LIGHT behind a HEAVY takes 6 NM, and HEAVY behind HEAVY 4 NM.
uw1EUlIV25wHezvjZLR9: A red arc means the drive is overheating and about to fail, so it is disconnected at once to save the accessory gearbox. The disconnect is a one-way mechanical latch that can only be reset on the ground, so that generator is lost for the rest of the flight.
uw9hZpBJgVLOkz82XYT1: Converted at the quoted scale the earth rhumb line distance, 10 x 60 x cos53 = 361 NM, would occupy 54.19 cm. uwBEsKamsnVWbcAkuF9I: Variation is a property of the EARTH's field at a place, so it is the same whatever the aircraft is doing and whatever compass is fitted, but it changes slowly year by year as the magnetic poles wander. Dependence on heading is deviation, not variation.
uwBju51ZyiFAlnpPaiyB: The primary exchanger pre-cools the hot engine bleed air before it enters the pack, and the secondary cools it again after the pack's own compressor has raised its pressure and temperature. Both reject heat to ram air; neither warms anything.
uwZGUs0ZI0iukiOu0Jpj: If the timebase is sweeping but the aerial is not moving, every sweep is drawn along the same radius, so the returns pile up into one bright line instead of a fan. uwg7HetfVWfNK7YokdaJ: Where the captain does not exercise command, someone else fills the vacuum: the copilot, or occasionally another crew member, ends up effectively running the flight while the legal responsibility stays with the captain. uwuFEbbdkpTG7eZOEWz1: The regulator controls the generator by varying its field excitation, holding the output voltage constant as the load changes and as the drive speed varies. Batteries have no regulator of their own - their voltage is whatever their state of charge and the bus give them.
uxgLBPiehiQkVpeuriVg: When visibility is degraded the outside world can no longer be trusted as a reference and the balance organs will produce false information, so the aircraft is flown by reference to the instrument panel as a whole. Fixating on a single instrument is not a scan, and the semicircular canals are precisely the source that is misleading.
uy3QGqXZ4ktiUcwwIoQv: Pressure falls exponentially with height, and half the mass of the atmosphere lies below about 18,000 ft - so at 18,000 ft the pressure is roughly 500 hPa, half the sea-level value. That is why a given volume of trapped gas doubles by 18,000 ft and why the physiological effects of climb are concentrated in the lower levels.
uyGAHB3aVAYs3etjFbuD: Subsiding air warms adiabatically as it is compressed, and where it meets the cooler, turbulent boundary layer beneath it a subsidence inversion forms across a wide area. That inversion caps vertical mixing, so cloud dissolves above it while moisture, smoke and dust accumulate below, giving the widespread haze and mist typical of a stagnant anticyclone. Extensive layer cloud and thunderstorms both require ascent, not descent.
uyigsbb0Y7PUQM652nh9: Wavelength is the speed of light divided by frequency: 300 000 000 divided by 121 950 000 gives about 2.46 metres. The whole VHF communication band lies close to this figure.
uz0baWXRjkEEnTA0nYJJ: Aquaplaning is prevented by breaking through the water film and getting the tyres onto the surface. A firm, positive touchdown at the correct point does that - a soft, floated landing lets the aeroplane skim on the water at high speed with no braking available. Reverse thrust works regardless of runway friction and should be selected promptly, and brakes should be applied early so anti-skid can find whatever friction exists.
uze97n7jqqbrV6Yb8rRh: The interrogation goes out on one frequency and the ground station replies 63 MHz away, so the airborne receiver is simply not listening on the frequency its own interrogator uses and cannot hear the ground reflection. uzjfqiuasm2YkYnRfRtI: Temporary long-term changes (3+ months) and short-term information with extensive text/graphics are published as AIP Supplements, not NOTAMs.
uzytCCwnyMKkqBOFlIdW: The remedies for overload are to use one's own reserves intelligently (1), to share the work across the crew (2), and - critically - to shed the tasks that do not matter and hold to the top priorities (4). Statement 3 is the opposite of what helps: abandoning automated processing for conscious analysis increases the load at exactly the moment there is no capacity for it.
v1K23YwuTfvU2cUs3NlH: A diesel runs at a much lower speed and cannot use a rich mixture, so for the same swept volume it produces less power - and it needs a far heavier structure to withstand its compression ratio. What it gains is a markedly lower fuel consumption for the power it does produce.
v1LGaTMw9BEyLpB7tQ5g: FIS collision hazard information covers airspace classes C through G. In A and B, full ATC separation makes separate FIS collision info unnecessary.
v1UU6gTQvEACaJ2fBfX3: The 10% passenger case sits in the band above 10 000 ft and up to 13 000 ft, for the entire flight time after the first 30 minutes at those altitudes. Above 13 000 ft the requirement becomes 100% of the passengers with no grace period.
v1YsB6HQfOF8HGsWO3Se: Transfer between ATC units is done by agreement with the receiving unit. Coordination ensures continuity of service.
v3aKa0vJ1MmHjUNanz7t: Flap adds a great deal of drag for its lift, so (L/D)max falls and the best glide angle steepens - the aeroplane covers less distance for the height available. Note the other traps: flap LOWERS the angle of attack for maximum lift rather than raising it (that is what slats do), it makes the zero-lift angle MORE negative, and it certainly increases drag rather than lowering it.
v4808Z1ZjuuGSCeuHN31: Expectation biases perception: having predicted the standard clearance, the pilot hears the standard clearance even though a non-standard one was passed. This is why readback is required and why non-standard instructions are the ones most often misheard. Anticipating weather or delay is prudent planning.
v4IOQRE8oP5lk9yBhnYz: Fail safe works by redundancy: more than one member carries the load, so if one cracks the others take it up and the structure survives until an inspection finds the damage. It is the opposite of relying on a single part never failing.
v4ivyENc8Uc5RCLHFRj3: Convert the heading first: 255(M) with 40W variation is 215(T). Getting the variation the wrong way round reverses the drift, which is what the mirrored options are for.
v5l6GCB4GjYpQUvDBlrQ: Both are correct. Material that engages the individual is attended to, processed more deeply and integrated into the mental picture, while dull material is skimmed and forgotten. v6AfgkLRDdl6QxSG0k5C: Fault protection distinguishes a genuine fire from a short circuit in the sensing loop: if the line is grounded, the circuit recognises the fault and inhibits the detector instead of ringing the bell. v6F8qj8WJdSFiqiHWUk0: The earth's circumference is about 40 000 km, and the diameter is circumference divided by pi: 40 000 / 3.1416 = about 12 700 km. The 6350 km option is the RADIUS, which is the trap.
v6HDeAE81j8RBqUR671a: The variable inlet guide vanes sit at the front of the high pressure compressor and, together with the variable stator vanes in its early stages, set the angle at which the air meets the blades. Closing them at low RPM keeps the angle of attack down and prevents surge.
v6jy1QtiKjno4wqUHfWd: The system warns of excessive terrain closure rate (3) and, in its later versions, of windshear (2). It knows nothing about the selected altitude - that is the altitude alerting system's business.
v6taXT94pqJIOZaspw00: A chromel-alumel thermocouple generates its own emf, so the sensing and indicating circuit needs no power supply at all - which is why the gauge still reads after a total electrical failure. The only power required is for the instrument lighting.
v7QTWxyzEHhbArvAxOTi: The stick shaker must fire early enough to give the pilot a usable warning, but late enough not to be a nuisance - so it is set just above the stall, typically around 5-10% above VS depending on the aeroplane. v7cZZFkQAkWNNGBaUGPx: A slow loss of pressurisation raises the cabin altitude gradually, so hypoxia comes on insidiously - euphoria and impaired judgement first, with the pilot feeling well and satisfied with his performance. There is no bang, no rush of air and no obvious cue, which is why the cabin altitude warning exists and why it must never be rationalised away.
v7zqTs9vNIW2KdDfpsRF: Above the tropopause the temperature stops falling. Through the lower stratosphere, from about 11 km to 20 km in the standard atmosphere, it stays almost constant at around -56.5 C; only higher up does absorption of ultraviolet radiation by ozone warm the air, so the temperature rises toward the stratopause at about 50 km. This isothermal, very stable layer is what makes the tropopause such an effective lid on convection.
v8EKnXIoXtYMeHmVXRsX: For precision approaches (ILS), the final approach segment begins at the FAP (Final Approach Point), where the glide path is intercepted. The FAF is for non-precision approaches.
v9kthwW9wO90mOLPFxIj: A tri-color VASI consists of one light projector producing three colors: red (below slope), green (on slope), and amber (above slope). It is simpler than PAPI or standard VASIS.
vANZdEzZWbe6g6r65iSO: The otolith organs sense the resultant of gravity and acceleration and cannot separate the two. Accelerating in level flight tilts that resultant backwards, which feels exactly like a nose-up pitch; decelerating produces the opposite. The false climb sensation on acceleration is particularly dangerous after take-off at night.
vAaLrzl1zhTWNuqbxknx: Vortex strength follows the lift coefficient the wing is working at, so the worst case is slow, heavy and clean. Thrust plays no part - the wake is a product of lift, not of engine power - which is why a heavy aeroplane just after rotation is the classic hazard.
vB5j1wHJYzyOluKT43vJ: VHF range is line of sight: range in NM = 1.23 x root(height in feet). At FL100 that is 1.23 x root(10 000) = 1.23 x 100 = 123 NM. Watch the units in the options: 123 NM is about 228 km, so neither the 123 km nor the 1230 km figure is the same quantity.
vBCckgXiROxAkGXj5kMg: Life jackets for every occupant are required once a landplane operates over water more than 50 NM from the shore, or beyond gliding distance from land. The 100 NM and 400 NM figures belong to the separate life-raft rule.
vBU4J5QL84D5I33u2DuW: Proprioception reports the resultant of gravity and acceleration and cannot distinguish one from the other, so once the outside visual reference is lost it produces confidently wrong information about attitude. No amount of training makes it reliable in IMC; it is useful for motor coordination, but for orientation it must be disregarded.
vBrNziXvVnYnssfMkEl5: A capacitance gauge works because fuel has a different permittivity from air, so the capacitance of the tank unit changes as the fuel level rises and the dielectric between the plates changes from air to fuel. It is a capacitance measurement, not a resistance bridge.
vC1LrIHSTqdnMcNe1nBH: ICAO Doc 4444: radar separation minimum may be reduced from 5 NM but shall not be less than 3.0 NM. This is the absolute minimum.
vC8qMccL29bOoB22J71J: Whatever the reason for the diversion, the fuel plan must still deliver the aeroplane to the chosen airfield with its FINAL RESERVE intact, which for a turbine aeroplane is 30 minutes at holding speed. The 45 minute figure belongs to piston aeroplanes.
vCFFKRik3o4pM9nFqvVS: The pendulous erection system cannot tell an acceleration from a tilt, so a forward acceleration displaces the vanes exactly as a nose-up attitude would and the gyro is precessed accordingly. vCX4uzOybs0U54aKRmEM: Long-term memory holds semantic, episodic and procedural material (1), and both the ease and the speed of retrieval depend heavily on how often the item is recalled - which is why recurrent training and recency requirements exist (4). vDDM21fSxyXPfjZ8eqII: Half the distance should have used half the trip fuel. vDJk3nqNJxVtasG84uHN: Acceleration integrated once gives velocity and twice gives distance, so double integration of the east/west accelerometer output is distance east/west. Turning that into a change of LONGITUDE needs a further step, dividing by the cosine of latitude.
vDeE1EpWj6I4ivqRHHWM: On a Direct Mercator the equator and every meridian project as straight lines, and they ARE great circles, so a blanket statement that all great circles are curves is wrong. Every other great circle plots as a curve concave to the equator, i.e. bowing towards the nearer pole, and the correct option states that exception explicitly.
vDt442VFsnpTwGTrG0vG: In myopia the eye is too long, or its refractive power too great, so parallel rays converge in front of the retina and distant objects are blurred while near vision is good. Hypermetropia is the opposite, presbyopia is the age-related loss of accommodation, and astigmatism is an uneven corneal curvature.
vDydqZSxM7GVZ1G7ZtHt: Personality is the product of inherited temperament (1) and everything that has happened since: the childhood environment (2), upbringing (3) and accumulated experience (4). It is essentially formed and stable by adulthood, which is why selection tests for personality while training targets attitudes and behaviour instead.
vEcfk5OwgJtPHhYgJZUb: In a hung start the engine lights but will not accelerate, so N2 sits well below idle with fuel still burning and too little airflow to cool the turbine. The EGT climbs steadily, and the start must be cut before the limit is reached.
vG4doLGhkmW2L5nrKJgc: GPS transmits on L1 at 1575.42 MHz and L2 at 1227.6 MHz, both in the UHF band (300 MHz to 3 GHz). The civil C/A code rides on L1, so the civil service is UHF. vHnIbBhlcxaAUv2aB3pl: Oxygen is carried bound to haemoglobin inside the red blood cells - about 98% of the total, with only a trace physically dissolved in the plasma. That is why anaemia and carbon monoxide, which attack the haemoglobin rather than the lungs, produce hypoxia just as effectively as altitude does.
vIErV2MrJiSmtNyjSQSB: Calibrated airspeed at a fixed Mach number is a function of the static pressure, which falls throughout the climb, so the CAS decreases whatever the temperature is doing. The constant total temperature only tells us the static temperature is unchanged, so the TAS is constant.
vIFGraZf5actHeAidYyj: Deviation is caused by the aircraft's own magnetism acting on the compass, and the geometry between the aircraft field and the earth's field changes as the aircraft turns, so deviation varies with HEADING.
