vJBJxqwCNssrBr4mnKpB: ICAO Doc 4444: wake turbulence departure separation for Medium behind Heavy on the same runway = 2 minutes. For intersection departures behind Heavy, 3 minutes applies.
vJSDGgGNyG6CPT7oXJVM: The escape manoeuvre is maximum available thrust, pitch increased toward the stick shaker, and CONFIGURATION UNCHANGED. Retracting gear and flaps mid-shear removes lift while the aeroplane is already short of it, and chasing best lift-to-drag speed gives away the height the manoeuvre exists to protect.
vJjQfUpP45B16VpTQdg8: Knocking - detonation - comes from high pressure and temperature with time for the end gas to explode: high manifold pressure supplies the pressure, and low RPM gives the slow-burning charge the time. That is why running at high boost and low RPM is specifically prohibited.
vKRy0ORNNkbcjW8TlVd3: VDF works on VHF, so the range is line of sight: 1.23 x (root of aircraft height + root of station height) = 1.23 x (root 13 000 + root 1024) = 1.23 x (114 + 32) = about 180 NM. Note how little the station's 1024 ft contributes compared with the aircraft's altitude.
vKYoH4MFqKtvCS9a0tEY: Machines are better at the tasks that defeat human vigilance: waiting patiently for a rare event (1), holding a value steady over a long period (2) and watching continuously to see that a limit is not exceeded (3). vLNdafT3VV6VgEQJoPG4: Filters, pressure relief valves, bypasses and the fire shut-off valve are all there to protect the system and the aircraft from the consequences of a failure. Pumps are usually engine-driven, the reservoir is pressurised for pump inlet head rather than as a pressure reserve, and regulation applies to the system as a whole.
vLOEpdZM5kzYkKLnLWMs: 'Radar contact' means the radar identity of the aircraft has been established. It confirms identification, not positive control or omission of position reports.
vLUc8KLYh9P7g9X1CjjQ: Use the 1-in-60 rule twice. Track error = 4 NM in the 60 NM run = 4 degrees. Closing angle = 4 NM in the 30 NM remaining = 8 degrees. Total alteration to reach B = 4 + 8 = 12 degrees left. The later the fix, the smaller the track error and the larger the closing angle.
vLVf2ggVj7cJL2X0PaVj: Dalton's Law: in a mixture of gases the total pressure is the sum of the partial pressures, each gas behaving as though the others were not there. It is why the oxygen partial pressure is 21% of the total at every altitude, and therefore why altitude hypoxia occurs even though the composition of the air is unchanged.
vLoYEkt7NxH3BDtqYDiB: Dry air is about 21% oxygen and 78% nitrogen by volume, with the remaining 1% made up of argon and traces of other gases including carbon dioxide. Those proportions hold to about 80 km, so it is the falling total pressure, not any change in composition, that causes altitude hypoxia.
vMPgpn8tYuxTQ1aTqAbG: Mach trim exists to counter the aft movement of the centre of pressure and the resulting tuck under, which only appear above a particular Mach number. Below that the system is dormant, and it works whether the autopilot is engaged or not.
vNYoxjikFPdmnAuenZ2j: Clear air turbulence is caused by wind shear, so its intensity scales with the strength of the vertical and horizontal shear in the airflow - which is why CAT is worst near a sharply curved jet stream, on the cold side and just below the core, and around a deep trough. vO3gJ8bK7NO66U8gcvjj: The symbology escalates with the threat: an open diamond for other traffic, a filled white or cyan diamond for proximate traffic, a filled amber circle for a traffic advisory, and a filled red SQUARE for the aircraft causing a resolution advisory. Shape as well as colour tells the crew how urgent it is.
vP4HScRXjtXYBaeDpqqn: The eutectic salt core becomes conductive as it heats, so its resistance drops and the current leaking between the centre conductor and the outer tube rises. The control unit senses that rise and gives the warning, which is how a loop detects an overheat anywhere along its length.
vPIzlUyQPPE8QQmLxN9y: Depth is judged by binocular disparity at close range, but beyond about 200 metres the two eyes are effectively looking from the same point and stereopsis fails. vPedax5bEDSpCvvrhhd3: Red marks a warning - a condition requiring immediate crew action, such as a fire or a stall. Amber is for cautions and any other colour for advisory information, and keeping red for warnings alone is what preserves its meaning.
vQmm6Vvj0zekPbOofjIF: Dry chemical powder interrupts the combustion chain reaction and is non-conductive, so it works on paper and plastic (class A), hydrocarbons (class B) and live electrical equipment. Burning metals are the exclusion, and the residue and loss of visibility are why powder is not used on the flight deck.
vRDPtNUcTB0lBaL2i2St: The critical Mach number is the highest free-stream Mach number at which the flow remains subsonic EVERYWHERE on the airframe - the moment any point (normally the upper surface of the wing) reaches M1.0 locally, Mcrit has been reached. vS0niZ7Mb8fFfyy2blYZ: The Warsaw Convention (1929) and its amendments deal with the limitation of the carrier's liability for passengers and goods transported by international air carriage.
vSHFaViTxZLI5S916UK3: Magnetic bearing to the beacon = magnetic heading + relative bearing = 311 + 270 = 581, i.e. 221. The drift angle is a distractor: a relative bearing is measured from the aircraft's nose, i.e. from its HEADING, so drift plays no part in the conversion.
vSZ31XXkWlzAa21FjxoM: A trim tab acts in the opposite sense to the surface it drives, so an UP-deflected tab levers the elevator DOWN, which pitches the nose down and trims the aeroplane for a higher speed. vSdKaq2uxmJGPhuLTWty: The drive is disconnected when its own oil says it is about to fail - low oil pressure or high oil temperature. A generator's electrical misbehaviour is dealt with by tripping it off line; it is not a reason to break the mechanical drive.
vSragKQw94qQGQqMyVva: The body works properly only within a narrow temperature band, and a core temperature of 38°C is already outside it: concentration, judgement and reaction time deteriorate and physical work capacity falls. Clinical effects do not wait until 39°C, and apathy and collapse come later still.
vTCpBufgOWRDIzLYpsVY: A windshield wiper or equivalent means of keeping a portion of the windshield clear is required at each pilot station on aeroplanes above 5700 kg maximum certificated take-off mass - the same threshold that appears in several other equipment rules.
vTSsn2Ft3dw3fckjh3P1: An ionisation detector senses the change in current across an ionised gap when combustion particles enter it, so it responds to smoke rather than to heat. Heat and fire are detected by loops and bimetallic switches instead.
vTwcVUn1I2fi20x7IfK0: RNP 4 means navigation accuracy within plus or minus 4 NM on a 95% containment basis. The 95% probability is the ICAO standard for RNP.
vUTXpIb2F9mtXxih82kp: The MMEL is the manufacturer's document, produced by the type certificate holder and approved by the certification authority. vUusBkdk9qrRmHB0iy4Z: Mental rehearsal activates the same motor programme as physical practice, so walking through a drill or visualising an approach genuinely strengthens the skill - which is why it is used for complex perceptual-motor tasks. vUxUfqB87WOK4kArZk64: During instrument departure procedures, pilots are expected to correct for known wind to remain within the protected airspace. Wind correction is the pilot's responsibility.
vUzrJ1v0eQdFhN6YnOck: ICAO Doc 8168: the maximum circling speed for Category B aircraft is 135 kt IAS. This speed defines the circling area protection envelope radius.
vV3YQKLqsc7E0bAW3TAZ: Rolling left, the left aileron goes up and the right one down; the spoilers assist by rising on the LEFT wing - the down-going one - to spoil its lift, while the right spoilers stay stowed. Spoilers always deploy on the inside of the turn.
vVeQSKQYrjBPs1F1p0N7: Conductive loss means sound cannot reach the inner ear: an obstruction in the outer ear (3), a ruptured eardrum (4) or damage to the ossicles from infection or trauma (1) all block the mechanical path. vVj53ZOclCDng0QYmilb: The operator of an aircraft involved in an accident must file a report within 10 days. This allows time for initial investigation while ensuring timely documentation.
vWnZ65I7Z4mVep90Qj1n: ICAO Annex 2: RPLs are used for flights on at least 10 occasions or every day over at least 10 consecutive days on the same day(s) of consecutive weeks.
vXvN6Zev2bJtfV8LgFiD: A to B is one degree of LONGITUDE at 60N, which is 60 x cos60 = 30 NM. A to C is one degree of LATITUDE, which is 60 NM anywhere on earth. So the answers are 30 NM and 60 NM in that order. Latitude never shrinks with position; longitude always does.
vYaJEZ9DWWbcdOlUXX5J: Work from track to compass in order. Left drift means the track lies left of the heading, so true heading = 348 + 17 = 005. Magnetic heading = true heading plus west variation = 005 + 32 = 037. Compass heading = magnetic heading minus east deviation = 037 - 4 = 033.
vZ744qxam16YxGDQrGIF: The datum is an arbitrary reference plane chosen by the manufacturer, from which every arm and moment is measured. It may be at the nose, at the firewall, or even ahead of the aeroplane - what matters is that all figures in the manual use the same one.
vZEWqimcfSan8LruA0S3: The bends are pain in the large joints, caused by nitrogen coming out of solution as bubbles when the ambient pressure falls - Henry's Law. vZNDiaj8ADC0ApGVStbD: The instrument displays the indicated airspeed - what the needle shows, errors and all. Correcting for instrument and position error gives CAS, and further corrections give EAS and TAS, none of which the instrument itself can produce.
vZNQuZnlBUn1f6NxZD6r: Heavy rain (+RA) needs a deep, water-rich cloud with sustained ascent over a wide area, which is nimbostratus - the archetypal continuous-precipitation cloud of a warm front. wNgxToSsIGvp1ccvqsf9: Time = distance / groundspeed = 5 / 269 hours = 0.0186 h, which is 1.11 minutes, i.e. 1 MIN 07 SEC. A quick check: at 269 kt the aircraft covers about 4.5 NM per minute, so 5 NM takes just over a minute.

wQ61TAtbqYzEIhgc1tOJ: In the weather radar colour code black means no significant return, then green, amber/yellow and red mark increasing rainfall rate. Turbulence, on sets that detect it, is shown separately in MAGENTA or white so it cannot be confused with rainfall intensity.

wT63toFNl4ZpIeIyinPv: For IFR flights to a navaid-equipped airport, the estimated time of arrival is when the aircraft will arrive overhead the initial approach fix (IAF).
wTDmsZUzUN22XNfrM02z: The wind from 170 is on the starboard quarter of the 124 heading, so it pushes the aircraft left and takes speed off along track. Resolving the vectors gives a track of about 116 and a groundspeed of about 415 kt, i.e. about 8 degrees of port drift.
wTihQ06OxxD0xF2EIEKW: VNE, the red radial line, is the never exceed speed - beyond it flutter or structural failure become possible in any conditions. VNO, the top of the green arc, may be exceeded in smooth air with caution.

wUf3exHYd9AmPOwl6HW8: A lavatory fire is treated as an immediate, maximum-effort event: the compartment is enclosed, the fire may be burning out of sight behind panels or in the waste bin, and smoke reaches the cabin quickly. wVPiT2U7nnLzzwJO8qcb: Descending below the tropopause the temperature rises, so the local speed of sound increases. At a fixed true airspeed, a larger denominator means a smaller Mach number - which is why a descent at constant TAS moves away from the Mach limit.

wX3fx0AhqZfgiIV4WEGH: A motor programme is a stored, well-practised sequence that can be run off with little conscious supervision - which is exactly what makes it valuable, since it frees attention for other things. wX7PWTrEsH6mpSL7wQ2q: A caution needs the crew to know about it at once and to do something about it afterwards - immediate awareness with subsequent action. Awareness with action that MAY be required is the definition of an advisory, one level lower.
wXO9dJc0lcClX5pnNUJO: Mental rehearsal activates the same motor programme as physical practice, so visualising a procedure genuinely strengthens it - and that applies to the student learning the sequence, the line pilot reviewing an emergency drill and the instructor alike. wXSkNM2EHRxwToJTmgHo: The convention is red for warnings and for flight envelope and system limits, amber for cautions, green for engaged autopilot and flight director modes, and white or cyan for armed modes. Keeping those meanings fixed is what allows the displays to be read at a glance.
wYGRBbCq6SHZNpITtZU1: Ice or snow on the airframe destroys the smooth flow over the wing: maximum lift coefficient falls, so the STALLING SPEED rises, and the stalling angle of attack falls with it. wYol1Yk5JopGKcl36H0S: The short period mode is a rapid, heavily damped PITCH oscillation - rotation about the lateral axis - with a period of only a few seconds, in which the angle of attack changes but the speed barely does. wYvSsq90qsNlPV8O9nXp: The flow accelerates most where the aerofoil is thickest and the curvature greatest, which on a swept wing is the upper surface near the WING ROOT. As Mach increases further the shock strengthens and moves aft and outboard.
wZIEmO7dMq1KnkiLN4gj: A balanced V1 is by definition the V1 at which the accelerate-stop distance exactly equals the one-engine-inoperative take-off distance. Note that with a clearway available the balanced V1 is no longer optimal - a lower, unbalanced V1 gives a higher mass.
wa1umjQIrYFRS6rTFm1u: Opening the throttle raises the manifold pressure and the engine tries to accelerate, so the governor senses the overspeed and coarsens the blades until the extra power is absorbed at the original RPM. The higher pitch is what holds the constant speed.
wabmjjcY1nl9pt9D4lw5: Boots are de-icing devices: the crew allow ice to accrete visibly and then select the system (2), which inflates each tube in sequence over a cycle lasting some tens of seconds (3) to crack the ice off. wbhMX90xZoaTueAxI6cf: ATC clearances are issued to achieve separation between controlled flights, covering both IFR and participating VFR traffic.
wc2CiquoixQdhuwF3xH7: Practical sources for a civil crew are the ATIS, NOTAMs and reports from other crews - all three carry current bird activity for the aerodrome. BIRDTAMs are a military product, and weather radar does not reliably show flocks at the ranges and heights that matter.
wcIsgzl5aBtpHyR6t7l2: The angle between the wind and the runway is 100 - 063 = 37 degrees, so the crosswind is V x sin37 = 0.60V. Setting that equal to the 20 kt limit gives V = 20 / 0.60 = about 33 kt. Runway QDM and wind are both magnetic, so no conversion is needed.
wcoKv9tqdMdbOjb6sLvS: Fuel is jettisoned in straight and level flight at a relatively high level so that it atomises and evaporates long before reaching the ground, and so the aeroplane does not fly back through its own fuel. weDyWDBoDFihGHXFhOks: Presbyopia is the age-related stiffening of the crystalline lens, which can no longer be made more convex by the ciliary muscle. wejLOsk8sSCp0hS6aoEB: XXX is a distress signal in some communication protocols and shall not be used as an aircraft registration mark combination to avoid confusion.
wfVtEKk7fSOjWTqf7p65: TAS = IAS divided by the square root of the density RATIO, so the two are equal only when the density equals the ISA sea-level value. wgJYY0oLXDJzn2Q1HtnK: Icing needs supercooled LIQUID water, so any cloud with 'cirro' in its name is ruled out - cirrostratus and cirrocumulus form above about 20,000 ft at temperatures near -40 C and are pure ice crystal. wgQRQzs2xDQkGjyLbZ2e: Synchronisation continuously nulls the autopilot's outputs against the aeroplane's actual condition while the channel is NOT driving, so that at the moment of engagement the computed command is zero and the aircraft is not snatched onto a new datum. wgwKsZRf1BNDTqCdKpqq: With regional QNH 1013 set there is no pressure error, so only temperature matters. whFC6AbJjkTmyNS45MgL: The passenger and cabin crew masks drop automatically when the cabin altitude rises past the trigger height, because those occupants cannot be relied on to act for themselves. whZiem5OMeqIpXMgz9Ls: A hydraulic fuse senses either an abnormally high flow or an excessive volume passing through it, and shuts off when it finds one - which is what a burst pipe downstream produces. That isolates the leak and saves the rest of the system's fluid.
whd8ZxCMH8HllrtTbZT9: Climbing at constant CAS, the falling density makes TAS increase steadily, while the falling temperature reduces the local speed of sound. whhBZuGM3Y1CU8YCuQvd: The circumference of a parallel is the equatorial circumference times the cosine of latitude, so the 60N parallel is only half as long as the equator. Covering twice the distance in the same time needs twice the speed: 480 x 2 = 960 kt.
whuRvArHpJQnNpCgaE8k: Both statements are wrong, and in opposite directions. Irreversible controls need no gust lock, because the hydraulic actuators hold the surfaces immovably against the wind. Manual controls, having nothing to hold them, are exactly the ones that DO need locking on the ground.
whuZHpypvD8xuq62G7f6: For a given configuration, vortex strength follows the lift coefficient the wing is working at - heavy for the lift required, slow for the high angle of attack that produces it. HEAVY, CLEAN and SLOW is the standard summary of the worst generator.
whvUBIK4c3YV1oEDvy2g: An AND gate produces an output only when every input is present, so it is described as an 'all or nothing' gate. The OR gate, which responds to any one input or to all of them, is the 'any or all' one.
wiJL3rX9p21TuEax98Ci: Propulsive efficiency is best when a large mass of air is given a small increase in velocity, and that is exactly what the bypass stream does - a much greater mass flow leaving at a much lower average velocity. wiNaFGEBEow9YX56EVyP: The blades are aerofoils, and they stall for the same reason a wing does - the angle at which the air meets them becomes too great. That happens when the axial velocity falls relative to the blade speed, which is why a throttle slam or a disturbed intake can provoke it.
wiUTc5qdUy4dn62D2sse: Induced drag is proportional to lift squared divided by speed squared, so at a fixed weight it varies as 1/V2 - it falls away rapidly as speed increases. wifrSvCjBwa1ArOo2Dtc: At a constant flight level the static pressure is fixed, and CAS at a given Mach number depends only on that pressure. Holding Mach therefore holds CAS whatever the temperature does; it is the true airspeed that changes.
wigTvxHddNSqQR1x4UOF: International aviation works because there is one common language, and that language is English: a pilot and a controller who share no other tongue can still work together. wjDbIZhkMBUOZals8oI0: An electronic tachometer counts pulses, so its reading is immune to line resistance and temperature and it has no commutator to generate noise. What it does need, unlike a self-generating tachometer generator, is an aircraft power supply for its counting and display circuitry.
wkR2wJxctNp2iTxsN5qR: Intake pressure is an absolute pressure, so it is sensed by an evacuated aneroid capsule which expands and contracts with it, its movement converted into an electrical signal for the EPR computation. A differential capsule would need a second pressure to compare it with.
wlB08rHOh9qWkK5CLmD5: All four must be demonstrated: no fire hazard from the system or its operation, the fuel discharging clear of every part of the aeroplane, no fumes entering it, and no adverse effect on controllability. wmKwT1ixPLNUBTQSBCVE: Command brings new roles, new responsibilities and a new set of expectations from others, and the individual's self-concept has to be reworked to accommodate them. wmV1ORxVutBkQcPNcb8w: The required warnings are excessive sink rate (2), altitude loss after take-off or go-around (3), an unsafe landing configuration (4), dangerous ground proximity (5) and descent below the glideslope (6). wmaCG1t6BU3CMgGoNKIu: In the southern hemisphere the compass turning errors are the reverse of the northern: the roll-out onto a southerly heading is undershot and onto a northerly heading overshot, by roughly the latitude plus an allowance for the bank. wmwnNl3mmtuzxXL8dMAs: The generator breaker connects the machine to the busbar, and it may only do so once the generator is producing more than the busbar voltage - otherwise current would flow backwards into the generator and drive it as a motor. It opens again as soon as that condition is lost.
wmyvUvnVf9njCZriqQsl: Both parcels cool by expansion as they rise, but in a saturated parcel the water vapour is condensing, and condensation RELEASES latent heat back into the parcel. wn6z7goS2JN0Lttp4hE9: Acceleration errors are greatest on easterly and westerly headings, and in the southern hemisphere they act in the opposite sense to the northern: accelerating gives an apparent turn to the south and decelerating one to the north. wnKnF10bGp0u7xptvfvf: The pressoreceptors, or baroreceptors, sit in the carotid sinuses and the arch of the aorta, where they sense arterial blood pressure and feed the cardiovascular control centres. wnNrZT4LVM040KPtmgHF: Accelerating displaces the pendulously mounted magnet, and the effect is greatest on easterly and westerly headings. In the northern hemisphere acceleration produces an apparent turn towards the north - the rule remembered as accelerate north, decelerate south.
wngRjdgRXGPwuneh0vlg: A destination ALTERNATE whose only approach is non-precision is planned to non-precision minima PLUS 200 ft and 1000 m. The alternate is the aerodrome the flight will use if the first plan fails, so the planning margin added to it is the largest in the table.
wnhLuYN6ji8fqOJDxdRm: The standard approach speed rule is 1.5 times the stall speed - a 50% margin - plus half the estimated wind speed. wnheoYtJMJDMdxu83BHc: With the aeroplane still on stand the failure is a dispatch question, and the Minimum Equipment List in the Operations Manual is what answers it - whether the item may be inoperative, under what conditions and with what procedures. wo6xGm7ucNRp2MKLJ7Y4: For a jet, thrust available is roughly constant with speed, so the maximum EXCESS thrust - and therefore the steepest climb angle - occurs where the drag is least: at the speed giving the highest CL/CD ratio, VMD. woKr7dwy1juki2SRysJ1: The wind from 190 is almost exactly behind the 003 track, so it is a near pure tailwind: the groundspeed rises from 130 to about 170 kt and the drift correction is only a couple of degrees, giving a heading of about 001.
woToCw3Q6cqMrDAun7Jj: A capacitance system responds to the permittivity of the fuel, which varies with its density in the same way its mass does, so the two effects compensate and the indication is unaffected by fuel temperature. wp5bIpHPv4R5R24BNlcO: Social motives distort decisions. wqpRG2Gx33XnIKEibfbg: ICAO Doc 8168: Category I precision approach has a minimum Decision Height of 200 ft. Category II is 100 ft, Category IIIA is below 100 ft or no DH.
wr04ToKGplApM4nXDtJ9: RVR is assessed against high-intensity runway lights, which stay visible through fog long after unlit dark objects have disappeared, and it is measured close to the runway surface. wsQwoNOsstlSqjYInkjr: RVR is defined as the range over which the pilot of an aircraft on the centre line of a runway can see the runway surface markings, or the lights delineating the runway or identifying its centre line - so it is a LENGTH OF RUNWAY, specific to that runway, not a general visibility. wsvYcrafbyizTL9BERsn: Final reserve is calculated at the mass on arrival at the DESTINATION ALTERNATE, so with B as the alternate it is 30 minutes at holding speed at 1500 ft above aerodrome B. It would be measured above the destination only if no alternate were required.
wszFbwrmceijKTz9kAvD: Weather radar returns need the forward-looking arc, so on the B737-400 they can only be shown in the EXPANDED modes. That rules them out of the two FULL compass-rose modes and out of PLAN, which is a north-up route display with no radar picture at all.
wtyouZVhp9zFxmJnfprq: DSRTK/STS displays the DESIRED TRACK, the initial great circle track to the next waypoint, alongside system status. TK/GS shows the track being made good and groundspeed, XTK/TKE how far off track and by what angle, and HDG/DA heading and drift angle.
wuWWWkl8biKbzv5oKdBa: An easterly wave is a shallow trough moving westward through the trade wind belt. wvWBmDqUxS70Xi0Wm1zO: Chemical generators are light and compact (1), simple to stow at each seat row and needing no plumbing or servicing (2 and 6), and there is no high pressure vessel to explode (4). What they cannot do is run for long or be turned off once fired.
wwmnX115S4iivllvdTmI: The carburettor meters fuel against the volume of air passing the venturi, and that volume does not change with height - but its density, and therefore its mass, falls. The same quantity of fuel is then burnt with less air, so the mixture becomes progressively richer.
wxJeGRxdrErXxH0JUltC: Expectation directs attention: having predicted what will be there, the mind looks for that and processes it preferentially, while alternatives - including what actually happened - go unattended. wyUENpWYTEsyf90UeBg5: The worst case combines a heavy generator, an aeroplane just rotating, and a LIGHT crosswind - light enough to carry the vortex sideways onto the adjacent runway but too weak to break it up. wzPGalQBbn4xtiOoV1kh: At a constant angle of attack and mass, the lift coefficient is fixed and the lift must still equal the weight - so the dynamic pressure, and therefore the CAS, is unchanged. x0N3zoIuy1V9liSq1Fxw: The primary flight display carries everything needed to fly the aeroplane - attitude, airspeed, altitude, vertical speed, heading and the flight mode annunciations. Engine parameters, alerts and system synoptics are presented on the separate engine and system displays.
x0UEg88hM9oH4NPcXz5N: Any body producing lift also produces drag - the two are simply the components, perpendicular and parallel to the airflow, of a single resultant force. A lifting surface with no drag is not physically possible.
x0fGvlg1YTqVxDqLAf3F: Compressing the air first, and then cooling it in the secondary heat exchanger, gives the turbine a much greater pressure ratio to expand through - and the temperature drop across a turbine depends on that ratio. x0oUGeF6K46wrVKzzpBM: The wind from 165 blows towards 345, almost straight along the 355 heading, so it is nearly a pure tailwind with a small crosswind from the right of the nose. The groundspeed rises to about 215 kt and the small crosswind gives about 1 degree of port drift.
x1Jne7LDmzyR6CKEUCVu: A float follows the fuel surface, so its reading is disturbed by attitude (2), by accelerations and manoeuvres (3), and by temperature (4), since warm fuel expands and the same mass fills a larger volume. x2sE9eGQAnmrrmujUlqY: A narrower-than-normal runway subtends a smaller angle, so it looks farther away and the pilot judges himself too high. Correcting for a height error that does not exist, he flattens the approach and descends below the correct path, arriving low and landing short.
x3YThY3VO2EirUCvE7SG: The optimum level of arousal is lower for a difficult task than for a simple one, because a demanding task needs a broad attentional field and spare capacity. x3q76damVbKDAy1g0oZA: A professional language works by restricting itself: a limited, agreed vocabulary in which each term has one meaning (1), and a shared operational context that supplies the rest and so removes ambiguity (4). x3sqzFA7YarhUrOLiTEn: High manifold pressure with low RPM is the damaging combination: the cylinder pressures are high while the slow-turning engine gives the charge plenty of time to detonate. x4HaM4me5yu3ggsBR0RK: The route runs west from 100W to 140E, so the vertex is at the mid-longitude 160W where the westbound track is 270. x4JwheCRRCVRsvusQxJh: Integration is multiplication by time - acceleration multiplied by time gives velocity, and velocity multiplied by time gives distance. Doing it twice to the measured accelerations is what yields position.
x4L2IKHsQ7ZAHCgzrX8f: Work the heading into true first: compass 237 with -5 deviation is 232 magnetic, and with 19W variation that is 213 true. x4PxF395bOwnKWdX34QR: Hypovigilance is an under-arousal problem, so the remedies are physiological: general fitness, diet and adequate sleep (1), and planned in-flight rest on long sectors so that alertness is restored rather than merely endured (4). Dimming the lighting deepens the drowsiness, and stimulants are prohibited and simply defer the debt.
x4fhHc141pdofpd8dH8D: A smoke hood covers the whole head and seals around the neck, because smoke and fumes injure the eyes and blind the wearer as surely as they damage the lungs. It is supplied with a continuous flow, which also keeps the hood slightly pressurised so nothing can leak in.
x4lWbSQ0QXOo1MZTIFAA: Frequency is the number of pole PAIRS multiplied by the revolutions per second: 400 Hz at 6 000 rpm, or 100 rev/s, needs four pole pairs - that is, eight poles. The same relation gives 12 000 rpm for a four-pole machine at 400 Hz.
x4oq1Y7GDg0dyV0IR9Yv: The command bars are superimposed on the attitude display, because they command pitch and roll and the pilot flies them against the aircraft symbol. That combination of attitude and command is what the attitude director indicator is.
x552k5nhMYzhe7Dja4fj: An actuator, or jack, is a piston in a cylinder: pressure on one side of the piston drives it along, converting the fluid pressure into a straight-line force and movement. Rotary output requires a hydraulic motor instead.
x55esao9j1Qw51Penj2a: South of 70N on east-west NAT tracks, position reports are made every 10 degrees of longitude between 5W and 65W. North of 70N the interval opens to 20 degrees because the meridians converge.
x5Xeq0fKjM7sJJUrKg7X: The creeps are the skin form of decompression sickness: nitrogen bubbles under the skin produce itching, a crawling sensation and a mottled rash. The bends are joint pain, the chokes are chest pain and cough, and the leans is an unrelated vestibular illusion.
x5wpI3DeObvLEFQpVRUU: With the pitot blocked the trapped total pressure and the falling static pressure make the indication rise, so holding a constant indicated airspeed means continuously reducing the real speed. The aeroplane slows all the way to the stall while the instrument reads normally.
x6f3MpT9R5oagsBWqDqh: The pampero is a sudden, vigorous surge of cold polar air from the south sweeping across the Argentine pampas, effectively a South American cold front outbreak. x6prqIfJqmredgnNlf3A: Mach number is TAS divided by the local speed of sound, and the speed of sound falls with temperature. Colder air therefore means a smaller denominator, so the same true airspeed represents a higher Mach number.
x7EzRH27ffBDG5rVsKPM: Cabin altitude and cabin pressure are inverse, so a cabin descending means the pressure inside is rising. It is entirely independent of the aeroplane's own rate of descent and can happen in level flight.

x8jMmgQ3xs7OoaKhaK1C: An INS flies the great circle, which between two points on the same parallel bows towards the nearer pole, so at the mid-longitude the aircraft is slightly NORTH of 60N. Using tan(60) = tan(vertex) x cos(5), the vertex latitude is about 60 degrees 06 minutes north.

xAJViZX8ik10RnA7bdm0: Motivation follows the inverted-U like any other source of arousal. xASLIxLcq0iU6GKLbeDd: Both points are on the 70N parallel with 120 degrees of longitude between them, so the great circle vertex is at the mid-longitude, Greenwich, well north of 70N. xBKS3iEVFqo3bQsfB6gi: XXX is a distress/urgency signal and must not be used as a registration mark combination.
xBpsdy1LJbBZnY6oVXJH: A basic VOR/DME RNAV derives the phantom waypoint entirely from the reference station's own rho and theta, so it can produce nothing at all unless that station is being received. xCL2FTvKq3Ic6BVt1YI3: The basic or inner loop does what the pilot's hands do: it stabilises and controls the aeroplane's rotation about its centre of gravity in pitch, roll and yaw. Taking it somewhere is the outer loop's job, and it works by commanding this one.
xD3cjfddASHZDab61Gow: In gyro terminology WANDER is the general term, and it splits in two: DRIFT is movement of the spin axis in the HORIZONTAL plane, i.e. in azimuth, and TOPPLE is movement in the vertical plane. That is why a directional gyro suffers drift and an artificial horizon topples.
xD9W1BxsJPn2lvTepSzm: A microburst is a concentrated downdraught striking the surface and spreading radially, producing a strong headwind, then a downdraught, then an equally strong tailwind within seconds - severe vertical and horizontal wind shear. Supercooled water is an icing phenomenon and unrelated.
xDMGgNiLzpeX468nHjLH: Arterial pressure is sensed by the pressoreceptors - baroreceptors - in the carotid sinuses and the aortic arch, which feed the cardiovascular control centres. The arterioles are effectors, adjusting peripheral resistance in response; the adrenal glands supply the hormones; and the pacemaker sets the heart rate.
xDSWZUcWUhZdPbifLMzw: Fog reduces contrast, and the eye reads low contrast as distance, so the airfield appears farther away than it is. The pilot then judges his approach path shallower than it really is, and the visual picture becomes unreliable at exactly the point where he is deciding whether to continue.
xDrJLG6jUuXWX9VwPd0C: Leading-edge devices work on the mechanism that actually limits CLmax - boundary layer separation - by ducting or guiding high-energy air over the upper surface. xE6Co9PmSksEZqMWVaY7: Life jackets are inflated as the wearer leaves the aeroplane, never inside it. xEVfzB0NbzQxrGPm3NBz: Cigarette smoke contains carbon monoxide, which binds to haemoglobin with over 200 times the affinity of oxygen and will not readily let go. xEmDEzCkdL6YGHdmor3D: Ice or snow on the airframe spoils the flow over the wing: maximum lift coefficient falls, so the STALLING SPEED rises while the stalling angle of attack falls. Drag rises, roll and pitch response deteriorate, and the stall can arrive with little warning.
xEo7HFJ85m9TXpTUJ84t: Mass flow is density multiplied by area multiplied by velocity. This is the same density effect that reduces engine thrust and degrades take-off performance on a hot day.
xGost0oCIgsYhkentC1c: Bypass ratio is a ratio of MASS flows, not volumes - the two streams are at quite different densities - so the first statement is wrong. But inlet flow and bypass flow are enough to compute it: subtract one from the other to get the core flow, then divide.
xH9cujfcIqjB9WGYqpIJ: Aerodrome RFFS category is based on the overall length AND maximum fuselage width of the longest aeroplane normally using the aerodrome. Weight is not a factor.
xHLnUZM4XV5iFttBt7Du: A clearway is a defined rectangular area established to permit an aircraft to make a portion of its initial climb to a specified height after takeoff.
xJA23zcB0KvI3kuFo1CU: A ring laser IRS takes about 10 minutes to align at mid-latitudes. xJpjxHqBwhGiUtOEq1P2: QNH 995 is 18 hPa below 1013, so a minimum altitude of 7800 ft corresponds to a pressure altitude of 7800 + (18 x 27) = about 8290 ft, i.e. FL83 as a bare minimum. xK3dDX3tILTTM5QeK2fO: The airflow over the fuselage produces a slight suction inside an unpressurised cabin, so the pressure there is lower than true static. Feeding that lower pressure to the instruments makes the difference between total and static larger than it should be, so the airspeed indicator over-reads.
xLQHlR2klRxBXh4fdgHi: A fusible plug is a hollow bolt filled with an alloy that melts at a set temperature, letting the tyre deflate in a controlled way rather than bursting. A bursting wheel is lethal to anyone nearby, which is why the gear is left alone until the wheels have cooled after a rejected take-off.
xNja3bOBOqBT8VZjQw1W: The steepest wind shear around a polar front jet is on the polar (cold) side, because the jet's speed falls away much more sharply toward the cold air than toward the warm air. The standard escape is to climb or descend, and to move toward the warm side.
xNvsQOh5bdhgJJcp0bZZ: If the ears will not clear on descent, the answer is to reduce or reverse the pressure change: level off, or climb a little to relieve the differential, and then descend more slowly, using the Valsalva manoeuvre, swallowing and jaw movement. Increasing the descent rate makes it worse, and blocking the ear does nothing at all.
xOfOw6j1W7uodorHmH4e: A frontal depression forms on the polar front and is steered by the flow in its own warm sector, which runs broadly west to east along the front. So the centre travels ALONG the front, eastward, with the low pressure on its left in the northern hemisphere - which is why Atlantic depressions track from west to east across Europe rather than moving across the frontal zone.
xPprG9P5QDjIlTwHjbJy: The MOCA is an ALTITUDE, flown on QNH, so it must be converted before it can be compared with a flight level. The station elevation of 4000 ft is a distractor, since QNH is already referred to sea level.
xQ7T9ofmRa5kPIaPUIWu: With calm and clear synoptic conditions the diurnal land-sea circulation dominates. By day the land heats faster than the water, forming a shallow thermal low over the land, and the wind blows from the water inland - the sea breeze. At night the land cools faster, the gradient reverses, and the weaker land breeze blows from the land out over the water.
xQDFsKI7pPKFSLGFfLyK: Wake turbulence timed approach separation: Medium behind Heavy = 2 minutes, Light behind Medium = 3 minutes, Light behind Heavy = 3 minutes. The marked answer of 4 minutes for Light behind Medium is incorrect.
xQK5YpqqzUExJpadxGkr: In a holding pattern the aeroplane flies at (L/D)max, so the thrust required equals W/(L/D)max - directly proportional to weight. With specific fuel consumption assumed constant, the fuel flow scales with weight in the same way: 3100 x (105,000 / 95,000) = 3426 kg/h. Sense-check the direction: the heavier aeroplane must burn MORE, not less.
xRVK2ZMaWgaFXeYvnQef: The chain starts with the shipper, who certifies on the shipper's declaration that the article is not forbidden and is correctly classified, packed, marked and labelled. The operator's acceptance check and the commander's notification follow, but neither replaces that initial certification.
xRWqbU0OTZyLiFtBHgt3: Flattening = (a - b) / a, so the semi-minor axis b = a x (1 - 1/298) = 6378.4 x 0.99664 = about 6357 km. The difference between the two axes is only about 21 km, roughly 0.3 percent, which is why the earth can be treated as a sphere for most navigation but not for satellite geodesy.
xSjwQurL2Cq8XcZb2Saz: Bandwidth is conventionally measured between the points where the gain has fallen 3 decibels below its maximum - the half power points. It is the band over which the amplifier can be said to be working properly.
xSwBkdAsWlnHykE22ZuG: The maximum certificated taxi or ramp mass is a structural limit - what the gear and airframe will take manoeuvring on the ground - and it is the greatest mass at which the aeroplane may begin to move. It exceeds the maximum take-off mass by the taxi fuel allowance.
xUN63IzRxiGDRsVjKMCI: The yaw damper's output is summed with whatever the pilot or the autopilot is commanding, so its small rapid corrections are superimposed on the normal rudder demand. It is never inhibited - Dutch roll has to be damped whoever is flying.
xUY9PtPUlLXXgijajEY0: Right-of-way in Class D: right-of-way rules apply regardless of flight rules. The aircraft with the other on its right gives way. Aircraft B has right of way if A is on B's right.
xVpdxcDooN96Mj5AJU73: A flight director needs a computer to work out what the aeroplane should be doing, and command bars to tell the pilot to do it. It is a display system for hand flying and needs no autopilot at all - which is exactly why it is useful when the autopilot is out.
xWdQjOcCIj6KyZHigf1E: A stick pusher applies a firm automatic nose-down input once the angle of attack reaches a value beyond which the aeroplane's natural stall behaviour would be unacceptable - a deep stall or a violent wing drop. It is a last-resort protection fitted where the stall characteristics fail certification, and it acts AFTER the stick shaker, which is a warning rather than an intervention.
xWsAtXfKcEDb31A7y9hP: ICAO Annex 9: in certain cases, contracting States may require additional identity documents from visitors, depending on national regulations.
xX9zQs3dWvzOyEbmMKHL: Static pressure is the pressure of the air molecules themselves, arising from their random thermal motion, so it acts equally in ALL directions - it has no preferred orientation. That is precisely why a static port can be a flush hole in the fuselage side, aligned parallel to the flow, and still sense it correctly. DYNAMIC pressure, by contrast, is directional, acting only along the flow.
xXG17FiSQmi1LBEfg4s1: Compressibility makes the pitot system over-read, and the correction that turns CAS into EAS is therefore always a reduction. EAS equals CAS only when the compressibility correction is nil - low speed and low altitude - and is smaller everywhere else.
xXbaV9IWoCOxSpQ5lvBl: ANDS: Accelerate North, Decelerate South on east/west headings in the northern hemisphere. Accelerating on an easterly heading gives an apparent turn towards the NORTH, and since the indicated heading moves from 090 back towards 000, i.e. decreases, the card turns clockwise.
xXlLQoSUCqw6lWmkcSea: Overexcitation would drive the voltage up and damage every load, so the protection kills that machine at source: the exciter breaker collapses its field and the generator breaker takes it off its busbar. xXz1avRhgzt51rBXGKlM: Track 046 against heading 035 is 11 degrees of right drift, and the groundspeed of 220 kt is 25 kt below the TAS, so the wind is on the port bow. Resolving the vectors gives a wind from about 340 degrees at 50 kt.
xY7Px4pZ24GeD6EIoZMN: The yaw damper exists to suppress Dutch roll and damp oscillatory yaw; it has no sideslip target and does not know the turn is unbalanced. Keeping the ball centred remains the pilot's job, in a skidding turn as in a slipping one.
xYJPI5obtwHn41ZebyYL: Propeller blades are de-iced electrically, by heating elements bonded to the leading edge of each blade and fed through slip rings, usually cycling between blades to limit the power drawn. xYgm5Lcy1KhTFvLG5GgO: V1 cannot exceed VR, because the decision to continue or reject must be made before rotation begins - there is no meaningful 'stop' decision once the aeroplane is being rotated. xYmOcQTCTEoUXWTLaxPD: Wind is the difference between the aircraft's motion through the air and its motion over the ground, so the inertial system needs true airspeed from the air data computer to compute it. xZ3pxA2KQrSZ4myUoM9V: Before flight the crew uses the CDU to type in what the aircraft cannot know for itself: present position and alignment data for the IRSs, then the route, cruise level, cost index and the mass and centre of gravity for the FMC. xZRdMoPz24UFRKy7QQQg: The descent is 39 000 - 7000 = 32 000 ft, which at a maximum of 2500 ft/min takes 12.8 minutes. At 248 kt the aircraft covers 248 x 12.8/60 = about 53 NM, so descent must begin no later than 53 NM from the facility.
xaRVCCqfhfBq0FpUYgDs: The list of goods forbidden for carriage by air in any circumstances is in the ICAO Technical Instructions (Doc 9284). Annex 18 creates the obligation to comply with the Instructions but does not itself contain the lists.
xadY4IxNpjZIm5Sqq6nf: ICAO Doc 4444: missed approach instruction if no landing clearance by 2 NM from touchdown during a radar approach.
xak7XTun5Gt9jqWeaOZG: Navigation databases run on the 28 day AIRAC cycle, so a loaded database is valid for that period and must be replaced at the next cycle date. Flying on an expired database means the procedures and frequencies in it can no longer be relied on.
xbBbs6UnBPf8RDQKsBuj: Proficiency shows as spare capacity. When the routine handling and procedural work have become automatic, they consume almost no conscious attention, leaving the limited cognitive resource free for monitoring, anticipation and decision making. The pilot who must think about every action has nothing left when something unexpected happens.
xbR30VnwSrw91w800CvI: The command bars say what to do, not where the aeroplane is: they display the pitch and roll the computer has worked out as necessary to reach and hold the selected flight condition. Raw deviation is shown separately, on the deviation scales.
xbbEnIxTDd0Rkpd4eJKL: A basic RNAV's course-line computer takes the rho and theta it gets from one VOR/DME and solves the triangle to a phantom waypoint the crew has defined by bearing and distance from that station, producing track and distance to the phantom instead of to the beacon. xbyC6RozYKikyPX8i4BD: A clearway is an obstacle-free area beyond the runway over which the aeroplane may make its initial climb to 35 ft, so it counts toward the TAKE-OFF DISTANCE AVAILABLE - up to a maximum of half the take-off run available. xcCD5yj7VuxRTOeEP5w8: Both statements have the direction wrong. Gyroscopic precession makes an applied force take effect 90 degrees onward in the direction of rotation, so for a propeller turning clockwise as seen from the cockpit, pitching up precesses into a yaw to the RIGHT (not left), and yawing right precesses into a pitch DOWN (not up). The familiar tailwheel case follows the same rule: raising the tail yaws the aeroplane left.
xcLprx6juXhcPqok5dM9: A single jet would richen the mixture as the airflow increased, because fuel flow varies with the square root of the pressure drop while airflow varies more nearly with it directly. The compensating jet or diffuser bleeds air into the fuel to offset that, holding the ratio steady from low to high power.
xcROWKfQ1WGFbgZ3UmnB: An engine burns fuel by mass, and range and endurance depend on the mass carried, not on the volume it happens to occupy at that temperature. That is why capacitance gauging, which indicates mass, replaced the float gauge on transport aircraft.
xccxfQkujPG8SjaK5bHa: Air taken from the compressor is air that never reaches the turbine, so to hold the same thrust the control adds fuel - and with less air left to cool the turbine, the exhaust gas temperature rises. Both go up together, which is why bleed carries a performance penalty.
xdGtKPL9IARKfBxPTOlS: Compression ratio compares the volume above the piston at the bottom of its stroke with the volume at the top: total volume divided by clearance volume. It is what determines how much the charge is squeezed, and hence what octane rating the fuel must have.
xdNqVcaZ9rFGoAi0m9xN: Time = distance / groundspeed = 985 / 122 = 8.07 hours. The decimal 0.07 of an hour is about 4 minutes, so 8 HR 04 MIN. All four options lie within 20 minutes of each other, so the decimal conversion has to be exact.
xdVRcu4BiPG9OfWSMvLI: With the static source blocked the pressure in the case is frozen at the value it had at that moment, so the capsule cannot move and the pointers stay where they were. The altimeter simply holds the blockage altitude, however far the aeroplane descends.

xeZLhJgQf9Ad8SuXmYf6: Refuelling with passengers on board is permitted under conditions, and one of them is that the ground beneath the emergency exits and the slide deployment areas is kept clear, so an evacuation remains possible at any moment. Two-way communication with a qualified person on board and the signs off are the other elements.
xeaAonxjkXAcydkUtvx4: PET distance from A = D x H / (O + H) = 1973 x 385 / 815 = about 932 NM, and the TIME to reach it is that distance at the OUTBOUND groundspeed: 932 / 430 = 2.17 hours = about 130 minutes.
xfFzc19GbkUAIGeXOQS3: Catastrophic is the top of the severity scale: the failure would prevent continued safe flight and landing, and the consequence for the occupants is multiple fatalities. Serious or fatal injury to a small number of them defines the hazardous level below it.
xfs4PStFQh1WUc0AOCgO: The laissez-faire captain does not exercise command: decisions, choices and actions are left to whoever takes them, without direction, without allocation of tasks and without anyone taking responsibility for the outcome. It is as dangerous as autocracy in the opposite direction, because nobody is coordinating and nobody knows who is doing what.
xg2EHUab9DhJxU9NmY65: Without RAIM the receiver cannot tell you whether its own solution is trustworthy, so GPS may not be used as the primary means under IFR. The flight continues on the other certificated navigation systems on board. Flying a constant heading, or watching the display manually, does nothing to restore integrity monitoring.
xgfQ8R8yxBLFz43QZMio: The inverted-U describes it: performance peaks at an optimum level of arousal (2), falls away when stress becomes excessive because attention narrows and thinking becomes rigid (3), and also falls away when there is too little stress, since arousal, vigilance and motivation are then inadequate (4). Statement 1 is therefore wrong.
xhkY71XCtp0f99LAdGAz: The assignment is fixed: the vertical bar moves left and right and commands roll, and the horizontal bar moves up and down and commands pitch. Neither can ever be associated with the other channel - which is what makes the display readable without thought.
xhvw0hmdneuuWcrvwg3h: Central vision is cone vision: it resolves fine detail, colour and movement (2), and the fovea packs roughly 150,000 cones per square millimetre to achieve that resolution (4). xi4C4oPrTQhJKO1i6pBT: The reduction gear's fixed annulus tries to rotate with the torque being transmitted and is held by pistons whose oil pressure is therefore proportional to that torque. Reading that pressure gives a direct and robust measure of shaft power, which is why turboprops are set on torque.
xkAQ0XCfq5m90oCq3Ohx: Around 99% of atmospheric water vapour is in the troposphere, and most of that in its lowest few kilometres. The source is evaporation from the surface, and the temperature falls rapidly with height so the air's capacity to hold vapour drops away sharply. The tropopause then acts as a lid on vertical moisture transport, which is why the stratosphere is extremely dry and cloud-free.
xkN6TY3QkkTzkuATcByi: On a polar stereographic the meridians, which are great circles, are exactly straight, and other great circles are shallow curves whose departure from a straight line grows with distance from the pole. So the higher the latitude, the better a straight line approximates a great circle - which is what makes the projection so useful for polar navigation.
xku6YUyJ7Rj9lJzVNO1z: The extinguisher count is driven by the maximum approved number of SEATS - one for 7-30, two for 31-60, three for 61-200, then one more per hundred. It is a design figure, so it does not change with the number of passengers actually carried on the day.
xl9cpFBSKy77Ob3MNf3P: A swept wing stalls at the tips first, which moves the centre of pressure forward and produces a NOSE-UP pitching moment. If the wing's turbulent wake then blankets the horizontal tail - the classic T-tail geometry - the elevator loses effectiveness at exactly the moment it is needed to lower the nose. That combination is the deep or super stall, and it is why such designs carry stick pushers.
xlIEDggGoRoG6oiIXyzT: 100 statute miles in 20 minutes is 300 statute miles per hour, which is 300 x 0.868 = about 260 kt. 215 NM at 260 kt takes 215 / 260 = 0.83 hours = about 50 minutes. The whole question turns on converting statute miles to nautical miles before dividing.
xliWtvnnRj7Gl9bWpnMn: Evaporation requires energy to break the molecular bonds of liquid water, and that latent heat is taken FROM the surroundings - which is why evaporation cools. The vapour added also raises the relative humidity, since the amount present increases while the saturation capacity (fixed by temperature) does not. The heat is given back later, when the vapour condenses, and that release is what powers thunderstorms.
xloCa0xEeOvKRbpqwDyJ: NAV is the normal operating position, in which the system computes position, ground speed, track, heading and attitude. ATT is the reversion: if the navigation solution is lost, the unit still provides attitude and heading, which is what keeps the aeroplane flyable.
xlv52SxUF4nIKmhoM5dU: With 330 selected against the 120 radial the difference is 150 degrees, well over 90, so the flag reads TO: the selected course would be flown inbound on the 150 radial. The aircraft is on the 120 radial, which lies to the right of that inbound course, so the course is to the left and the CDI indicates fly LEFT, fully deflected since the error is 30 degrees.
xmquChWJwnDZiRNTK7RM: Perceived brightness is a distance cue, so a light that dims because it is being attenuated by fog, dust or haze is read as a light that is receding. On approach this makes the runway appear more distant than it is and encourages the pilot to press on or to descend, which is why reduced-visibility approaches produce undershoots.
xnNxedKzPgYQl86PfW8R: ICAO Doc 4444: minimum radar separation on the same localizer course is 3 NM, plus additional wake turbulence separation as required.
xnpSHUeibxCCMwdBZ3BG: JAR-OPS 1.775 makes the oxygen reserve mandatory for a pressurised aeroplane operated above a pressure altitude of 10 000 ft, and the passenger percentages then scale with cabin altitude from that figure upward. 13 000 ft is the unpressurised threshold at which the passenger requirement becomes 100%, from a different rule.
xosjxeG50D5awRGmJsfx: Acceleration errors are greatest on easterly and westerly headings, and in the southern hemisphere they act in the opposite sense to the northern - accelerating gives an apparent turn to the south and decelerating one to the north. xpBiSTQnsLtkIWn6Xpli: The induced drag coefficient is proportional to CL SQUARED (divided by aspect ratio, with a span efficiency factor and pi as constants). The square law is why induced drag climbs so steeply at low speed and high angle of attack, and why it quadruples in a 2g turn where the lift coefficient doubles.
xplj9SmJd2CGQyh6YD04: Category IIIA requires an RVR of not less than 200 m, with a decision height below 100 ft or none at all. IIIB takes the RVR down to 75 m, IIIC removes the limitation, and 300 m belongs to Category II.
xr3hFi77jQOoT0jm7IOc: The turbine and compressor share a shaft, so the work the turbine extracts is used to drive the compressor - which raises the air's pressure and temperature before the secondary heat exchanger, and the hotter the air entering that exchanger the more heat the ram air can take out of it.
xrRPpDWGCAAP8o9W7VhT: Subsidence is slow, widespread DOWNWARD motion of air, the defining feature of a large anticyclone. The descending air is compressed and warms adiabatically, so its relative humidity falls, cloud dissolves and a subsidence inversion forms, trapping haze beneath it. Convection is localised upward motion, convergence is inflow, and advection is horizontal transport.
xsMnW0exX91GaPoRURBf: Ground temperature continues to fall all night and reaches its minimum around or just after sunrise, because the surface only stops losing more heat than it gains once the sun is properly up. That is when the air is most likely to be cooled to its dewpoint, so radiation fog typically forms or reaches its greatest density shortly after sunrise - and often thickens briefly as the first heating stirs moist air upward before finally burning off.
xsUB2v9SZcAWSgF6LgQQ: Mode 3 is altitude loss after take-off or a go-around, and its call is 'DON'T SINK'. 'SINK RATE' belongs to mode 1, excessive descent rate, and 'PULL UP' is the escalation of modes 1 and 2.
xt1YnLj10YXtSriyvrT6: A destination alternate need not be selected when the destination is isolated and no adequate alternate exists - in which case the flight carries additional fuel instead (two hours at normal cruise consumption for a turbine aeroplane). The other exemption concerns a destination with a suitable instrument approach and settled forecast weather within a defined window, not simply an ILS on every runway.
